src: 일찍이 관시노비(官寺奴婢)에 속했던 무리들이 세력가에게 투속(投屬)하여 신역(身役)을 면하고, 왕후(王侯)나 궁원(宮院)에 붙어 정치를 어지럽히고 변란을 부르는 자가 있을 것이라고 훈요(訓要)에 이름
t: It was stated in the Ten Injunctions (訓要) that those who had once belonged to government and temple slaves (官寺奴婢) would seek refuge under powerful families to escape their duties, and that there would be those who attached themselves to kings, princes, or palace residences and threw politics into disorder and invited upheaval.

src: 왕이 왕규(王規) 세력에 대항하기 위해 경화공주(慶和公主)를 자신의 이복동생인 왕소(王昭)와 결혼시킴.(경화궁부인(慶和宮夫人) 임씨)
t: To counter the faction of Wang Gyu (王規), the king had Princess Gyeonghwa (慶和公主) married to his half-brother Wang So (王昭). (Queen Gyeonghwagung, Lady Im)

src: 왕규(王規)가 반란을 일으키자 서경(西京)의 대광(大匡) 왕식렴(王式廉)이 이를 진압함
t: When Wang Gyu (王規) raised a rebellion, Wang Sik-ryeom (王式廉), Daegwang of Seogyeong (西京), suppressed it.

src: 거란족의 침입에 대비하기 위해 군사 30만을 뽑아 광군(光軍)을 편성하고 광군사(光軍司)를 설치함
t: To prepare against the invasion of the Khitan, 300,000 troops were selected to form the Gwanggun (光軍), and the Gwanggunsa (光軍司) was established.

src: 노비안검법(奴婢按檢法)을 시행함
t: The Slave Investigation Act (奴婢按檢法) was implemented.

src: 왕이 노비를 조사해 양천(良賤)을 가리게 하자 노비로서 주인을 배반하는 자가 많아 대목왕후(大穆王后) 황보씨가 간절히 이를 간함.
t: When the king investigated the slaves to distinguish commoners from the lowborn, many slaves betrayed their masters, and Queen Daemok (大穆王后), Lady Hwangbo, earnestly remonstrated against this.

src: 태조(太祖)의 제도에 의거하여 궁중의 노비의 수를 참작하여 정하고, 나머지는 모두 밖으로 나누어 보낼 것을 최승로(崔承老)가 상소함
t: Choe Seung-ro (崔承老) submitted a memorial stating that, following the system of Taejo (太祖), the number of palace slaves should be fixed with consideration, and the rest should all be sent out and distributed.

src: 양천(良賤)의 법이 오래되었으니, 천한 자가 귀한 자를 업신여기지 못하게 하고, 노비와 주인의 구분에 있어 중도(中道)를 잡아 처리할 것을 최승로(崔承老)가 상소함
t: Choe Seung-ro (崔承老) submitted a memorial stating that since the law distinguishing commoners from the lowborn had long existed, the lowborn should not be permitted to slight the noble, and that in matters concerning the distinction between slave and master, a middle path should be taken in handling them.

src: 도망한 노비를 숨겨 차지하는 자는, 1일에 생사 3척(尺)을 내는 율문(律文)에 의거하여 날마다 베 30척을 거두어 본주인에게 주되 원래 가격을 넘지 못하게 함
t: For those who concealed and kept fugitive slaves, in accordance with the statute of paying three cheok (尺) of raw silk per day, thirty cheok of cloth were to be collected daily and given to the original master, provided it did not exceed the original price.

src: 본주인을 대신하여 수로(水路)로 전쟁에 나갔거나 3년동안 묘살이를 한 자는 그 주인이 해당관청에 알리고, 공로를 심사하여 나이 40이 넘은 자는 천인을 면하게 함
t: Those who had gone to war by waterway in place of their master, or who had tended a grave for three years, had their master report the matter to the relevant office; upon review of their merit, those over the age of 40 were to be released from lowborn status.

src: 문무상참관(常參官) 이상의 부모와 처에게 작위를 주도록 명함.
t: He ordered that titles be granted to the parents and wives of civil and military officials of Sangchamgwan (常參官) rank and above.

src: 좌군과 우군의 군영(軍營)을 설치함
t: The military camps of the Left Army and Right Army were established.

src: 효자, 순손(順孫), 의부(義夫), 절부(節婦)에게 표창함.
t: Filial sons, obedient grandsons (順孫), righteous husbands (義夫), and chaste wives (節婦) were honored with commendations.

src: 과부였던 경종의 왕비 헌정왕후(憲貞王后) 황보씨가 종친인 안종(安宗)과 간통하여 아이(훗날의 현종)를 낳다가 죽음.
t: Queen Heonjeong (憲貞王后), Lady Hwangbo, the widowed consort of King Gyeongjong, committed adultery with her relative Anjong (安宗) and died giving birth to a child (the future Hyeonjong).

src: 제1차 거란 침입. 서희(徐熙)가 거란 장수 소손녕(蕭孫寧)과 담판하여 화약(和約) 체결.
t: The First Khitan invasion. Seo Hui (徐熙) negotiated with the Khitan general Xiao Sunning (蕭孫寧) and concluded a peace treaty.

src: 서희(徐熙)가 여진족을 축출하고 장흥진(長興鎭), 흥화진(興化鎭), 곽주(郭州), 구주(龜州)에 축성함.
t: Seo Hui (徐熙) expelled the Jurchen and built fortifications at Jangheungjin (長興鎭), Heunghwajin (興化鎭), Gwakju (郭州), and Guju (龜州).

src: 철전(鐵錢)인 건원중보(乾元重寶)를 사용
t: The iron coin Geonwon Jungbo (乾元重寶) was put into use.

src: 의부(義夫), 절부(節婦), 효자, 순손(順孫)에게 표창함.
t: Righteous husbands (義夫), chaste wives (節婦), filial sons, and obedient grandsons (順孫) were honored with commendations.

src: 동국통보(東國通寶), 동국중보(東國重寶) 발행국립민속박물관,
t: The Dongguk Tongbo (東國通寶) and Dongguk Jungbo (東國重寶) were issued. National Folk Museum of Korea,

src: 경주인 융대(融大)라는 자가 양민 5백여 명을 노비로 만들어 궁인 김씨 및 권세가에게 뇌물로 줌. 왕이 김씨에게 벌금을 받음.
t: A man named Yungdae (融大), a Gyeongju clerk, turned over 500 commoners into slaves and bribed palace lady Kim and powerful families with them. The king had Lady Kim pay a fine.

src: 육위(六衛)의 군영을 짓고 직원, 장수를 갖추어 두고 그 군사로 하여금 잡역을 면하게 함.
t: The camps of the Six Guards (六衛) were built, staffed with officials and commanders, and their soldiers were exempted from miscellaneous labor duties.

src: 헌애태후(獻哀太后) 황보씨(천추태후)가 김치양(金致陽)과 정을 통하고 아들을 낳아 왕의 후사로 삼고자 대량원군(大良院君)을 핍박함.
t: Queen Dowager Heonae (獻哀太后), Lady Hwangbo (Empress Cheonchu), had an affair with Kim Chi-yang (金致陽) and bore a son whom she wished to make the king's heir, pressuring Daeryangwongun (大良院君).

src: 동여진(東女眞)이 등주(登州)에 침입하여 주진(州鎭)의 부락 30여개 소를 불태움.
t: The East Jurchen invaded Deungju and burned down more than 30 villages of the provincial garrisons (州鎭).

src: 경주(慶州) 사람 융대(融大)가 신라 원성왕(元聖王)의 원손(遠孫)이라고 사칭하고, 양민 5백 여명을 노비로 삼아 궁인(宮人) 김씨(金氏) 등에게 선물로 보냄
t: Yungdae, a man from Gyeongju, falsely claimed to be a distant descendant of Silla's King Wonseong, and made more than 500 commoners into slaves, sending them as gifts to court lady Kim and others.

src: 성종의 딸 김씨를 왕비로 삼음.(원정왕후(元貞王后) 김씨)
t: Made King Seongjong's daughter Lady Kim queen. (Queen Wonjeong, Lady Kim)

src: 거란 왕이 군사 40만을 이끌고 고려 침입. 제2차 거란 침입. 강조(康兆)가 패배하고 죽임을 당함.
t: The Khitan king led 400,000 troops to invade Goryeo. The Second Khitan invasion. Gang Jo was defeated and killed.

src: 거란의 침입에 대비하여 강조(康兆)를 행영도통사(行營都統使)로 삼아 군사 30만을 거느리고 등주(登州)에 주둔하게 함.
t: In preparation for the Khitan invasion, Gang Jo was made Field Marshal (行營都統使) and stationed at Deungju with 300,000 troops.

src: 김은부 딸을 왕비로 맞음.(원성왕후(元城王后) 김씨)
t: Took Kim Eunbu's daughter as queen. (Queen Wonseong, Lady Kim)

src: 왕이 거란과의 전투에서 공을 세우고 전사한 김숙흥(金叔興)의 어미 이씨에게 매년 곡식 50석을 지급하라는 교지를 내림.
t: The king issued a decree to give 50 seok of grain annually to Lady Lee, mother of Kim Sukheung, who died in battle against the Khitan after achieving merit.

src: 거란과의 전투에서 큰 공을 세운 양규(楊規)의 처 은율군군(殷栗郡君) 홍씨에게 곡식을 주고, 매년 벼 백섬 하사를 약속함.
t: Gave grain to Lady Hong, wife of Yang Gyu who achieved great merit in battle against the Khitan and Lady of Eunyul County, and promised to grant 100 seom of rice every year.

src: 동여진이 청하현(淸河縣), 영일현(迎日縣), 장기현(長鬐縣)에 침입하여 강민첨(姜民瞻) 등이 격퇴함
t: The East Jurchen invaded Cheongha-hyeon, Yeongil-hyeon, and Janggi-hyeon, and Gang Min-cheom and others repelled them.

src: 경장태자(敬章太子)의 딸을 왕비로 삼음.(원용왕후(元容王后) 유씨)
t: Made Crown Prince Gyeongjang's daughter queen. (Queen Wonyong, Lady Yu)

src: 거란군이 통주(通州)와 흥화진(興化鎭)을 침입하여 장군 정신용(鄭神勇) 등이 격퇴함.
t: The Khitan army invaded Tongju and Heunghwa-jin, and General Jeong Sinyong and others repelled them.

src: 북산(北山)에 있는 여러 절의 승려들이 병사를 이끌고 개경으로 들어온다는 요언이 나돌아 민심이 크게 동요함
t: A rumor spread that monks from various temples on Mt. Buksan were leading soldiers into Gaegyeong, greatly unsettling public sentiment.

src: 부녀가 니승되는 것을 금지함.
t: Prohibited women from becoming Buddhist nuns.

src: 거란의 소손녕(蕭遜寧)이 군사 10만으로 고려 침입. 제3차 거란 침입. 강감찬(姜邯贊)을 상원수로, 강민첨(姜民瞻)을 부원수로 임명하여 막게 함.
t: Khitan's Xiao Xunning invaded Goryeo with 100,000 troops. The Third Khitan invasion. Gang Gam-chan was appointed Supreme Commander and Gang Min-cheom Deputy Commander to defend against it.

src: 거란을 방어하는데 전공이 있는 자 9,472명에게 품계와 직위를 더하여 줌
t: Granted rank and position to 9,472 people who achieved merit in defending against the Khitan.

src: 강감찬(姜邯贊)이 거란군을 귀주(龜州)에서 대파함. (귀주대첩)
t: Gang Gam-chan decisively defeated the Khitan army at Gwiju. (Battle of Gwiju)

src: 국자제주(國子祭主) 서눌(徐訥)의 딸을 맞아 숙비(淑妃)에 봉함.(원목왕후(元穆王后) 서씨)
t: Took the daughter of Seo Nul, Chancellor of the National Academy, and made her Consort Suk. (Queen Wonmok, Lady Seo)

src: 아들 없이 죽은 군인의 처에게 구분전(口分田)을 지급함.
t: Gave gubunjeon (口分田) land to wives of soldiers who died without sons.

src: 광주(廣州)에서 무장한 도적들이 봉기하자 용호군(龍虎軍)을 동원해 진압함
t: When armed bandits rose up in Gwangju, the Yongho-gun (Dragon-Tiger Army) was mobilized to suppress them.

src: 이가도(李可道) 등에게 명하여 개경(開京)의 나성(羅城)을 축조하게 함. 둘레 10,660보, 높이 27척
t: Ordered Lee Gado and others to construct the outer walls (羅城) of Gaegyeong. Circumference 10,660 bo, height 27 cheok.

src: 왕가도(王可道) 딸을 왕비로 삼음.(경목현비(敬穆賢妃) 왕씨)
t: Made Wang Gado's daughter queen. (Royal Consort Gyeongmok, Lady Wang)

src: 궁인 한씨, 김씨, 한씨, 서씨를 각각 상궁, 상침(尙寢), 상식(尙食), 상침(尙針)으로 삼음.
t: Made court ladies Han, Kim, Han, and Seo Sanggung, Sangchim (尙寢), Sangsik (尙食), and Sangchim (尙針) respectively.

src: 이공(李龔)이 가노(家奴)를 시켜 역마(驛馬)를 빌려 타게 하였으므로, 어사대(御史臺)에서 죄 주기를 청함
t: Because Lee Gong had his household slave borrow and ride a post horse, the Eosadae (Royal Censorate) requested that he be punished.

src: 대상(大相) 주오(主烏)가 어미를 구타했으므로 목을 베어 시체를 저자에 버림.
t: Because Daesang Juo beat his mother, he was beheaded and his body was discarded in the marketplace.

src: 혁거(革車), 수질노(繡質弩), 뇌등석포(雷騰石砲), 팔우노(八牛弩) 등 무기를 제작함
t: Manufactured weapons such as hyeokgeo (革車), sujilno (繡質弩), noedeungseokpo (雷騰石砲), and paluno (八牛弩).

src: 북쪽 국경 일대에 천리장성(千里長城) 축조를 시작함
t: Began construction of the Cheolli Jangseong (千里長城) along the northern border.

src: 서북로(西北路)의 송령(松嶺) 동쪽에 장성(長城)을 쌓음. 또 재전(梓田)에 성을 쌓아 창주(昌州)라 이름함
t: Built a great wall east of Songnyeong (松嶺) in the Seobungno (西北路) region. Also built a fortress at Jaejeon (梓田) and named it Changju (昌州).

src: 김해병서(金海兵書)를 연변의 주진(州鎭)에 각각 1부씩 내려 보냄
t: Sent one copy each of the Gimhae Byeongseo (金海兵書) to the garrison towns (州鎭) along the border.

src: 지중추원사(知中樞院事) 김원충(金元沖)의 딸을 왕비로 맞음.(용절덕비(容節德妃) 김씨)
t: Took the daughter of Kim Won-chung (金元沖), Jijungchuwonsa (知中樞院事), as queen. (Yongjeoldeokbi (容節德妃) of the Kim clan)

src: 서면병마도감사(西面兵馬都監使) 박원작(朴元綽)이 제작한 수질구궁노(繡質九弓弩)를 동서 변진(邊鎭)에 두게 함
t: Had the Sujilgugungno (繡質九弓弩) crossbows made by Park Won-jak (朴元綽), Seomyeon Byeongma Domgamsa (西面兵馬都監使), placed at the eastern and western border garrisons (邊鎭).

src: 저화(楮貨)의 유통을 위해 한시적으로 상승오포(常五升布)의 사용을 금지시킴조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: To promote the circulation of paper currency (楮貨), temporarily prohibited the use of sangseung-opo (常五升布) cloth. Sillok of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 육위군(六衛軍)의 1령(領) 마다 300명을 선발하여 선봉군으로 선발함.
t: Selected 300 men from each ryeong (領) of the Six Guards Army (六衛軍) to form a vanguard force.

src: 전정연립(田丁連立)은 적자(嫡子), 적손, 같은 어머니 자손, 첩의 자손, 딸의 자손 순서로 하게 함.
t: Ordered that jeonjeong-yeollip (田丁連立) succession follow the order of legitimate son, legitimate grandson, descendants of the same mother, descendants of concubines, and descendants of daughters.

src: 유민이 대거 발생하자 1만 3천여 호를 진주(晉州)에 정착시킴
t: When a large number of displaced people arose, settled over 13,000 households in Jinju (晉州).

src: 서경(西京)의 맹군(猛軍)과 해군(海軍) 모두 10령(領)을 선발하고 각 령 1000명마다 선봉 300명씩을 뽑아 낭장(郎將)이 지휘하게 함
t: Selected a total of 10 ryeong (領) of the Maenggun (猛軍) and Navy (海軍) of Seogyeong (西京), and from each ryeong of 1,000 men selected 300 as vanguard, to be commanded by a nangjang (郎將).

src: 6품이하 7품이상으로 자손이 없는 아내에게는 구분전 8결, 8품이하는 구분전 5결, 부부가 사망하고 딸만 있는 집에는 구분전 8결 지급을 결정.
t: Decided to grant 8 gyeol of gubunjeon (口分田) to wives without descendants of rank 6th grade and below down to 7th grade, 5 gyeol of gubunjeon to those of 8th grade and below, and 8 gyeol of gubunjeon to households where both husband and wife had died leaving only daughters.

src: 김원충(金元沖) 딸을 왕비로 삼음.(인목덕비(仁穆德妃) 김씨)
t: Took the daughter of Kim Won-chung (金元沖) as queen. (Inmokdeokbi (仁穆德妃) of the Kim clan)

src: 전국 각지에서 굶주려 유망하는 사람들이 많이 발생하자 의창(義倉)을 열어 진휼을 시행함
t: When many starving and displaced people arose throughout the country, opened the Uichang (義倉) and carried out relief.

src: 사면기광군(四面奇光軍)를 설치하여 15세 이상 60세 이하의 질병이 없는 자로 편성함.
t: Established the Samyeon Gigwanggun (四面奇光軍), organized with those aged 15 and above to 60 and below who had no illness.

src: 경창원(景昌院)에 속해 있던 전지(田地)와 시지(柴地)는 흥왕사(興王寺)에 소속시키고, 어량(魚梁) 및 배와 노비는 모두 관(官)에 되돌리게 함
t: Had the farmland (田地) and firewood land (柴地) belonging to Gyeongchang-won (景昌院) transferred to Heungwang-sa (興王寺), and had the fish weirs (魚梁), ships, and slaves all returned to the government (官).

src: 개가한 어머니의 상에 100일 상복을 입도록 정함.
t: Decreed that mourning clothes be worn for 100 days for the funeral of a remarried mother.

src: 도적이 현릉(顯陵) 묘실(廟室)에 침입하자 능실 시위대장군(陵室侍衛大將軍) 은정(殷貞)을 처벌함
t: When thieves broke into the shrine chamber (廟室) of Hyeolleung (顯陵), punished Eun Jeong (殷貞), the Neungsil Siwi Daejanggun (陵室侍衛大將軍).

src: 외관(外官)의 아내로 서울에 있는 자가 병이 들었으면 남편에게 30일 휴가를 줌.
t: When the wife of a local official (外官) residing in the capital fell ill, granted the husband 30 days of leave.

src: 주진(州鎭)에 입거한 군인에게 그 본관(本貫)의 양호(養戶) 2명씩을 지급함.
t: Granted two yangho (養戶) households from their hometown (本貫) to soldiers stationed at the garrison towns (州鎭).

src: 비주록(妃主祿)을 정함. 또 국대부인(國大夫人)과 어전 시녀(御殿侍女), 시비(侍婢)의 녹봉도 정함.
t: Set the bijurok (妃主祿) stipend. Also set the stipends for gukdaebuin (國大夫人), royal attendants (御殿侍女), and maidservants (侍婢).

src: 동번(東蕃)이 난을 일으켰으므로 보병과 기병 3만 명을 정주(定州)로 보내어 토벌함.
t: When the Dongbeon (東蕃) raised a rebellion, sent 30,000 infantry and cavalry to Jeongju (定州) to suppress them.

src: 이예(李預)의 처 왕씨 등을 왕태후 궁관으로 삼고 녹봉 줌.
t: Made Lady Wang, the wife of Yi Ye (李預), and others palace officials (宮官) of the Queen Dowager, and granted them stipends.

src: 문종비인 인예순덕태후(仁睿順德太后) 이씨가 국청사(國淸寺)를 짓기 시작함.
t: Inye Sundeok Taehu (仁睿順德太后) of the Yi clan, queen of Munjong, began construction of Gukcheong-sa (國淸寺).

src: 개가한 어머니 대상제(大喪祭) 때 외직에 있는 아들은 서울에 올라오지 못하게 함.
t: Prohibited sons serving in local offices (外職) from coming up to the capital for the daesangje (大喪祭) rite of a remarried mother.

src: 순종비 장경궁주(長慶宮主) 이씨가 순종 사후 외궁(外宮)에서 살다가 궁노와 간통해 폐위됨.
t: Jang Gyeong-gungju (長慶宮主) of the Yi clan, queen of Sunjong, lived in the oegung (外宮) after Sunjong's death, and was deposed after committing adultery with a palace slave.

src: 병거(兵車)를 제작하여 귀주(龜州)에 배치함
t: Manufactured war chariots and deployed them at Gwiju.

src: 왕이 유약하므로 선종비인 사숙태후(思肅太后)가 대리청정(代理廳政)함.
t: As the king was young and weak, Sasuk Taehu, the queen consort of King Seonjong, conducted regency government.

src: 의천(義天)이 금속화폐의 사용을 강력히 주장하여, 화폐주조 업무를 담당할 관청으로 개경 광화문 동남쪽에 고려 최초의 조폐기관인 주전도감(鑄錢都監)을 설치
t: Uicheon strongly advocated the use of metal currency, and established Jujeondogam, Goryeo's first minting institution in charge of coin-casting affairs, southeast of Gwanghwamun in Gaegyeong.

src: 김부철(金富轍) 형제 4명이 과거에 급제했으므로 어미에게 매년 쌀 40석을 내림.
t: As four brothers of Kim Bu-cheol passed the state examination, 40 seok of rice was granted to their mother every year.

src: 대각국사(大覺國師) 의천(義天)(1055-1101)이 주화 사용을 강력히 건의(의천(義天)의 주전론(鑄錢論))李碩崙,
t: Daegak-guksa Uicheon (1055-1101) strongly recommended the use of coinage (Uicheon's theory of coinage) Yi Seok-ryun,

src: 연덕궁주(延德宮主) 유씨를 왕비로 삼음.(명의태후(明毅太后) 유씨)
t: Lady Yu, Yeondeokgungju, was made queen consort. (Myeongui Taehu, Lady Yu)

src: 우리 나라의 지형을 본떠서 만든 은병(銀甁)을 발행하여 사용, 일명 활구(濶口)라고도 함
t: Issued and used silver bottles modeled after the topography of Goryeo, also called hwalgu.

src: 이경택(李景澤)의 아내 김씨(金氏)가 남편의 계모(繼母)를 죽이려고, 비(婢)를 시켜 밥에 독(毒)을 넣게 함
t: Lady Kim, wife of Yi Gyeong-taek, had a maidservant put poison in the food in order to kill her husband's stepmother.

src: 해동통보(海東通寶) 15,000관(貫)을 주조하여 관리들과 군인들에게 나누어 줌. 이어서 삼한통보(三韓通寶), 삼한중보(三韓重寶), 해동중보(海東重寶)도 발행
t: Cast 15,000 gwan of Haedong Tongbo and distributed it to officials and soldiers. Subsequently, Samhan Tongbo, Samhan Jungbo, and Haedong Jungbo were also issued.

src: 윤관(尹瓘)의 건의로 신기군(神騎軍), 신보군(神步軍), 항마군(降魔軍)으로 편성된 별무반(別武班)을 창설함.
t: On the recommendation of Yun Gwan, Byeolmuban, composed of Singigun, Sinbogun, and Hangmagun, was established.

src: 윤관(尹瓘)이 별무반(別武班)을 설립하여, 복례(僕隷)에 이르기까지 말이 있는 자는 신기(神騎), 말이 없는 자는 신보(神步) 등으로 삼음
t: Yun Gwan established Byeolmuban, and even down to servants and slaves, those who had horses were made Singi and those without horses were made Sinbo, and so on.

src: 서해도(西海道)의 유주(儒州), 안악(安岳), 장연(長淵)을 비롯하여 전국 각지에서 유민이 발생하자 감무관(監務官)을 파견하여 정착시킴
t: As displaced people arose in Yuju, Anak, and Jangyeon of Seohaedo as well as throughout the country, Gammu officials were dispatched to settle them.

src: 윤관(尹瓘)이 지휘하는 17만 여진 정벌군이 135개 촌락을 격파하고 적병 3,740명을 참살함.
t: The 170,000-strong Jurchen expedition army commanded by Yun Gwan destroyed 135 villages and killed 3,740 enemy soldiers.

src: 윤관(尹瓘)이 여진을 평정한 지역에 9개소의 성을 축성함
t: Yun Gwan built nine fortresses in the region where the Jurchens had been pacified.

src: 급사중(給事中) 이자겸(李資謙)의 딸을 왕비로 삼음.(문경태후(文敬太后) 이씨)
t: The daughter of Geupsajung Yi Ja-gyeom was made queen consort. (Mungyeong Taehu, Lady Yi)

src: 유부녀가 음란하면 자녀안(恣女案)에 기록해 바느질하는 노비로 삼게 함.
t: If a married woman was licentious, she was recorded in the Janyeoan and made a sewing slave.

src: 여진족의 간청으로 9성을 여진족에게 돌려줌
t: At the earnest request of the Jurchens, the nine fortresses were returned to the Jurchens.

src: 도적 20인이 도제고(都祭庫)에 침입하여 고직(庫直)인 낭장 동정(郞將同正) 김가숭(金可崇)을 죽이고 물건을 훔쳐감
t: Twenty bandits broke into Dojego, killed the warehouse keeper Nangjang Dongjeong Kim Ga-sung, and stole goods.

src: 도적이 상림사(上林司)에 침입하여 창고를 지키는 노비를 죽이고 물건을 훔쳐감
t: Bandits broke into Sangnimsa, killed the slave guarding the warehouse, and stole goods.

src: 장성(長城)의 높이를 3척(尺)씩 더 쌓음
t: The height of the long wall was increased by an additional 3 cheok.

src: 김한충(金漢忠)의 아내가 문종(文宗)이 총애하던 여종의 딸이어서, 달관(達官)에 올랐으나 대성(臺省)에는 들어가지 못하고 죽음
t: Since Kim Han-chung's wife was the daughter of a maidservant favored by King Munjong, he rose to a high office but died without entering Daeseong.

src: 진한공(辰韓公)의 장녀를 귀비(貴妃)에, 최용의 계녀를 숙비(淑妃)에 봉함.
t: The eldest daughter of Jinhangong was invested as Gwibi, and Choe Yong's adopted daughter was invested as Sukbi.

src: 관리들이 민간의 어린아이를 뽑아 강물에 던진다는 요언이 나돌아 민심이 놀라고 동요하여 산속에 도망가 숨는 자들이 많았는데 서해도(西海道)가 가장 심함
t: A rumor spread that officials were selecting children from among the people and throwing them into the river, causing public unrest and agitation, and many fled to hide in the mountains, with Seohaedo being the worst affected.

src: 이자겸(李資겸)의 제3녀를 왕비로 들임.(폐비 이씨)
t: The third daughter of Yi Ja-gyeom was made queen consort. (Deposed Queen, Lady Yi)

src: 이자겸(李資謙)의 제4녀를 왕비로 들임.(폐비 이씨)
t: The fourth daughter of Yi Ja-gyeom was made queen consort. (Deposed Queen, Lady Yi)

src: 왕이 이자겸(李資謙)의 딸인 이씨 왕비 둘을 폐하고 전중내급사(殿中內給事) 임원후(任元厚)의 딸을 왕비로 삼음.(공예태후(恭睿太后) 임씨)
t: The king deposed both Queens of the Yi clan, daughters of Yi Jagyeom, and made the daughter of Im Wonhu, Vice Director of the Palace Provisions (殿中內給事), his queen. (Queen Gongye of the Im clan)

src: 이자겸(李資謙)과 그의 아들들이 복례(僕隷)를 풀어 다른 사람의 수레와 말을 빼앗아서 자기 물건을 실어들임
t: Yi Jagyeom and his sons released their servants to seize other people's carts and horses to carry off their own goods.

src: 산정도감판관(刪定都監判官) 김선(金璿)의 딸을 차비(次妃)로 삼음.(선평왕후(宣平王后) 김씨)
t: The daughter of Kim Seon, Judge of the Directorate for Revision (刪定都監判官), was made secondary queen. (Queen Seonpyeong of the Kim clan)

src: 이자겸(李資謙)의 일족(一族)이 빼앗은 다른 사람의 토전(土田)과 장획(臧獲)을 모두 본주인에게 돌려줌
t: All the land and slaves that the clan of Yi Jagyeom had seized from others were returned to their original owners.

src: 남해 지방민들이 바다에서 봉기하자 어사 중승(御史中丞) 정응문(鄭應文)을 선무사(宣撫使)로 파견해 효유함
t: When the people of the Namhae region rose up at sea, Vice Censor-in-Chief (御史中丞) Jeong Eungmun was dispatched as Pacification Commissioner (宣撫使) to admonish them.

src: 거제도 연해의 명진현(溟珍縣), 송변현(松邊縣), 아주현(鵝洲縣)에서 봉기에 가담한 8백 20명이 사로잡히자 합주(陜州)삼기현(三岐縣)과 진주(晉州)의령현(宜寧縣)에 귀원장(歸原場), 취안장(就安場), 화순장(和順場
t: When 820 people who had joined the uprising in Myeongjin-hyeon, Songbyeon-hyeon, and Aju-hyeon along the coast of Geojedo were captured, Gwiwonjang, Chwianjang, and Hwasunjang were [established] in Samgi-hyeon of Hapju and Uiryeong-hyeon of Jinju

src: 노예(奴隷)가 혁대를 하는 것을 금지함
t: Slaves were forbidden to wear leather belts.

src: 묘청(妙淸) 등이 서경(西京)에서 난을 일으켜 대위국(大爲國)을 건립하자 서북 지방의 농민들이 호응하여 봉기함(묘청의 난)
t: When Myocheong and others raised a rebellion in Seogyeong and established the state of Daewi, farmers of the northwestern region responded and rose up. (Myocheong's Rebellion)

src: 묘청(妙淸) 등이 서경(西京)에서 반란을 일으킴. 국호를 대위(大爲), 연호를 천개(天開)로 정함 김부식(金富軾)을 원수로 삼아 토벌하게 함. (묘청의 난)
t: Myocheong and others raised a rebellion in Seogyeong. They set the state name as Daewi and the era name as Cheongae. Kim Busik was made commander-in-chief to suppress them. (Myocheong's Rebellion)

src: 도적이 원릉(元陵)에 침입하여 제기(祭器)를 훔치고 능지기 3인을 살해함
t: Bandits broke into Wolleung and stole ritual vessels, killing three tomb keepers.

src: 김부식(金富軾)을 중심으로 한 관군의 공격과 내부 이반으로 서경(西京)이 함락되어 묘청(妙淸)의 난 끝남
t: Seogyeong fell due to the attack of the government forces led by Kim Busik and internal defection, ending Myocheong's Rebellion.

src: 사도(司徒) 온(溫)의 딸을 태자비로 삼음.(장경왕후(莊敬王后) 김씨)
t: The daughter of Sado On was made Crown Princess. (Queen Janggyeong of the Kim clan)

src: 외삼촌의 첩(妾)의 토지와 집과 장획(臧獲)을 빼앗아, 그 모자(母子)로 하여금 추위와 배고픔에 떨게 한 박정유(朴挺蕤)가 죽음
t: Bak Jeongyu, who had seized the land, house, and slaves of his maternal uncle's concubine, causing the mother and son to suffer from cold and hunger, died.

src: 남경(南京)에 행차한 왕이 남경(南京)의 관노(官奴)인 백선연(白善淵)을 보고 좋아하여 양자로 삼음
t: The king, having traveled to Namgyeong, saw Baek Seonyeon, a government slave of Namgyeong, took a liking to him, and adopted him as his son.

src: 고봉어(故奉御) 최단(崔端)의 딸을 왕비로 맞음.(장선왕후(莊宣王后) 최씨)
t: The daughter of the late Bongeo (奉御) Choe Dan was received as queen. (Queen Jangseon of the Choe clan)

src: 군제를 개편하여 5군을 3군으로 고침.
t: The military system was reorganized, changing the Five Armies into Three Armies.

src: 서북면병마사 조진약(曹晋若)이 봉수식(烽燧式)을 정함.
t: Jo Jinyak, Military Commissioner of the Northwestern Region, established the beacon fire system.

src: 형제 3명이 등과하면 아버지에게 벼슬 주고 어머니에게는 쌀 20석을 하사하기로 함.
t: It was decided that if three brothers passed the state examination, the father would be granted an official post and the mother would be given 20 seok of rice.

src: 아들 셋이 전쟁에 나가 공세우면 아들 셋 등과의 예에 따라 부모에게 봉증하고 쌀을 하사하기로 함.
t: It was decided that if three sons went to war and achieved merit, the parents would be honored and given rice in accordance with the precedent for three sons passing the examination.

src: 경시안(京市案)에 오른 실행녀가 낳은 자식은 실행 전 소생은 6품까지, 실행 뒤 소생은 관직에 나갈 수 없게 함.
t: For children born to a woman of misconduct registered in the Capital Market Register, those born before the misconduct could rise up to the sixth rank, while those born after the misconduct could not enter government service.

src: 형제가 과거에 수석하면 3자등과에 준해 어미에게 곡식 30석을 줌.
t: If brothers ranked first in the state examination, the mother would be given 30 seok of grain in accordance with the precedent for three sons passing the examination.

src: 정함(鄭諴)이 이 시기부터 조정 반열에 참여하여, 관노(官奴) 왕광취(王光就)와 백자단(白子端)을 끌어들여 같은 편을 삼음
t: From this time, Jeong Ham participated in the ranks of the court, and drew in the government slaves Wang Gwangchwi and Baek Jadan to make them his allies.

src: 개경에서 폭동이 일어나 30여명이 영평문(永平門)을 파괴함
t: A riot broke out in Gaegyeong, and more than 30 people destroyed Yeongpyeong Gate.

src: 관비(官婢) 선화(善花)가 임산부와 곡식을 가지고 다투다 죽이니, 자연도(紫燕島)로 귀양보냄
t: The government slave Seonhwa, having quarreled with a pregnant woman over grain and killed her, was exiled to Jayeondo.

src: 이천(伊川), 안협(安峽), 동주(東州), 평강(平康), 영풍(永豊), 의주(宜州), 곡주(谷州) 등지에서 농민들이 봉기하자 병부낭중 김장(金莊) 등을 파견하여 평정함
t: When farmers rose up in Icheon, Anhyeop, Dongju, Pyeonggang, Yeongpung, Uiju, and Gokju, Kim Jang, Vice Director of the Ministry of War, and others were dispatched to suppress them.

src: 도적이 대묘(大廟)에 침입하여 제기(祭器)를 훔쳐감
t: Thieves broke into the Grand Shrine and stole ritual vessels.

src: 역졸의 아내가 머리를 잘라 팔아 남편의 음식 마련해 옴.
t: The wife of a postal station servant cut and sold her hair to provide food for her husband.

src: 적(賊)을 고하는 자는 공사천례(公私賤隷)에게도 관직에의 참여를 허락할 것을 고함
t: It was decreed that those who reported bandits, even public and private slaves, would be permitted to hold office.

src: 강양백(江陽伯) 감의 딸을 맞아 태자비로 삼음.
t: The daughter of Gam, Prince of Gangyang, was taken as the Crown Princess.

src: 탐라(耽羅)에서 관리들의 수탈로 인해 양수(良守) 등이 봉기하자 조동희(趙冬曦)를 순무사(巡撫使)로 파견하여 평정함
t: When Yangsu and others rose up in Tamna due to exploitation by officials, Jo Donghui was dispatched as Pacification Commissioner and suppressed them.

src: 김칭(金稱)의 처가 남편과 함께 천신사(天神寺)에 별전을 창건해 대장경 5천여 권을 만들어 봉안하고 미곡을 희사함.남원군부인 양씨묘지 대방광불화엄경 권34(박상국, 1990,
t: The wife of Gim Ching, together with her husband, built a separate hall at Cheonsinsa Temple, produced and enshrined over 5,000 volumes of the Tripitaka, and donated grain. (Namwongun Buin Yangssi Myoji, Daebanggwangbul Hwaeomgyeong, gwon 34 (Park Sang-guk, 1990,

src: 창주(昌州), 성주(成州), 철주(鐵州) 등 서북면에서 농민 봉기가 발생하여 창주에서는 수령의 애기(愛妓)를 죽여 관아에 버려두고, 철주에서는 수령을 죽이려 모의하다 실패함
t: Peasant uprisings occurred in the northwestern region, including Changju, Seongju, and Cheolju; in Changju, the magistrate's beloved gisaeng was killed and left at the government office, while in Cheolju, a plot to kill the magistrate failed.

src: 이의방(李義方)의 딸을 태자비로 삼음.(사평왕후(思平王后) 이씨)
t: The daughter of Yi Uibang was taken as the Crown Princess.(Queen Sapyeong, of the Yi clan)

src: 조위총(趙位寵)이 서경(西京)에서 반란을 일으켜 절령(岊嶺) 이북 40여 성이 호응함
t: Jo Wichong raised a rebellion in Seogyeong, and more than 40 castles north of Jeollyeong responded in support.

src: 서경(西京) 유수(西京留守) 조위총(趙位寵)이 정중부(鄭仲夫), 이의방(李義方)을 치려고 난을 일으키자 이에 호응해서 서북 지방의 40여 성에서 봉기하고 이후 전국적으로 농민 봉기가 확산됨(서북농민봉기)
t: When Jo Wichong, the Governor of Seogyeong, raised a rebellion to attack Jeong Jungbu and Yi Uibang, more than 40 castles in the northwestern region rose up in response, and peasant uprisings subsequently spread nationwide (the Northwestern Peasant Uprising).

src: 신안백(信安伯) 성(宬)의 딸의 태자비로 삼음.(원덕왕후(元德王后) 왕씨)
t: The daughter of Seong, Prince of Sinan, was taken as the Crown Princess.(Queen Wondeok, of the Wang clan)

src: 승선 송지인(宋智仁) 진사 진공서(秦公緖) 등이 남도의 농민 봉기군 석령사(石令史)와 연결하여 정변을 계획한다는 혐의로 처벌됨
t: Royal Secretary Song Jiin, Licentiate Jin Gongseo, and others were punished on charges of plotting a coup in connection with Seok Ryeongsa, a leader of a peasant uprising force in the southern provinces.

src: 남적(南賊)과의 싸움에서 관군이 불리하자 승병(僧兵)을 모집함
t: When the government army was at a disadvantage in fighting against the southern bandits, monk soldiers were recruited.

src: 대장군 정황재(丁黃載), 장군 장박인(張博仁)에게 장사(壯士) 3천을 주어 남적(南賊)의 봉기를 평정하게 함
t: Grand General Jeong Hwangjae and General Jang Bagin were given 3,000 strongmen to suppress the uprising of the southern bandits.

src: 공주 명학소(鳴鶴所)의 천민 망이(亡伊), 망소이(亡所伊) 등이 봉기하여 공주를 함락시킴(망이와 망소이의 난)
t: The lowborn Mangi, Mangsoi, and others of Myeonghakso in Gongju rose up and captured Gongju (the Rebellion of Mangi and Mangsoi).

src: 남부 지방 곳곳에서 남적(南賊)으로 불린 농민들이 봉기하자 조정에서 채원부(蔡元富), 박강수(朴剛壽) 등을 파견해 효유하였으나 물러가지 않음
t: When peasants called the southern bandits rose up throughout the southern region, the court dispatched Chae Wonbu, Bak Gangsu, and others to persuade them to disperse, but they did not withdraw.

src: 장군(將軍) 박순(朴純)과 형부 낭중(刑部郞中) 박인택(朴仁澤)을 보내 남적(南賊)을 회유하였으나 응하지 않고 예산을 함락하여 감무(監務)를 죽임
t: General Bak Sun and Director of the Ministry of Punishments Bak Intaek were sent to appease the southern bandits, but they did not comply, and captured Yesan, killing the magistrate.

src: 대장군 정세유(鄭世猷)와 이부(李夫)를 처치 병마사(處置兵馬使)로 삼아 좌, 우도로 나누어서 남적(南賊)을 치게 하는 등 남부 지방민의 봉기를 평정하기 위해 대규모로 관군을 파병함
t: Grand General Jeong Seyu and Yi Bu were appointed as Military Commissioners for Suppression, dividing the left and right routes to attack the southern bandits, and a large-scale government army was dispatched to suppress the uprisings of the southern populace.

src: 서북 봉기군의 김단(金旦)이 항복을 요청함
t: Gim Dan of the northwestern uprising forces requested surrender.

src: 서북 지방의 봉기군이 금(金)의 사신 영접 행차를 공격함
t: The uprising forces of the northwestern region attacked the procession welcoming envoys from Jin.

src: 상장군(上將軍) 이의민(李義旼)이 서북의 봉기군을 공격함
t: Senior General Yi Uimin attacked the northwestern uprising forces.

src: 서북의 봉기군 강축(康畜)이 10월에 항복하고, 11월에는 조충(曹忠)이 항복함
t: Gang Chuk of the northwestern uprising forces surrendered in the 10th month, and Jo Chung surrendered in the 11th month.

src: 의주(義州), 정주(靜州)에서 농민 봉기가 발생하고 남적(南賊)은 청주목 내의 고을 대부분을 점령함
t: Peasant uprisings occurred in Uiju and Jeongju, and the southern bandits occupied most of the towns within Cheongju-mok.

src: 남적(南賊)의 일부가 황려현(黃驪縣)과 진주(鎭州)를 공격하고 서해도(西海道)에서도 농민 봉기가 발생함
t: Some of the southern bandits attacked Hwangnyeo-hyeon and Jinju, and peasant uprisings also occurred in Seohae-do.

src: 서북의 봉기군이 다시 곡주(谷州)와 수안(遂安)을 공격하여 함락시킴
t: The northwestern uprising forces again attacked and captured Gokju and Suan.

src: 서북면 병마사(西北面兵馬使) 박제검(朴齊儉)이 서북의 봉기군을 평정함
t: Northwestern Region Military Commissioner (西北面兵馬使) Bak Je-geom (朴齊儉) suppressed the uprising army in the northwest

src: 서북로 병마사(西北路兵馬使) 이의민(李義旼)이 서북 지방의 봉기군 3백여명을 처단함
t: Northwestern Road Military Commissioner (西北路兵馬使) Yi Ui-min (李義旼) executed over 300 members of the uprising army in the northwestern region

src: 새로 부임하는 서경 유수 판관(西京留守判官) 박인택(朴仁澤)이 봉기군의 잔여 세력에 의해 살해됨
t: The newly appointed Western Capital Deputy Governor (西京留守判官) Bak In-taek (朴仁澤) was killed by remaining forces of the uprising army

src: 금나라에 사신으로 가는 최정(崔貞)에게 송유인(宋有仁)이 자기 노(奴) 1명을 데리고 가라고 부탁하였으나 인원수가 차니, 그 노가 주인의 세력을 믿고 따라갔다가 금나라에서 체포됨
t: Song Yu-in (宋有仁) asked Choe Jeong (崔貞), who was going as an envoy to the Jin dynasty, to take along one of his slaves, but since the number of people was already full, the slave relied on his master's power and went along, and was captured in the Jin dynasty

src: 서북 지방에서 농민 봉기가 다시 발생함
t: Farmer uprisings occurred again in the northwestern region

src: 서북면 지병마사(西北面知兵馬事) 이부(李富)가 서북 봉기군을 유인하여 구주(龜州), 가주(嘉州) 등지에서 크게 물리침
t: Northwestern Region Deputy Military Commissioner (西北面知兵馬事) Yi Bu (李富) lured the northwestern uprising army and dealt them a great defeat at places such as Guju (龜州) and Gaju (嘉州)

src: 이부(李富)의 생질(甥姪)과 권력자들의 자제들이 부녀자를 희롱하는 것을, 정국검(鄭國儉) 등이 가동(家僮)을 거느리고 잡음
t: When the nephew of Yi Bu (李富) and the sons of powerful men were harassing women, Jeong Guk-geom (鄭國儉) and others led their household servants and caught them

src: 개경(開京)에서 도적 무리가 일어나 대창(大倉)의 양곡과 봉은사(奉恩寺)의 은병(銀甁) 30여개를 약탈함
t: A band of thieves rose up in Gaegyeong (開京) and plundered grain from the Great Granary (大倉) and over 30 silver bottles (銀甁) from Bongeunsa (奉恩寺)

src: 조정에서 은자장경(銀字藏經)을 필사(筆寫)하려고 많은 재물을 모아두자 폭동이 발생하여 사경원(寫經院)에 불을 지름
t: When the court gathered much wealth to hand-copy the Silver-lettered Buddhist Canon (銀字藏經), a riot broke out and set fire to the Sutra Copying Institute (寫經院)

src: 전주(全州)의 기두(旗頭) 죽동(竹同) 등 6명이 관노(官奴) 등을 불러모아 난(亂)을 일으킴(죽동(竹同)의 난)
t: Jukdong (竹同) and five others, banner leaders (旗頭) of Jeonju (全州), gathered government slaves and others and rose in rebellion (Jukdong's Rebellion)

src: 관성(管城)과 부성(富城)에서 현령의 수탈에 맞서 이민(吏民)들이 봉기하여 현령을 유폐(幽閉)시키자 조정에서 주모자와 현령을 동시에 처벌함(관성과 부성의 농민봉기)
t: In Gwanseong (管城) and Buseong (富城), the clerks and people (吏民) rose up against the county magistrate's exploitation and confined the magistrate, whereupon the court punished both the ringleaders and the magistrate at the same time (Peasant Uprising of Gwanseong and Buseong)

src: 왕공(王珙)은 물건을 살 때 가노(家奴)를 보내어 빼앗고 물건 값을 주지 않았는데, 조원정(曹元正)의 가노(家奴)가 죽은 꿩 두마리를 사는 것을 왕공의 노(奴)가 빼앗아감
t: Wang Gong (王珙), when buying goods, would send his household slave to seize them without paying, and when Jo Won-jeong's (曹元正) household slave bought two dead pheasants, Wang Gong's slave seized them

src: 전주 사록(全州司錄) 진대유(陳大有)와 상호장(上戶長) 이택민(李澤民)이 관선(官船) 제조의 역을 가혹하게 하자 기두(旗頭), 죽동(竹同) 등이 관노와 농민을 이끌고 봉기하여 진대유를 축출하고 이택민 등의 집을 불태
t: When Jeonju Recorder (全州司錄) Jin Dae-yu (陳大有) and Senior District Chief (上戶長) Yi Taek-min (李澤民) imposed harsh labor for the construction of government ships, the banner leader (旗頭) Jukdong (竹同) and others led government slaves and farmers to rise up, drove out Jin Dae-yu, and burned down the houses of Yi Taek-min and others

src: 국가에서 흰 개 기르는 것을 금하는데, 따르지 않는 자는 주벌(誅罰)한다는 요언이 떠돌아 민심이 동요하고 흰 개를 죽이거나 물들이는 일이 늘어나자 이를 중지시킴
t: A rumor spread that the state prohibited the keeping of white dogs and that those who did not comply would be punished by death, causing public unrest and an increase in the killing or dyeing of white dogs, which was then stopped

src: 강남(江南)의 여자로 예쁘고 남편 없는 자는 죽임을 당한다는 요언이 나돌아 민심이 동요함
t: A rumor spread that women of Gangnam (江南) who were beautiful and without husbands would be killed, causing public unrest

src: 진주(晉州)와 안동에서 수령의 수탈을 견디지 못한 농민들이 봉기하려 하자 조정에서 수령을 장죄(贓罪)로 다스려 귀양보내자 그대로 가라앉음(진주와 안동의 농민봉기)
t: In Jinju (晉州) and Andong, when farmers who could not endure the exploitation of the magistrates were about to rise up, the court punished the magistrates for corruption (贓罪) and exiled them, and the unrest subsided (Peasant Uprising of Jinju and Andong)

src: 서북면 순주(順州)의 귀화소(歸化所)에 안치된 농민 수백 명이 폭동을 일으키자 군사를 동원해 체포함(순주 귀화소의 봉기)
t: Several hundred farmers settled at the Surrender Bureau (歸化所) of Sunju (順州) in the Northwestern Region rose in riot, and troops were mobilized to arrest them (Uprising at the Sunju Surrender Bureau)

src: 견주(見州)에 사는 김영관(金永寬)의 가노(家奴) 평량(平亮)이 농사를 지어 재산을 모아, 권세가에게 뇌물을 주어 천인을 면하고 양인(良人)이 되었으며, 산원동정(散員同正)의 벼슬을 함
t: Pyeongnyang (平亮), household slave of Kim Yeong-gwan (金永寬) who lived in Gyeonju (見州), farmed and accumulated wealth, bribed powerful men to be freed from slave status and become a commoner (良人), and held the office of Deputy Guard Officer (散員同正)

src: 죽은 재상 최충렬(崔忠烈)의 처가 쌀 백섬을 나라에 바침.
t: The wife of the late minister Choe Chung-ryeol (崔忠烈) offered one hundred sacks of rice to the state.

src: 동경(東京)에서 농민들이 봉기하자 안찰 부사(按察副使) 주유저(周惟氐)가 군사를 거느리고 공격하여 많은 사람들이 살상됨(동경농민봉기)
t: When farmers rose up in Donggyeong (東京), Deputy Inspector (按察副使) Ju Yu-jeo (周惟氐) led troops to attack them, and many people were killed and wounded (Peasant Uprising of Donggyeong)

src: 최지의(崔祗義) 형제 넷이 과거에 급제했으므로 어미에게 상을 더해줌.
t: Since all four brothers of Choe Ji-ui (崔祗義) passed the state examination, a reward was given to their mother.

src: 경상도 봉기군 주도자의 한 사람인 득보(得甫)가 궐문에 와 항복하자 토벌군의 일원으로서 봉기를 진압하게 함
t: Deukbo (得甫), one of the leaders of the Gyeongsang-do uprising army, came to the palace gate and surrendered, and was made to join the suppression forces to put down the uprising

src: 상장군 최인(崔仁)을 남로착적 병마사(南路捉賊兵馬使), 대장군 고용지(高湧之)를 도지병마사(都知兵馬使)로 삼아 경상도 봉기군을 공격함
t: Senior General Choe In (崔仁) was made Southern Road Bandit-Catching Military Commissioner (南路捉賊兵馬使), and Great General Go Yong-ji (高湧之) was made Chief Military Commissioner (都知兵馬使), to attack the Gyeongsang-do uprising army

src: 경상도 운문(雲門)의 김사미(金沙彌)와 초전(草田)의 효심(孝心)이 주동이 되어 남부 지방에서 대규모의 봉기를 일으킴(김사미와 효심의 봉기)
t: Kim Sa-mi (金沙彌) of Unmun (雲門) and Hyosim (孝心) of Chojeon (草田) in Gyeongsang-do led a large-scale uprising in the southern region (Uprising of Kim Sa-mi and Hyosim)

src: 김사미(金沙彌)와 효심(孝心) 등의 봉기를 진압하기 위해 대장군 김존걸(金存傑)이 장군 이지순(李至純) 등을 이끌고 출정하였으나 이지순은 적과 내통하고 김존걸은 자살함
t: To suppress the uprising of Kim Sa-mi (金沙彌) and Hyosim (孝心), Great General Kim Jon-geol (金存傑) set out with General Yi Ji-sun (李至純) and others, but Yi Ji-sun secretly colluded with the enemy and Kim Jon-geol killed himself

src: 남로 병마사가 경상도 봉기군의 주도자 효심(孝心)을 사로잡고 군대를 철수함
t: The Military Commissioner of the Southern Route captured Hyosim (孝心), the leader of the Gyeongsang Province uprising forces, and withdrew the troops.

src: 남로 병마사(南路兵馬使)의 관군과 경상도 봉기군이 밀성(密城)에서 접전하여 봉기군 7천여 명이 참살됨
t: The government troops of the Military Commissioner of the Southern Route (南路兵馬使) clashed with the Gyeongsang Province uprising forces at Miseong (密城), and over 7,000 of the uprising forces were massacred.

src: 경상도 봉기군이 이순(李純) 등 4인을 보내어 항복을 청하자 그들을 대정(隊正)에 임명하고 베를 주어 돌려보냄
t: When the Gyeongsang Province uprising forces sent four people including Yi Sun (李純) to request surrender, they were appointed as Squad Leaders (隊正) and given cloth before being sent back.

src: 남로 병마사가 경상도 봉기군의 처(妻)등 3백 5십여 명을 잡아 얼굴에 형벌을 가하고 서해도(西海道)에 분배하여 여러 성(城)의 노비로 삼음
t: The Military Commissioner of the Southern Route captured over 350 people including the wives of the Gyeongsang Province uprising forces, branded their faces as punishment, and distributed them to Seohae Province (西海道) to become slaves of various castles.

src: 경상도 봉기군의 주도자 김사미(金思彌)가 항복을 청하였으나 참살(斬殺)되고 토벌군 장군 사량주(史良柱)가 전사함. 이때 명주(溟州)에서 농민군 봉기하여 관군을 격파함
t: Kim Sami (金思彌), the leader of the Gyeongsang Province uprising forces, requested surrender but was executed (斬殺), and General Sa Ryangju (史良柱) of the suppression forces died in battle. At this time, peasant forces rose up in Myeongju (溟州) and defeated the government troops.

src: 태자가 사랑하던 비(婢)와 관계를 맺은 최비(崔斐)의 죄를 이 때 들추어 내어 귀양보냄
t: At this time, the crime of Choe Bi (崔斐), who had relations with a maidservant (婢) beloved by the crown prince, was exposed, and he was exiled.

src: 세가(勢家)의 가노(家奴) 등이 전조(田租)를 반복해서 거두어 백성들이 모두 근심하고 있다고 최충헌(崔忠獻) 형제가 봉사(奉事)를 올림
t: Choe Chungheon (崔忠獻) and his brother submitted a memorial (奉事) stating that the household slaves (家奴) of powerful families (勢家) were repeatedly collecting land tax (田租), causing all the people to worry.

src: 사동(私僮) 만적(萬積)의 난이 일어남
t: The rebellion of Manjeok (萬積), a private slave (私僮), broke out.

src: 동경(東京)의 봉기 주도자 김순(金順)과 울진의 봉기 주도자 금초(今草) 등을 효유하여 항복시키고 주식과 의복을 주어 돌려보냄
t: Kim Sun (金順), the leader of the Donggyeong (東京) uprising, and Geumcho (今草), the leader of the Uljin uprising, were persuaded and made to surrender, and given food, drink, and clothing before being sent back.

src: 명주(溟州)에서 농민들 봉기하여 삼척현(三陟縣), 울진현(蔚珍縣)을 함락시키고 동경(東京)에서도 봉기가 발생해 명주의 봉기군과 합세하여 주군을 장악하자 낭장(郞將) 오응부(吳應夫) 등을 보내 효유함
t: Peasants rose up in Myeongju (溟州) and captured Samcheok County (三陟縣) and Uljin County (蔚珍縣); an uprising also occurred in Donggyeong (東京), and when it joined forces with the Myeongju uprising forces and seized control of the province, Nangjang (郞將) O Eungbu (吳應夫) and others were sent to persuade them.

src: 진주(晋州) 공사노예(公私奴隷)의 난이 일어남
t: The rebellion of public and private slaves (公私奴隷) of Jinju (晋州) broke out.

src: 진주리(晉州吏) 정방의(鄭方義)가 봉기하자 소부감(小府監) 조통(趙通)을 보내 효유함
t: When Jeong Bang-ui (鄭方義), a clerk of Jinju (晉州吏), rose up, Sobugam (小府監) Jo Tong (趙通) was sent to persuade him.

src: 밀성(密城)의 관노 50여 명이 관의 기물을 훔쳐 운문(雲門)에서 일어난 봉기군으로 들어감(밀성관노 투속사건)
t: Over 50 government slaves of Miseong (密城) stole government property and joined the uprising forces that had risen in Unmun (雲門) (the incident of the government slaves of Miseong defecting).

src: 밀성(密城)의 관노(官奴) 50여 명이 은그릇을 훔쳐 운문(雲門)의 적(賊)에게 달아남
t: Over 50 government slaves (官奴) of Miseong (密城) stole silver vessels and fled to the rebels (賊) of Unmun (雲門).

src: 금주(金州)의 잡족인(雜族人)들이 봉기하여 호족(豪族)의 사람들을 살해하자 부사(副使) 이적유(李迪儒)가 이들을 유인해 모두 처단함
t: When the mixed-clan people (雜族人) of Geumju (金州) rose up and killed people of powerful clans (豪族), Deputy Commissioner (副使) Yi Jeogyu (李迪儒) lured them out and executed them all.

src: 13세기. 설신(薛愼)의 어머니 조씨가 네 배에 여덟명의 아들을 낳고 그 중 세명이 과거에 급제했으므로 국대부인(國大夫人)에 봉해짐.
t: 13th century. Lady Jo, the mother of Seol Sin (薛愼), gave birth to eight sons in four pregnancies, and since three of them passed the state examination, she was granted the title Gukdaebuin (國大夫人).

src: 진주(晉州)에서 봉기한 정방의(鄭方義)가 죽자 그의 아우 정창대(鄭昌大)가 2백여 명을 이끌고 계속 저항하였으나 모두 평정됨
t: When Jeong Bang-ui (鄭方義), who had risen up in Jinju (晉州), died, his younger brother Jeong Changdae (鄭昌大) led over 200 people and continued to resist, but they were all suppressed.

src: 경주에서 농민들이 봉기하자 이부낭중(吏部郎中) 송효성(宋孝成)과 형부원외랑(刑部員外郞) 박인석(朴仁碩)을 보내 선유함
t: When peasants rose up in Gyeongju, Ibu Nangjung (吏部郎中) Song Hyoseong (宋孝成) and Hyeongbu Wonoerang (刑部員外郞) Park Inseok (朴仁碩) were sent to pacify them.

src: 탐라(耽羅)에서 봉기가 발생하자 소부 소감(少府少監) 장윤문(張允文)과 중랑장(中郞將) 이당적(李唐績)을 보내 효유함(탐라농민봉기)
t: When an uprising occurred in Tamna (耽羅), Sobu Sogam (少府少監) Jang Yunmun (張允文) and Jungnangjang (中郞將) Yi Dangjeok (李唐績) were sent to persuade them (the Tamna peasant uprising).

src: 경주에서 별초군(別抄軍)이 폭동을 일으켜 운문(雲門)의 봉기군과 부인사(符仁寺), 동화사(桐華寺)의 승도(僧徒)를 함께 이끌고 영주(永州)를 공격하다 패주함(경주 별초군의 봉기)
t: In Gyeongju, the Byeolcho troops (別抄軍) rioted and, together with the uprising forces of Unmun (雲門) and the monks (僧徒) of Buinsa (符仁寺) and Donghwasa (桐華寺), attacked Yeongju (永州) but were defeated and fled (the uprising of the Gyeongju Byeolcho troops).

src: 탐라(耽羅)의 봉기가 평정되고 주도자 번석(煩石), 번수(煩守) 등은 처형당함. 경주, 운문(雲門), 울진이 연합한 대규모 봉기가 발생하여 주군을 장악하자 대장군 김척후(金陟候) 등을 보내 토벌함
t: The uprising in Tamna (耽羅) was suppressed, and its leaders Beonseok (煩石) and Beonsu (煩守) were executed. When a large-scale uprising formed by the union of Gyeongju, Unmun (雲門), and Uljin occurred and seized control of the province, Great General Kim Cheokhu (金陟候) and others were sent to suppress it.

src: 흥국사(興國寺)를 보수할 때 노관(盧琯)의 처가 백은(白銀) 10근을 시주함.김포군정씨부인묘지
t: When Heungguksa (興國寺) was being repaired, the wife of No Gwan (盧琯) donated 10 geun of white silver (白銀). (Epitaph of Lady Jeong of Gimpo County)

src: 태백산 봉기군의 주모자 아지(阿之)가 사로잡혀 옥사함
t: Aji (阿之), the leader of the Taebaeksan uprising forces, was captured and died in prison.

src: 경주 농민 봉기군의 주도자 도령(都領) 이비(利備) 부자(父子)가 사로잡힘
t: Doryeong (都領) Yi Bi (利備) and his son, the leaders of the Gyeongju peasant uprising forces, were captured.

src: 운문산(雲門山) 봉기군의 주도자 패좌(悖佐)가 대정(隊正) 함연수(咸延壽)에게 잡혀 죽고 봉기는 평정됨
t: Paejwa (悖佐), the leader of the Unmunsan (雲門山) uprising forces, was captured and killed by Squad Leader (隊正) Ham Yeonsu (咸延壽), and the uprising was suppressed.

src: 경주의 농민 봉기군 김순(金順) 등이 안찰사(安察使) 박인석(朴仁碩)이 이끄는 관군과의 싸움에서 패하여 사로잡힘
t: Kim Sun and others of the peasant uprising army of Gyeongju were defeated and captured in battle with the government army led by the inspector Park In-seok.

src: 도적(盜賊)이 무릉(武陵)을 도굴함
t: Bandits robbed the tomb of Mureung.

src: 최충헌(崔忠獻)의 처 임씨를 수성택주(綏成宅主), 왕씨를 정화택주(靜和宅主)로 삼음
t: Choe Chung-heon's wife Lady Im was made Suseong-taekju, and Lady Wang was made Jeonghwa-taekju.

src: 수만 명의 거란 유민들이 고려에 침입하여 영주(寧州), 삭주(朔州) 등을 공격함. 김취려(金就礪) 등을 보내어 거란을 막게 함.
t: Tens of thousands of Khitan refugees invaded Goryeo and attacked Yeongju, Sakju, and other places. Kim Chwi-ryeo and others were sent to repel the Khitan.

src: 도적이 순릉(純陵)을 도굴함
t: Bandits robbed the tomb of Sulleung.

src: 거란군에게 고려군이 패하니, 임보(任輔)를 동남도가발병마사(東南道加發兵馬使)로 삼아 성안에 있는 공사노예(公私奴隷)를 뽑아 군대에 채움
t: As the Goryeo army was defeated by the Khitan army, Im Bo was appointed as the Additional Military Commissioner of the Southeast Circuit, and public and private slaves within the fortress were selected to fill the army.

src: 희종 딸을 왕비로 삼음.(안혜태후(安惠太后) 유씨)
t: The daughter of Huijong was made queen. (Queen Anhye, Lady Yu)

src: 고려, 몽고, 동진 연합군이 강동성(江東城)을 함락시키고 농성 중인 거란 유민을 섬멸함. (강동성 전투)
t: The allied forces of Goryeo, Mongolia, and Eastern Jin captured Gangdongseong and annihilated the Khitan refugees who were holding out inside. (Battle of Gangdongseong)

src: 의주(宜州)에서 별장(別將) 한순(韓恂)과 낭장(郞將) 다지(多智)를 중심으로 수졸(戍卒)들이 폭동을 일으켜 북계(北界)의 여러 성을 점령하자 관군을 파견해 토벌함(의주농민봉기)
t: In Uiju, garrison soldiers led by vice-commander Han Sun and captain Daji rioted and occupied several fortresses in Bukgye, and government troops were dispatched to suppress them. (Uiju Peasant Uprising)

src: 남원에서 봉기가 발생하였으나 곧바로 평정됨
t: An uprising occurred in Namwon but was immediately suppressed.

src: 최우(崔瑀)가 자기 아버지 최충헌(崔忠獻)이 빼앗아 가진 공사전민(公私田民)을 본래의 주인에게 되돌려줌
t: Choe U returned the public and private land and people that his father Choe Chung-heon had seized to their original owners.

src: 어사중승(御史中丞) 안석정(安碩貞)은 사노(私奴)의 아들이니 대각(臺閣)에 두는 것이 마땅하지 않다고 어떤 사람이 상소함
t: Someone submitted a memorial saying that since Vice Director-General of the Censorate An Seok-jeong was the son of a private slave, it was not proper for him to hold office in the Censorate.

src: 평로진(平虜鎭)의 아들 9명이 모두 문무에 재주가 있다고 하자 어미에게 매년 벼 20석을 줌.
t: Since all nine sons of Pyeongnojin were said to be talented in both civil and military affairs, their mother was given 20 seok of rice every year.

src: 개경에 3월 8일에 문밖을 나가는 사람들은 모두 죽을 것이라는 요언이 나돌아 거리가 텅빔
t: In Gaegyeong, a rumor spread that anyone who went out of doors on the 8th day of the 3rd month would die, and the streets became empty.

src: 신기군(神騎軍) 군인인 남경(南京) 사람 인걸(仁傑)이 농민들을 규합해 봉기하고 개경에서도 활동하다 사로잡힘(인걸의 봉기)
t: Ingeol, a soldier of the Singi Army from Namgyeong, rallied peasants and rose in rebellion, also active in Gaegyeong, but was captured. (Ingeol's Uprising)

src: 도적이 대묘(大廟) 9실(室)의 옥책(玉冊) 가장 자리에 장식된 백금을 훔쳐감
t: Bandits stole the silver decoration on the edges of the jade tablets in the nine chambers of the Grand Shrine.

src: 몽고 원수 살리타이(撒禮塔)이 고려에 침입하여 함신진(咸新鎭)을 공격함. 다음날 함신진의 고려군 항복. 몽고 1차 침입
t: The Mongol commander Sartai invaded Goryeo and attacked Hamsinjin. The next day, the Goryeo army at Hamsinjin surrendered. First Mongol invasion.

src: 몽고군이 귀주성(龜州城)을 공격하였으나 함락에 실패함. 이듬해 1월까지 수 차례 공격하였으나 실패함.
t: The Mongol army attacked Gwijuseong but failed to capture it. They attacked several more times until the first month of the following year but failed.

src: 공녀와 환자를 바치라는 원의 요구에 대해 왕이 고려는 일부일처라 인구가 번성하지 않아 보낼 수 없다고 보고함.
t: In response to Yuan's demand to offer tribute women and eunuchs, the king reported that since Goryeo practiced monogamy and its population was not flourishing, they could not be sent.

src: 충주(忠州) 관노(官奴)의 난(亂)이 일어남(충주(忠州) 관노(官奴)의 난)
t: The revolt of the government slaves of Chungju broke out. (Revolt of the Government Slaves of Chungju)

src: 충주에서 관노들이 난을 일으키자 주서(注書) 박문수(朴文秀)와 전 봉어사(前奉御史) 김공정(金公鼎)을 보내 효유함
t: When the government slaves of Chungju rose in revolt, Secretary Park Mun-su and former Bongeosa Kim Gong-jeong were sent to persuade them.

src: 처인성(處仁城)에서 승장(僧將) 김윤후(金允候)가 지휘하는 고려군이 몽고군을 공격하여 몽고 원수 살리타이(撒禮塔)를 사살함.
t: At Cheoinseong, the Goryeo army led by the monk-general Kim Yun-hu attacked the Mongol army and killed the Mongol commander Sartai.

src: 어사대(御史臺)의 조례(皂隷) 이통(李通)이 경기(京畿)의 초적(草賊) 및 성중의 노예(奴隷)들을 불러 모아 반란을 일으킴
t: Lee Tong, a clerk of the Censorate, gathered bandits from Gyeonggi and slaves within the fortress and raised a rebellion.

src: 강화(江華)의 외성(外城)을 축조함.
t: The outer fortress wall of Ganghwa was constructed.

src: 거복(居卜)과 왕심(往心) 등이 용문창(龍文倉)에서 봉기하였다 상장군 이자성(李子晟)에게 패하여 죽음
t: Geobok and Wangsim and others rose up at Yongmunchang but were defeated and killed by senior general Yi Ja-seong.

src: 동경(東京), 영주(永州)에서 봉기한 최산(崔山), 이유(李儒) 등이 병마사 이자성(李子晟)군에 의해 평정됨
t: Choe San, Yi Yu and others who rose in revolt in Donggyeong (東京) and Yeongju (永州) were suppressed by the army of military commissioner Yi Jaseong.

src: 서경에서 필현보(畢賢甫), 홍복원(洪福源) 등이 선유사(宣諭使) 정의(鄭毅), 박녹전(朴祿全)을 죽이고 봉기함
t: In Seogyeong, Pil Hyeonbo, Hong Bokwon and others killed the royal pacification envoys Jeong Ui and Bak Nokjeon and rose in revolt.

src: 최우(崔瑀)가 가병(家兵) 3천명을 서경에 보내 필현보(畢賢甫)를 잡아 처형한뒤 홍복원(洪福源)은 몽고로 도망하였으며 서경인들 다수는 해도(海島)로 옮겨짐
t: Choe U sent 3,000 private troops to Seogyeong, captured Pil Hyeonbo and executed him, whereupon Hong Bokwon fled to Mongolia, and most of the people of Seogyeong were moved to islands.

src: 전쟁피해와 과중한 징수로 의주(宜州), 정주(靜州)인들이 도망하여 농토가 황폐해짐
t: Due to war damage and excessive levies, the people of Uiju and Jeongju fled and the farmland became desolate.

src: 몽고 원수 탕꾸(唐古)가 지휘하는 몽고군이 고려를 침입함.
t: The Mongol army under the command of the Mongol marshal Tangu invaded Goryeo.

src: 지주사(知奏事) 김약선(金若先)의 딸을 태자비로 삼음.(원종비 순경태후(順敬太后) 김씨)
t: The daughter of Jiju-sa Kim Yakseon was made crown princess consort. (Queen Sungyeong of the Kim clan, consort of King Wonjong)

src: 초적(草賊)이연년(李延年) 형제가 원율(原栗), 담양(潭陽) 등지의 사람을 모아 여러 고을을 공격하여 함락시키자 전라도지휘사 김경손(金慶孫)이 나주에서 평정함
t: When the bandit chief Yi Yeonnyeon and his brother gathered people from Wonyul, Damyang and other areas and attacked and captured several counties, the Jeolla-do Inspector-General Kim Gyeongson suppressed them at Naju.

src: 초적(草賊)이연년(李延年)이 아우와 함께 담양 등지에서 산림의 무리를 모아 백적도원수(百賊都元帥)를 자칭하고 해양(海陽; 光州) 등지의 주군을 점령하여 위세를 떨침. 1237년 봄에 나주성에 진주한 전라도 지휘사(全
t: The bandit chief Yi Yeonnyeon, together with his younger brother, gathered a band from the mountains and forests in Damyang and other areas, styled himself Baekjeok Do-wonsu, occupied the counties of Haeyang (海陽; Gwangju) and other areas, and showed great power. In the spring of 1237, the Jeolla-do Inspector (全

src: 신안공 전(新安公 佺)의 딸을 태자비로 삼음.(원종비 경창궁주(慶昌宮主) 유씨)
t: The daughter of Prince Sinan Jeon was made crown princess consort. (Queen Gyeongchang of the Yu clan, consort of King Wonjong)

src: 단오에 그네놀이를 금지함.
t: The swinging game at Dano was prohibited.

src: 도적이 내탕(內帑)의 옥대(玉帶), 보기(寶器)를 훔쳐감
t: Thieves stole a jade belt and treasures from the Privy Treasury.

src: 사람 50명을 써서 제사를 지낸다는 요언이 나돌아 민심이 동요하고 도적이 횡행하다 한달여 만에 그침
t: A rumor spread that fifty people were used to perform a sacrifice, causing public unrest and rampant banditry, which stopped after about a month.

src: 김보정(金寶鼎)과 이보(李輔)가 노비를 소송하던 것을 공정하게 판정한 유석(庾碩)이 안북도호부사(安北都護府使)로 내쫓김
t: Yu Seok, who had fairly judged the lawsuit over slaves between Kim Bojeong and Yi Bo, was demoted and sent out as Anbuk Protector-General.

src: 박훤(朴喧)의 집을 정업원(淨業院)으로 하여 비구니와 중을 모여 살게 함.
t: Bak Hwon's house was made into Jeongeobwon, where nuns and monks were gathered to live.

src: 충실도감(充實都監)을 설치하여 한인(閑人)과 백정(白丁)을 점검하여 각 령의 군대에 보충시킴.
t: The Chungsil-dogam was established to inspect hanin and baekjeong and supplement the troops of each battalion.

src: 최항(崔沆)의 창두(蒼頭) 46명에게 복두(㡤頭)를 쓰도록 허락하니, 이 뒤부터 권세가의 노(奴)들이 모두 이를 착용함
t: Choe Hang permitted 46 of his changdu servants to wear bokdu, and from then on, the slaves of powerful families all wore it.

src: 갑곶강(甲串江)에서 수전(水戰)을 연습함
t: Naval warfare drills were practiced on the Gapgotgang.

src: 도적이 후릉(厚陵)과 예릉(睿陵)을 도굴함
t: Thieves broke into and robbed the tombs of Hureung and Yereung.

src: 예꾸(也窟)이 지휘하는 몽고군이 고려 침입. 주민들을 산성과 섬으로 대피시킴.
t: The Mongol army under the command of Yeku invaded Goryeo. The people were evacuated to mountain fortresses and islands.

src: 방호별감(防護別監) 김윤후(金允候)가 지휘하는 고려군이 충주성(忠州城)을 공격한 몽고군을 12월 중순까지 70여일 동안 방어함.
t: The Goryeo army led by Defense Commissioner Kim Yunhu defended Chungju Fortress against the attacking Mongol army for over 70 days until mid-December.

src: 몽고군이 충추(忠州)를 포위하니, 김윤후(金允侯)가 군사들에게 죽음을 각오하고 싸운다면 귀천(貴賤)이 없이 모두 관직을 제수하겠다고 하고, 관노(官奴)의 문서를 태워 없앰
t: When the Mongol army besieged Chungju, Kim Yunhu told the soldiers that if they fought resolved to die, all would be granted official positions regardless of status, and he burned the documents of the government slaves.

src: 도적이 강종릉(康宗陵)을 도굴함
t: Thieves broke into and robbed the tomb of Gangjongneung.

src: 기근과 전염병으로 많은 사람이 죽고 유망하자 유민에게 토지를 나누어줌
t: Due to famine and epidemic, many people died or became displaced, and land was distributed to the displaced people.

src: 도적이 태자부(太子府)에 들어와 옥책(玉冊)의 장식과 비단 등의 물건을 훔쳐감
t: Thieves broke into the Crown Prince's residence and stole the ornaments of the jade documents and silk goods.

src: 우구치 이북 지역은 상남면과 중춘양면이 됨
t: The area north of Uguchi became Sangnam-myeon and Jungchunyang-myeon.

src: 원주(原州)에서 안열(安悅)을 중심으로 농민들이 봉기하자 장군 윤군정(尹君正), 낭장(郞將) 권찬(權贊)을 보내 토벌하고 관련자들을 섬으로 이주시킴
t: When farmers rose up in Wonju centered around An Yeol, General Yun Gunjeong and Nangjang Gwon Chan were sent to suppress them and relocate those involved to islands

src: 몽고군이 침입해 맹주(孟州)를 지키던 호수(胡壽)가 해를 당하자 그의 아내 유씨(兪氏)가 물에 빠져 죽음.
t: When the Mongol army invaded and Ho Su, who was guarding Maengju, was killed, his wife Lady Yu drowned herself.

src: 최의(崔竩)가 가노(家奴) 이공주(李公柱)를 낭장으로 삼았으니, 노예를 참직(參職)에 임명한 것이 이때부터 시작됨
t: Choe Ui made his household slave Yi Gongju a Nangjang, marking the first time a slave was appointed to a chamjik office

src: 김인준(金仁俊) 등을 위사공신(衛社功臣)에 임명하면서, 그 중 천례(賤隷)에 속한 자는 자손에 이르기까지 모두 벼슬길을 틔우도록 허락함
t: Kim Injun and others were appointed Meritorious Subjects for Guarding the State, and among them those of lowly slave status were permitted to have official careers opened to them down to their descendants

src: 도적이 후릉(厚陵)과 예릉(睿陵)을 도굴함
t: Thieves looted the royal tombs of Hureung and Yereung

src: 고려 태자의 입조(入朝)를 조건으로 몽고와 강화 성립. 몽고군 철수
t: Peace was concluded with the Mongols on condition that the Goryeo crown prince enter their court. The Mongol army withdrew

src: 원종(元宗)이 송화(宋和)를 어견룡행수(御牽龍行首)로 선발했다가 중금지유(中禁指諭)까지 주었으나, 그의 어머니가 천인이어서 벼슬을 삼품직으로 제한 당함
t: King Wonjong selected Song Hwa as Eogyeonnyonghaengsu and even granted him the post of Junggeumjiyu, but because his mother was of lowly status his office was restricted to the third rank

src: 위문경(魏文卿) 형제가 과거에 수석해 어미에게 쌀을 줌.
t: The brothers Wi Mun-gyeong placed first in the state examination and gave rice to their mother.

src: 사도(司徒) 인(絪)의 딸을 태자비로 삼음.(충렬왕비 정신부주(貞信府主) 왕씨)
t: The daughter of Sado In was made crown princess consort. (King Chungnyeol's consort, Lady Wang of Jeongsinbuju)

src: 천인(賤人)들이 조정의 중요한 길에서 말을 타는 것은 이전에 내린 명령대로 모두 금지하며, 이 법령에 따르지 않는 자는 해당 기관에 넘긴다고 어사대(御史臺)에서 공시함
t: The Eosadae announced that, in accordance with previous orders, lowly persons riding horses on the main roads of the court would all be prohibited, and that those who did not comply with this law would be handed over to the relevant office

src: 정자경(鄭子卿)의 아내 손씨(孫氏)가 일찍이 가노(家奴) 양수(良守), 서균(徐均)과 간통하였던 사실이 발각되어 감옥에 갇혔다가 죽음
t: It was discovered that Lady Son, wife of Jeong Jagyeong, had once committed adultery with the household slaves Yangsu and Seo Gyun, and she was imprisoned and died

src: 횡천(橫川), 홍천(洪川)에서 폭동이 일어나 30여 명이 희생됨
t: A riot broke out in Hoengcheon and Hongcheon, and more than 30 people were killed

src: 장군 주선(周瑄)이 숙부처 대씨와 사통. 대씨는 옥사함.
t: General Ju Seon committed adultery with his uncle's wife, Lady Dae. Lady Dae died in prison.

src: 전민변정도감(田民辨正都監)을 둠
t: The Jeonmin Byeonjeong Dogam was established

src: 정주(靜州) 관노(官奴) 정오부(丁伍孚)가 강을 건너 파사부(婆娑府)에 가 세자에게 임연(林衍)이 왕을 내쫓고 새 왕을 세운 사실을 일러 바침
t: Jeong Obu, a government slave of Jeongju, crossed the river to Pasabu and reported to the crown prince that Im Yeon had driven out the king and installed a new king

src: 삼별초(三別抄)를 혁파함.
t: The Sambyeolcho was abolished.

src: 삼별초(三別抄) 군이 탐라(耽羅)를 공격하여 함락시킴.
t: The Sambyeolcho army attacked Tamna and captured it.

src: 삼별초(三別抄) 군이 진도(珍島)로 들어가 근거지로 삼음.
t: The Sambyeolcho army entered Jindo and made it their base.

src: 임연(林衍)의 가신(家臣) 이공렬(李公烈) 및 가노(家奴) 등을 해도(海島)에 귀양보냄
t: Im Yeon's retainer Yi Gongnyeol and household slaves were exiled to island regions

src: 장군 배중손(裵仲孫), 노영희(盧永禧) 등이 강화(江華)에서 삼별초(三別抄)를 이끌고 봉기함. 승화후(承化侯) 왕온(王溫)을 왕을 삼음. (삼별초의 항쟁)
t: General Bae Jungson, No Yeonghui, and others led the Sambyeolcho in an uprising at Ganghwa. They made Seunghwahu Wang On king. (The Sambyeolcho Rebellion)

src: 공사노비(公私奴婢)들이 천인(賤人)을 면하려고 몽고군이나 서경(西京)에 가서 의탁하는 것을 금지해달라고 몽고황제에게 요청함
t: A request was made to the Mongol emperor to prohibit public and private slaves from seeking refuge with the Mongol army or in Seogyeong in order to escape their lowly status

src: 김련(金鍊)의 딸이 다루가치 탈타아(脫朶兒)에게 시집감.
t: The daughter of Kim Ryeon married the darughachi Taltaa.

src: 도적이 관리 임명장에 사용하는 어보(御寶)를 훔쳐감
t: Thieves stole the royal seal used for official appointment documents

src: 고려와 몽고 연합군이 삼별초(三別抄) 군의 근거지인 진도(珍島)용장성(龍藏城)를 함락시킴. 배중손(裵仲孫), 노영희(盧永禧) 등 전사.
t: The combined Goryeo-Mongol forces captured Yongjangseong in Jindo, the base of the Sambyeolcho army. Bae Jungson, No Yeonghui, and others were killed in battle.

src: 양주(襄州)인 장세(張世), 김세(金世) 등이 수령(守令)과 향리를 모살(謀殺)하려다 발각되어 처형되자 잔여 세력이 이민(吏民)을 거느리고 해도(海島)로 들어감
t: When Jang Se, Kim Se, and others of Yangju, who had plotted to assassinate the local magistrate and clerks, were discovered and executed, their remaining forces led clerks and commoners into island regions

src: 관노(官奴) 숭겸(崇謙), 공덕(功德) 등이 무리를 모아 다루가치(達魯花赤)와 관리들을 죽이고 진도(珍島)로 가서 투항하려고 함
t: Official slave Sunggyeom, Gongdeok, and others gathered a crowd, killed the Darughachi and officials, and attempted to go to Jindo to surrender.

src: 강화 지방에 들어와 있던 몽고군이 대부도(大部島)에 들어가 침탈을 일삼는데 맞서 섬 주민들이 몽고군을 죽이고 봉기를 일으키자 수주 부사(水州副使) 안열(安悅)이 군사를 동원해 평정함
t: When Mongol troops stationed in the Ganghwa region entered Daebudo and engaged in plunder, the island's residents killed the Mongol troops and rose in revolt, and Suju Vice Magistrate An Yeol mobilized troops to suppress it.

src: 도적이 전목고(典牧庫)의 은 80근을 훔쳐감
t: Thieves stole 80 geun of silver from Jeonmokgo.

src: 부모와 의논하지 않고 이유없이 아내를 버린 자는 직(職)을 정지시키고 부처(付處)함.
t: Those who abandoned their wives without reason and without consulting their parents were suspended from office and banished.

src: 삼별초(三別抄)가 합포(合浦)를 공격하여 전함 32척을 불사르고 몽고 군사 십여 명을 잡아 죽임.
t: The Sambyeolcho attacked Hapo, burned 32 warships, and captured and killed over ten Mongol soldiers.

src: 고려의 요청에 의하여 몽고군이 양인 여자를 함부로 빼앗아 여종으로 삼는 것을 금지
t: At Goryeo's request, the Mongol army was prohibited from arbitrarily seizing commoner women to make them female slaves.

src: 김방경(金方慶) 등이 이끄는 고려와 몽고 연합군이 삼별초(三別抄) 최후의 근거지인 탐라성(耽羅城)를 함락함. 대장 김통정(金通精) 자결
t: The combined Goryeo-Mongol army led by Kim Bang-gyeong and others captured Tamna Fortress, the last stronghold of the Sambyeolcho. Commander Kim Tong-jeong committed suicide.

src: 방고감전별감(房庫監傳別監)을 설치
t: The Banggogamjeon Byeolgam was established.

src: 결혼도감을 설치하고 촌가의 여자 140명을 수색해 몽고인에게 나눠 줌.
t: The Marriage Directorate was established, and 140 women from village households were searched out and given to Mongols.

src: 세자가 원 공주 홀도로게리미실(忽都魯揭里迷失, 제국대장공주(齊國大長公主))과 결혼함.
t: The crown prince married the Yuan princess Holdorogerimisil (Jegukdaejang Gongju).

src: 고려와 몽고 연합군 3만 여명이 일본 원정. 일기도(一岐島)에 상륙하였으나 폭풍으로 실패함.
t: A combined Goryeo-Mongol army of over 30,000 men set out on an expedition to Japan. They landed on Iki Island but failed due to a storm.

src: 귀족 자제로서 충렬왕(忠烈王)을 따라가 독로화(禿魯花)가 되었던 자를 번을 나누어 숙위케 하고 홀치(忽赤)라 함.
t: Sons of nobles who had accompanied King Chungnyeol and become dorohwa were divided into shifts to guard the palace, and were called Holchi.

src: 어느 여승의 여자 종이 가늘기가 매미 날개 같고 꽃무늬가 놓여 있는 백저포(白苧布)를 짤 줄 알았는데, 제국대장공주가 그 여자 종을 빼앗음
t: A certain nun's female slave knew how to weave white ramie cloth as fine as a cicada's wings with a flower pattern, and Princess Jegukdaejang seized the female slave.

src: 금주(金州) 평민 대문(大文)의 일가 족속 약 100명을 이영주(李英柱)가 노비로 만들려고 하니, 도관좌랑 이순신(李舜臣)이 이영주의 뜻을 맞추어 붓끝으로 그들을 천민으로 만듦
t: When Yi Yeong-ju attempted to enslave about 100 members of the family of Daemun, a commoner of Geumju, Dogwan Jwarang Yi Sun-sin complied with Yi Yeong-ju's wishes and turned them into lowborn status with the stroke of his pen.

src: 처녀 10여 명을 원에 바침.
t: Over ten virgins were presented to Yuan.

src: 처녀 진헌으로 나라 안의 혼인을 금함.
t: Due to the presentation of virgins, marriages within the country were prohibited.

src: 제주도루인물추고색(濟州逃漏人物推考色)을 설치함
t: The Jeju Doru Inmul Chugosaek was established.

src: 일본 정벌에 필요한 무기 제작을 위해 군기조성도감(軍器造成都監)을 설치함.
t: The Gungi Joseong Dogam was established to manufacture weapons needed for the conquest of Japan.

src: 대부경(大府卿) 박유가 관품에 따라 차등적으로 여러 처를 두자고 상소.(박유의 다처제 상소) 부녀자 원망 큼.
t: Daebugyeong Park Yu submitted a memorial proposing that men be allowed multiple wives according to differentiated rank (Park Yu's memorial on polygamy). Women's resentment was great.

src: 상장군 강윤소(康允紹)가 천례(賤隷)에서 높은 관직에 올랐다고 감찰사에서 탄핵하므로 그를 면직시킴
t: General Kang Yun-so was impeached by the Inspector-General's office for having risen to high office from lowborn status, and was dismissed.

src: 원의 귀부군 5백명의 아내를 맞기 위해 전국의 과부와 처녀를 수색함.
t: Widows and virgins throughout the country were searched out to become wives for 500 Yuan surrendered soldiers.

src: 장군 최유엄(崔有渰)을 인물추고별감(人物推考別監)으로 임명하여 장국강(張國綱)과 함께 합포(合浦)로 파견
t: General Choi Yu-eom was appointed Inmul Chugo Byeolgam and dispatched to Hapo together with Jang Guk-gang.

src: 제국대장공주가 잣과 인삼을 중국 강남에 수출해 이익을 얻음. 내시를 각처에 보내 이를 구했으므로 백성이 고통스러워함.
t: Princess Jegukdaejang exported pine nuts and ginseng to Jiangnan in China and profited from it. She sent eunuchs to various places to procure these, causing the people suffering.

src: 제국대장공주(齊國大長公主)를 저주했다고 하여 경창궁주(慶昌宮主)를 폐해 서인(庶人)으로 함.
t: Because she was said to have cursed Princess Jegukdaejang, Gyeongchang Gungju was deposed and reduced to commoner status.

src: 정백지(鄭伯芝)가 서림현(西林縣)의 여종 두명을 제안공(齊安公)의 집에 보냈다가 원성전(元成殿) 직실사(織室司)에 소속시킴
t: Jeong Baek-ji sent two female slaves from Seorim County to the house of Jean-gong, then had them assigned to the Jiksilsa of Wonseongjeon.

src: 경상도에 유민이 많이 발생하자 조인규(趙仁規)를 파견하여 조사하고 이들을 호적에 올림
t: As many displaced people occurred in Gyeongsang-do, Jo In-gyu was dispatched to investigate and register them in the household register.

src: 백성을 안집(安集)시킬 대책을 논의하니, 처간(處干)을 철폐해 부역을 부과하자는 논의가 주류를 이룸
t: Discussions were held on measures to stabilize the people, and the dominant opinion was to abolish the cheogan and impose corvée labor.

src: 고려의 재상들이 민호를 많이 차지하고 숨겨 부역을 면피하는 것을 금지시키라고 흔도(忻都)가 몽고황제에게 요청함
t: Hindu requested the Mongol Emperor to prohibit Goryeo's ministers from occupying and concealing many households to evade corvée labor.

src: 주열(朱悅), 권단(權㫜), 최유(崔濡), 최유후(崔有侯), 우준충(禹濬冲)을 제도계점사(諸道計點使)로 파견
t: Ju Yeol, Gwon Dan, Choe Yu, Choe Yu-hu, and U Jun-chung were dispatched as gyejeomsa of the provinces.

src: 공사노비(公私奴婢)를 해방하여 양인(良人)으로 만드는 것을 금지함
t: The manumission of public and private slaves into commoners was prohibited.

src: 원나라에서 일본 정벌에 필요한 전함 900척을 제작하게 함.
t: Yuan had 900 warships built for the invasion of Japan.

src: 각도에 계점사(計點使)를 파견하는 것을 중지함
t: The dispatch of gyejeomsa to each province was stopped.

src: 미결(未決)된 전민(田民)에 관계되는 소송을 지체없이 처리할 것을 명령함
t: It was ordered that unresolved lawsuits concerning land and people be handled without delay.

src: 여러 신하들이 하사받은 관노비(官奴婢)를 환수해 도관(都官)에 소속시킴
t: Government slaves granted to various officials were reclaimed and placed under the Dogwan.

src: 노비상송(奴婢相訟)에 있어서 임금의 행차 앞에 와서 신소하거나, 자문교수(紫門敎授)가 임금의 재가를 요청하는 것을 일체 금지함
t: In lawsuits concerning slaves, it was entirely prohibited to appeal directly before the king's procession or to have the Jamun gyosu request the king's approval.

src: 주열(朱悅)을 경상도의, 곽여필(郭汝弼)을 전라도의, 우준충(禹濬冲)을 서해도의, 최유후(崔有侯)를 동계교주의 계점사(計點使)로 임명
t: Ju Yeol was appointed gyejeomsa of Gyeongsang-do, Gwak Yeo-pil of Jeolla-do, U Jun-chung of Seohae-do, and Choe Yu-hu of Donggye and Gyoju.

src: 총랑 김원(金洹)과 장군 조윤번의 딸을 원나라 평장(平章) 아합마(阿哈馬)에게 시집보냄.
t: The daughters of Chief Secretary Kim Won and General Jo Yun-beon were sent to marry Ahmad, a pyeongjang of Yuan.

src: 도적이 왕궁에 들어가 보옥(寶玉)을 훔쳐감
t: Thieves entered the royal palace and stole treasures and jewels.

src: 김방경(金方慶), 흔도(忻都), 홍다구(洪茶丘) 등이 일본 정벌 출발
t: Kim Bang-gyeong, Hindu, and Hong Da-gu departed for the invasion of Japan.

src: 고려, 몽고군이 일본군과의 전투에서 패배하고, 태풍으로 큰 피해를 입음
t: Goryeo and Mongol forces were defeated in battle against the Japanese army, and suffered great damage from a typhoon.

src: 원나라에서 금주(金州) 등에 진변만호부(鎭邊萬戶府)를 두어 일본의 역습에 대비하도록 함.
t: Yuan established the Jinbyeon Manhobu at Geumju and other places to prepare against a Japanese counterattack.

src: 인물추고도감(人物推考都監)을 회문사(會問司)로 고치고, 조인규(趙仁規)가 왕경단사관(王京斷事官)으로써 이를 겸하여 주관하게 함
t: The Inmul Chugo Dogam was renamed Hoemunsa, and Jo In-gyu, as Wanggyeong Dansagwan, was made to concurrently oversee it.

src: 인물추고별감(人物推考別監) 이영주(李英柱)의 상소(上疏)(이영주(李英柱)의 상소)
t: The memorial of Inmul Chugo Byeolgam Yi Yeong-ju.

src: 은병(銀甁)의 절미가(折米價)로 개경에서는 은병 1개의 가치를 쌀 15-16석, 지방에서는 18-19석으로 정함 (은병(銀甁)의 가치)
t: The exchange rate of silver bottles for rice was set: in Gaegyeong, one silver bottle was valued at 15-16 seok of rice, and in the provinces, 18-19 seok.

src: 탑자적(塔刺赤)에게 내시(內侍) 정부의 딸을 아내로 줌.
t: Tapjajeok was given the daughter of Naesi Jeong Bu as his wife.

src: 천인(賤人)은 모두 어머니를 따라 귀속시키도록 명령함
t: It was ordered that all lowborn people follow their mother's status.

src: 곡주(谷州)수안현(遂安縣)에 유민들이 많이 몰려들자 구제하여 신은현(新恩縣)으로 옮겨 살도록 함
t: As many displaced people gathered in Suan-hyeon, Gokju, they were relieved and moved to reside in Sineun-hyeon.

src: 정화원비(貞和院妃)가 양민을 노예로 삼으니 그 양민이 전법사(典法司)에 소송하였으나, 왕의 지시로 노예로 결정한 김서(金㥠)가 죽음
t: Lady Jeonghwawonbi made commoners into slaves, and the commoners sued at the Jeonbeopsa, but Kim Seo, who had decided them to be slaves by the king's order, died.

src: 춘양(春陽)으로 고치고 현(縣)으로 승격
t: It was renamed Chunyang and elevated to a hyeon.

src: 당시 권귀(權貴)가 민전(民田)을 침탈하고 간사한 백성들은 권세가에 붙어 부역을 면하는 경우가 많아 평민들이 이를 고통스럽게 여김
t: At the time, powerful nobles seized people's land, and cunning commoners often attached themselves to powerful families to evade corvée labor, causing ordinary people to suffer from this.

src: 김주정(金周鼎)을 충청도, 전라도, 경상도 계점도지휘사(計點都指揮使)로 임명하고 여러 도(道)들에 각각 계점사(計點使)와 별감(別監)을 파견
t: Kim Ju-jeong was appointed Gyejeom-dojihwisa (計點都指揮使) of Chungcheong-do, Jeolla-do, and Gyeongsang-do, and Gyeomjeomsa (計點使) and Byeolgam (別監) were dispatched respectively to the various provinces.

src: 영천군(榮川郡)을 영주(榮州)로 고침
t: Yeongcheon-gun (榮川郡) was renamed Yeongju (榮州).

src: 영월에서 강윤명(康允明)을 중심으로 봉기가 발생하여 현령을 죽임
t: An uprising centered on Kang Yun-myeong broke out in Yeongwol, killing the county magistrate.

src: 동진(東眞)에 유민이 많이 생겨나자 조정에서 관리를 보내 조사함
t: As many displaced people arose in Dongjin (東眞), the court sent officials to investigate.

src: 지방의 노비들을 소송하는 것은 그 곳 수령이나 안렴사(按廉使)가 처리하고, 소임 이외의 별함(別銜)이 처리하는 것을 금지함
t: It was decreed that lawsuits concerning slaves in the provinces be handled by the local magistrate or Anlyeomsa (按廉使), and that handling by Byeolham (別銜) outside their duties be prohibited.

src: 이인춘(李仁椿)의 딸을 원에 바침.
t: The daughter of Lee In-chun was presented to Yuan.

src: 왕이 양가 처녀는 관에 고한 뒤 혼인하라는 명령을 내림.
t: The king issued an order that daughters of good families report to the government before marrying.

src: 화폐에 은과 동을 합주(合鑄)하는 것을 금하고, 쇄은(碎銀)이 화폐로 유통됨
t: The mixed casting of silver and copper into currency was prohibited, and broken silver (碎銀) circulated as currency.

src: 원(元)나라의 지원보초(至元寶鈔)와 중통보초(中統寶鈔)가 사용됨, 지원보초(至元寶鈔) 1관이 중통보초(中統寶鈔) 5관에 해당
t: Yuan's Zhiyuan Baochao (至元寶鈔) and Zhongtong Baochao (中統寶鈔) were used; 1 guan of Zhiyuan Baochao (至元寶鈔) was equivalent to 5 guan of Zhongtong Baochao (中統寶鈔).

src: 도적이 공릉(恭陵)을 도굴함
t: Thieves robbed the tomb of Gongneung (恭陵).

src: 상장군 차신(車信)을 원에 파견해 처녀를 바치게 함.
t: Senior General Cha Sin was sent to Yuan to present maidens.

src: 도적이 의릉(義陵)을 도굴하여 은기(銀器)를 훔쳐감
t: Thieves robbed the tomb of Ureung (義陵) and stole silver vessels.

src: 아전이나 노비의 처가 양반집 부인의 외출복인 노의(露衣)와 모자 쓰는 것을 금지함.
t: It was prohibited for the wives of clerks and slaves to wear noui (露衣), the outer garment worn by noble ladies when going out, and hats.

src: 서원후 영(西原侯 瑛)의 딸을 세자비로 맞음.(충목왕비 정비(靜妃) 왕씨)
t: The daughter of Seowonhu Yeong (西原侯 瑛) was taken as the crown prince's consort. (Queen Jeongbi of King Chungmok, of the Wang clan)

src: 대장군 장순룡(張舜龍)을 보내 동지밀직사사 채인규(蔡仁揆)의 딸을 원에 바치게 함.
t: Senior General Jang Sun-ryong was sent to have the daughter of Dongji-milljiksasa Chae In-gyu presented to Yuan.

src: 당시 환관 및 권귀(權貴)들이 모두 사전(賜田)을 받고, 각기 양민을 점유하여 모두 부역을 면제받음
t: At the time, eunuchs and powerful nobles all received sajeon (賜田, granted land), and each occupied commoners, all of whom were exempted from labor service.

src: 상장군 차신이 처녀 17명을 원에 바침.
t: Senior General Cha Sin presented 17 maidens to Yuan.

src: 세자가 전 추밀원부사 홍문계의 딸을 비로 맞음.
t: The crown prince took the daughter of former Chumirwon-busa Hong Mun-gye as his consort.

src: 원나라의 반란군인 합단(哈丹)의 군사가 해양(海陽)에 침입. (합단의 침입)
t: The forces of Hadan (哈丹), a rebel army of Yuan, invaded Haeyang (海陽). (The Invasion of Hadan)

src: 연기(燕岐)에서 한희유(韓希愈) 등이 이끈 고려와 몽고 연합군이 합단(哈丹)의 군대를 공격하여 격파함. 이후 합단의 군대는 고려에서 완전 철수
t: At Yeon-gi (燕岐), the combined Goryeo-Mongol forces led by Han Hui-yu and others attacked and defeated Hadan's army. Afterward, Hadan's forces completely withdrew from Goryeo.

src: 조인규(趙仁規)의 딸을 세자비로 맞음.(충선왕비 조비(趙妃))
t: The daughter of Jo In-gyu was taken as the crown prince's consort. (Queen Jobi of King Chungseon)

src: 왕과 공주가 양가 처녀 셋을 데리고 원에 감.
t: The king and the princess went to Yuan bringing three maidens of good families.

src: 호세가(豪勢家)가 남의 전민(田民)을 빼았는데도 담당관청이 해결하지 못한다고 사서인(士庶人)들이 세자의 길을 막고 하소연함
t: Powerful and influential families seized others' land and people, and as the responsible authorities failed to resolve it, commoners and scholars blocked the crown prince's path to plead their case.

src: 도적이 최우(崔瑀)의 무덤을 도굴함
t: Thieves robbed the tomb of Choe U.

src: 세자가 진왕(晉王) 감마랄(甘麻刺)의 딸 보탑실련공주(계국대장공주)와 결혼함.
t: The crown prince married Botapsillyeon Gongju (Princess Gyeguk Daejang), daughter of Prince Gamma-ral of Jin.

src: 빈민들이 조세납부 때문에 자식을 판 자는 관청에서 갚아주고 자식을 돌려보내주라고 명령함
t: Ordered that the government repay and return the children of those among the poor who had sold their children due to tax payments.

src: 원(元)이 사신을 요양로(遼陽路)에 파견하여 포로와 유민 3백 50호를 돌려 보냄
t: Yuan dispatched an envoy to Liaoyang Route and returned 350 households of captives and displaced people.

src: 세자(충선왕)가 죽은 진사 최문(崔文)의 아름다운 아내 김씨를 왕에게 바침.(숙창원비(淑昌院妃) 김씨)
t: The crown prince (King Chungseon) presented the beautiful wife of the deceased jinsa Choe Mun, Lady Kim, to the king. (Lady Kim, Consort Sukchangwon)

src: 순마소에 명해 원에 바칠 양가 처녀를 수색하게 함.
t: Ordered the Patrol Bureau to search for maidens from good families to present to Yuan.

src: 오빠와 정을 통한 교서랑(校書郞) 조진성(趙晉成)의 아내를 가둠.
t: Imprisoned the wife of Gyoseorang Jo Jinseong, who had an affair with her older brother.

src: 보탑실련공주(계국대장공주)가 조비를 질투해 원에 무고함.(보탑실련공주(계국대장공주)의 조비무고사건)
t: Grand Princess Gyeguk (Princess Botapsillyeon), jealous of Jobi, falsely accused her to Yuan. (The false accusation of Jobi by Grand Princess Gyeguk (Princess Botapsillyeon))

src: 충선왕(忠宣王)이 노비정책에 대한 교서를 내림(충선왕의 노비정책 교서)
t: King Chungseon issued a royal edict on slave policy. (King Chungseon's edict on slave policy)

src: 관현방(管絃坊)의 대악(大樂)과 재인(才人)이 부족하여 도성의 관비(官婢) 등에서 선발하였으며, 적(籍)을 궁중에 둠
t: As the court musicians and entertainers of the Gwanhyeonbang were insufficient, they were selected from the government female slaves of the capital, and their registers were kept in the palace.

src: 상장군 고세(高世)를 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Dispatched Senior General Go Se to Yuan to present young girls.

src: 원(元)나라 중서성(中書省)에 공문을 보내 활리길사(闊里吉思)의 고려 노비법 개혁의 부당성을 지적
t: Sent an official document to the Central Secretariat of Yuan pointing out the unjustness of Khorguz's reform of Goryeo's slave laws.

src: 활리길사(闊里吉思)가 고려의 노비법을 변경하려고 하므로 국가에서 이에 대응함(활리길사(闊里吉思)의 고려 노비법 개정)
t: As Khorguz attempted to change Goryeo's slave laws, the state responded to this. (The state's response to Khorguz's revision of Goryeo's slave laws)

src: 14세기. 김태현의 처 왕씨의 세 아들 및 외손주 넷이 과거에 급제해 왕씨와 그 딸이 나라로부터 녹을 받게되자 이를 사양함.
t: 14th century. When the three sons and four grandsons through daughters of Lady Wang, wife of Kim Tae-hyeon, passed the state examination, and Lady Wang and her daughter were to receive stipends from the state, they declined.

src: 탈탈대왕(脫脫大王)이 매를 바치며 처녀를 요구함.
t: King Taltal presented a hawk and demanded maidens.

src: 한손수(韓孫秀)의 딸을 안서왕(安西王) 아난달(阿難達)에게 시집보냄.
t: Married the daughter of Han Son-su to Prince Anseo Ananda.

src: 전민변정사(田民辨正司)를 설치함
t: Established the Office for the Rectification of Land and People.

src: 원나라에 홀라대 등이 탈점한 전민(田民)을 모두 본주인에게 돌려줄 것을 요청
t: Requested Yuan that the land and people seized by Hollade and others all be returned to their original owners.

src: 퇴관부곡(退串部曲)에 바람이 크게 붐
t: A great wind blew in Toegwan-bugok.

src: 대장군 진량필(秦良弼)을 보내 원에 동녀를 바침.
t: Sent Grand General Jin Ryang-pil to present young girls to Yuan.

src: 전민변정도감(田民辨正都監)에 명령하여 활리길사(闊里吉思)의 판결에 의해 양민으로 된 노비들을 등록하고 본주인에게 돌려주게 함
t: Ordered the Directorate for the Rectification of Land and People to register the slaves who had become commoners by Khorguz's ruling and return them to their original owners.

src: 왕이 계국대장공주를 서흥후(瑞興候)에게 개가시키고자 함.(계국대장공주의 개가 시도)
t: The king wished to remarry Grand Princess Gyeguk to Seoheunghu. (The attempt to remarry Grand Princess Gyeguk)

src: 왕유소(王惟紹)를 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Dispatched Wang Yu-so to Yuan to present young girls.

src: 호군 정공(鄭恭)을 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Dispatched Hogun Jeong Gong to Yuan to present young girls.

src: 원 안서왕(安西王)이 부인사신을 보내 동녀를 구함.
t: The Prince Anseo of Yuan sent an envoy for his wife to seek young girls.

src: 진량필을 원에 파견해 동녀 8인을 바침.
t: Dispatched Jin Ryang-pil to Yuan to present 8 young girls.

src: 16세이하 13세이상 여자의 혼인을 제한함.
t: Restricted marriage for women aged 13 to 16 and under.

src: 원의 환관 이언충(李彦忠)이 와서 동녀를 선발함.
t: An eunuch of Yuan, Yi Eon-chung, came and selected young women.

src: 동지밀직사사 진량필(秦良弼)을 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Dispatched Deputy Director of the Privy Council Jin Ryang-pil to Yuan to present young women.

src: 도첨의참리 김심(金深)을 원에 파견해 동녀 18인을 바침.
t: Dispatched Chamui-chamri Kim Sim to Yuan to present 18 young women.

src: 황태후 명으로 동녀를 뽑음.
t: Selected young women by order of the Empress Dowager.

src: 부왕인 충렬왕의 후궁 숙창원비(淑昌院妃)를 간음하고 숙비(淑妃)로 봉함.
t: Committed adultery with Sukchang-wonbi, a consort of his father King Chungnyeol, and enfeoffed her as Sukbi.

src: 종친 및 문무양반의 동성혼인을 금함.(동성불혼(同姓不婚)) 외가사촌과는 혼인은 허락함.
t: Prohibited same-surname marriage among royal relatives and civil and military yangban.(Dongseong bulhon) Marriage with maternal cousins was permitted.

src: 왕이 교서를 내려, 간신이 일어나 나라의 정권을 농락하고 공사전민(公私田民)을 모두 탈취하고 있다고 함
t: The king issued an edict, saying that treacherous officials had arisen, manipulating state power and seizing all public and private land and people.

src: 공을 세운 박경량(朴景亮)의 친아들과 사촌형제자매들을 위시해 자손들에 이르기까지 모두 양민으로 만들 것을 명령
t: Ordered that the biological sons and cousins of Park Gyeong-ryang, who had achieved merit, along with his descendants, all be made commoners.

src: 권세가와 교활한 무리들이 문서를 조작하여 남의 노비를 탈취한데 대하여 본주인이 관청에 고소하면 관청에서는 지체없이 판결할 것을 명령함
t: Ordered that when powerful families and cunning groups forged documents to seize others' slaves, if the original owner filed a complaint with the government office, the office should render judgment without delay.

src: 대장군 윤길보(尹吉甫)를 원에 파견해 동녀와 환관을 바침.
t: Dispatched Great General Yun Gil-bo to Yuan to present young women and eunuchs.

src: 헌부(讞部)에서 주군노비(州郡奴婢) 25명을 선발하고, 일반인들의 상쟁노비(相爭奴婢)로 쌍방이 부당해 어느 한편으로 귀속시킬 수 없는 노비들은 모두 왕이 있는 곳으로 보내게 함
t: The Heonbu selected 25 provincial and prefectural slaves, and ordered that slaves disputed between commoners, where neither side could rightfully be judged owner, all be sent to where the king was.

src: 원 승상 탈탈(脫脫)이 사자를 보내 동녀와 환자를 요구함.
t: Yuan Chancellor Toqto'a sent an envoy to demand young women and eunuchs.

src: 위득유(韋得儒)의 딸이 영평궁(永平宮)과 노비를 다투게 되자, 대순(大順)이 원나라 황제에게 아뢰어 제서(制書)를 내려 헌부로 하여금 판결하게 함
t: When Wi Deuk-yu's daughter disputed with Yeongpyeonggung over slaves, Daesun reported to the Yuan emperor, who issued an imperial edict having the Heonbu render judgment.

src: 순군부(巡軍府)는 도적을 잡기 위하여 설치한 기관이므로, 노비의 일은 처리하지 말고 순찰에만 주력할 것을 명령함
t: Ordered that since the Sungunbu was an institution established to catch thieves, it should not handle slave matters but focus solely on patrolling.

src: 소량(訴良)한 자가 많았는데 헌부(讞部)에서 심의해 내지 못하였으므로, 다시 도관(都官)을 설치하고 정랑(正郞)과 좌랑(佐郞)을 둠
t: There were many who filed suits for commoner status, but the Heonbu could not review them all, so the Dogwan was reestablished and the posts of Jeongnang and Jwarang were set up.

src: 다시 선군(選軍)을 설치함.
t: Reestablished the Seongun.

src: 강온(康瑥)이 남의 노비를 빼앗은 죄로 파면되어 서인(庶人)이 됨
t: Gang On was dismissed and demoted to commoner status for the crime of seizing others' slaves.

src: 왕이 익성군 홍규(洪奎)의 딸을 왕비로 맞음.
t: The king took the daughter of Ikseong-gun Hong Gyu as queen.

src: 낭장 심숙공(沈淑公)의 아내가 간부와 공모해 남편을 독살하고 사위와 정을 통해 아들을 낳음.
t: The wife of Nangjang Sim Suk-gong conspired with her lover to poison her husband, and had an affair with her son-in-law, bearing a son.

src: 명희궁(明熙宮)을 없애고 거기 속했던 토전(土田)과 장획(臧獲)을 요물고(料物庫)에 소속시킴
t: Abolished Myeonghuigung and assigned its land and slaves belonging to it to the Yomulgo.

src: 단오에 그네뛰기를 금지함.
t: Prohibited swing-riding on Dano.

src: 국파 전원발(菊坡 全元發) 원나라 괴과(魁科)에 급제
t: Gukpa Jeon Won-bal passed the Yuan dynasty's top examination.

src: 왕이 원 영왕(營王)의 딸 역련진팔자공주(복국장공주)와 결혼함.
t: The king married Princess Yeollyeonjinpalja (Bokguk-jang Gongju), daughter of Prince Yeong of Yuan.

src: 서해도(西海道)에 유망하는 사람들이 많아 주군(州郡) 가운데 5-6 곳의 인가는 텅빌 지경에 이름
t: There were many wandering refugees in Seohae-do, and in 5-6 prefectures and counties, households were nearly emptied.

src: 남편 사후 승려가 된 김변의 처 양천군부인 허씨가 계림을 유람함.양천군부인 허씨묘지
t: After her husband's death, Lady Heo of Yangcheon-gun, wife of Kim Byeon who had become a monk, traveled to Gyerim.

src: 왕이 영왕의 요청으로 동녀를 뽑음.
t: The king selected virgin girls at the request of King Ying.

src: 상호군 이견간(李堅幹)을 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Dispatched Senior General Yi Gyeon-gan to Yuan to present virgin girls.

src: 원나라에서 사자를 보내어 군기소(軍器所), 궁노도감(弓弩都監), 강화(江華)의 군기를 검열함
t: Yuan sent an envoy to inspect the weapons of the Weapons Bureau, the Directorate of Bows and Crossbows, and Ganghwa.

src: 제주민의 봉기 평정됨
t: The uprising of the people of Jeju was suppressed.

src: 제주에서 대호군(大護軍) 장공윤(張公允)과 제주 부사(濟州副使) 장윤화(張允和)의 탐학으로 사용(使用), 김성(金成) 등이 봉기하여 탐라(耽羅) 성주(星主)와 왕자(王子)를 쫓아내자 검교 평리(檢校評理) 송영(宋英)
t: In Jeju, due to the exploitation of Grand General Jang Gong-yun and Jeju Vice Magistrate Jang Yun-hwa, Sayong Kim Seong and others rose up and drove out the Seongju and Wangja of Tamna, whereupon Acting Deputy Councilor Song Yeong

src: 주현사심관(州縣事審官)의 인민 2360호, 노비 137명, 토지 19,798결, 사전(賜田) 1,227결, 위전(位田) 315결 등의 토전인민(土田人民)을 회수함(주현사심관의 토전인민(土田人民) 회수)
t: Recovered the land and people (tojeon-inmin) of the Provincial Inspectors of Prefectures and Counties, amounting to 2,360 households of people, 137 slaves, 19,798 gyeol of land, 1,227 gyeol of granted land, and 315 gyeol of stipend land. (Recovery of the land and people of the Provincial Inspectors of Prefectures and Counties)

src: 원이 동녀 53명과 환자 23명을 요구함.
t: Yuan demanded 53 virgin girls and 23 eunuchs.

src: 양성군(陽城君) 이정을 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Dispatched Yangseong-gun Yi Jeong to Yuan to present virgin girls.

src: 이진(李瑱)은 아들인 이제현(李齊賢)의 세력을 배경으로 하여 남의 노비를 많이 빼앗았는데, 이 때 죽음
t: Yi Jin, relying on the influence of his son Yi Je-hyeon, had seized many other people's slaves; he died at this time.

src: 왜구(倭寇)가 군산도(群山島)에서 회원(會原)의 조운선을 약탈함.
t: Japanese pirates plundered the grain transport ships of Hoewon at Gunsan Island.

src: 제주민이 제주만호(濟州萬戶) 임숙(林淑)의 탐욕과 그를 비호한 관리의 잘못을 폭로하는 글을 시장 거리와 행성(行省)의 문에 써붙이자 임숙을 파직함
t: When the people of Jeju posted writings exposing the greed of Jeju Myriarch Im Suk and the wrongdoing of the officials who protected him on the market streets and the gate of the Regional Secretariat, Im Suk was dismissed from office.

src: 원이 사신 활활출(闊闊黜)을 보내 동녀를 요구함.
t: Yuan sent envoy Hwalhwalchul to demand virgin girls.

src: 왕이 원 위왕(魏王) 아목가(阿木哥)의 딸 금동공주(金童公主, 조국장공주)와 결혼함.
t: The king married Princess Geumdong (Jeguk-jang Princess), daughter of Yuan's Prince Wi, Amokga.

src: 관사노자(官私奴子)가 망령되이 남반(南班)이라고 칭하고, 양민의 부녀를 유인하여 혼인을 하였을 때에는 법에 의하여 다스린다고 명령함
t: Ordered that when public or private slaves falsely claimed to be Namban and lured commoner women into marriage, they should be punished according to law.

src: 천인을 양인으로 만들어 호구(戶口)를 위조한 자는 처벌하고, 권세가에서 넓은 농장을 만들고 인민을 모아다가 숨겨두고 국가의 부역에 바치지 않는 자는 공호(貢戶)에 충당시킬 것을 명령
t: Ordered that those who turned lowborn people into commoners and falsified household registers be punished, and that those among the powerful families who created large estates, gathered and hid people, and did not provide them for state corvée duty be assigned to tribute households.

src: 원이 불가노(不家奴)를 보내 동녀를 요구함.
t: Yuan sent Bulgano to demand virgin girls.

src: 도적이 능침(陵寢)의 제기(祭器)를 훔쳐감
t: Thieves stole the ritual vessels from the royal tomb.

src: 좌상시(左常侍) 윤신걸(尹莘傑)을 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Dispatched Left Attendant Yun Sin-geol to Yuan to present virgin girls.

src: 화평군(化平君) 김심(金深)의 딸 달마실리(達麻實里)가 원 황후가 됨.
t: Dalmasilli, daughter of Hwapyeong-gun Kim Sim, became the Yuan empress.

src: 눌륜 공주(訥倫公主)를 장사지냈는데 그 다음날 도적이 묘를 도굴함
t: Princess Nullyun was buried, but the next day thieves dug up her grave.

src: 왕이 관서왕(關西王) 초팔(焦八)의 장녀 덕령공주(德寧公主)와 결혼함.
t: The king married Princess Deokryeong, eldest daughter of Gwanseo-wang Chopal.

src: 상인 임신(林信)의 딸은 단양대군(丹陽大君)의 비(婢)로서 사기(沙器)장사를 하고 있었는데, 왕이 그를 총애함
t: The daughter of merchant Im Sin was a servant of Danyang-daegun and sold porcelain ware; the king favored her.
