src: 기철(奇轍)의 매부인 염돈소(廉敦紹)의 노(奴)의 일당 5-6명이 공모하여 남의 유부녀를 왕의 명령이라고 속이고 강제로 데려옴
t: Five or six accomplices among the slaves of Yeom Don-so, brother-in-law of Gi Cheol, conspired to deceive people, claiming it was the king's order, and forcibly took away another man's married woman.

src: 원이 환자 홍대불화(洪大不花)를 보내어 동녀를 요구함.
t: Yuan sent eunuch Hong Dae-bulhwa to demand virgin girls.

src: 소은병(小銀甁)을 발행하여 재래 은병(銀甁)의 통용을 금지함. 소은병 1개의 교환가치는 오승포(五升布) 15필로 정함
t: Issued small silver bottles and prohibited the circulation of the traditional silver bottles. The exchange value of one small silver bottle was set at 15 rolls of five-seung cloth.

src: 도적이 고릉(高陵)을 도굴함
t: Robbers looted Goreung (高陵).

src: 전 좌상시(佐常侍) 권형(權衡)의 딸을 수비(壽妃)로 책봉함.
t: The daughter of former Jwasangsi (佐常侍) Gwon Hyeong (權衡) was appointed as Subi (壽妃).

src: 전의부령(典儀副令) 이곡(李穀)이 공녀 징발금지를 원에 청함.(이곡의 공녀징발금지 상소)
t: Jeonuibu-ryeong (典儀副令) Yi Gok (李穀) petitioned the Yuan to prohibit the levy of tribute women.(Yi Gok's memorial against the levy of tribute women)

src: 면천(免賤)하여 양민이 되었던 자들을 다시 돌려 천례(賤隷)에 속하게 함
t: Those who had been freed from slave status to become commoners were returned to slave status again.

src: 기인(其人)들이 과중한 역으로 계속 도망하자 해당 관청에서 일수를 계산하여 대가를 주군에서 징수하므로 많은 사람들이 그 폐해 때문에 유망함
t: As the giin (其人) continued to flee due to excessive labor duties, the relevant office calculated the number of days and had the cost collected from the provinces and counties, and many people absconded because of the harm.

src: 공사천구(公私賤口)가 성안에서 말을 타는 것을 금지함
t: Public and private slaves (公私賤口) were prohibited from riding horses within the walled city.

src: 부녀의 향도회(香徒會) 금지. 백성은 자식에게, 양반집 부녀자는 남편에게 죄를 연좌시킴.
t: Women's hyangdohoe (香徒會) gatherings were prohibited. Commoners were to have their children held liable, and women of yangban households were to have their husbands held liable.

src: 각호노비(各戶奴婢)들을 너무 고되게 부려, 그들이 병에 걸려도 치료해 주기를 꺼리고 죽은 뒤에는 길거리에 내버려 매장하지 않는 자는 중죄로 다스릴 것을 공표
t: It was proclaimed that those who worked household slaves (各戶奴婢) too harshly, refusing to treat them when ill and abandoning their bodies in the streets without burial after death, would be punished severely.

src: 원이 고려인 기씨녀를 제2황후로 책봉함.(기황후(奇皇后))
t: Yuan appointed the Goryeo woman of the Gi clan as second empress.(Empress Gi)

src: 순흥향교(順興鄕校) 건립
t: Sunheung Hyanggyo (順興鄕校) was built.

src: 평리(評理) 홍탁(洪鐸)의 딸을 화비(和妃)로, 임씨를 은천옹주(銀川翁主)로 봉함.
t: The daughter of Pyeongni (評理) Hong Tak (洪鐸) was appointed as Hwabi (和妃), and Lady Im was appointed as Euncheon-ongju (銀川翁主).

src: 원이 기황후의 어미 이씨를 영안왕대부인(英安王大夫人)에 봉함.
t: Yuan appointed Lady Yi, the mother of Empress Gi, as Yeongan-wang Daebuin (英安王大夫人).

src: 원이 태감(太監) 박첩목아볼화(朴帖木兒不花)를 보내 동녀를 요구함.
t: Yuan sent Taegam (太監) Bak Cheommokaburhwa (朴帖木兒不花) to demand young women.

src: 왕이 사건노비(四件奴婢)를 바치라는 분부를 매우 급하게 내림
t: The king issued an order very urgently demanding the presentation of sageon nobi (四件奴婢).

src: 경상도 산원(散員) 동정(同正)이 가난해 세금을 못내자 딸이 머리를 잘라 팔아 납부한 뒤 아비와 함께 목을 매 죽음.
t: In Gyeongsang-do, when a Sanwon-dongjeong (散員同正) was too poor to pay his taxes, his daughter cut off and sold her hair to pay it, after which she and her father hanged themselves.

src: 전민추쇄도감(田民推刷都監)을 설치하고 정을보(鄭乙輔)와 장항(張沆)을 제조(提調)에 임명
t: The Jeonmin Chusoe Dogam (田民推刷都監) was established, and Jeong Eulbo (鄭乙輔) and Jang Hang (張沆) were appointed as its directors (提調).

src: 개경에서 민간의 어린아이 수십명을 잡아 새 궁궐의 주춧돌 밑에 묻으려 한다는 와언(訛言)이 나돌아 민심이 동요하고 도적이 성행함
t: A rumor spread in Gaegyeong that dozens of children from among the common people were being seized to be buried beneath the cornerstones of the new palace, causing public unrest and a surge in banditry.

src: 내승(內乘)과 응방(鷹坊)을 폐지함
t: The Naeseung (內乘) and Eungbang (鷹坊) were abolished.

src: 박충좌(朴忠佐)와 허백(許伯)을 판전민도감사(判田民都監事)로 임명함
t: Bak Chungjwa (朴忠佐) and Heo Baek (許伯) were appointed as Panjeonmindogamsa (判田民都監事).

src: 보흥고(寶興庫), 덕녕고(德寧庫), 내승(內乘), 응방(鷹坊)을 폐지하고 토지와 노비를 각각 본래의 곳에 돌려보냄
t: The Boheunggo (寶興庫), Deokryeonggo (德寧庫), Naeseung (內乘), and Eungbang (鷹坊) were abolished, and their land and slaves were each returned to their original places.

src: 나익희(羅益禧)는 어머니가 재산을 나누어 줄 때 따로 장획(臧獲) 40구를 주니, 6남매가 고르게 나눌 것을 주장
t: When Na Ikhui's (羅益禧) mother divided her property, she gave him an additional 40 janghoek (臧獲), but he insisted that the six siblings share it equally.

src: 묵은 빚이 있다는 구실로 양인을 협박하여 노비로 만들어 부리는 자는 “천구역가(賤口役價)는 1년에 5승포 32필반”이라는 법규대로 계산하여 보상하게 하고, 노역을 전부 면제할 것을 명령
t: It was ordered that those who, under the pretext of old debts, coerced commoners into becoming slaves and working them be made to compensate according to the law stipulating that 'the labor price of a slave is 5 seungpo, 32 rolls and a half per year,' and that all labor duties be entirely exempted.

src: 도적이 태묘(太廟)에 침입함
t: Robbers broke into the Taemyo (太廟).

src: 익성군(益城君) 서를 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Ikseong-gun (益城君) Seo was sent to Yuan to present young women.

src: 원이 사신을 파견해 정승 노책의 둘째 딸을 데려감.
t: Yuan sent an envoy who took away the second daughter of Prime Minister No Chaek.

src: 행성낭중(行省郎中) 이수산(李壽山)을 원에 파견해 동녀를 바침.
t: Dispatched Haengseong Nangjung (行省郎中) Yi Su-san (李壽山) to Yuan to present a young girl.

src: 민심이 불안하자 농민들의 소요를 무마하기 위해 각도에 찰방 별감(察訪別監)을 파견함
t: As public sentiment grew unstable, Chalbang Byeolgam (察訪別監) were dispatched to each province to placate unrest among farmers.

src: 강릉대군(江陵大君) 기(祺)가 위왕(衛王)의 딸 노국대장공주(魯國大長公主)와 결혼함.
t: Gangneung-daegun Gi (江陵大君 祺) married Princess Noguk (魯國大長公主), daughter of the Prince of Wei (衛王).

src: 왜선(倭船) 100여 척이 순천부(順天府)에 침입하고, 남원(南原), 구례(求禮) 등지의 조선(漕船)을 노략질함.
t: Over 100 Japanese pirate ships invaded Suncheon-bu (順天府), and plundered grain transport ships (漕船) in Namwon (南原), Gurye (求禮), and other areas.

src: 왜구가 고성(固城), 죽림(竹林), 거제(巨濟) 등지를 노략질함. 합포 천호 최선(崔禪) 등이 격퇴함. 이후 왜구의 침입이 본격화함.
t: Japanese pirates plundered Goseong (固城), Jungnim (竹林), Geoje (巨濟), and other areas. Hapo Cheonho (合浦千戶) Choe Seon (崔禪) and others repelled them. Thereafter, Japanese pirate invasions began in earnest.

src: 김태현의 처 왕씨의 아들 셋이 과거에 급제해 매년 국가로부터 20석의 곡식을 받음.
t: The three sons of Lady Wang, wife of Kim Tae-hyeon, passed the state examination, and received 20 seok of grain annually from the state.

src: 허유(許猷)가 첩과 간통한 가노(家奴)의 두 눈알을 뽑고, 귀, 코, 발을 베고, 생식기를 베어 첩에게 먹임
t: Heo Yu (許猷) gouged out both eyes of a household slave (家奴) who had committed adultery with his concubine, cut off his ears, nose, and feet, and cut off his genitals and fed them to the concubine.

src: 문익점(文益漸)이 가져온 목화를 정천익(鄭天益)이 생산하여, 베 짜는 기술을 가비(家婢)에게 가르쳐서 베 1필을 짜게 함
t: Jeong Cheon-ik (鄭天益) cultivated the cotton that Mun Ik-jeom (文益漸) had brought, and taught weaving techniques to a household female slave (家婢), having her weave one pil of cloth.

src: 왜구가 교동(喬棟)에 침입함.
t: Japanese pirates invaded Gyodong (喬棟).

src: 조카와 간통한 상장군(上將軍) 전보문(全普門)의 아내 송씨 처벌.
t: Lady Song, wife of Sangjanggun (上將軍) Jeon Bo-mun (全普門), was punished for committing adultery with her nephew.

src: 복안부원군(福安府院君) 권겸(權謙)이 원에 가서 황태자에게 딸을 바침.
t: Bokan-buwongun Gwon Gyeom (福安府院君 權謙) went to Yuan and presented his daughter to the crown prince.

src: 교서를 내려 권세(權勢)가 탈점한 전택(田宅), 노비를 여러해 소송하고 있는 사건을 판결하여 처리할 것을 명함
t: Issued a royal edict ordering that cases of land, houses, and slaves seized by the powerful, which had been under litigation for many years, be judged and resolved.

src: 교서를 내려 빈민이 자녀를 판 경우 3년이 지나도 방역(放役)하지 않은 자는 감찰사와 안렴사가 처벌할 것을 명함
t: Issued a royal edict ordering that when the poor had sold their children, those who failed to release them from servitude (放役) after three years be punished by the Gamchalsa (監察司) and Allyeomsa (按廉使).

src: 전민(田民)의 소송이 날로 번잡하니 감찰, 전법, 도관은 전민을 잉집(仍執)하거나 거집(據執)한 자를 검거하며, 권호(權豪)는 잉집되거나 거집된 자를 본주인에게 돌려보낼 것을 명함
t: As lawsuits concerning land and people (田民) grew increasingly complex day by day, it was ordered that the Gamchal (監察), Jeonbeop (典法), and Dogwan (都官) apprehend those who had illegally retained (仍執) or seized (據執) such land and people, and that the powerful and mighty (權豪) return those retained or seized to their original owners.

src: 원 태자가 김윤장(金允臧)의 딸과 혼인을 약속하고 그 딸을 데려감. 이에 앞서 실두태자도 만호(萬戶) 임숙(林淑)의 딸을 혼인하고자 데려감.
t: The Yuan crown prince promised marriage to the daughter of Kim Yun-jang (金允臧) and took her away. Prior to this, Crown Prince Sildu had also taken the daughter of Manho (萬戶) Im Suk (林淑), intending to marry her.

src: 경양대군(慶陽大君) 노책이 딸을 원에 바치고 집현전 학사가 됨.
t: Gyeongyang-daegun No Chaek (慶陽大君 盧頙) presented his daughter to Yuan and became a Jiphyeonjeon Haksa (集賢殿學士).

src: 원나라의 요청으로 한족(漢族) 부흥 세력인 장사성(張士誠) 토벌을 위해 유탁(柳濯) 등 장수 40명과 군사 2000여명을 파병함.
t: At the request of Yuan, in order to subjugate the Han Chinese restoration force led by Zhang Shicheng (張士誠), 40 generals including Yu Tak (柳濯) and about 2,000 soldiers were dispatched.

src: 인당(印璫)이 지휘하는 고려군이 압록강을 건너 파사부(婆娑府) 등 세 참(站)을 격파함
t: The Goryeo army commanded by In Dang (印璫) crossed the Yalu River and destroyed three stations (站) including Pasa-bu (婆娑府).

src: 동북면병마사가 여진 포로 여자 20명을 바치므로 각 관청에 나누어 소속시켜 비(婢)로 삼음
t: The Military Commissioner of Dongbuk-myeon (東北面兵馬使) presented 20 captured Jurchen women, who were distributed among various government offices and made into female slaves (婢).

src: 기철(奇轍) 등 3가(家)의 노비를 몰수하여 의성창(義成倉), 덕천창(德泉倉), 유비창(有備倉) 등에 소속시킴
t: The slaves of the three households, including that of Gi Cheol (奇轍), were confiscated and placed under Uiseong-chang (義成倉), Deokcheon-chang (德泉倉), Yubi-chang (有備倉), and other granaries.

src: 기철(奇轍) 등이 빼앗아 가진 인구와 토지에 대하여는 빼앗긴 사람에게 고발하는 것을 허락하여 각각 원주인에게 돌려줄 것을 명령함
t: It was ordered that regarding the people and land seized by Gi Cheol (奇轍) and others, those who had been dispossessed be allowed to file complaints, and that each be returned to its original owner.

src: 도당(都堂)에서 화폐문제를 논의할 때 은 1량(兩)으로 그 액면가치를 표시한 은전을 주조하여 교환수단으로 사용하자고 건의
t: When the Dodang (都堂) discussed the currency issue, it was proposed that silver coins marked with a face value of 1 ryang (兩) of silver be minted and used as a medium of exchange.

src: 검교대호군 최룡각(崔龍角)이 전주(全州)의 양민 70여 호를 사사로이 부리고 타인의 토지를 빼앗았으므로, 그 집을 몰수하고 본인은 수졸(戍卒)로 삼음
t: Geomgyo Daehogun (檢校大護軍) Choe Ryong-gak (崔龍角) privately exploited over 70 households of commoners in Jeonju (全州) and seized others' land, so his house was confiscated and he himself was made a garrison soldier (戍卒).

src: 왜구가 교동(喬桐)에 침입하였으므로 경성(京城)에 계엄을 내리고, 홀치(忽只), 충용위(忠勇衛) 등을 파견함.
t: As Japanese pirates invaded Gyodong (喬桐), martial law was declared in the capital (京城), and the Holchi (忽只), Chungyongwi (忠勇衛), and others were dispatched.

src: 향리들이 양민들을 모아다가 자기 종을 삼는 등 백성들을 침해하니, 어사대(御史臺)와 안렴사(按廉使)를 시켜 이를 바로잡을 것을 도평의사사에서 아룀
t: As local clerks (鄕吏) gathered commoners and made them into slaves, thereby harming the people, the Dopyeongeuisasa (都評議使司) reported that the Eosadae (御史臺) and Allyeomsa (按廉使) should be ordered to rectify this.

src: 이제현(李齊賢)의 딸을 혜비(慧妃)로 맞음.
t: Took the daughter of Yi Je-hyeon as Lady Hye.

src: 사람들이 마음대로 비구와 비구니되는 것을 금지함.
t: Prohibited people from freely becoming monks and nuns.

src: 유민이 되어 압록강을 건너 거주하던 사람들이 병란(兵亂)이 있자 돌아옴
t: People who had become refugees and crossed the Yalu River to live there returned when there was military unrest.

src: 홍두적(紅頭賊) 4만명이 고려를 침공하여 의주(義州), 서경(西京) 등을 점령함. (제1차 홍건적의 침입)
t: 40,000 Red Turban bandits invaded Goryeo and occupied Uiju, Seogyeong, and other places. (First invasion of the Red Turbans)

src: 홍주창(洪州倉)을 맡아 보던 곽중룡(郭仲龍)이 쌀 20석을 도둑질하여 관기(官妓)와 관노(官奴)에게 주었으므로 직책을 박탈하여 군대에 충당시킴
t: Gwak Jung-ryong, who oversaw the Hongju Warehouse, stole 20 seok of rice and gave it to government gisaeng and government slaves, so he was stripped of his post and sent to fill a military post.

src: 낭장 안천검(安天儉)의 집에 불이 났는데, 안천검이 술에 취해 일어나지 않자 그 처가 함께 타죽음.
t: A fire broke out at the house of Nangjang An Cheon-geom, and as An Cheon-geom was drunk and did not get up, his wife burned to death together with him.

src: 서북면(西北面)에 크게 기근이 들자 농민 봉기가 발생함
t: A great famine struck Seobuk-myeon, causing a peasant uprising to occur.

src: 반성(潘誠), 사유(沙劉) 등이 지휘하는 홍두적(紅頭賊) 10만여 명이 고려를 침공. (제2차 홍건적의 침입)
t: Over 100,000 Red Turban bandits commanded by Pan Cheng and Sha Liu invaded Goryeo. (Second invasion of the Red Turbans)

src: 홍두적(紅頭賊)이 절령(岊嶺)의 책문(柵門)에서 고려군을 격파하고 개경(開京)을 점령함. 국왕은 복주(福州)로 피난함(12월)
t: The Red Turban bandits defeated the Goryeo army at the stockade of Jeollyeong and occupied Gaegyeong. The king fled to Bokju (December).

src: 군대 모집에 응하는 궁사노예(宮司奴隷)는 소원에 따라 양민으로 삼거나 혹은 돈과 비단으로 상을 준다는 모병방이 붙음
t: A notice for military recruitment was posted stating that palace agency slaves who joined the army would, according to their wish, be made commoners or rewarded with money and silk.

src: 공사간의 노예들이 부역을 피하기 위하여 사원에 들어가니 모두 체포하여 모두 본래의 직무로 돌려보낸 것을 어사대(御史臺)에서 아룀
t: The Eosadae reported that public and private slaves who had entered temples to avoid corvée labor were all being arrested and sent back to their original duties.

src: 사천(私賤)을 제외하고, 군대모집에 응모한 궁사노예(宮司奴隷)는 원하는 대로 평민으로 만들거나 혹은 돈이나 비단을 주도록 명령
t: It was ordered that, excepting private slaves, palace agency slaves who joined the military recruitment be made commoners according to their wish, or given money or silk.

src: 전 중랑장 김광철(金光徹)의 딸을 요양성고가노(高家奴)에게 보냄.
t: The daughter of former Jungnangjang Kim Gwang-cheol was sent to Gao Jianu, governor of Liaoyang.

src: 정세운(鄭世雲)이 지휘하는 20만 고려군이 개경(開京)을 탈환함. 10만 명의 홍두적이 사살되고 잔존 군사들은 요동(遼東)으로 완전히 퇴각함.
t: 200,000 Goryeo troops commanded by Jeong Se-un recaptured Gaegyeong. 100,000 Red Turban bandits were killed and the surviving troops completely retreated to Liaodong.

src: 여러 궁사창고(宮司倉庫)의 노(奴)들이 조세를 거둘 때에 행하는 폐단을 금지할 것을 명령
t: It was ordered that the abuses committed by the slaves of the various palace agency warehouses in collecting taxes be prohibited.

src: 힘센 자들이 차지한 성균십이도(成均十二徒)와 동서학당(東西學堂) 및 주군(州郡)의 향교의 인구들을 관청에서 판별하여 학교의 쓰임에 충당하게 할 것을 명령함
t: It was ordered that the government identify the people occupied by powerful men at the Twelve Schools of Seonggyungwan, Dongseohakdang, and the hyanggyo of the prefectures and counties, and have them fill school duties.

src: 각 도의 양가 자제(良家子弟)를 뽑아 위(衛)에 보충시키고 윤번으로 숙위하게 함.
t: Sons of good families were selected from each province to fill the guards, and served night duty in rotation.

src: 여진족인 삼선(三善)과 삼개(三介) 등이 여진족을 이끌고 함주(咸州)를 점렴함. 이성계(李成桂)의 반격으로 격퇴
t: Samseon and Samgae, leading the Jurchen, occupied Hamju. They were repelled by a counterattack led by Yi Seong-gye.

src: 덕흥군(德興君)을 고려 국왕으로 세우기 위해 최유(崔濡)가 1만여 명을 이끌고 의주(義州) 등지를 점령. 최영(崔塋)과 이성계(李成桂)의 반격으로 격퇴
t: In order to install Deokheung-gun as king of Goryeo, Choe Yu led over 10,000 men and occupied Uiju and other places. They were repelled by a counterattack led by Choe Yeong and Yi Seong-gye.

src: 전민추정도감(田民推整都監)을 설치하고 신돈(辛旽)을 판사로 삼아 노비를 변정(辨定)함(신돈(辛旽)의 노비변정)
t: The Jeonmin Chujeong Dogam was established, and Sindon was made its head to adjudicate slave status. (Sindon's adjudication of slaves)

src: 여러 도의 한산관(閑散官)을 오군(五軍)에 속하게 함. 곧 이를 혁파함.
t: Idle officials of the various provinces were attached to the Five Armies. This was then abolished.

src: 어떤 노(奴)가 자기 주인을 배반하고 영안군(永安君)에게 의탁했으나 도관좌랑(都官佐郞) 견사제(堅思濟)가 판결을 내려 그 주인에게 돌려 줌
t: A slave betrayed his master and sought refuge with Yeongan-gun, but Dogwan Jwarang Gyeon Sa-je rendered judgment and returned him to his master.

src: 민간에서 5, 6월에 사람들이 모두 죽을 것이라는 요언이 떠돌아 민심이 동요하고 의식(衣食)을 즐기며 기다리는 자들이 늘어나자 이를 금하였으나 소요가 더욱 크게 일어남
t: A rumor spread among the people that everyone would die in the fifth or sixth month, causing public unrest, and as more people indulged in food and drink while waiting for it, this was prohibited, but the disturbance grew even greater.

src: 중국 배들이 침입해 들어온다는 요언이 개경에 나돌아 민심이 동요하고 유리하는 자들이 많이 생김
t: A rumor that Chinese ships were invading spread in Gaegyeong, causing public unrest, and many people became displaced.

src: 영주향교(榮州鄕校) 건립
t: Yeongju Hyanggyo was established.

src: 시중 김일봉(金逸逢)의 딸을 오왕(吳王)에게 보냄.
t: The daughter of Prime Minister Kim Il-bong was sent to the King of Wu.

src: 수원(水原)에 기근이 들고 유민이 발생하여 연복사(演福寺)의 공주 기일 행사에 이들이 대거 몰려듦
t: A famine occurred in Suwon and refugees arose, and they flocked in large numbers to the memorial ceremony for the princess's death anniversary at Yeonboksa Temple.

src: 서경(西京), 안주(安州), 의주(義州). 이성(泥成) 만호부에 상호(上戶), 부호(副戶), 천호(千戶)를 둠.
t: Seogyeong, Anju, Uiju. At the Iseong Office of the Myriarch, the ranks of Superior Household, Deputy Household, and Chiliarch were established.

src: 지용수(池龍壽), 이성계(李成桂) 등이 만주의 동녕부(東寧府)를 점령함. (동녕부 정벌)
t: Ji Yong-su, Yi Seong-gye, and others occupied Dongnyeong Prefecture in Manchuria. (Conquest of Dongnyeong Prefecture)

src: 중국 사람들이 개경 안팎에서 사람들을 잡아 먹는다는 요언이 나돌아 민심이 크게 동요함
t: A rumor spread that Chinese people were catching and eating people inside and outside Gaegyeong, greatly disturbing public sentiment.

src: 염제신(廉悌臣)의 딸을 맞아 신비(愼妃)로 삼음.
t: The daughter of Yeom Je-sin was taken as a wife and made Consort Sinbi.

src: 전쟁때문에 호구 문서를 모두 잃고 말았으니, 공민왕(恭愍王) 21년부터 옛 제도에 따라서 양인과 천인, 출생자를 분간하여 호적을 작성할 것을 명령
t: Because of the war, all household registration documents were lost, so it was ordered that from the 21st year of King Gongmin, household registers be compiled according to the old system, distinguishing commoners, lowborn, and newborns.

src: 영천지주사(榮川知州事) 하륜(河崙) 부임
t: Ha Ryun took office as Magistrate of Yeongcheon.

src: 제주 봉기군 항복함
t: The Jeju rebel army surrendered.

src: 나하추(納哈出) 등이 이성(泥城), 강계(江界) 등지를 침범함
t: Nagachu and others invaded areas such as Iseong and Ganggye.

src: 자제위(子弟衛)를 설치하여 국왕에 대한 시위(侍衛)를 담당하게 함.
t: The Guard of Sons and Younger Brothers was established to be in charge of guarding the king.

src: 동계(東界)의 관노가 된 이춘부(李春富)의 아들 이옥(李沃)이 왜적을 물리치니 그 역(役)을 면제해 줌
t: Yi Ok, son of Yi Chun-bu who had become a government slave in Donggye, repelled Japanese pirates, so his labor duty was exempted.

src: 제주민이 봉기하여 비서감(秘書監) 유경원(劉景元), 목사 이용장(李用藏), 판관 문서봉(文瑞鳳) 겸임 만호(權萬戶) 안방언(安邦彦) 등을 죽임
t: The people of Jeju rose up and killed Yu Gyeong-won, Director of the Palace Library, Yi Yong-jang, the Magistrate, Mun Seo-bong, the Assistant Magistrate, and An Bang-eon, who concurrently served as Myriarch.

src: 사람을 모집하여 충용 우군(忠勇右軍)과 좌군(左軍)을 설치하고 판사(判事)와 지사(知事)를 두어 통솔하게 함.
t: People were recruited to establish the Loyal and Brave Right Army and Left Army, and Commissioners and Directors were appointed to command them.

src: 별동 윤상(別洞 尹祥) 출생
t: Byeoldong Yun Sang was born.

src: 사위 박계양(朴啓陽)과 간통한 홍씨를 관비로 삼음.
t: A woman surnamed Hong who had committed adultery with her son-in-law Bak Gye-yang was made a government slave.

src: 최영(崔塋)이 제주(濟州)의 목호(牧胡)들이 일으킨 난을 평정함. (목호(牧胡)의 난)
t: Choe Yeong suppressed the rebellion raised by the Mongol herdsmen of Jeju. (Rebellion of the Mongol Herdsmen)

src: 강녕대군(江寧大君)을 죽은 궁인 한씨 소생으로 칭하고, 한씨의 부, 조, 증조, 외조를 추봉함.
t: Grand Prince Gangnyeong was declared to be the son of the deceased court lady Han, and Lady Han's father, grandfather, great-grandfather, and maternal grandfather were posthumously ennobled.

src: 염흥방(廉興邦)의 가노(家奴) 이광(李光)이 조반(趙胖)의 백주(白州) 땅을 강탈함
t: Yi Gwang, a household slave of Yeom Heung-bang, seized Jo Ban's land in Baekju.

src: 사위와 간통한 홍씨(洪氏)를 곤장을 치고 재산을 몰수하며, 관비(官婢)로 삼음
t: A woman surnamed Hong who had committed adultery with her son-in-law was flogged, had her property confiscated, and was made a government slave.

src: 찬성사 우제(禹磾)의 가노(家奴)가 북원(北元)에 가서 행상을 하였다고 함
t: It was said that a household slave of Vice Councilor U Je went to the Northern Yuan and engaged in trade.

src: 강제로 양인을 천인으로 만든 것은 한 달 이내에 모두 방면할 것을 명령
t: It was ordered that those who had been forcibly turned from commoners into lowborns be all released within one month.

src: 이천계(李天桂)와 그의 누이인 강우(康祐)의 처가 이성계(李成桂)의 노(奴)로써 소량(訴良)한 자와 결탁하여 난을 일으키려 함
t: Yi Cheon-gye and his sister, the wife of Gang U, conspired with a slave of Yi Seong-gye who had petitioned to be recognized as a commoner, and attempted to raise a rebellion.

src: 제주차현유(車玄有) 등이 관청을 불태운 뒤 안무사(安撫使) 임완(林完)과 목사 박윤청(朴允淸)을 죽이고 봉기하였으나 성주(城主) 고실개(高實開) 등에 의해 곧바로 평정됨
t: Cha Hyeon-yu and others of Jeju burned down government offices, killed Pacification Commissioner Im Wan and Magistrate Bak Yun-cheong, and rose in rebellion, but it was immediately suppressed by Castellan Go Sil-gae and others.

src: 최영(崔塋)이 홍산(鴻山)에서 왜구를 대파함. (홍산대첩)
t: Choe Yeong won a great victory over Japanese pirates at Hongsan. (Battle of Hongsan)

src: 제주에서 봉기한 합적(哈赤), 강백안(姜伯顔) 등 13명이 처형되고 부인과 자식들은 광주와 나주에 유배당함
t: Thirteen people, including Hapjeok (哈赤) and Gang Baekan (姜伯顔), who had risen in rebellion in Jeju, were executed, and their wives and children were exiled to Gwangju and Naju.

src: 화통도감(火㷁都監)을 처음으로 설치함.
t: The Directorate of Firearms (火㷁都監) was established for the first time.

src: 안주(安州)에 두 익군(翼軍)을 설치하여 신용(新勇), 신맹(新猛)으로 칭함.
t: Two Ikgun (翼軍) units were established in Anju and were called Sinyong and Sinmaeng.

src: 하삼도에 사신을 보내 한산자제(閑散子弟)를 군사로 뽑으니 심지어 아들을 팔아 말을 산 사람도 있었으며, 뽑힌 사람의 태반은 농민이나 사예(私隷)였음
t: Envoys were sent to the three southern provinces to recruit idle young men (閑散子弟) as soldiers, and some even sold their sons to buy horses; the majority of those recruited were farmers or private slaves (私隷).

src: 왜구가 침입하자 강화부 관리의 세 딸이 강에 빠져 죽음.
t: When Japanese pirates invaded, the three daughters of an official of Ganghwa-bu drowned themselves in the river.

src: 홀치(忽赤) 4번을 고쳐서 근시(近侍) 좌위, 우위, 전위, 후위로 칭하고 4품 이하의 녹관(祿官)을 설치함.
t: The four divisions of the Holchi were renamed the Left, Right, Front, and Rear Divisions of the Royal Attendants, and salaried offices of rank four and below were established.

src: 이안인(李安仁)이 자기 처의 머리를 깎아 가비(家婢)라고 속인 다음 팔아 먹으려다가 마음대로 되지 않자 죽이려고 하기 때문에 처가 도망감
t: Yi Anin shaved his wife's head and deceived others into thinking she was a household slave in order to sell her, and when this did not go as planned, he tried to kill her, so his wife fled.

src: 유만수(柳曼殊), 오계남(吳季南), 안익(安翊), 남좌시(南佐時), 왕안덕(王安德), 경보(慶補)를 제도(諸道)에 파견하여 호구를 계점(計點)함
t: Yu Mansu, O Gyenam, An Ik, Nam Jwasi, Wang Andeok, and Gyeong Bo were dispatched to the various provinces to take a census of households.

src: 조운선(漕運船)의 불통때문에 첫번 녹(祿)을 나누어 주는데 권세가의 노(奴)들이 막대기를 휘두르고 부르짖으며, 앞을 다투어 빼앗으려 하다가 짓밟혀 죽은 자가 2-3명이 됨
t: Because grain transport ships could not get through, when the first stipends were being distributed, the slaves of powerful families wielded clubs and shouted, competing to seize the goods, and two or three were trampled to death.

src: 판개성부사 이림(李琳)의 딸을 근비(謹妃)로 삼음.
t: The daughter of Yi Rim, Magistrate of Gaeseong Prefecture, was made Queen Geunbi.

src: 면주(沔州) 사람 최유룡(崔有龍)이 백성 80명을 숨긴 일이 발각되어 계점사(計點使) 안익(安翊)이 참형에 처함
t: It was discovered that Choe Yuryong of Myeonju had hidden eighty commoners, and the census commissioner An Ik had him executed.

src: 양인 30여 명을 노비로 삼아 부린 마경수(馬坰秀)와 그 아들을 옥에 가두었다가 곤장 107대를 때림
t: Ma Gyeongsu and his son, who had enslaved more than thirty commoners and made them work, were imprisoned and then flogged with 107 strokes.

src: 왜적이 진주에 들어오자 호장(戶長) 정만(鄭滿)의 처 최씨가 정절지키려다 죽임을 당함.
t: When Japanese pirates entered Jinju, Lady Choe, wife of the local headman Jeong Man, was killed for protecting her chastity.

src: 안주(安州)에 두 익군(翼軍)을 설치하여 신용(新勇), 신맹(新猛)으로 칭함.
t: Two Ikgun (翼軍) units were established in Anju and were called Sinyong and Sinmaeng.

src: 이성계(李成桂)가 이끈 고려군이 황산(荒山)에서 왜구를 대파함. (황산대첩)
t: The Goryeo army led by Yi Seong-gye won a great victory over Japanese pirates at Hwangsan. (Battle of Hwangsan)

src: 나세(羅世), 최무선(崔茂宣) 등이 이끈 고려 수군이 진포(鎭浦)에서 화약 무기를 사용하여 왜구의 전선 500척을 격파함.
t: The Goryeo navy, led by Na Se, Choe Museon, and others, used gunpowder weapons to destroy 500 warships of the Japanese pirates at Jinpo.

src: 왕의 진영(眞影)을 옮김
t: The king's portrait was relocated.

src: 전민변위도감(田民辨僞都監)을 둠
t: The Directorate for Investigating False Land and Slave Claims (田民辨僞都監) was established.

src: 서운부정(書雲副正) 노영수(盧英壽) 딸 석비(釋婢)를 의비(毅妃)로 삼음.
t: Seokbi, daughter of No Yeongsu, Vice Director of the Bureau of Astronomy, was made Queen Uibi.

src: 사노(私奴) 무적(無敵)이 자칭 미륵불의 화신이라고 선전하다가 죽임을 당함
t: The private slave Mujeok, who had proclaimed himself an incarnation of Maitreya Buddha, was put to death.

src: 배중선(裵仲善)의 딸이 왜적에게 굴하지 않고 죽임을 당해 정표함.
t: The daughter of Bae Jungseon was killed for refusing to submit to Japanese pirates, and she was posthumously commended.

src: 경상도 협주(陜州)의 한 사노(私奴)가 스스로 검대장군(劍大將軍)이라 칭하고 무리를 모아 주인과 수령을 죽여 봉기하려 하다 잡혀 처형됨
t: A private slave of Hyeopju (陜州) in Gyeongsang Province, who called himself the Sword General and gathered a group intending to kill his master and the local magistrate and rise in rebellion, was captured and executed.

src: 양수척(揚水尺)들이 영해에서 봉기하여 관청과 인가를 불태우자 판밀직(判密直) 임성미(林成味) 등을 보내 평정한뒤 주동자는 처형하고 나머지는 각지에 분산 수용함
t: When the Yangsucheok rose in revolt in Yeonghae and burned government offices and private houses, Im Seongmi, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and others were sent to suppress them; the ringleaders were executed and the rest were dispersed and resettled in various places.

src: 경상도합주(陜州)의 한 사노(私奴)가 검대장군이라 자칭하고 무리를 지어 다니며 재물을 강탈했으며, 그 주인과 고을 수령을 죽이고 반란을 일으키려 함에 잡아 죽임
t: A private slave of Hapju (陜州) in Gyeongsang Province called himself the Sword General, gathered a band, and plundered property; when he tried to kill his master and the local magistrate and rise in rebellion, he was captured and executed.

src: 전민도감관(田民都監官)을 각 도(道)에 파견함
t: Officials of the Jeonmin Directorate (田民都監官) were dispatched to each province.

src: 여진족인 호발도(胡拔都)가 단주(端州)를 침입하자 이성계(李成桂)가 격퇴함.
t: Hobaldo, a Jurchen, invaded Danju, and Yi Seong-gye repelled him.

src: 남해현(南海縣)에 침입한 왜구 선단을 정지(鄭地)가 관음포(觀音浦)에서 화포 공격으로 격파함. 관음포 전투
t: Jeong Ji destroyed a fleet of Japanese pirates that had invaded Namhae-hyeon with cannon fire at Gwaneumpo. Battle of Gwaneumpo

src: 첨설직(添設職)을 임시로 설치하였는데 심지어는 공상천례들이 모두 함부로 이 관직을 받아 벼슬이 매우 천하게 되었다고 권근(權近)이 말함
t: Additional posts (cheomseoljik) were temporarily established, and Gwon Geun said that even craftsmen, merchants, and lowborn people all improperly received this office, so that its rank became very base.

src: 교주도 안렴사 정부(鄭符)가 길가던 중에 왜적을 만나 군수품 및 인장까지 모두 약탈당했으나, 창고노예(倉庫奴隷)로 전조(田租)를 거두며 백성을 괴롭힘
t: Jeong Bu, the inspector (anryeomsa) of Gyoju-do, encountered Japanese pirates while traveling and had his military supplies and even his official seal all plundered, yet he collected land tax through warehouse slaves and oppressed the people.

src: 문주(文州), 강릉도(江陵道)의 화척(禾尺)과 재인(才人)들이 왜구를 가장하여 평창, 원주(原州), 영주(永州), 순흥, 횡천 등지를 약탈하다 50여명이 잡혀 처형되고 처자는 각지에 분산 수용됨
t: Leatherworkers and entertainers of Munju and Gangneung-do disguised themselves as Japanese pirates and plundered Pyeongchang, Wonju, Yeongju, Sunheung, Hoengcheon, and other places; more than 50 were captured and executed, and their wives and children were dispersed and detained in various places.

src: 각 도의 한량 자제(閑良子弟)를 뽑아 보충군(補充軍)을 편성함.
t: Sons of hallyang from each province were selected to form the Supplementary Army (Bochunggun).

src: 조영길(趙英吉)이 이인임(李仁任)의 비서(婢壻)가 되어 딸을 낳아 봉가이(鳳加伊)라고 했는데, 우왕(禑王)이 이인임의 집에서 간음하고 후궁에 둠
t: Jo Yeong-gil became the husband of a slave woman (biseo) of Yi In-im's household and had a daughter named Bonggai; King U committed adultery with her at Yi In-im's house and placed her in the harem.

src: 노예들 중 악소년들이 백색 초립을 쓰고 임금으로 가장하여 밤이면 마을로 돌아다니며 닭과 개를 죽이고 주민들의 재산을 약탈하다가 발각되어 처단당함
t: Among the slaves, wicked youths wore white chorip hats and disguised themselves as the king, roaming villages at night, killing chickens and dogs, and plundering the property of residents, but were discovered and executed.

src: 이인임(李仁任), 임견미(林堅味), 염흥방(廉興邦)이 악노(惡奴)들을 풀어 좋은 토지를 가진 사람이 있으면 모두 물풀레나무로 때리고 빼앗음
t: Yi In-im, Im Gyeon-mi, and Yeom Heung-bang released their wicked slaves, and wherever anyone had good land, they beat them with privet-wood clubs and seized it.

src: 오충좌(吳忠佐)의 아내는 본래 단양대군 왕욱(王珛)의 가비(家婢)로 의순고(義順庫)에 몰입되었는데, 오충좌가 그의 천역(賤役)을 면해주었으며 딸 셋을 둠
t: O Chung-jwa's wife was originally a household slave of Grand Prince Danyang Wang Uk and had been confiscated into Uisungo; O Chung-jwa exempted her from her lowly labor, and they had three daughters.

src: 강씨(姜氏)를 안비(安妃)로, 봉가이(鳳加伊)를 숙녕옹주(肅寧翁主)로, 기생 칠점선(七點仙)을 영선옹주(寧善翁主)로 삼으니, 사비(私婢)와 관비(官婢)로써 옹주를 봉한 것은 최초의 일로 나랏사람들이 해괴하게 여김
t: Lady Gang was made Anbi, Bonggai was made Princess Suknyeong, and the gisaeng Chiljeomseon was made Princess Yeongseon; this was the first time a private slave and a government slave were granted the title of princess (ongju), and the people of the country found it bizarre.

src: 서북면에 유민이 많이 발생하자 성균좨주(成均祭酒) 왕강(王康)을 안무사(安撫使)로 삼아 정착시킴
t: When many displaced people arose in Seobuk-myeon, Wang Gang, a Libationer of the National Academy (Seonggyungwan), was appointed as anmusa (pacification commissioner) to settle them.

src: 축마별감 변벌개(邊伐介)가 제주(濟州)에 가서 타인의 장획(臧獲)을 빼앗는 등의 일을 저지르므로 헌부에서 탄핵하여 귀양보냄
t: Byeon Beol-gae, a special commissioner for horse breeding, went to Jeju and seized other people's slaves and committed other such acts, so the Censorate impeached him and exiled him.

src: 부평(富平)에 사는 염흥방(廉興邦)과 최렴(崔濂)의 가노(家奴)가 군정(軍丁)을 점검하는 아전 및 부사 주언방(周彦邦)을 때림
t: Household slaves of Yeom Heung-bang and Choe Ryeom, who lived in Bupyeong, beat the clerk inspecting military registers and Deputy Magistrate Ju Eon-bang.

src: 경기 좌도(左道)와 우도(右道)의 군인을 뽑아 기선군(騎船軍)으로 삼아 동강과 서강의 왜구를 막게 함.
t: Soldiers from Left and Right Gyeonggi-do were selected to form the naval troops (giseongun) to defend against Japanese pirates at Donggang and Seogang.

src: 박영무(朴英茂)가 역마(驛馬)를 남용하고 또 양민 11호를 영점(影占)했으므로 왕승보(王承寶)가 국문함
t: Park Yeong-mu abused post-horses and also illegally claimed 11 households of commoners, so Wang Seung-bo interrogated him.

src: 창고궁사의 전민(田民)을 탈점한 자의 명단을 작성해 보고하라고 우왕(禑王)이 지시했으나, 도당(都堂) 자체가 꺼리는 바가 있어 집행치 않음
t: King U ordered that a list be made and reported of those who had illegally seized the land and people of warehouses and palace agencies, but the Dodang itself had reservations and did not carry it out.

src: 서운정(書雲正) 김언경의 처 김씨, 전의정(典醫正) 경덕의의 처 안씨, 낭장 이득인의 처 이씨가 왜적의 침입에서 정절 을 지키려다 죽음.
t: Lady Kim, wife of Seounjeong Kim Eon-gyeong; Lady An, wife of Jeonuijeong Gyeong Deok-ui; and Lady Yi, wife of Nangjang Yi Deuk-in, died trying to preserve their chastity during a Japanese pirate invasion.

src: 신아(申雅)의 딸을 정비(正妃)로, 왕흥(王興)의 딸을 선비(善妃)로 봉함.
t: The daughter of Sin A was made Jeongbi, and the daughter of Wang Heung was made Seonbi.

src: 최영의 딸을 맞아 영비(寧妃)로 봉하고, 부(府)를 세워 영혜(寧惠)라 함.
t: He took Choe Yeong's daughter and made her Yeongbi, and established an office (bu) called Yeonghye.

src: 이성계(李成桂), 조민수(曹敏修)가 지휘하는 요동(遼東) 정벌군이 출정함. (요동정벌)
t: The expeditionary army to conquer Liaodong, commanded by Yi Seong-gye and Jo Min-su, set out. (Liaodong Campaign)

src: 내시 김량(金亮)과 김완(金完)을 경기좌우도찰방 겸 제창고전민사(諸倉庫田民使)로 임명하여 파견함
t: Eunuchs Kim Ryang and Kim Wan were appointed as Chalbang of Left and Right Gyeonggi-do concurrently as Jechang-gojeonminsa, and dispatched.

src: 안숙로의 딸을 현비(賢妃)로, 기생 소매향(小梅香)을 화순옹주(和順翁主)로, 연쌍비(燕雙飛)를 명순옹주(明順翁主)로 봉함.
t: The daughter of An Suk-ro was made Hyeonbi, the gisaeng So Mae-hyang was made Princess Hwasun, and Yeon Ssang-bi was made Princess Myeongsun.

src: 대궐의 역(役)은 최근에 없앤 창고노비로 대신하게 하고, 각 관청의 역은 변정도감이 속공(屬公)한 노비로 충당할 것을 조준(趙浚) 등이 상소
t: Jo Jun and others petitioned that labor service for the palace be replaced with warehouse slaves that had recently been abolished, and that labor service for each government office be filled with slaves confiscated to the state by the Byeonjeong Dogam.

src: 경상도원수(慶尙道元帥) 박위(朴葳)가 대마도(對馬島)에 있는 왜구 근거지를 정벌함.
t: Park Wi, the Wonsu of Gyeongsang-do, conquered the base of Japanese pirates on Tsushima Island.

src: 표영(表營)이 배다른 동생을 강제로 천인(賤人)으로 삼았으므로 헌부에서 그 죄를 논함
t: Pyo Yeong forcibly made his half-brother a lowborn person, so the Office of the Inspector-General discussed his crime.

src: 헌부에서 이인임(李仁任)의 파당 이양중(李養中)과 전자충(全子忠)이 양인을 압박하여 천인으로 만든 데 대해 탄핵했으므로 관직을 삭탈하고 귀양보냄
t: The Office of the Inspector-General impeached Yi Yang-jung and Jeon Ja-chung, members of Yi In-im's faction, for coercing commoners into becoming lowborn persons, so their official posts were stripped and they were exiled.

src: 관해(官廨) 업무의 시작
t: Beginning of government office (gwanhae) duties.

src: 도당이 명부(命婦) 및 관리 부인들의 차등적인 재가 금지를 상소함.
t: The Top Council petitioned to prohibit remarriage, according to rank, of title holders (myeongbu) and officials' wives.

src: 헌사(憲司)에서 부인과 중에게 봉작하는 것을 허락하지 말기를 청해 이에 따름.
t: The Office of the Inspector-General requested that granting of titles to wives and monks not be permitted, and this was followed.

src: 우왕(禑王)과 창왕(昌王) 때의 탐오한 무리들이 토지와 장획(臧獲)을 권세가에게 납입하여 중국에까지 들리게 되었으니, 관직을 삭탈하고 토지 지급하는 것을 허락하지 말 것을 사헌부에서 상소
t: Corrupt officials from the reigns of King U and King Chang paid land and slaves (janghoek) to powerful families, and word of this reached even as far as China, so the Office of the Inspector-General petitioned that their official posts be stripped and that they not be granted land.

src: 양반호구의 호적에는 노비의 종파(宗派), 소생명부, 남자종의 아내와 여자종의 남편이 양인인지 천인인지를 기록했으니, 호적에 기록되어 있지 않은 노비는 모두 속공(屬公)할 것을 도당(都堂)이 아룀
t: In the household registers of yangban households, the lineage of slaves, the register of their children, and whether the wives of male slaves and husbands of female slaves were commoners or lowborn were recorded, so the Top Council reported that all slaves not recorded in the household register should be confiscated to the state.

src: 안동부(安東府)에 소속된 현(縣)이 됨
t: Became a county (hyeon) attached to Andong-bu.

src: 회양부(淮陽府) 백성 권금(權金)이 범에 물려가는데 그 처가 남편 허리를 잡고 범을 꾸짖음. 마을을 정표함.
t: When Kwon Geum, a commoner of Hoeyang-bu, was being seized by a tiger, his wife grabbed her husband's waist and scolded the tiger. The village was honored with a commemorative marker.

src: 부녀자가 절에 가는 것을 금지함.
t: Prohibited women from going to temples.

src: 해안의 주민을 모아 3정(丁)으로 1호(戶)를 삼아 수군(水軍)으로 편성하도록 함.
t: Coastal residents were gathered, with three able-bodied men (jeong) forming one household, to be organized into the navy.

src: 도평의사사가 상서해 수절하지 않은 아내에게는 남편의 과전(科田)을 받지 못하게 함.
t: The Top Council petitioned that wives who did not maintain their chastity should not be allowed to receive their husband's stipend land (gwajeon).

src: 5군을 3군으로 줄이고, 도총제부(都總制府)로 하여금 서울과 지방의 군사(軍事)를 통솔하게 함.
t: Reduced the Five Armies to Three Armies, and had the Directorate-General of Military Affairs command military affairs in the capital and provinces.

src: 복제를 대명률에 따르되 외조부모와 장인 장모복은 친백부, 숙부와 같게함.(외조부모와 장인 장모의 복식)
t: Mourning attire regulations followed the Great Ming Code, but mourning attire for maternal grandparents and parents-in-law was made the same as for paternal uncles. (Mourning attire for maternal grandparents and parents-in-law)

src: 헌사에서 내외명부(內外命婦)의 봉작 정비와 재혼한 명부(命婦)의 봉작 삭제를 주장해 이에 따름.
t: The Office of the Inspector-General argued for reorganizing the titles of inner and outer title holders (naeoe myeongbu) and revoking the titles of remarried title holders, and this was followed.

src: 강씨를 현비로 책립함
t: Lady Kang was invested as Hyeonbi.

src: 도총중외제군사부(都摠中外諸軍事府)를 혁파하고 의흥친군위(義興親軍衛)를 설치함
t: Abolished the Directorate-General of All Military Affairs Inside and Outside, and established the Righteous and Martial Personal Guard.

src: 도관(都官)의 노비법(奴婢法) 실시
t: Implementation of the slave law (nobibeop) of the Bureau of Slaves (Dogwan).

src: 노비 소량자(訴良者)에 대한 정책 발표
t: Announcement of policy regarding slaves who petitioned to be recognized as commoners (soryangja).

src: 인물추변도감(人物推辨都監)의 노비결송법(奴婢決訟法) 실시
t: Implementation of the slave lawsuit settlement law (nobigyeolsongbeop) of the Directorate for Investigating and Distinguishing People (Inmul Chubyeon Dogam).

src: 채무 때문에 남의 노비가 되는 부채노비를 금지할 것을 이민도(李敏道)가 상소함
t: Yi Min-do petitioned to prohibit debt slavery (bochae nobi), in which people became another's slave due to debt.

src: 평주(平州)와 봉주(鳳州) 등지에서 초적(草賊)이 발생함
t: Bandits (chojeok) arose in areas such as Pyeongju and Bongju.

src: 삼군총제부(三軍摠制府)를 의흥삼군부(義興三軍府)로 개칭하고 중방(重房)을 폐지함.
t: Renamed the Three Armies Directorate-General (Samgun Chongjebu) as the Righteous and Martial Three Armies Command (Uiheung Samgunbu), and abolished the Chungbang.

src: 소량인(訴良人) 50여 명이 임금 행차 앞에서 호소하므로, 장소를 어긴 죄를 심문하고 괴수 3명에게 곤장을 침
t: More than 50 people petitioning to be recognized as commoners (soryangin) appealed before the king's procession, so they were interrogated for violating the designated place, and the three ringleaders were flogged.

src: 궁사창고의 노속(奴屬)이 여러 주(州)에 나누어 가서 전조(田租)를 불법 징수하니, 노(奴) 1명과 말 1필로써 정수를 삼고 불법 징수하는 것은 엄하게 금지할 것을 도평의사사에서 상소함
t: Slaves belonging to palace storehouses were dispatched to various districts and illegally collected land taxes (jeonjo), so the Top Council petitioned that the collection be fixed at one slave and one horse per levy, and that illegal collection be strictly prohibited.

src: 의복의 사치를 금함.
t: Prohibited extravagance in clothing.

src: 고려조에서 왕씨를 하사받은 자는 본성을 따르도록 하고 본래 왕씨인 자는 모성을 따르게 함.
t: Those who had been granted the Wang surname during the Goryeo dynasty were made to follow their original surname, and those who were originally Wang were made to follow their mother's surname.

src: 고려조의 비, 모, 궁주, 옹주, 국대부인에게 공상(供上) 주는 것을 없애고 월봉만 주도록 함.
t: Abolished the provision of gongsang (tribute supplies) to the consorts, mothers, gungju, ongju, and national grand ladies of the Goryeo dynasty, and had only monthly stipends given instead.

src: 호조판서 이민도(李敏道)가 새로운 화폐 발행을 건의조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Minister of Taxation Yi Min-do proposed the issuance of new currency Annals of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 고려의 토지문제는 해결되었으나 노비문제는 해결되지 않았으니, 도감(都監)을 설치하여 기한을 정해 노비문제를 해결할 것을 전백영(全伯英) 등이 상소
t: Jeon Baek-yeong and others petitioned that although Goryeo's land problem had been resolved, the slave problem had not been resolved, so a dogam (directorate) should be established to resolve the slave problem within a set deadline.

src: 각도 효자, 절부 등의 문려에 정표함.
t: Commendation plaques were awarded at the gates of filial sons, chaste wives, and others in each province.

src: 관리의 취처와 이혼(離異)에 대하여 결정함.
t: Decided on matters concerning officials taking wives and divorce (離異).

src: 여진의 동화를 위해 국인(조선인)과 혼인하게 함.
t: For the assimilation of the Jurchen, had them intermarry with the people of the country (Joseon people).

src: 중추원사 권근이 명하여 관혼상제의 사례를 상정토록 함.
t: Ordered Jungchuwonsa Gwon Geun to establish the proper forms for coming-of-age, marriage, funeral, and ancestral rites.

src: 삼군부(三軍府)에서 ≪수수도(蒐狩圖)≫와 ≪진도(陣圖)≫를 간행함.
t: The Samgunbu published the Susudo (蒐狩圖) and the Jindo (陣圖).

src: 사노(私奴) 최문(崔文), 오천수(吳天壽) 등이 왕지(王旨)를 위조하였으므로, 모두 참형에 처함
t: Private slaves Choe Mun and O Cheon-su forged royal decrees, so they were all executed by beheading.

src: 창기가 궁중에 출입함.
t: Prostitutes entered and left the palace.

src: 신덕왕후 강씨, 판내시부사 이득분의 집에서 죽음.
t: Queen Sindeok, Lady Kang, died at the house of Pannaesibusa Yi Deuk-bun.

src: 남녀의 황색 복장 및 말 고들개 드리우는 것을 엄금함.
t: Strictly prohibited men and women from wearing yellow clothing and from hanging godeulgae (horse chin straps) on horses.

src: 김사형(金士衡)을 오도병마도통처치사(五道兵馬都統處置使)로 삼아 일기도(一歧島)와 대마도(對馬島)를 정벌함
t: Made Kim Sa-hyeong the Odobyeongmadotongcheochisa (Commander-in-Chief of the Military Forces of the Five Provinces) and had him conquer Iki Island and Tsushima Island.

src: 윤침(尹忱)의 가노(家奴) 2명이 의성고(義成庫)에 소속되려고 임금의 행차 앞에 나와서 하소연하니, 곤장을 쳐서 보냄
t: Two household slaves of Yun Chim came before the king's procession to plead to be assigned to Uiseonggo, so they were flogged and sent away.

src: 목은 이색(牧隱 李穡) 졸
t: Mogeun Yi Saek died.

src: 신덕왕후 강씨를 장례지내고 정릉이라 이름함.
t: Queen Sindeok, Lady Kang, was buried, and the tomb was named Jeongneung.

src: 상서사판사 조준, 정도전 등이 청하여 내관(궁녀)의 작호와 품계를 청함.
t: Sangseosapansa Jo Jun, Jeong Do-jeon, and others petitioned for the titles and ranks of the naegwan (court ladies).

src: 각도의 병마도절제사(兵馬都節制使)를 없애고 각 진(鎭)에 첨절제사(僉節制使)를 설치함.
t: Abolished the Byeongmadojeoljesa of each province and established Cheomjeoljesa in each jin (garrison).

src: 판결을 내린 문서는 소각하여 없애자고 노비변정도감(奴婢辨定都監)에서 청함
t: The Nobibyeonjeongdogam petitioned that documents on which judgments had been rendered be burned and destroyed.

src: 정령손(丁令孫)이 노비문서를 일부러 더럽히고 뭉갠 죄를 변정도감(辨定都監)에서 청함
t: The Byeonjeongdogam petitioned regarding Jeong Ryeong-son's crime of deliberately soiling and crumpling slave documents.

src: 변정도감(辨定都監)에서 노비관련 19개 조목을 상소함(변정도감(辨定都監) 19조)
t: The Byeonjeongdogam submitted a memorial of 19 articles concerning slaves (the 19 Articles of the Byeonjeongdogam).

src: 광흥창에 명하여 개국공신의 모, 처, 옹주, 댁주의 녹봉을 다시 내리게 함.
t: Ordered Gwangheungchang to again grant stipends to the mothers, wives, ongju, and daekju of the meritorious subjects of the founding of the dynasty.

src: 궁인 유씨(유준의 딸)를 정경옹주, 김씨(김해기생 칠점선)를 화의옹주에 봉함.
t: Court lady Lady Yu (daughter of Yu Jun) was invested as Jeonggyeong-ongju, and Lady Kim (Chiljeomseon, a gisaeng of Gimhae) was invested as Hwaui-ongju.

src: 조준(趙浚)과 김사형(金士衡)이 노비변정도감(奴婢辨定都監)에서 일을 봄
t: Jo Jun and Kim Sa-hyeong worked at the Nobi Byeonjeong Dogam

src: 정탁(鄭擢)의 노(奴) 이금(李金)이 여러 해 동안 역(役)을 피하기 위해 이름을 바꿈
t: Jeong Tak's slave Yi Geum changed his name for several years to evade labor service

src: 김을남(金乙南) 등이 이름을 속여 다른 사람의 노비를 쟁송(爭訟)하다가 일이 발각되어 처벌받음
t: Kim Eul-nam and others falsified names to dispute over others' slaves in litigation, but the matter was discovered and they were punished

src: 노비의 가격은 남녀를 불문하고 15세에서 40세까지는 4백필, 14세 이하와 41세 이상은 3백필로 정함
t: The price of slaves, regardless of gender, was set at 400 rolls of cloth for those aged 15 to 40, and 300 rolls for those 14 and under or 41 and over

src: 왜구 침입의 우려로 각 도의 기선군(騎船軍)을 다시 설치함.
t: Due to concerns over Japanese pirate invasions, the mounted naval forces of each province were reestablished.

src: 부녀자들의 간음 때문에 중들이 민호에 들어가지 못하도록 금령을 내림.
t: A prohibition was issued banning monks from entering commoners' households due to adultery with women.

src: 동북면(東北面)과 강원도의 선군(船軍)을 폐지하고 경기도, 경상도, 충청도, 전라도의 선군을 감축함.
t: The naval forces of Dongbuk-myeon and Gangwon-do were abolished, and the naval forces of Gyeonggi-do, Gyeongsang-do, Chungcheong-do, and Jeolla-do were reduced.

src: 형조도관(刑曹都官)에서 공사노비(公私奴婢)의 장부를 만들자고 청함
t: The Hyeongjo Dogwan requested the creation of registers for public and private slaves

src: 노비변정도감(奴婢辨定都監)에서 송사를 결단하는 것을 2월 그믐날까지로 한정함
t: The Nobi Byeonjeong Dogam limited the deciding of lawsuits to the last day of the second month

src: 곽추(郭樞)가 전흥(田興)을 가노(家奴)라고 하여 강제로 역사(役使)하니, 전흥이 헌사(憲司)에 소송함
t: Gwak Chu called Jeon Heung his household slave and forced him into labor, so Jeon Heung filed a suit with the Heonsa

src: 사병(私兵) 혁파.
t: Private armies were abolished.

src: 봉상시승 김권이 기생 효도의 인사청탁에 의한 부정으로 귀양감.
t: Bongsangsi Seung Kim Gwon was exiled for corruption due to a personnel appointment solicited by the gisaeng Hyodo.

src: 사순(司楯), 사의(司衣)를 혁파하고, 자제(子弟)를 뽑아 별시위(別侍衛)를 창설함.
t: The Sasun and Saui were abolished, and sons of officials were selected to establish the Byeolsiwi.

src: 노비변정도감(奴婢辨定都監)을 다시 설치함
t: The Nobi Byeonjeong Dogam was reestablished

src: 사신을 각도에 보내어 각 절의 노비를 수색함
t: Envoys were sent to each province to search for the slaves of temples

src: 천례(賤隷)가 말을 타는 것을 금지하는 법을 세움
t: A law was established prohibiting the lowborn from riding horses

src: 부녀들의 궁중출입을 금함.
t: Women were prohibited from entering the palace.

src: 무격 음사(淫祀)(무당굿)를 명의 예제에 따라 봄, 가을에만 행하도록 함.
t: Shamanistic rites were ordered to be held only in spring and autumn, following the Ming ritual system.

src: 변정도감(辨定都監)을 혁파함
t: The Byeonjeong Dogam was abolished

src: 도관(都官)의 인원수를 늘림
t: The number of personnel in the Dogwan was increased

src: 반역자의 노비를 관가에 몰수하는 법을 다시 엄격하게 함
t: The law confiscating the slaves of traitors to the government was strengthened again

src: 노비소송에 참여하지 않은 사람에게는 노비를 주지 않는 법을 세움
t: A law was established that those who did not participate in slave lawsuits would not be given slaves

src: 안변 부사 조사의(趙思義) 등이 반란을 일으킴.
t: Anbyeon Buprefect Jo Sa-ui and others raised a rebellion.

src: 태상왕이 명하여 삭발을 허락하고, 부녀자들이 절에 올라가는 것을 금하지 않도록 함.
t: The Taesangwang ordered that tonsure be permitted, and that women not be prohibited from going up to temples.

src: 경원부에 침입한 우디거(兀狄哈)를 맞아 싸우던 병마사(兵馬使) 곽승우(郭承祐)가 패배함.
t: Byeongmasa Gwak Seung-u, who fought against the Udige who had invaded Gyeongwon-bu, was defeated.

src: 노비를 잉집(仍執)하거나 거집(據執)하는 자를 징계하도록 명령함
t: Ordered that those who illegally retain (仍執) or forcibly hold (據執) slaves be punished

src: 사섬서(司贍署)에서 저화(楮貨) 2천장을 발행함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Saseomseo issued 2,000 sheets of paper currency (楮貨)

src: 저화(楮貨)의 가치를 상오승포(常五升布) 1필, 쌀 2두로 정함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Set the value of paper currency (楮貨) at 1 bolt of ordinary five-sung cloth (常五升布) and 2 mal of rice

src: 사간원의 건의에 의해 喪制를 주자가례(朱子家禮)에 따르도록 함.
t: At the suggestion of the Office of the Censor-General, mourning rites were ordered to follow the Family Rites of Master Zhu (朱子家禮).

src: 공상천례(工商賤隷)의 무리가 특별한 공을 세우면 다른 물건으로 상을 주고 토지로는 상을 주지 말 것을 사간원(司諫院)에서 상소함
t: The Office of the Censor-General petitioned that if artisans, merchants, and lowborn servants (工商賤隷) achieved special merit, they should be rewarded with other goods, not with land

src: 정탁(鄭擢)이 노비를 빼앗았다고 노적(盧績)이 신문고를 쳤으므로, 사헌부(司憲府)로 하여금 알아보게 하여 정탁을 해풍(海豊)으로 내쫓음
t: Because No Jeok struck the petition drum (申聞鼓) alleging that Jeong Tak had seized his slaves, the Office of the Inspector-General (司憲府) was ordered to investigate, and Jeong Tak was banished to Haepung

src: 고려의 신하들이 본관(本貫)의 주군(州郡)으로 하여금 관노비(官奴婢) 등을 뽑아 보내게 하여 선상(選上)이라 일컫고 부리던 일이 지금도 계속되고 있으니 금지시킬 것을 사간원에서 상소함
t: The Office of the Censor-General petitioned that the practice, continuing from Goryeo, whereby officials had the prefectures and counties of their home region (本貫) select and send government slaves, called seonsang (選上), and employed them, should be prohibited

src: , 민간에서 사용가치가 있는 포화(布貨)를 선호하고 교환가치밖에 없는 저화(楮貨) 사용을 기피하였기 때문에, 사섬서(司贍署)를 혁파하고 저화(楮貨) 통용을 금지함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Because the people preferred cloth currency (布貨), which had use value, and avoided using paper currency (楮貨), which had only exchange value, Saseomseo was abolished and the circulation of paper currency was prohibited

src: 죽림 권산해(竹林 權山海) 출생
t: Jungnim Gwon San-hae was born

src: 부녀들이 외출할 때는 얼굴을 가리고, 3품 이상의 정처는 옥교자(뚜껑있는 가마)를 타도록 함.
t: Women were required to cover their faces when going out, and the principal wives of officials of the third rank or higher were to ride in okgyoja (covered palanquins).

src: 관청에 신고하지 않고 노비를 사사로이 주고 받는 것을 금지함
t: Prohibited the private giving and receiving of slaves without reporting to government offices

src: 호구법(戶口法)의 정비를 통하여 귀천(貴賤)의 분별을 엄격하게 할 것을 상소함
t: Petitioned that the distinction between noble and base be strictly enforced through the reorganization of the household registration law (戶口法)

src: 조부녀(趙夫女)의 손자 김한제(金漢齊)가 형조(刑曹)에서 노비를 오결(誤決)하였다고 신문고를 쳐서 아룀
t: Kim Han-je, grandson of Lady Jo (趙夫女), struck the petition drum (申聞鼓) to report that the Ministry of Justice (刑曹) had wrongly adjudicated a slave case

src: 박질(朴質)이란 자가 주인집 딸 내은이(內隱伊)를 강간하도록 도와준 사노(私奴) 실구지(實仇知) 형제를 베어죽임
t: A man named Bak Jil killed by beheading the brothers Silguji, private slaves who had helped him rape Nae-eun-i, the daughter of his master's household

src: 사대부의 혼례는 주자가례(朱子家禮)를 따르도록 하고 상중의 혼인을 금하도록 함.
t: Ordered that the weddings of the sadaebu follow the Family Rites of Master Zhu (朱子家禮) and prohibited marriage during mourning.

src: 사간원이 상소하여 女官을 없애자고 함.
t: The Office of the Censor-General petitioned to abolish court women officials (女官).

src: 남편이 죽은 후 삼년 안에 재가하는 것을 금함.
t: Prohibited remarriage within three years after a husband's death.

src: 노비전계문자(奴婢傳繼文字)의 법을 세움
t: Established the law on documents of slave inheritance (奴婢傳繼文字)

src: 폐지된 절의 토지와 인구를 모두 속공(屬公)함
t: Confiscated to the state (屬公) all the land and people of abolished temples

src: 노비변정도감(奴婢辨定都監)을 설치했다가 곧 폐지함
t: Established the Directorate for the Adjudication of Slaves (奴婢辨定都監) but soon abolished it

src: 공사천인(公私賤人)이 양인 여자에게 장가드는 것을 금지함
t: Prohibited public and private lowborn men (公私賤人) from marrying commoner women

src: 의정부(議政府)에서 노비의 소송을 처리하는 조목(條目)을 아룀
t: The State Council (議政府) reported the articles for handling slave litigation

src: 의정부(議政府)에서 속공노비(屬公奴婢)의 진고법(陳告法)을 올림
t: The State Council (議政府) submitted the reporting law (陳告法) for slaves confiscated to the state (屬公奴婢)

src: 상속자가 없는 노비는 4촌에 한정하여 나누어 주는 법을 밝힘
t: Clarified the law that slaves without heirs be distributed only to relatives within the fourth degree

src: 공처(公處)의 노비를 소송하는 사건에서 이를 결정하여 처리하는 법을 정함
t: Established the law for deciding and handling litigation cases concerning slaves of government offices (公處)

src: 의정부(議政府)에 명령하여 각년(各年)의 속공(屬公)된 노비를 자세히 기록하여 아뢰게 함
t: Ordered the State Council (議政府) to record in detail the government-confiscated slaves (屬公) of each year and report.

src: 형조도관(刑曹都官)에서 노비상속에 대한 조목과 노비를 함부로 점거한 자에 대한 처리 조목을 올림
t: The Slave Registry Bureau of the Ministry of Justice (刑曹都官) submitted articles on slave inheritance and on the handling of those who illegally occupied slaves.

src: 전총제 김한로의 집에서 친영(親迎)함.
t: Held the ceremony of receiving the bride (親迎) at the house of former Chongje Kim Han-ro.

src: 양반 여자로 30살이 넘도록 가난하여 혼인하지 못한 자에게 자장(資粧)을 관에서 지급하도록 함.
t: Ordered that dowries (資粧) be provided by the government to yangban women who had not married by the age of 30 due to poverty.

src: 안로생(安魯生) 등이 노비에 대한 일을 상소함
t: An No-saeng and others submitted a memorial on matters concerning slaves.

src: 사헌부(司憲府)에서 사사노비(寺社奴婢)에 대한 역사(役使)의 지침을 아룀
t: The Office of the Inspector-General (司憲府) reported guidelines on the corvée service of temple slaves (寺社奴婢).

src: 절을 혁파한 뒤에 노비를 모두 관청에 소속시켰으나 노비의 자손 중에 빠진 자가 있는 등의 일로 전민별감(田民別監)을 각 도에 나누어 보냄
t: After temples were abolished, their slaves were all placed under government control, but since some descendants of the slaves had been omitted, Special Investigators of Land and Slaves (田民別監) were dispatched to each province.

src: 강원도평강현(平康縣)에 사는 자기 가노(家奴)의 전지(田地)가 5결(結)인데, 경차관(敬差官)이 이를 25결로 측량했다고 김승주(金承霔)가 주장함
t: Kim Seung-ju claimed that the land of his household slave, residing in Pyeonggang County, Gangwon Province, was 5 gyeol, but the Royal Inspector (敬差官) had measured it as 25 gyeol.

src: 태종과 황엄이 최종심사하여 공녀 5명을 선발함.
t: Taejong and Hwang Eom made the final selection and chose 5 tribute women.

src: 출가녀의 본종부모의 복상을 기년(1년)으로 함.
t: Set the mourning period for a married daughter's birth parents at one year (期年).

src: 황엄 등이 경복궁에서 궁중 각 도의 처녀 70여 명 중 7명만 뽑음.
t: Hwang Eom and others selected only 7 out of more than 70 maidens from various provinces at Gyeongbokgung.

src: 진헌색(進獻色)을 두어 중외의 13세 이상 25세 이하 양가녀의 혼인을 금함.
t: Established the Bureau of Tribute Offerings (進獻色) and prohibited the marriage of commoner women aged 13 to 25 throughout the capital and provinces.

src: 황엄 등이 경복궁에서 경외처녀 총 300여 명 중 44명만 뽑고 나머지는 돌려 보냄.
t: Hwang Eom and others selected only 44 out of more than 300 maidens from the capital and provinces at Gyeongbokgung, and sent the rest back.

src: 평안도(平安道)에만 있는 영속노비(營屬奴婢)를 폐지할 것을 윤목(尹穆)이 상소함
t: Yun Mok submitted a memorial proposing the abolition of the permanent government slaves (營屬奴婢) found only in Pyeongan Province.

src: 황엄이 처녀 정씨만 데리고 명으로 돌아감.
t: Hwang Eom returned to Ming China, taking only Lady Jeong with him.

src: 이도(李韜), 최해산(崔海山) 등이 화차(火車)를 제작하여 시험 발사함.
t: Yi Do and Choe Hae-san manufactured fire carts (火車) and tested them by firing.

src: 의정부(議政府)의 노비진고법(奴婢陳告法)
t: The State Council's (議政府) Law on Reporting Slaves (奴婢陳告法)

src: 관청에 귀속된 자기 조상의 노비 두명이 숨어 있는 것을 데려다 부린 이사강(李斯剛)이, 새로 잡은 것이라고 관청에 신고하여 상을 받음
t: Yi Sa-gang, who had taken in and used two of his ancestors' slaves that had been hiding after being placed under government control, reported them to the government as newly captured slaves and received a reward.

src: 관청에 소속된 외방노비(外方奴婢)와 혁파한 사사노비(寺社奴婢) 중 16세에서 59세의 남자노비에게는 종자곡식 10두(斗)씩, 여자노비에게는 8두씩을 주어서 추수한 뒤에 1두마다 10두씩을 거두기를 의정부(議政府)에서
t: The State Council proposed that, for provincial government slaves (外方奴婢) and the slaves of abolished temples (寺社奴婢) aged 16 to 59, male slaves be given 10 mal of seed grain each and female slaves 8 mal each, to be collected after harvest at a rate of 10 mal for every 1 mal.

src: 여진족의 계속된 침입으로 경원부(慶源府)를 경성(鏡城)으로 이전함.
t: Due to continued invasions by the Jurchens, Gyeongwon-bu was relocated to Gyeongseong.

src: 갑사(甲士)의 정원이 3,000명으로 확대되고 번상 제도가 규정됨.
t: The quota of Gapsa (甲士) was expanded to 3,000 men, and the rotation duty (番上) system was established.

src: 우디거(兀狄哈)가 경흥을 침범하여 길주찰리사(吉州察理使) 조연(趙涓)에게 우디거를 공격하게 함.
t: The Udige (兀狄哈) invaded Gyeongheung, and Jo Yeon, the Investigation Commissioner of Gilju (吉州察理使), was ordered to attack the Udige.

src: 사헌부(司憲府)의 노비사의(奴婢事宜)가 결정되어 국왕에게 올려짐
t: The Office of the Inspector-General's (司憲府) Regulations on Slave Affairs (奴婢事宜) were decided and submitted to the king.

src: 다른 사람의 장획(臧獲)이 본궁(本宮)에 투속(投屬)하는 것을 금지시킴
t: Prohibited others' slaves (臧獲) from being registered under the Bon-gung (本宮).

src: 각 도에 세금을 포(布) 대신에 저화(楮貨)로 거둘 것을 지시함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Instructed that taxes in each province be collected in jeohwa (paper currency, 楮貨) instead of cloth (布).Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 경국대전과 주자가례(朱子家禮)의 오복제가 다르므로 예조에 계하여 개혁하도록 함.
t: As the five mourning garment systems of the Gyeongguk daejeon and the Jujiagarye (朱子家禮) differed, it was reported to the Ministry of Rites (禮曹) to have it reformed.

src: 개성 유휴사에서 각 호의 포화(布貨)를 수색함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: The Gaeseong Yuhusa (留後司) searched each household's cloth currency (布貨).

src: 각 호마다 거두었던 호저화(戶楮貨) 징수를 중지함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Collection of household paper currency (戶楮貨) levied on each household was stopped.

src: 경차관(敬差官) 유의(柳顗)가 마음대로 회양교수관(淮陽敎授官) 이로(李路)에게 역마를 주어서 자기의 도망노비를 찾게 함
t: The royal inspector (敬差官) Yu Ui (柳顗) arbitrarily gave post horses to the Hoeyang instructor (淮陽敎授官) Yi Ro (李路) to have him search for his own runaway slaves.

src: 포(布)를 저화(楮貨)로 교환하게 하고, 가옥의 칸수를 계산하여 매 칸마다 저화(楮貨) 1장씩을 세금으로 내게 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Cloth (布) was exchanged for paper currency (楮貨), and the number of bays (間) of houses was calculated so that one sheet of paper currency (楮貨) was levied as tax for each bay.

src: 사람들에게 포(布)를 납부하고 저화(楮貨)를 받도록 하니, 부유한 상인인 좌군노(左軍奴) 불정(佛丁)이 추포(麤布) 1,500 여필을 다른 집으로 옮겨 놓음(좌군노(左軍奴) 불정(佛丁))
t: People were made to pay cloth (布) and receive paper currency (楮貨) in return, and the wealthy merchant Jwagunno (左軍奴) Buljeong (佛丁) moved over 1,500 rolls of coarse cloth (麤布) to another house.

src: 부인 출입 때 얼굴을 가리게 함.
t: Women were made to cover their faces when going out.

src: 부인들의 복장을 명의 제도를 따르게 함.
t: Women's clothing was made to follow the system of Ming.

src: 15,16세 창기 6명을 뽑아 명빈전 시녀로 함.
t: Six courtesans aged 15 and 16 were selected to serve as attendants at Myeongbinjeon.

src: 후궁 장씨(장사길의 기첩 복덕의 딸)를 순혜옹주에 봉함.
t: Royal consort Jang (daughter of Bokdeok, the concubine of Jang Sagil) was invested as Sunhye Ongju.

src: 정안왕후(정종비)의 49재로 왕이 개경사에서 경숙하고 돌아옴.
t: For the 49th-day memorial rite of Queen Jeongan (consort of King Jeongjong), the king stayed overnight at Gaegyeongsa and returned.

src: 각 고을 관청의 구종(丘從)은 관노(官奴)를 쓰되, 주부군(州府郡)의 차등을 보아 수를 정하게 함
t: For attendants (丘從) of each local government office, government slaves (官奴) were to be used, and the number was to be set according to the grade of the ju, bu, and gun (州府郡).

src: 처와 첩의 구별을 분명히 하도록 함.
t: The distinction between wife and concubine was made clear.

src: 처녀로서 여승이 된 자에게 환속토록 함.
t: Maidens who had become Buddhist nuns were made to return to secular life.

src: 수군의 만호(萬戶)와 천호(千戶)의 칭호를 정함.
t: The titles of manho (萬戶) and cheonho (千戶) of the navy were established.

src: 범죄적몰자의 처는 공신가의 비로 삼고 노비는 관에서 몰수함.
t: The wife of a criminal whose property was confiscated was made a servant of a meritorious subject's household, and slaves were confiscated by the government.

src: 노비중분법(奴婢中分法)을 세움
t: The law of equal division of slaves (奴婢中分法) was established.

src: 형조(刑曹)에서 노비의 계본(啓本)을 올림
t: The Ministry of Justice (刑曹) submitted a report (啓本) on slaves.

src: 혼례를 의논하여 정함.
t: Marriage rites were discussed and established.

src: 궁녀를 삼번하도록 명함.
t: It was ordered that court ladies be divided into three shifts.

src: 하륜(河崙)이 노비소송에 관한 몇가지 일을 상소함
t: Ha Ryun (河崙) submitted a memorial on several matters concerning slave litigation.

src: 의정부(議政府)에서 노비(奴婢) 및 호구법(戶口法)을 올림
t: The State Council (議政府) submitted the law on slaves (奴婢) and household registration (戶口法).

src: 변정도감(辨正都監)에서 비로소 서로 소송한 노비문서를 불태워버림
t: The Byeonjeong Dogam (辨正都監) for the first time burned the slave documents of mutual litigation.

src: 의정부(議政府)에서 노비변정(奴婢辨正)의 조건(條件)을 올림
t: The State Council (議政府) submitted the terms (條件) for the adjudication of slaves (奴婢辨正).

src: 가뭄으로 교방여악을 정지시킴.
t: Due to drought, the female musicians and dancers of the Gyobang were suspended.

src: 천첩자손의 속신법에 조항을 추가함.
t: Added clauses to the law of self-redemption for the descendants of cheoncheop (lowborn concubines).

src: 화통군(火㷁軍) 400명을 추가하여 1,000명으로 증원함.
t: Added 400 men to the Hwatonggun (火㷁軍), increasing it to 1,000.

src: 외척의 복제를 정하고 예조에 명하여 친영의 예를 상정하게 함.
t: Established the mourning-dress regulations for maternal relatives and ordered the Ministry of Rites to formulate the rites of chinyeong (bride-welcoming ceremony).

src: 무녀들이 백악에서 기우함.
t: Shamans performed a rain-prayer ritual at Baegak.

src: 각사노비쇄권색(各司奴婢刷卷色)의 계목(啓目)
t: The report (gyemok 啓目) of the Gaksa Nobi Swaegwonsaek (各司奴婢刷卷色).

src: 궁중 시녀, 방자 중 연장자를 간출함.
t: Selected the eldest among the palace maids and female servants (bangja).

src: 불충죄인인 여러 민씨 남녀에게 평민과 혼인하는 것을 허락함.
t: Allowed the men and women of the Min clan, who were criminals of disloyalty, to marry commoners.

src: 쇄권색(刷卷色)에서 노비추쇄사의(奴婢推刷事宜)를 아룀
t: The Swaegwonsaek (刷卷色) reported on matters concerning the tracking and seizure of slaves (奴婢推刷事宜).

src: 형조(刑曹)에서 하사받은 노비를 자손에게 전하는 법을 아룀
t: The Ministry of Punishments (刑曹) reported the law on transmitting bestowed slaves to descendants.

src: 각사노비쇄권색(各司奴婢刷卷色)을 부활하고, 유정현(柳廷顯), 박신(朴信), 이발(李潑), 이지강(李之剛)을 담당관리로 삼음
t: Revived the Gaksa Nobi Swaegwonsaek (各司奴婢刷卷色) and appointed Yu Jeong-hyeon, Bak Sin, Yi Bal, and Yi Ji-gang as the officials in charge.

src: 윤린(尹麟)이 창원(昌原)의 기인(其人) 황길(黃吉)을 대신하여 강순(姜順)의 노(奴)가 대궐내에 나아가 일을 하게 하다가 일이 발각됨
t: Yun Rin had Gang Sun's slave go into the palace to work in place of Hwang Gil, a giin (其人) of Changwon, and the matter was discovered.

src: 명부(命婦)의 봉작식(封爵式)을 정함.
t: Established the investiture ceremony (封爵式) for myeongbu (命婦).

src: 양인에게 시집가서 낳은 자식은 종부하여 양인이 되게 함.
t: Children born to women who married commoners were made to follow the father's status and become commoners.

src: 하정사통사 원민생이 명에서 미녀를 구한다는 밀계로 중외에 혼인을 금지함.
t: Won Min-saeng, the interpreter of the New Year's greetings envoy (賀正使通事), secretly reported that Ming was seeking beautiful women, and marriage was prohibited throughout the country.

src: 사신 황엄이 처녀 한씨, 황씨, 종비 12명과 화자 4명을 데리고 명으로 떠남.
t: The envoy Hwang Eom departed for Ming, taking the maidens Lady Han, Lady Hwang, 12 female servants, and 4 hwaja.

src: 공사노비(公私奴婢)의 소량(訴良)의 한계를 정함
t: Set limits on the petitions for commoner status (訴良) by public and private slaves (公私奴婢).

src: 형조(刑曹)에서 노비공문(奴婢公文)의 법식을 정함
t: The Ministry of Punishments (刑曹) established the format for official documents concerning slaves (奴婢公文).

src: 정희왕후 윤씨가 홍천공아에서 출생함.
t: Queen Jeonghui of the Yun clan was born at Hongcheon gonga.

src: 관기들이 양부와 혼인하여 아들을 낳으면 도청에 속하게 함.
t: When government kisaeng married commoner men and bore sons, the sons were made to belong to the docheong.

src: 신하들의 공사연회 및 사대부의 혼례시 신부가 시부모를 뵐 때 유밀과 사용을 금함.
t: Prohibited the use of yumilgwa at public and private banquets of officials and when brides of the sadaebu paid respects to their parents-in-law at weddings.

src: 충의위(忠義衛)를 설치하여 개국(開國), 정사(定社), 좌명공신(佐命功臣) 자손들을 소속시킴
t: Established the Chunguiwi (忠義衛) and enrolled the descendants of the Merit Subjects of the Founding of the Dynasty (開國), the Stabilization of the State (定社), and the Assistance to the Throne (佐命功臣).

src: 의녀를 임시로 둠.
t: Temporarily established female physicians (醫女).

src: 대소사신이 관기를 간하는 것을 금함.
t: Prohibited envoys of high and low rank from having relations with government kisaeng.

src: 송(宋)의 고사에 따라 날을 달로 바꾸어 담제를 지내고 혼인하는 것을 금하지 않음.(상기단축(喪期短縮))
t: Following the precedent of Song, days were converted to months for holding the damje, and marriage was not prohibited. (Shortening of the mourning period)

src: 삼군도체찰사(三軍都體察使) 이종무(李從茂)가 이끄는 병선 227척, 조선군 17,000여명이 대마도 정벌을 위해 거제도 출항. (대마도정벌)
t: Yi Jong-mu, the Samgun Dochechalsa, led 227 warships and over 17,000 Joseon troops departing from Geoje Island to conquer Tsushima. (Conquest of Tsushima)

src: 더럽고 찢어진 저화(楮貨)라도 도장이 명백히 찍혀있는 것은 계속 통용하게 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Even dirty and torn jeohwa (楮貨) currency continued to be circulated as long as the stamp was clearly imprinted. Annals of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 광주(廣州)는 한양과 가까워 사무가 복잡한 반면 관노비의 숫자가 적으니, 관기(官妓)를 없애주기를 형조(刑曹)에서 요청하므로, 이를 따름
t: Since Gwangju (廣州) was close to Hanyang and its administrative affairs were complicated while the number of government slaves was small, the Ministry of Justice (刑曹) requested that government gisaeng (官妓) be abolished, and this was followed.

src: 태조(太祖)와 태종(太宗)이 준 노비 중에서 선공감(繕工監)이 2명을 빼앗아 이장(泥匠)을 만들었으니 돌려주거나 다른 노비로 보충해 달라고 흥덕사(興德社)의 중이 주장하므로 이를 따름
t: A monk of Heungdeoksa (興德社) argued that among the slaves granted by Taejo (太祖) and Taejong (太宗), the Office of Construction (繕工監) had seized two and made them mud plasterers (泥匠), and requested that they be returned or replaced with other slaves, and this was followed.

src: 부재위모상(父在爲母喪)은 고제에 따라서 십일월이연, 십삼월이상, 십오월이담, 심상(心喪) 3년으로 정함.
t: For mourning for a mother while the father is alive (父在爲母喪), it was determined according to ancient rites that the yeon rite be held at the 11th month, the sang rite at the 13th month, the dam rite at the 15th month, and simsang (心喪) mourning last three years.

src: 형조(刑曹)에서 여러 역(驛)의 전운노(轉運奴)에 대해서 아룀
t: The Ministry of Justice (刑曹) reported on the transport slaves (轉運奴) of the various post stations (驛).

src: 각 관청의 노비를 신고하여 상으로 받았던 사람은 본인이 죽은 뒤 6개월 이내에 관청에 신고하게 함
t: Those who had received rewards for reporting slaves of the various government offices were made to report to the office within 6 months after the person himself died.

src: 지금부터 노비가 주인을 고발하면 그 고발을 받아들이지 말고 노비를 목베어 죽이라고 허조(許稠)가 아룀
t: Heo Jo (許稠) reported that from now on, if a slave accused his master, the accusation should not be accepted and the slave should be beheaded.

src: 중외의 효자, 절부, 의부, 순손의 소재를 찾도록 하교하자 그 실적이 수백 명이 됨.
t: When an order was given to search for filial sons, chaste wives, righteous husbands, and obedient grandsons throughout the capital and provinces, the results reached several hundred people.

src: 지금 사대부집에서 노복(奴僕)을 시켜 장사하기를 힘쓰고 있어 염치가 없어진다고 김맹성(金孟誠)이 아뢰니, 조정 사대부의 노예(奴隷)가 장사하는 것을 관찰사가 징계하라고 결정
t: Kim Maeng-seong (金孟誠) reported that nowadays scholar-official households were making efforts to have their servants (奴僕) engage in trade, causing a loss of shame, and it was decided that provincial governors should discipline the slaves (奴隷) of court scholar-officials who engaged in trade.

src: 병조에서 ≪진도법(陣圖法)≫을 지어서 올림.
t: The Ministry of War compiled and submitted the Jindobeop (陣圖法).

src: 각 도의 군사를 오위(五衛)에 나누어 소속시킴.
t: The soldiers of each province were divided and assigned to the Five Guards (五衛).

src: 왕자, 왕녀을 외가에서 양육시키던 것을 모두 궁중에서 양육하게 함.
t: Princes and princesses, who had been raised at their maternal relatives' homes, were now all raised within the palace.

src: 승려들의 법손노비(法孫奴婢)를 관청에 소속시키자는 형조(刑曹)의 아룀을 세종이 상왕인 태종에게 보고함
t: King Sejong reported to the retired king Taejong (太宗) the Ministry of Justice's (刑曹) proposal to place the beopson slaves (法孫奴婢) of monks under government offices.

src: 국장 때는 고제에 따라서 궁인이 곡종(哭從)하고, 대신 예장(禮葬)에는 집안의 노비를 사용하게 함.
t: At state funerals, according to ancient rites, palace attendants wailed in procession (哭從), while at the funerals of high officials (禮葬), the slaves of the household were used instead.

src: 나누어 준 왜노비(倭奴婢)는 그들이 안심하도록 힘쓰고, 흉악한 자가 혹 난잡하게 놀아나거나 그들끼리 개인적으로 통하는 자가 있을 때에는 주인이 관가에 고발하여 죄를 줄 것을 명령함
t: It was ordered that efforts be made to put at ease the distributed Japanese slaves (倭奴婢), and that if any vicious person behaved licentiously or had private dealings among themselves, the master should report them to the government office to be punished.

src: 태상왕에게 이직의 딸과 이운로의 딸을 바침.
t: The daughters of Yi Jik and Yi Un-ro were offered to Taesangwang (太上王).

src: 태종이 죽자, 후궁 의빈 권씨, 신녕궁주 신씨 등이 삭발하고 여승이 됨.
t: When Taejong died, royal concubines Uibin Lady Gwon and Sinnyeong-gungju Lady Sin, among others, shaved their heads and became Buddhist nuns.

src: 황해도, 평안도, 함경도, 강원도 등에 흉년과 기근으로 수많은 유민이 발생함
t: In Hwanghae-do, Pyeongan-do, Hamgyeong-do, Gangwon-do, and other regions, a great number of displaced people arose due to bad harvests and famine.

src: 흉년인 까닭에 여러 관청의 노비들의 급료를 쌀로서 주게 하니, 편하게 여김
t: Because of the bad harvest, the salaries of the slaves of the various government offices were given in rice, which was considered convenient.

src: 노비가 주인을 고발한 자는 그 고발을 받지 말고 무고죄에 의거하여 교수형에 처하며, 여자 종의 남편과 남자 종의 아내가 주인을 고발한 자는 고발을 받지 말고 곤장 100대, 3천리 유배에 처할 것을 결정
t: It was decided that if a slave accused his master, the accusation should not be accepted and he should be executed by hanging on the charge of false accusation, and if the husband of a female slave or the wife of a male slave accused the master, the accusation should not be accepted and they should be punished with 100 strokes of the cane and exile of 3,000 li.

src: 각 관청의 노비들이 전농시(典農寺) 소속의 누락된 노비를 신고하여 그 공으로 모두 신역(身役)을 면제받는데, 이들은 모두 한양에 거주하고 잘사는 자들이니 앞으로는 상을 주되 신역을 면제시키지 말 것을 전농시제조(典農
t: Slaves of the various government offices reported the omitted slaves belonging to the Jeonnongsi (典農寺) and were all exempted from body labor duties (身役) as a reward for this, but since these were all wealthy people residing in Hanyang, the Jeonnongsi jejo (典農

src: 과부들의 강제삭발을 금함.
t: Forced head-shaving of widows was prohibited.

src: 혼인 자장(資粧)의 사치를 금함.
t: Extravagance in marriage trousseau (資粧) was prohibited.

src: 동교에 무녀들이 모여서 3일 동안 기우함.
t: Shamans gathered at Donggyo and prayed for rain for three days.

src: 지방에 의녀를 두고 선상기녀의 예에 따라 봉족을 주도록 함.
t: Female physicians (醫女) were placed in the provinces, and support households (奉足) were provided to them according to the precedent for seonsang gisaeng (選上妓女).

src: 궁중여악을 정지하고 관습도감의 기녀 108명을 자원에 따라 방송함.
t: Court female music performances were suspended, and 108 gisaeng of the Gwanseupdogam were released from bondage according to their wishes.

src: 제생원 의녀 가운데 나이가 어리고 영특한 3, 4명을 뽑아 교훈시킴.
t: A few especially bright young female physicians, three or four in number, were selected from Jesaengwon for instruction.

src: 각 도에 진헌색별감 및 내사를 보내어 처녀를 뽑아올리게 함.
t: Special envoys of the Tribute Bureau and palace messengers were dispatched to each province to select virgin girls for presentation.

src: 사족부녀 중 범죄에 관련된 자를 잡아다가 신문하지는 못하게 함.
t: Women of the sajok (gentry) families implicated in crimes were no longer to be seized and interrogated.

src: 진문사 민원생이 명에서 돌아와 처녀진헌으로 중외에 혼인을 금하고 진헌색을 설치함.
t: Envoy Min Won-saeng returned from Ming, and marriage was banned throughout the capital and provinces for the tribute of virgin women, and the Tribute Bureau was established.

src: 함경도 익군(翼軍) 7,046명의 편제를 함흥도(咸興道), 길주도(吉州道), 화주도(和州道)로 나누고 각 3익으로 편성함.
t: The 7,046 troops of the Ikgun in Hamgyong Province were reorganized into Hamheung-do, Gilju-do, and Hwaju-do, each divided into three ik.

src: 경상도와 전라도에 주전소(鑄錢所)를 설치함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Mints were established in Gyeongsang and Jeolla Provinces.

src: 평안도 익군(翼軍)의 편제를 조정하여 평양도(平壤道), 안주도(安州道), 의주도(義州道), 삭주도(朔州道), 강계도(江界道)로 나누어 각 3익으로 편성함.
t: The organization of the Ikgun in Pyeongan Province was adjusted and divided into Pyeongan-do, Anju-do, Uiju-do, Sakju-do, and Ganggye-do, each formed into three ik.

src: 각품 첩 소생에게는 춘추 도목 시험만을 허락함.
t: Children born of concubines of officials of each rank were permitted only the spring and autumn dogmok examinations.

src: 선상노비(選上奴婢)의 폐단을 구제하는 조건을 형조(刑曹)에서 아룀(선상노비(選上奴婢) 구제조건)
t: The Ministry of Punishments reported measures to relieve the hardships of seonsang nobi.

src: 각 관청의 노비공(奴婢貢)을 1426년(세종 8년)을 한하여 반액으로 감액할 것을 호조(戶曹)에 지시함
t: The Ministry of Taxation was instructed to reduce the nobi-gong of each government office by half, limited to the year 1426 (King Sejong's 8th year).

src: 동 1근 가격을 조선통보(朝鮮通寶) 1백 30문으로 정함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: The price of one geun of copper was set at 130 mun of Joseon Tongbo.

src: 동전을 사용하지 않고 물품화폐로 거래하는 자는 경시서에 잡아 가두게 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Those who traded using goods as currency instead of copper coins were to be arrested and imprisoned by the Gyeongsiseo.

src: 경시서의 가혹한 법 운영으로 가죽신장이(갖바치) 이상좌(李上左)가 자살함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Due to the harsh enforcement of the law by the Gyeongsiseo, the leather shoemaker Lee Sang-jwa committed suicide.

src: 경외에 혼인을 금하고 진헌색을 설치함.
t: Marriage was banned in the capital and provinces, and the Tribute Bureau was established.

src: 경외의 공처비자에게 산후 100일의 휴가를 줌.
t: Government-owned female slaves in the capital and provinces were granted 100 days of leave after childbirth.

src: 화적 이금도(李金道)가 능지처참 당함
t: The bandit Lee Geum-do was executed by dismemberment.

src: 음성에서 잡힌 화적 도자(道者)가 처벌됨
t: The bandit Doja, captured in Eumseong, was punished.

src: 화적 여경(余慶)이 사로잡혀 수레에 매달아 찢어 죽이는 형벌을 당함
t: The bandit Yeo Gyeong was captured and executed by being torn apart by carts.

src: 화적 송오마지(宋吾魔知)가 수레에 매달아 찢어 죽이는 형벌을 당함
t: The bandit Song Oma-ji was executed by being torn apart by carts.

src: 진헌의 처녀들이 명으로 출발함.
t: The virgin girls for tribute departed for Ming.

src: 화적 이동(李同)이 참형을 당함
t: The bandit Lee Dong was beheaded.

src: 정녕(定寧)의 화적 유원(劉元)이 참형을 당함
t: The bandit Yu Won of Jeongnyeong was beheaded.

src: 홍주(洪州)의 화적 박무(朴茂)가 참형을 당함
t: The bandit Park Mu of Hongju was beheaded.

src: 주자가례(朱子家禮)에 의하여 여자 14세이상 20세 내외에 모두 혼인하게 함.
t: According to Master Zhu's Family Rites, all women aged 14 and above, around 20, were made to marry.

src: 각 관청의 노비로서 나이 66세가 된 사람은 역(役)을 면제해 줄 것을 형조(刑曹)에서 청하니, 임금이 60세가 넘으면 역(役)을 없애는 것이 옳을 것이라고 하고 의논하여 아뢰라고 명령함
t: The Ministry of Justice requested that slaves belonging to each government office who had reached 66 years of age be exempted from labor duty; the king said that it would be right to remove labor duty for those over 60, and ordered that it be discussed and reported.

src: 처녀진헌으로 중외의 혼가를 금함.
t: Because of the presentation of virgins as tribute, marriages inside and outside the capital were prohibited.

src: 황해도에서 재인(才人)과 화척 등 천민 신분 출신인 신백정(新白丁)에 의한 폭동이 일어나 토호(土豪)와 부상(富商)들의 집을 습격하고 재물을 약탈함
t: In Hwanghae-do, a riot broke out by entertainers, butchers, and other new commoners (sinbaekjeong) of lowborn status, who attacked the houses of local powerful families and wealthy merchants and plundered their property.

src: 공노비(公奴婢)의 소량(訴良)은 일을 잘 아는 자 2, 3명으로 하여금 이를 분별하여 밝히게 하고, 양민(良民)이라는 판결이 내릴 때까지는 그 관청이 부리도록 함
t: For petitions of public slaves seeking commoner status, two or three persons well versed in the matter were made to examine and clarify it, and until a ruling of commoner status was given, the relevant office was to employ them.

src: 후손이 없이 죽은 사노비의 가산은 태종 14년 7월의 “후손이 없이 죽은 노비가 소유한 노비는 주인이 부리는 것을 허락하고, 상속문서가 있는 경우 예외로 한다”는 규정에 의해 처리할 것을 결정함
t: It was decided that the estate of a private slave who died without descendants would be handled according to the regulation of the 7th month of the 14th year of King Taejong's reign, which states, "Slaves owned by a slave who died without descendants shall be permitted for the master to employ, except in cases where there is a document of inheritance."

src: 황해도의 각 관청에서 뽑아 올린 노비 중에 여자는 많고 남자는 적으며, 부강(富强)한 남자종은 한양에 거주하는 노비의 봉족(奉足)이 되고 가난한 자만 번상(番上)함으로써 고생스러워 도망간다고 형조(刑曹)에서 보고함
t: The Ministry of Justice reported that among the slaves selected and sent up by each government office in Hwanghae-do, women were many and men were few, and that strong and wealthy male slaves became bongjok (supporting households) for slaves residing in Hanyang, while only the poor served in rotation, suffering hardship and running away.

src: 죽산현(竹山縣)에 살던 박포(朴苞)의 아내가 자기의 종과 간통하다가 이를 알게 된 우두머리 종을 죽여 연못 속에 집어 넣었으며, 시체가 드러나자 한양로 도망가 황희(黃喜)의 집에 토굴을 파고 숨어 지내며 황희와 간통
t: The wife of Bak Po, who lived in Juksan-hyeon, committed adultery with her own slave, and when the head slave found out, she killed him and threw him into a pond; when the body was discovered, she fled to Hanyang and hid in a dugout at the house of Hwang Hui, committing adultery with Hwang Hui.

src: 휘빈 김씨를 사제로 내쫓음.
t: Lady Kim, the Crown Princess Consort, was expelled to a private residence.

src: 봉씨를 왕세자 순빈에 봉함.
t: Lady Bong was invested as the Crown Prince's consort, Sunbin.

src: 대소인원의 가묘제례법을 정함.
t: The rites for ancestral shrine ceremonies for officials of high and low rank were established.

src: 세자빈 김씨를 폐하여 서인으로 함.
t: Crown Princess Consort Lady Kim was deposed and reduced to commoner status.

src: 천자수모법(賤者隨母法)을 다시 시행함.
t: The law by which the lowborn status followed the mother (cheonjasumobeop) was reinstated.

src: 명으로 뽑혀 가는 가무녀 8명, 집찬녀 12명, 소화자 6명에 대한 송별연을 베풀음.
t: A farewell banquet was held for the 8 dancing girls, 12 cooking girls, and 6 young eunuchs selected to be sent to Ming.

src: 대소명부의 봉작을 개정함.
t: The system of titles of nobility for the wives of officials of high and low rank was revised.

src: 대소인원의 처부모의 복상을 시마로 정함.
t: The mourning period for the parents-in-law of officials of high and low rank was set at three months (sima).

src: 공사비자에게 산월 및 산후 백일 동안 면역하게 함.
t: Public and private female slaves were exempted from labor for the month of childbirth and for 100 days after childbirth.

src: 공신적실 및 양첩무자자, 천첩장자 외에 중자에게 충의위에 속하지 못하도록 함.
t: Aside from the legitimate sons of meritorious subjects, the sons without heirs of commoner concubines, and the eldest sons of lowborn concubines, other sons were not permitted to belong to the Loyal Righteousness Guard (Chunguiwi).

src: 부녀자들이 외출할 때는 얼굴을 옹폐하도록 함.
t: Women were made to cover their faces when going out.

src: 만경현(萬頃縣) 사람인 사노(私奴) 김봉(金奉)이 장문핵(張文翮)과 노비(奴婢)를 다투었는데, 장문핵이 한 마을 사람 김소남(金召南)과 더불어 공모하여 김봉을 살해하고 그의 재물을 탈취함
t: Kim Bong, a private slave from Manggyeong-hyeon, had a dispute over slaves with Jang Munhyeok; Jang Munhyeok conspired with a fellow villager, Kim Sonam, to kill Kim Bong and seize his property.

src: 양반부녀들의 대면(對面)을 제한함.
t: Face-to-face meetings of women of the yangban class were restricted.

src: 부녀상사(婦女上寺), 음사(淫祠)를 금지하도록 함.
t: Women's visits to temples (busangsang) and to shrines of illicit worship (eumsa) were prohibited.

src: 명화적(明火賊)사개무지(沙介無知)를 붙잡음
t: The armed bandit Sagae Muji was captured.

src: 부녀들의 광화문 및 영제교정(永濟橋庭), 근정전정(勤政殿庭) 출입을 금함.
t: Women were prohibited from entering Gwanghwamun, the courtyard of Yeongjegyo, and the courtyard of Geunjeongjeon.

src: 종실의 제군(諸君), 원윤(元尹), 정윤(正尹), 공신 및 시산일품(時散一品) 이하의 정처 봉작은 모두 남편의 직을 따르게 함.
t: For the various princes of the royal clan, wonyun, jeongyun, meritorious subjects, and those of the incumbent and retired first rank and below, the titles of their principal wives were all made to follow their husbands' ranks.

src: 양반부녀들이 무격(巫覡)가에 왕래하는 것을 금함.
t: Women of the yangban class were prohibited from visiting the houses of shamans.

src: 회례 시에 여악 대신 남악을 사용하게 함.
t: Ordered that male musicians be used instead of female musicians at reception ceremonies.

src: 사신들이 내왕할 때 부녀들의 상사를 엄금함.
t: Strictly banned women from meeting with envoys when they came and went.

src: 양반부녀들이 평교자(平轎子) 타는 것을 금함.
t: Banned yangban women from riding pyeonggyoja (flat sedan chairs).

src: 삼군도총제부(三軍都摠制府)를 혁파하고 중추원(中樞院)을 설치하여 소속 관원을 옮겨 소속시킴.
t: Abolished the Samgundochongjebu and established the Jungchuwon, transferring its officials into it.

src: 2품 이상 처는 청색 유옥교자(有屋轎子)를, 3품 이하 처는 흑색 유옥교자를 타도록 함.
t: Ordered that wives of officials of the second rank and above ride blue-roofed sedan chairs (yuokgyoja), while wives of officials of the third rank and below ride black-roofed sedan chairs.

src: 공사비(公私婢)가 양인 남편에게 시집 가서 낳은 자식을 양민으로 하는 법을 어떻게 할지에 대해서 의논함
t: Discussed how to handle the law making children born to public and private slave women who married commoner husbands into commoners.

src: 경중 무녀를 성문 밖으로 추방함.
t: Expelled female shamans in the capital beyond the city gates.

src: 경중 여기(女妓) 소생을 종부하여 양인 되게 함.
t: Made children born to female entertainers in the capital follow their father's status to become commoners.

src: 판중추부사 하경복(河敬復) 등이 왕명에 따라 ≪진서(陣書)≫를 편찬하여 올림.
t: Panjungchubusa Ha Gyeong-bok and others compiled and presented the Jinseo by royal command.

src: 중추원 부서 이맹진으로 하여금 집찬비자(執饌婢子) 20명을 데리고 가게 함.
t: Had Jungchuwon Busa Yi Maeng-jin take along 20 kitchen maidservants.

src: 명부(命婦)의 인신(印信: 도장) 및 대소인의 안자(鞍子:안장)의 제도를 정함.
t: Established regulations for the seals of myeongbu (women of court rank) and the saddles of officials of high and low rank.

src: 한 번에 4개의 화살을 한꺼번에 쏠 수 있는 새로운 화포전(火砲箭)을 시험 발사함.
t: Test-fired a new hwapojeon capable of shooting four arrows at once.

src: 금후부터 중궁을 왕비로 왕녀를 공주라 부르게 함.
t: Ordered that from now on the jungung be called wangbi (queen) and the king's daughters be called gongju (princess).

src: 왕자, 왕녀의 혼인은 고제에 따라서 친영주의(親迎儀注)케 함.
t: Ordered that the marriages of princes and princesses follow the chinyeong rite according to ancient regulations.

src: 노비를 매매하는 자가 많으나 값이 서로 다르니, 그 값을
t: There were many who bought and sold slaves, but their prices differed, so the price

src: 잔인하고 포학한 무리들이 노비를 고소(告訴)하지 않고 함부로 때려 죽이니 지금부터 노비가 죄가 있더라도 법에 따라 형벌을 주도록 하고, 제 마음대로 형벌을 가하는 자는 이웃과 오가장(五家長)이 고발하게 함
t: Since cruel and tyrannical people beat slaves to death without reporting them, it was ordered that from now on, even if a slave was guilty, punishment be given according to law, and that neighbors and the ogajang report those who inflicted punishment arbitrarily.

src: 가난하여 혼인하지 못한 자는 관에서 자장(資粧)을 지급하게 함.
t: Had the government provide wedding supplies to those too poor to marry.

src: 평안도여연성(閭延城)을 포위 공격한 오량합(吾良哈) 기병 2,700여 명을 격퇴함.
t: Repelled over 2,700 Oryanghap cavalry who besieged and attacked Yeoyeon-seong in Pyeongan-do.

src: 파원군 윤평이 숙신옹주(태종 후궁 이씨소생)에 친영함. 이후부터 친영이 시작됨.
t: Pawongun Yun Pyeong performed chinyeong with Suksin-ongju, daughter of King Taejong's concubine Lady Yi. Chinyeong began from this time.

src: 계모(繼母)가 나누지 않은 노비는, 반은 의자(義子)에게 주고 반은 사촌에 한하여 나누어 주되 노비가 하나만 있는 사람은 의자(義子)에게 줄 것을 상정소(詳定所)에서 아뢰니, 이를 따름
t: The Sangjeongso reported that slaves not divided by a stepmother should be given half to the uija and half divided among cousins, but if there was only one slave, it should be given to the uija; this was followed.

src: 삼송정 임귀지(三松亭 林貴枝) 출생
t: Birth of Im Gwi-ji of Samsongjeong.

src: 의화군 영(瓔)이 박중손의 딸에 친영함.
t: Uihwagun Yeong performed chinyeong with the daughter of Bak Jung-son.

src: 왕세자빈 봉씨를 폐하여 서인이 되게 함.
t: Deposed Crown Princess Consort Bong, making her a commoner.

src: 세자의 가례색을 없애고 책봉도감을 세움.
t: Abolished the Garyesaek for the crown prince and established the Chaekbong Dogam.

src: 함경도경원(鏡源) 읍성을 포위 공격한 올적합(兀狄哈) 3천여명을 격퇴함.
t: Repelled over 3,000 Oljeokhap who besieged and attacked the town wall of Gyeongwon in Hamgyeong-do.

src: 사대부의 처로서 세번 시집간 자는 사헌부에서 자녀안(恣女案)에 기록하여 후세에 징계하도록 함.
t: Wives of sadaebu who married three times were recorded in the Janyeoan (恣女案) by the Office of the Inspector-General to serve as a warning for later generations.

src: 한양에 선상(選上)하는 노비들은 그 괴로움을 견디지 못하여 6개월에 면포(綿布) 15필을 주고 사람을 사서 대신 선상하게 하는데, 이로 인해 소, 말, 토지 등을 저당잡히거나 팔고 있음
t: Slaves selected for service in Hanyang could not endure the hardship, so they paid 15 pil of cotton cloth every six months to hire someone to serve in their stead, and because of this they were mortgaging or selling cattle, horses, and land.

src: 계양군 증이 중추원사 한확의 딸에 친영함.
t: Gyeyanggun Jeung performed the chinyeong marriage rite with the daughter of Han Hwak, the Jungchuwonsa.

src: 금성대군 유가 참찬 최사강의 딸에게 친영함.
t: Geumseong Daegun Yu performed the chinyeong marriage rite with the daughter of Choe Sagang, the Chamchan.

src: 여진족 기병 3천여명이 평안도벽동(碧潼)에 침입하여 목책을 불지르고 철수함.
t: About 3,000 Jurchen cavalry invaded Byeokdong in Pyeongan-do, burned the wooden stockade, and withdrew.

src: 평안도 도절제사 이천(李蕆)이 군사 7천여명을 이끌고 압록강 건너 여진족을 토벌함.
t: Yi Cheon, the Military Commander of Pyeongan-do, led about 7,000 troops across the Yalu River to subjugate the Jurchens.
