src: 공법(貢法)의 시행을 두고 경중과 외방에서 신문고를 울리고 상언(上言)하며 저항함
t: Regarding the implementation of the Gongbeop, people in the capital and the provinces rang the Sinmungo and submitted petitions in protest.

src: 소혜왕후 한씨 출생함.
t: Queen Sohye, Lady Han, was born.

src: 평원대군 임이 홍이용의 딸에 친영함.
t: Pyeongwon Daegun Im performed the chinyeong marriage rite with the daughter of Hong Iyong.

src: 향화인의 여진 처를 취한 자는 공사비가양부소생녀(公私婢嫁良夫所生女)와 같이 급하도록 함.
t: Those who took Jurchen wives of naturalized subjects (hyanghwain) were to be treated the same as the daughters born of public or private female slaves married to commoner men.

src: 죄를 짓고 적몰(籍沒)되어 관청 노비가 된 자는 나이에 상관없이 종신토록 사역하고 있으니, 이들도 나이 60이 되면 노역을 면제할 것을 의정부(議政府)에 명령함
t: The State Council was ordered that those who had committed crimes and had their property confiscated to become government slaves, who had been serving for life regardless of age, should be exempted from labor once they reached the age of 60.

src: 허백당 홍귀달(虛白堂 洪貴達) 출생
t: Heobaekdang Hong Gwidal was born.

src: 의창군 강이 직장 김수의 딸에 친영함.
t: Uichanggun Gang performed the chinyeong marriage rite with the daughter of Kim Su, the Jikjang.

src: 부인삼범자(婦人三犯者)는 죄에 따라서 과죄토록 함.
t: Women who committed offenses three times were to be punished according to the severity of their crimes.

src: 양천간에 서로 혼인한 자는 이혼시킨 후 입송하게 함.
t: Those who intermarried between commoners and slaves were to be divorced and then sent back.

src: 각사노비추쇄색(各司奴婢推刷色)이 관청의 노비를 추쇄(推刷)하는 합당한 조건을 아룀
t: The Gaksa Nobi Chusoesaek reported appropriate conditions for investigating and reclaiming government slaves.

src: 효령대군(孝寧大君)의 가노(家奴)인 승재(升才)와 난봉(難奉)이 떠돌아다니는 자 340여 명을 불러들이고 승재가 또 60여 호를 차지하여, 부리기를 노예와 같이 하고 빼앗기를 한이 없이 함
t: Seungjae and Nanbong, household slaves of Hyoryeong Daegun, gathered in more than 340 vagrants, and Seungjae also seized more than 60 households, treating them like slaves and plundering without limit.

src: 평안도여연(閭延)과 벽동(碧潼)에 평안도와 황해도 장정을 동원하여 장성(長城)과 석보(石堡) 축조를 시작함
t: Able-bodied men from Pyeongan-do and Hwanghae-do were mobilized to Yeonyeon and Byeokdong in Pyeongan-do to begin construction of long walls and stone forts.

src: 잡색군(雜色軍) 체제를 정비함.
t: The Japsaekgun system was reorganized.

src: 화초(火鞘)를 개발하여 평안도와 함길도에 배치함.
t: Hwacho (火鞘) were developed and deployed to Pyeongan-do and Hamgil-do.

src: 왕비가 사정전에서 215명의 부녀들에게 양노연을 베풀음.
t: The Queen held a Yangnoyeon feast for 215 women at Sajeongjeon.

src: 출가녀는 부모의 죄에 따르지 않고 남편을 따라 면죄하게 함.
t: Married women were not held liable for their parents' crimes but were exempted following their husbands.

src: 함길도와 강원도의 역부 23,000명을 동원하여 함길도 온성부(穩城府)의 행성(行城)을 축조함.
t: 23,000 laborers from Hamgil-do and Gangwon-do were mobilized to construct the haengseong of Onseong-bu in Hamgil-do.

src: 노비를 신고하여 상으로 받은 자가 상을 받은 후에 노비가 낳은 소생을 부리고 있으니, 이들 소생들은 모두 공적(公籍)에 붙일 것을 추쇄색(推刷色)에서 아뢰니, 이를 따름
t: Those who reported slaves and received them as rewards were using the children born to those slaves after receiving the reward, so the Chusoesaek reported that these children should all be registered in the public register, and this was followed.

src: 함길도 역부를 차출하여 온성(穩城)과 종성(鍾城)에 행성(行城)을 축조함
t: Laborers were levied from Hamgil-do to construct haengseong at Onseong and Jongseong.

src: 대소종친은 같은 종친이 아니더라도 이성(李姓)과 혼인하지 못하게 함.
t: Ordered that great and lesser members of the royal clan, even if not of the same clan, be prohibited from marrying persons of the Yi surname.

src: 평안도 우예(虞芮), 자성(慈城), 강계(江界) 등지에 행성(行城)과 석보(石堡)를 수축함.
t: Constructed defensive walls (haengseong) and stone forts (seokbo) in Uye, Jaseong, Ganggye, and other areas of Pyeongan Province.

src: 노비를 뇌물로 바치는 경우가 많으니, 수양자(收養子), 시양자(侍養子), 동성의 친척, 이성친척 등의 한정됨 범위를 제외하고는 노비를 주고 받는 일을 일체 금지함
t: As bribery involving slaves occurred frequently, prohibited the giving and receiving of slaves entirely except within the limited scope of adopted sons (suyangja), foster sons (siyangja), relatives of the same surname, and relatives of different surnames.

src: 자식 없이 죽은 아내의 노비는 남편이 부리다가 남편이 죽은 뒤에는 후처(後妻)에게서 난 승중장자(承重長子)에게 3분의 1을 주게 하는 등 자식 없이 죽은 아내의 노비에 대한 상속 규정을 마련함
t: Established inheritance regulations for the slaves of a wife who died without children: the husband would use them during his lifetime, and after his death, one-third would be given to the seungjungjangja (heir continuing the ancestral rites) born of the second wife.

src: 안동부사 안완경(安完慶) 부임
t: Ahn Wan-gyeong took office as magistrate of Andong.

src: 새해 나례만 제하고 여악 대신에 모두 남악을 사용하게 함.
t: Ordered that, except for the New Year exorcism rites, male performers be used in place of female entertainers for all performances.

src: 함길도 도절제사 김효성(金孝誠)이 병거(兵車)를 이용한 병법을 시행할 것을 주장.
t: Kim Hyo-seong, army commander of Hamgil Province, argued for implementing military tactics using war chariots.

src: 평안도와 황해도의 정부(丁夫) 9,000명을 동원하여 창성군(昌城郡)에 행성(行城)과 석보(石堡)를 축조함
t: Mobilized 9,000 laborers from Pyeongan and Hwanghae Provinces to construct defensive walls (haengseong) and stone forts (seokbo) in Changseong County.

src: 함경도에서 5진(鎭)의 입거(入居) 문제로 와언(訛言)이 떠돌자 민심이 안정되지 못함
t: Public sentiment in Hamgyeong Province was unsettled as rumors spread concerning the issue of relocating people into the Five Garrisons (five jin).

src: 밀성군 침이 풍저창사 민승서의 딸에 친영함.
t: Chim, Prince Milseong, held the formal wedding ceremony (chinyeong) for the daughter of Min Seung-seo, director of the Punggeochang.

src: 여승이 죽립(竹笠) 쓰는 것과 대소부녀가 평교자 타는 것을 엄금함.
t: Strictly prohibited Buddhist nuns from wearing bamboo hats and both high and low-ranking women from riding pyeonggyoja (flat sedan chairs).

src: 궁녀 45명을 방출함.
t: Released 45 court ladies.

src: 각도의 선상노자(選上奴子)의 입번(立番)을 아전이 담당하여 뇌물을 받고 순서를 조작하니 의정부(議政府)에서 그에 대한 대책을 제시함
t: As clerks in charge of the rotation duty (ipbeon) of selected slaves (seonsang noja) from each province took bribes and manipulated the order, the State Council (Uijeongbu) proposed countermeasures.

src: 화포 제조를 전담하기 위해 사표국(司豹局)을 설치함.
t: Established the Sapyoguk to exclusively oversee the manufacture of firearms.

src: 각 도에 감련관(監鍊官)을 파견하여 새로 정한 제도에 따라 화포를 주조하도록 함.
t: Dispatched supervising officials (gamnyeon-gwan) to each province to have firearms cast according to the newly established regulations.

src: 총통군의 강화를 위해 별군(別軍)과 별도로 총통위(銃筒衛)를 설치하여 병조에 소속시켜 총통 연습을 전담하게 함.
t: To strengthen the firearms troops, established the Chongtongwi separately from the Special Corps (Byeolgun) and placed it under the Ministry of War to exclusively handle firearms training.

src: 의정부의 건의로 저화(楮貨)를 다시 사용하여 녹봉을 저화(楮貨)로 지급하고, 각 관청의 물품을 저화(楮貨)로 구입하게 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: On the recommendation of the State Council (Uijeongbu), resumed the use of paper currency (jeohwa), paying salaries in jeohwa and having government offices purchase goods with jeohwa.

src: 한양과 지방의 기생이 유품(流品)과 조관(朝官)에게 시집가서 낳은 자식은, 아버지의 소원에 따라 나이가 비슷한 노비로써 속신(贖身)하여 천인을 면하게 함
t: Ordered that children born to gisaeng in the capital and provinces who married officials of the civil-official ranks (yupum) or court officials (jogwan) be redeemed from bondage (soksin) according to the father's wish, using a slave of similar age, and thereby be freed from lowborn status.

src: 각 관청의 노비(奴婢)의 신공(身貢)을 연분법(年分法)을 사용하여, 거주하는 주군(州郡)이 하하년(下下年)이면 그 공(貢)을 면제하고 하중년(下中年) 이상이 되면 징수하는 것이 어떻겠는가를 의논하게 함
t: Discussed whether to apply the annual grading system (yeonbunbeop) to the tribute labor payments (sin-gong) of slaves of government offices, exempting the tribute if the residing prefecture or county was graded ha-ha-nyeon (lowest grade), and collecting it if graded ha-jung-nyeon (middle-low grade) or above.

src: 부녀자의 상사(上寺)를 엄금함.
t: Strictly prohibited women from visiting temples (sangsa).

src: 2품이상 사람의 천첩(賤妾)의 자손에게도 속신(贖身)하는 것을 허락할 것을 의정부(議政府)에서 아뢰니, 이를 따름
t: The State Council (Uijeongbu) reported and it was approved that the descendants of lowborn concubines (cheomcheop) of persons of the second rank and above also be permitted to redeem themselves from bondage (soksin).

src: 1446년 흉년과 부세수취 증가로 평안도 여러 지방의 농민들이 무장하고 평양 대성산에 모여, 폭정을 행하는 관리를 처단함. 여기에는 농민뿐만 아니라 노비나 향리 등 여러 계층의 사람들이 광범위하게 참여했으며 1447
t: In 1446, due to famine and increased tax collection, farmers in various regions of Pyeongan Province armed themselves and gathered at Daeseongsan in Pyeongyang, executing officials who carried out tyrannical governance. Not only farmers but also slaves, local clerks (hyangni), and people of various other classes participated broadly, and this continued into 1447.

src: 풍기현감 김상례(金相禮) 부임
t: Kim Sang-rye took office as magistrate of Punggi County.

src: 각 도에 ≪진도(陣圖)≫와 ≪진설(陣說)≫을 배포하여 이를 익히게 함.
t: Distributed the Jindo and Jinseol to each province to have them studied.

src: 총통의 제작 및 사용 방법을 기록한
t: Recorded the methods of manufacturing and using firearms.

src: 갑사(甲士), 별시위(別侍衛), 방패(防牌), 섭육십(攝六十), 근장(近杖), 잡색군(雜色軍)의 군사 수를 늘리고 5번으로 나누어 4개월마다 교대하게 함.
t: Increased the number of soldiers of Gapsa (甲士), Byeolsiwi (別侍衛), Bangpae (防牌), Seopyuksip (攝六十), Geunjang (近杖), and Japsaekgun (雜色軍), and divided them into 5 groups to rotate every 4 months.

src: 의정부에서 정업원(淨業院)을 혁파하고 노비와 토지를 처리할 것을 상소하니, 뒤에 한양에 있는 노비 484명과 주현(州縣)에 산재해 있는 노비 3,025명을 전농시(典農寺)에 소속시킴
t: The State Council (Uijeongbu) memorialized that Jeongeobwon (淨業院) be abolished and its slaves and land disposed of; later, 484 slaves in Hanyang and 3,025 slaves scattered in provinces and counties were placed under Jeonnongsi (典農寺).

src: 최포생(崔布生)의 첩의 아들 최익겸(崔益謙)이 도관(都官)에게 노비의 문서에 세금을 매겨 달라고 하였는데, 도관정랑(都官正郞) 박회(朴回)가 세금을 받지 못하게 하고 강제로 송사를 정지시킴
t: Choe Ikgyeom (崔益謙), the son of a concubine of Choe Poseng (崔布生), asked the Slave Bureau (都官) to levy a tax on slave documents, but Bak Hoe (朴回), the Dogwan-jeongnang (都官正郞), refused to collect the tax and forcibly stopped the lawsuit.

src: 사대부가 어머니의 심상(心喪)을 행할 때 복장은 천담복(淺淡服)을 입도록 함.
t: Ordered that when sadaebu (士大夫) observe simsang (心喪) mourning for their mothers, they wear cheondambok (淺淡服).

src: 타르타르족 에센(也先)의 공격에 대비하여 경기도, 충청도, 경상도, 전라도, 강원도, 황해도의 각종 군병을 131,704명에서 157,734명으로 증가시킴.
t: In preparation for the attack of Esen (也先) of the Tartars, increased the various troops of Gyeonggi, Chungcheong, Gyeongsang, Jeolla, Gangwon, and Hwanghae provinces from 131,704 to 157,734.

src: ≪동국병감(東國兵鑑)≫의 편찬을 명함.
t: Ordered the compilation of the Dongguk Byeonggam (東國兵鑑).

src: 화약 생산을 위해 전국 25개소에 도회(都會)를 정하여 염초를 구워내게 함.
t: Designated 25 places nationwide as dohoe (都會) to produce saltpeter for gunpowder manufacturing.

src: 문종이 평양(平壤)의 관노(官奴)가 2만여 명이나 된다고 들었다고 하니, 신하들이 평양의 관노는 겨우 2천여 명뿐이라고 함
t: King Munjong said he had heard that Pyongyang had more than 20,000 government slaves (官奴), but his officials said Pyongyang had only about 2,000 government slaves.

src: 기천현(基川縣)을 군으로 승격시킴
t: Elevated Gicheon-hyeon (基川縣) to the status of a county (郡).

src: 각 도의 정군(正軍) 23,486명을 증원함.
t: Increased the number of jeonggun (正軍) in each province by 23,486.

src: 환도(環刀)의 규격을 보병과 기병용으로 나누어 정함.
t: Set the specifications of hwando (環刀) separately for infantry and cavalry use.

src: 의녀에게 기녀에 준해서 매년 쌀 각 1석을 주도록 함.
t: Ordered that uinyeo (醫女) be given 1 seok of rice each year, equal to ginyeo (妓女).

src: 문종이 새로 만든 ≪진법(陣法)≫이 완성됨.
t: King Munjong's newly compiled Jinbeop (陣法) was completed.

src: 중국과 우리 나라의 역대 주요 전쟁을 기록한 ≪역대병요(歷代兵要)≫ 완성.
t: The Yeokdae Byeongyo (歷代兵要), recording major wars throughout history of China and Joseon, was completed.

src: 중앙 군제를 개편하여 기존의 12사(司)를 5사로 만들고 호군직(護軍職)을 신설함.
t: Reorganized the central military system, converting the existing 12 sa (司) into 5 sa, and newly established the office of hogun (護軍).

src: 공주의 녹봉은 종1품, 옹주의 녹봉은 종2품에 준하여 1년에 4번, 쌀, 콩, 보리를 주도록 함.
t: The stipend of a princess was set at the level of Senior 1st rank, and that of an ongju (翁主) at Senior 2nd rank, to be given four times a year in rice, beans, and barley.

src: 각 도의 도회소(都會所)에서 매년 제작하여야 하는 무기의 종류와 제조량을 정함.
t: Determined the types and quantities of weapons to be manufactured each year at the dohoeso (都會所) of each province.

src: 함경도 도절제사 이징옥(李澄玉)이 후임 도절제사 박호문(朴好問)을 죽이고 반란을 일으킴.
t: Yi Jing-ok (李澄玉), the Field Commander (都節制使) of Hamgyong Province, killed his successor Bak Ho-mun (朴好問) and rose in rebellion.

src: 선상노자(選上奴子)의 고통이 1년에 정포(正布) 1필만 바치는 납공노비(納貢奴婢)에 비하여 10배나 되며, 사람을 사서 대신 입역시키고, 사람을 사는 비용 때문에 파산하는 사람이 많다고 의정부(議政府)에서 아룀
t: The State Council (Uijeongbu) reported that the hardship of seonsangnoja (選上奴子) was ten times that of napgongnobi (納貢奴婢) who only paid one bolt of jeongpo (正布) cloth per year, and that many went bankrupt from the cost of hiring substitutes to serve in their place.

src: 형조도관(刑曹都官)의 노비소송에 대한 문안(文案) 중 미결(未決)된 것이 4천 8백 48명이니, 1454년 12월 그믐날을 기한으로 하여 소송을 제기한 사람의 서명을 받게 하자고 의정부(議政府)에서 아뢰니, 이를 따
t: The State Council (Uijeongbu) reported that among the case files on slave lawsuits at Hyeongjo Dogwan (刑曹都官), 4,848 remained undecided, and proposed to have petitioners sign by the end of December 1454; this was followed.

src: 이흥발(李興發)과 노비를 가지고 다툰 손신도(孫信道)가 이흥발의 비첩(婢妾) 연환(延還)에게 뇌물을 주어, 종 갓동(加叱同)을 시켜 이흥발의 딸 이귀금(李貴今)을 강제로 간음(姦淫)케 하고, 이귀금을 시켜 노비문서를
t: Son Sin-do (孫信道), who was disputing over slaves with Yi Heung-bal (李興發), bribed Yeonhwan (延還), a concubine slave of Yi Heung-bal, having the slave Gatdong (加叱同) forcibly commit adultery with Yi Heung-bal's daughter Yi Gwi-geum (李貴今), and had Yi Gwi-geum with the slave documents...

src: 용재 이종준(慵齋 李宗準) 출생
t: Yi Jong-jun (Yongjae) (慵齋 李宗準) was born.

src: 내륙에도 거진(巨鎭)을 설치하고 인근 고을을 중익(中翼), 좌익(左翼), 우익(右翼)에 나누어 소속시켜 전국을 익군 체제로 편성함.
t: Established geojin (巨鎭) also in inland areas, and organized the whole country into the ikgun (翼軍) system by assigning neighboring counties to jung-ik (中翼), jwa-ik (左翼), and u-ik (右翼).

src: 전라도 해변의 먼 포구와 골짜기 등의 넓은 공한지(空閑地)에 향리, 역자(驛子), 공사천구, 군민(軍民) 등으로 유랑하는 자와 도망한 자가 들어와 사는데, 그 가운데 세력있고 부유한 자가 긴 울타리를 둘러치고 살면서
t: In the vast unoccupied lands of remote ports and valleys along the coast of Jeolla Province, hyangni (鄕吏), yeokja (驛子), public and private slaves, and gunmin (軍民) who had fled or become vagrants came to settle, among whom the powerful and wealthy built long fences and lived there...

src: 안동도(安東都)의 좌익은 봉화로 함
t: The left wing (左翼) of Andongdo (安東都) was set as Bonghwa.

src: 충찬위(忠贊衛)를 설치하여 원종공신(原從功臣) 자손을 소속시킴
t: The Loyal Guard (忠贊衛) was established, and descendants of Auxiliary Meritorious Subjects (原從功臣) were assigned to it.

src: 지방의 관노(官奴)의 수가 고르지 않아 평양(平壤) 같은 곳은 수천 호인데 쇠잔한 군(郡)은 10호도 차지 못하니, 여러 관청의 노비와 근처에 있는 자를 쇠잔한 군에 헤아려 줄 것을 양성지(梁誠之)가 상소함
t: Yang Seong-ji (梁誠之) submitted a memorial stating that, since the number of local government slaves (官奴) was uneven—Pyongyang (平壤) having several thousand households while decrepit counties (郡) had fewer than ten—slaves belonging to various offices and those living nearby should be allotted to the decrepit counties.

src: 윤별동묘(尹別洞廟) 건립
t: The Yun Byeoldong Shrine (尹別洞廟) was built.

src: 안동부사 김담(金淡) 부임
t: Kim Dam (金淡), the magistrate of Andong, assumed his post.

src: 금성대군(錦城大君)을 안치함
t: Prince Geumseong (錦城大君) was banished and confined.

src: 총통위(銃筒衛) 혁파
t: The Firearms Guard (銃筒衛) was abolished.

src: 시위하는 각종 군사들을 모두 오위(五衛)의 각 위에 나누어 소속시킴.
t: All the various guard troops were divided and assigned to the respective divisions of the Five Guards (五衛).

src: 익군(翼軍) 체제를 폐지하고 각도에 몇 개의 거진(巨鎭)을 설치하여 각 고을을 나누어 소속시킴.
t: The Ikgun (翼軍) system was abolished, and several great garrisons (巨鎭) were established in each province, to which the various counties were divided and assigned.

src: 담양의 승려 혜명(惠明)이 고을 사람 수십 명이 난을 획책하고 있다는 상소와 명단을 올리자 조사, 처벌함
t: When the monk Hyemyeong (惠明) of Damyang submitted a memorial along with a list of names, reporting that several dozen people of the county were plotting a rebellion, an investigation was conducted and they were punished.

src: 나주의 선군(船軍) 박충(朴忠), 호삼(蒿三)과 사노 본치(本致) 등이 수령의 형벌 처리에 불만을 품고 외출하는 수령의 뒤를 따라가 위협하고 행장을 수색함
t: Bak Chung (朴忠) and Hosam (蒿三), naval soldiers (船軍) of Naju, and the private slave Bonchi (本致), harboring resentment over the magistrate's handling of punishments, followed the magistrate as he went out, threatened him, and searched his belongings.

src: 노비문서를 위조하는 자가 많으며, 비록 폭로되어도 사면을 만나면 죄를 면하니, 사면 전이라고 하더라도 죄를 줄 것을 도관(都官)의 정랑(正郞) 최준(崔濬)이 건의함
t: Choe Jun (崔濬), the Jeongnang (正郞, a fifth-rank official) of the Dogwan (都官), proposed that since many people forged slave registers and, even if exposed, escaped punishment when an amnesty occurred, they should be punished even for offenses committed before the amnesty.

src: 활 120근을 당길 수 있는 자를 뽑아 만강대(彎强隊)를 설치함.
t: Those who could draw a bow weighing 120 geun were selected and organized into the Strong Bow Unit (彎强隊).

src: 유배된 도둑 중 공천(公賤)은 유배된 고을의 관노(官奴)로 영원히 속하게 할 것을 형조(刑曹)에서 아뢰니, 이를 따름
t: The Ministry of Justice (刑曹) reported that exiled thieves who were public slaves (公賤) should be permanently registered as government slaves (官奴) of the county to which they were exiled, and this was followed.

src: 문수산수(文殊山水) 동쪽 땅을 편입
t: The land to the east of Munsusansu (文殊山水) was incorporated.

src: 순흥부(順興府) 경계의 대부분이 풍기군(豊基郡)에 귀속
t: Most of the boundary of Sunheung-bu (順興府) was incorporated into Punggi-gun (豊基郡).

src: 순흥부(順興府)를 폐지하여 4개면을 영천(榮川)에 붙임
t: Sunheung-bu (順興府) was abolished, and its four myeon were attached to Yeongcheon (榮川).

src: 소헌왕후의 내향인 경상도 청송군을 도호부로 승함.
t: Cheongsong-gun (淸松郡) in Gyeongsang-do, the maternal hometown of Queen Soheon, was elevated to a Dohobu (都護府).

src: 장용대(壯勇隊)를 설치하여 공사천(公私賤) 중에서 무예가 뛰어난 자를 뽑아 소속시킴.
t: The Valorous and Brave Unit (壯勇隊) was established, and those skilled in martial arts among public and private slaves (公私賤) were selected and assigned to it.

src: 신숙주(申叔舟) 등이 당시 운용되던 군제의 군령 계통을 규정한 ≪병정(兵政)≫을 편찬함.
t: Sin Suk-ju (申叔舟) and others compiled the Byeongjeong (兵政), which stipulated the chain of military command under the military system then in operation.

src: 도별로 명칭이 다른 정군(正軍)과 시위패(侍衛牌)를 모두 정병(正兵)으로 명칭을 통일함.
t: The regular troops (正軍) and guard units (侍衛牌), which had different names in each province, were all unified under the name Jeongbyeong (正兵).

src: 사대부 적처의 봉작은 남편의 관직을 따르나 봉작을 받지 못하고 죽었을 때는 추증하게 함.
t: The title conferred on the legitimate wife of a scholar-official followed her husband's official rank, but if she died before receiving the title, it was to be posthumously granted.

src: 파적위(破敵衛)를 설치하여 한량인(閑良人) 및 서원(書員), 일수(日守) 중에서 무예가 뛰어난 자를 뽑아 소속시킴.
t: The Pajeokwi (破敵衛) was established, and those skilled in martial arts among idle men of good standing (閑良人), clerks (書員), and daily watchmen (日守) were selected and assigned to it.

src: 세자 친영례를 행함.
t: The crown prince performed the ceremony of personally welcoming his bride (親迎禮).

src: 병조판서 한명회의 딸을 왕세자빈으로 정함.
t: The daughter of Han Myeong-hoe (韓明澮), the Minister of War (兵曹判書), was designated as the crown princess.

src: 양성지(梁誠之) 등에게 ≪손자주해(孫子註解)≫를 교정하게 함.
t: Yang Seong-ji (梁誠之) and others were ordered to proofread the Sonja Juhae (孫子註解).

src: 여진족 아비거(阿比車)가 1,500명을 이끌고 회령(會寧)에 침입하였다가 함길도 도절제사 양정(楊汀)의 반격으로 패주함.
t: Jurchen chieftain Abigeo led 1,500 men to invade Hoeryeong, but was routed by the counterattack of Yang Jeong, the military commander of Hamgil-do.

src: 사민(徙民) 모집에 응모한 사천(私賤)들이 본주인의 재산과 곡식을 자기 것으로 삼고, 노비들을 유인하여 솔정(率丁)이라 칭하고, 주인과 노비들이 서로 소송하니, 사천들의 사민(徙民) 응모를 들어주지 말 것을 병조(兵
t: Private slaves (sacheon) who had applied for recruitment to resettlement (semin) took their original masters' property and grain as their own, lured other slaves and called them solders (soljeong), and masters and slaves sued each other over this; it was proposed that private slaves not be allowed to apply for resettlement recruitment, to the Ministry of War (Byeongjo

src: 1439년(세종 21년) 미처 추쇄(推刷)하지 못한 노비가 2만 2천여 명인데, 지금 경안(京案)에 아직 추쇄하지 못한 노비가 1천여 명, 기타 외안(外案)의 관청 노비 가운데 추쇄하지 못한 것도 이와 유사하다고 제
t: As of 1439 (King Sejong's 21st year), there were more than 22,000 slaves who had not yet been reclaimed (chusoe); now more than 1,000 slaves in the capital registers (gyeongan) had not yet been reclaimed, and it was reported that the unreclaimed slaves among government slaves in the provincial registers (oean) were similarly numerous

src: 도적 아지동(阿只同) 등 20여 명이 무리를 지어 임영대군(臨瀛大君)의 집에 돌을 던짐
t: Thieves including Ajidong and more than 20 others formed a group and threw stones at the house of Grand Prince Imyeong.

src: 남자 14세 여자 13세이상 혼인을 허락하고 부모가 50이 넘어 병이 있는 경우, 10세 이상이면 관에 고하여 성혼하게 함.
t: Marriage was permitted for men aged 14 and women aged 13 or older; if the parents were over 50 and ill, marriage from age 10 was allowed to be reported to the government and concluded.

src: 여러 관청의 노비를 추쇄(推刷)하게 하니, 황수신(黃守身)이 그에 대한 건의를 함(황수신(黃守身)의 노비추쇄 건의)
t: Slaves belonging to various government offices were ordered to be reclaimed (chusoe), and Hwang Su-sin made a proposal regarding this (Hwang Su-sin's proposal on the reclamation of slaves).

src: 포화(布貨)의 품질을 정부에서 보장하기 위해 조선통폐지인(朝鮮通弊之印)이라는 관인을 찍어 사용하게 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: To guarantee the quality of cloth currency (pohwa), the government had the official seal "Joseon Tongpyeji-in" stamped for use.

src: 강계부에 女妓를 다시 둠.
t: Female entertainers (yeogi) were reinstated in Ganggye-bu.

src: 세조가 ≪병장설(兵將說)≫을 저술하고 신숙주(申叔舟)가 주석을 붙임.
t: King Sejo wrote the Byeongjangseol, and Sin Suk-ju added commentary.

src: 지방 각 진 진군(鎭軍)의 정액을 정하고 3번으로 나누어 2달마다 교대하게 함.
t: The fixed quota of garrison soldiers (jingun) at each local garrison was set, divided into 3 groups to rotate every 2 months.

src: 주전에 필요한 동이 부족하여 기명(器皿)을 새로 만드는 것을 금지함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Due to a shortage of copper needed for coin minting, the making of new vessels (gimyeong) was prohibited.

src: 시녀 이하 여러 잡부녀들이 승마로 궐내 출입하는 것을 금함.
t: Court maids and other various menial women were prohibited from entering the palace on horseback.

src: 난신 처첩 및 딸을 공신가에 비로 보낸 것을 모두 방송하고 타노비로 충급하게 함.
t: Wives, concubines, and daughters of rebellious officials who had been sent as slaves to meritorious subjects' households were all released, and other slaves were assigned as replacements.

src: 노비소송을 하는 경우에는 3개월 안에 까닭 없이 소송하지 않은 경우 30일이 되면 결정하여 지급하고, 소송한 사람이 다른 곳에 거주하거나 다른 곳에 나갔다가 돌아오는 자이면 길에 있는 날짜를 아울러 계산하도록 함
t: In cases of slave lawsuits, if a suit was not filed within 3 months without reason, a decision would be rendered and the slave granted after 30 days; if the litigant resided elsewhere or was returning from a journey, the days spent traveling were to be included in the calculation.

src: ≪삼갑전법(三甲戰法)≫을 간행하여 여러 장수에게 나누어 줌.
t: The Samgap Jeonbeop was published and distributed to various generals.

src: 보법(保法)을 실시하여 2정(丁)을 1보로 하고, 각 병종별로 지급하는 봉족의 수를 조정함.
t: The Bobeop (support-unit law) was implemented, setting 2 adult males (jeong) as 1 bo, and adjusting the number of bongjok (support households) provided for each military branch.

src: 전폐(箭幣)를 매년 10만개 씩 주조하게 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Arrow-shaped coins (jeonpye) were minted at 100,000 pieces per year.

src: 사대부가의 성혼납채에 채단(綵段) 사용을 못하게 하고 외방 사신의 침구에도 역시 채단을 금함.
t: The use of colored silk (chaedan) in the betrothal gifts (napchae) of yangban families' marriages was prohibited, and colored silk was also banned in the bedding of envoys from outlying regions.

src: 함길도(咸吉道) 내의 유이(流移)하는 사람들 가운데 함부로 양인이라고 일컫는 자가 많으며, 땅이 깊고 궁벽져서 주인을 배반하고 구실을 피하는 노예가 모두 도망하여 온다고 형조(刑曹)에서 보고함
t: The Ministry of Punishments (Hyeongjo) reported that among the migrants (yuyi) within Hamgil-do, many falsely claimed to be commoners, and that since the land was remote and secluded, slaves who betrayed their masters and evaded their duties all fled there.

src: 송수중(宋守中)이 전주(全州) 사람 한유계(韓有繼)와 노비를 소송하여 이겨 한유계의 집에 가서 그 종을 찾았더니, 한유계가 이웃 사람 김사례(金思禮) 등과 함께 송수중 및 데리고 온 종 춘부(春夫)를 고문함
t: Song Su-jung won a lawsuit over a slave against Han Yu-gye of Jeonju, and went to Han Yu-gye's house to retrieve the slave, whereupon Han Yu-gye, together with his neighbor Kim Sa-rye and others, tortured Song Su-jung and the slave Chunbu whom he had brought along.

src: 자식이 병들어 죽어 휴가를 청하였으나 얻지 못하자 원망하는 말을 한 계집종 보로미(甫老未)를 주인 조진경(曹晉卿)이 동대문 밖에서 활을 쏘아 죽임
t: When the female slave Boromi, whose child had fallen ill and died, requested leave but was not granted it and spoke words of resentment, her master Jo Jin-gyeong shot and killed her with a bow outside Dongdaemun.

src: 해괴제(解怪祭)를 지냄
t: The Haegoeje (rite to dispel calamity) was performed.

src: 중궁이 사정전에서 부녀 양노연을 베품.
t: The queen held a feast for elderly women at Sajeongjeon.

src: 병조에서 군기시(軍器寺)와 전국 각 고을에서 보유하고 있어야 하는 무기의 수량을 정함.
t: The Ministry of War set the quantity of weapons that the Bureau of Weapons (Gungisi) and localities throughout the country should possess.

src: 여러 고을의 군사는 3번으로 나누어 5개월 마다 교대하게 하고, 정병(正兵)은 7번으로 나누어 2개월마다 교대하게 함.
t: Soldiers of the various localities were divided into 3 groups to rotate every 5 months, and regular soldiers (jeongbyeong) were divided into 7 groups to rotate every 2 months.

src: 혼인 연령에 구애됨이 없이 혼인을 허락함.
t: Marriage was permitted without regard to age of marriage.

src: 본주인 이거물(李巨勿)이 토지와 말을 빼앗은 것을 원망한 사노(私奴) 대평(大平)이 사위인 종 덕지(德只)와 함께 몽둥이를 가지고 가서 이거물을 때렸으므로, 참형(斬刑)에 처함
t: The private slave Daepyeong, resentful that his master Yi Geomul had seized his land and horse, went with his son-in-law, the slave Deokji, carrying clubs and beat Yi Geomul, and was thus sentenced to beheading.

src: 1년 군기제조량(軍器製造量)
t: The amount of weapons manufactured in one year.

src: 을산군(乙山君, 예종)이 영의정 한명회의 딸에게 친영함.
t: Eulsan-gun (Yejong) held the formal wedding reception (chinyeong) for the daughter of Chief State Councillor Han Myeong-hoe.

src: 한성부에 잡색군(雜色軍) 76,036명 편성하고 지휘 체제를 정비함.
t: 76,036 men were organized into the miscellaneous-color army (japsaekgun) in Hanseong-bu, and the command system was reorganized.

src: 장흥의 사노 봉래(奉來) 등이 무리를 이루어 인명을 살상함
t: The private slave Bongnae of Jangheung and others formed a group and killed and wounded people.

src: 강순(康純)과 남이(南怡) 등이 파저강(婆猪江)을 건너 여진족을 정벌하여 이만주(李滿住) 부자를 죽임.
t: Kang Sun, Nam Yi, and others crossed the Pajeo River to campaign against the Jurchen, killing Yi Manju and his sons.

src: 전 회령절제사 이시애(李施愛)가 길주(吉州)에서 절도사 강효문(康孝文) 등을 죽이고 난을 일으켜 함길도 전역으로 확산됨. (이시애의 난)
t: The former military commissioner of Hoeryeong, Yi Si-ae, killed the military commissioner Kang Hyo-mun and others at Gilju and rose in rebellion, which spread throughout Hamgil-do. (The Rebellion of Yi Si-ae)

src: 변정원(辨定院)을 장예원(掌隷院)으로 고치고, 정문형(鄭文炯)을 판결사(判決事)로 삼음
t: Byeonjeong-won was renamed Jangnye-won, and Jeong Mun-hyeong was appointed as pangyeolsa.

src: 일산삼자자(一産三子者)에게는 도관찰사가 쌀을 주게 함.
t: Those who gave birth to triplets at one delivery were to be given rice by the provincial governor.

src: 전라도 무안 출신 장영기(張永奇)의 주도 아래 40여 명의 수적(水賊)이 전라도와 경상도 일대에서 활동하다 사로잡힘
t: About 40 water bandits led by Jang Yeong-gi of Muan, Jeolla-do, operated in the Jeolla-do and Gyeongsang-do regions and were captured.

src: 육진의 총통(銃筒)을 도성으로 운반하게 한 일로 함경도의 백성들이 동요하여 와언(訛言)이 떠돌자 길주, 단천 등지로 옮기게 함
t: When the people of Hamgyeong-do became agitated and rumors spread over the order to transport the firearms of the Six Garrisons to the capital, they were moved instead to places such as Gilju and Danchon.

src: 호패법(號牌法)을 세운 이후 모든 사람이 새로 얻은 노비를 제도관찰사(諸道觀察使)로 하여금 자세히 조사하여 추쇄(推刷)하게 할 것을 사헌부(司憲府)에서 아뢰니, 이를 따름
t: The Office of the Inspector-General reported that, since the establishment of the identification tag law, all newly acquired slaves should be thoroughly investigated and reclaimed by the provincial governors of each province, and this was followed.

src: 1466년(세조 12) 이전의 여러 관청의 노비신공(奴婢身貢) 중 거두지 못한 것을 면제하고 이미 거둔 물건은 면제하지 말라고 하였는데, 여러 고을의 수령들이 이미 거둔 포물(布物)을 남용한 자는 문서에서 빼버리고
t: It was ordered that uncollected slave tribute goods from the various offices before 1466 (12th year of Sejo) be exempted, and that already collected goods not be exempted, but the magistrates of the various counties struck from the records those who had misused the already collected cloth goods.

src: 안동부사 손소(孫昭) 부임
t: Son So took up his post as magistrate of Andong-bu.

src: 충청도감사의 계에 따라 효자, 절부 10명에게 정표함.
t: Following the report of the governor of Chungcheong-do, ten filial sons and chaste women were honored with commemorative markers.

src: 파주에서 활동한 명화적(明火賊) 사노 황신(黃信), 안금(安金)이 처벌됨
t: The private slaves Hwang Sin and An Geum, armed bandits (myeonghwajeok) active in Paju, were punished.

src: 각 병종의 군액과 번상수를 개정하고, 충청도, 전라도, 경상도의 군액을 줄여 전국의 총 군액을 110,468명으로 조정함.
t: The military quotas and rotation numbers of each troop type were revised, the military quotas of Chungcheong-do, Jeolla-do, and Gyeongsang-do were reduced, and the total military quota of the country was adjusted to 110,468.

src: 여러 고을의 노비는 비록
t: Although the slaves of the various counties

src: 공신(功臣)의 구사노비(丘史奴婢) 중 한양에 사는 사람은 본사(本司)에 되돌려 보내고, 지방에 사는 노비로 충당하여 주도록 장례원(掌隷院)에 명령함
t: It was ordered to Jangnye-won that among the personal attendant slaves (gusa nobi) of meritorious subjects, those residing in Hanyang be returned to their original offices, and that they be replenished with slaves residing in the provinces.

src: 선상노(選上奴)는 자기 차례 때마다 사람을 고용하여 대신 역(役)을 지게 하는데, 고용하는 값이 정해진 액수가 없어 폭리를 취하는 무리가 있으니, 앞으로는 1개월에 베 2필을 초과하지 말게 할 것을 형조(刑曹)에서
t: The Ministry of Punishments reported that for selected-service slaves (seonsangno), since there was no fixed amount for hiring a substitute to perform their turn of duty, some took excessive profit, and henceforth the amount should not exceed 2 bolts of cloth per month.

src: 성내에 거주하는 무격(巫覡)을 성외로 내쫓음. 외친 6촌의 상혼을 허락하지 않음.
t: Shamans (mugyeok) residing within the city walls were expelled outside the walls. Marriage between maternal relatives within the sixth degree was not permitted.

src: 동계(同系)의 동성혼, 이성의 근친혼을 제한함. 부인출입시에 그 얼굴을 가리도록 함.
t: Marriage between those of the same lineage and close-degree marriage between those of different surnames were restricted. Women going out in public were required to cover their faces.

src: 30여 명의 황해도 산적들이 경기도적성(積城) 관아를 습격하여 재물을 빼앗아 본거지로 되돌아 갔으며 1년 여간 활동함
t: More than 30 mountain bandits from Hwanghae-do attacked the government office of Jeokseong in Gyeonggi-do, seized goods, and returned to their base, remaining active for over a year.

src: 순천, 흥양, 낙안 등의 앞바다와 섬에서 수적들이 밤에는 왜구의 옷을 입고 배로 약탈을 행하고 낮에는 평민의 옷을 입어 신분을 위장하고 활동함
t: Water bandits operating in the seas and islands off Suncheon, Heungyang, and Nakan wore Japanese pirate clothing at night to plunder by boat, and disguised themselves in commoners' clothing during the day.

src: 내수사(內需司)의 노비는 역사(役使)가 수월하기 때문에 투탁(投托)하는 자가 많고, 누락된 것을 신고하면 많은 상을 받기 때문에 함부로 신고하는 자가 많으니 이를 처벌할 것을 형조(刑曹)에서 아룀
t: The Ministry of Justice reported that many people falsely commended themselves as slaves of the Bureau of Royal Household Affairs because its labor service was easy, and that many recklessly made false reports of omitted slaves because they received great rewards for doing so, and requested that they be punished.

src: 광평대군(廣平大君)의 부인 신씨(申氏)가 노비 730여 명과 토지 70여 결(結)을 불교사원에 시주하고, 장례원(掌隷院)과 한성부(漢城府)에서 문서를 받고자 하니, 홍귀달(洪貴達)이 벌을 줄 것을 청함
t: Lady Sin, wife of Grand Prince Gwangpyeong, donated over 730 slaves and over 70 gyeol of land to a Buddhist temple and sought to obtain documents from the Office of Slave Administration and the Hanseongbu, and Hong Gwidal requested that she be punished.

src: 遊女 화랑금제의 조건 7조를 정함.
t: Seven conditions of regulations prohibiting courtesans and itinerant male entertainers (hwarang) were established.

src: 여러 읍 수령의 처와 딸의 유옥교자(有屋較子) 사용의 폐를 검찰하여 치죄하게 함.
t: The abuse of the use of covered palanquins by the wives and daughters of magistrates of various counties was to be investigated and punished.

src: 하삼도(下三道)의 정병(正兵) 군액을 줄여 충청도는 18,581명, 전라도는 27,731명, 경상도는 19,015명으로 조정함.
t: The quota of regular troops in the Three Southern Provinces was reduced and adjusted to 18,581 in Chungcheong-do, 27,731 in Jeolla-do, and 19,015 in Gyeongsang-do.

src: 음사(淫祀)를 금함.
t: Licentious shrine worship was prohibited.

src: 낙안(樂安)의 무장한 장교 김배와 순천(順天)의 사노 배영달(裵永達), 옥산(玉山), 박장명(朴長命) 등 30여 명의 수적이 네 척의 배를 타고 왜인으로 속여 약탈을 행함
t: Armed officer Kim Bae of Nagan and Bae Yeongdal, Oksan, Park Jangmyeong, and other private slaves of Suncheon, more than 30 pirates in all, boarded four ships and plundered while disguising themselves as Japanese.

src: 사치를 금하는 절목을 정함. 1) 사서인의 복장, 혼인시 복장, 찬품 등을 정함. 2) 향촌의 부자들의 상제향품(喪祭享品)을 정함. 3) 서인의 음연(飮宴)에 대한 것. 4) 사족 부녀의 산간유연(山間遊宴) 금지.
t: Regulations prohibiting extravagance were established. 1) The clothing of scholars and commoners, clothing for weddings, and food offerings were regulated. 2) The mourning and ancestral rite offerings of wealthy people in the countryside were regulated. 3) This concerned the drinking banquets of commoners. 4) Mountain excursions and banquets of women of gentry families were prohibited.

src: 사족부녀가 중이 되는 것을 금단함.
t: Women of gentry families were prohibited from becoming Buddhist nuns.

src: 연향 외의 상시 행행(行幸)에 여악 사용을 금함.
t: The use of female musicians at regular royal outings other than banquets was prohibited.

src: 김을손(金乙孫)이 아버지의 첩의 소생을 노비로 삼고자 하여, 아버지가 쓴 방역문권(放役文券)을 훔침
t: Kim Eulson, wishing to make his father's concubine's offspring into slaves, stole the manumission document written by his father.

src: 1467년(세조 13) 이시애(李施愛)의 난에 참전하여 면천(免賤)하여 군역(軍役)에 소속된 손장수(孫長壽)가 가난하고 미약하여 군사(軍士)로는 합당하지 아니하므로 다시 천인이 되기를 원하므로 허락함
t: Son Jangsu, who had been manumitted from slave status and assigned to military service after participating in the rebellion of Yi Siae in 1467 (13th year of King Sejo), requested to become a lowborn person again because he was poor and weak and unfit to serve as a soldier, and this was permitted.

src: 장용대(壯勇隊) 설치 이후부터 노비가 주인을 배반하기 시작하였고, 1467년(세조 13) 이시애(李施愛)의 난때 천인의 신분에서 양민이 된 자가 많은데, 갑사(甲士)에까지 올라 주인과 같은 지위가 된 자가 있다고 서
t: Since the establishment of the Jangyongdae, slaves began to betray their masters, and during the rebellion of Yi Siae in 1467 (13th year of King Sejo), many who had been lowborn became commoners, and it was reported that some had even risen to become Gapsa and attained a status equal to their masters, so

src: 우암 홍언충(寓菴 洪彦忠) 출생
t: Uam Hong Eonchung was born.

src: 여진족 기병 3,000여명이 장성(長城)을 넘어 벽단(碧團)에 침입함.
t: Over 3,000 Jurchen cavalry crossed the Great Wall and invaded Byeokdan.

src: 집이 아주 부자인 송익손(宋益孫)이 양민과 천인을 불러들려 노비로 삼은 것이 수천명이라고 함
t: It was said that Song Ikson, whose household was extremely wealthy, had gathered commoners and lowborn people and made thousands of them into slaves.

src: 각 도 정병(正兵)의 정원과 유방(留防) 및 번상 인원을 정함
t: The quota of regular troops, garrison defense, and rotational service personnel for each province were established.

src: 병조에서 오위(五衛)를 총괄하고 분군(分軍)하는 것은 오위에서 담당하도록 함.
t: The Ministry of War was to oversee the Five Military Commands, and the division of troops was to be handled by the Five Military Commands themselves.

src: 야옹 권의(野翁 權檥) 출생
t: Yaong Gwon Ui was born.

src: 숙의 윤씨를 왕비로 삼음.
t: Consort Suk-ui Yun was made queen.

src: 예조에서 친잠(親蠶) 應行節目을 정함.
t: The Ministry of Rites established regulations for the implementation of the Royal Sericulture Rite.

src: 황효원이 그 비(난신의 딸로 공신가에 내린 비)를 첩으로 삼았다가 다시 처로 맞이한 데에 대한 논란이 일어남.
t: A controversy arose over Hwang Hyowon, who had taken as a concubine a female slave (a traitor's daughter given to a meritorious subject's household) and then took her again as his wife.

src: 대왕대비의 수렴청정(垂簾聽政)을 거두고 성종이 친정함.
t: The Grand Queen Dowager's regency behind the curtain ended, and King Seongjong began personal rule.

src: 안동부사 안초(安鉥) 부임
t: An Cho took office as Prefect of Andong.

src: 친잠의(親蠶儀)를 정함.
t: The protocol for the Royal Sericulture Rite was established.

src: 왕비가 채상단에 나아가 친잠(親蠶)을 행함.
t: The Queen went to Chaesangdan and performed chinjam (親蠶).

src: 부녀의 재가를 금함.(재가금지법(再嫁禁止法))
t: Remarriage of women was prohibited. (the Jaegageumjibeop (再嫁禁止法))

src: 평안도에서 엄산(嚴山)이란 사람이 와언(訛言)을 퍼뜨리다 처벌됨
t: In Pyeongan Province, a person named Eomsan (嚴山) spread false rumors (訛言) and was punished.

src: 저화(楮貨) 위조범을 체포하거나 관청에 고발하는 사람에게 면포 50필을 지급하도록 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: It was ordered that 50 rolls of cotton cloth be given to those who captured counterfeiters of jeohwa (楮貨) or reported them to the government office Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Compilation Committee,

src: 후손이 없는 자가 노비에게 묘지기와 봉사(奉祀)를 시키려고 하는 자는 관청에 고하는 것을 허락하고, 관청에서 문서에 서명하여 그 인원수에 한해서 영원토록 제사를 받들게 하는 것을 허락함
t: Those without descendants who wished to have their slaves serve as tomb keepers and perform bongsa (奉祀, ancestral rites) were permitted to report to the government office, and the office, by signing the documents, permitted ancestral rites to be carried out in perpetuity by the specified number of persons.

src: 성내 무격, 음사(淫祀)를 엄히 금함.
t: Shamans and eumsa (淫祀, illicit rites) within the capital were strictly prohibited.

src: 주인이 잘못을 저질렀을 때 노비가 주인을 고발하는 것을 허용할지 말지에 대해서 의논함
t: It was discussed whether to allow slaves to report their masters when the masters committed wrongdoing.

src: 노비의 일을 결정할 때 확실한 문서가 있으면 문서에 따르고, 만약 다른 문서가 없더라도 명백한 공문(公文)이 있으면 공문에 따라 판결하여 주도록 의금부(義禁府)와 형조(刑曹) 등에 명령함
t: It was ordered to the Uigeumbu (義禁府) and Hyeongjo (刑曹) that, when deciding matters concerning slaves, if there was a clear document it should be followed, and if there was no other document but a clear official document (公文) existed, the ruling should be made according to that official document.

src: 충재 권벌(冲齋 權橃) 출생
t: Chungjae Gwon Beol (冲齋 權橃) was born.

src: 왕비 윤씨를 폐위함.(폐비윤씨사건)
t: Queen Yun was deposed. (Deposition of Queen Yun incident)

src: 도원수 윤필상(尹弼商)이 건주위(建州衛) 여진족을 토벌함.
t: Do-wonsu Yun Pil-sang (尹弼商) subjugated the Jurchen of Geonjuwi (建州衛).

src: 궁궐 후원의 담 밖에서 격쟁(擊錚)하며 원통함을 호소하는 사람이 많이 생김
t: Many people appeared outside the wall of the rear garden of the palace, beating gongs (擊錚) to appeal their grievances.

src: 이미 혼서를 납한 후 타인에게 다시 허락하는 자는 그 주혼인(主婚人)에게 본율(本律) 2등을 논죄하고 여자는 전 남편에게 돌아가지 못하게 함.
t: Those who, after already having submitted a marriage document, permitted marriage to another person were to have the person in charge of the marriage (主婚人) charged with a penalty two degrees less than the original law (本律), and the woman was not allowed to return to her former husband.

src: 심회(沈澮)와 강희맹(姜希孟)이 공천(公賤)을 함부로 유인하여 숨겨두고 부리고, 또 몰래 그 종을 보내어 현재 입역(立役)하고 있는 공천을 꾀어내려다가 잡힘
t: Sim Hoe (沈澮) and Gang Hui-maeng (姜希孟) recklessly lured and hid public slaves (公賤) to use them, and also secretly sent their servants to entice public slaves currently performing labor duty (立役), but were caught.

src: 여러 관청의 죽은 노비는 그 소속 관청이나 살고 있는 부(部)의 입안(立案)이 있어야 사실로서 처리되나, 이제부터는 두 기관 중 한 관청의 입안만 있다고 하더라도 그 친척과 이웃에게 의뢰하여 처리할 것을 명령
t: For deceased slaves of various government offices, it had been required to have an ipan (立案) from either the affiliated office or the bu (部) where they resided in order to be processed as fact, but it was ordered that from now on, even if there was an ipan from only one of the two institutions, the matter should be processed by consulting the relatives and neighbors.

src: 어우동을 간통행적으로 교형에 처함.
t: Eouidong was executed by hanging for adultery.

src: 왕비연을 선정전에서 내외명부에게 베풀음.
t: A banquet for the Queen was held for the Naeoe Myeongbu at Seonjeongjeon.

src: 북변 방위를 위해 정로위(定虜衛)를 신설하고 용양위(龍驤衛)에 소속시킴.
t: Jeongnowi (定虜衛) was newly established for the defense of the northern border and placed under Yongyangwi (龍驤衛).

src: 경중 사족부녀로 30이 넘도록 가난하여 혼인하지 못한 자에게 자장(資粧)을 주어 성혼하게 함.
t: Women of the sajok class in the capital who were over 30 and unable to marry due to poverty were given jajang (資粧) to enable them to marry.

src: 무진장재(無盡藏齋)로 이름을 고침
t: The name was changed to Mujinjangjae (無盡藏齋).

src: 언문 삼강행실열녀도 약간을 경중 5부 및 각 도의 촌부(村婦) 항녀(巷女)에게 강습시킴.
t: Some vernacular script (eonmun) editions of the Samgang Haengsil Yeollyeodo were taught to village women (村婦) and alley women (巷女) in the five bu of the capital and in each province.

src: 정병 김수의(金守義)가 도성의 남장문(南墻門) 밖 나무꼭대기에 올라가 격쟁(擊錚)함
t: Jeongbyeong Kim Su-ui (金守義) climbed to the top of a tree outside Namjangmun (南墻門) of the capital city and beat a gong (擊錚).

src: 단송도감(斷訟都監)에서 노비를 속공(屬公)하기를 힘쓰므로, 노비문서가 분명하지 않은 사람을 관청에 고발하여 모두 속공시키겠다고 위협하여 노비를 빼앗는 사람이 있음
t: As the Dansongdogam (斷訟都監) strove to convert slaves to public ownership (屬公), there were people who threatened to report those whose slave documents were unclear to the government office and have them all converted to public ownership, thereby seizing their slaves.

src: 폐비 윤씨에게 사사(賜死)함.(폐비윤씨사건)
t: Deposed Queen Yun was ordered to commit suicide (賜死). (Deposition of Queen Yun incident)

src: 정희왕후 윤씨가 66세로 온양행궁에서 죽음.
t: Queen Jeonghui, Lady Yun, died at age 66 at the Onyang haenggung.

src: 전라도(全羅道)의 품관(品官)의 무리들이 시골에서 긴 울타리를 설치하고 양민과 다른 사람의 노비를 숨겨 두고, 약탈하여 다른 사람에게 파는 것이 풍속이 됨
t: The officials (品官) of Jeolla-do set up long fences in the countryside and hid commoners and other people's slaves, and it became customary to plunder and sell them to others.

src: 노비안(奴婢案)은 한성부(漢城府)의 담당이 아닌데 소송을 진행할 때 항상 참조하기 때문에 간악한 무리가 문질러버리거나 씻어 없애버리니, 정안(正案) 한 건(件)은 의정부(議政府)에 간직하도록 하라고 추쇄도감(推刷都監
t: The slave register was not under the jurisdiction of Hanseongbu, but because it was always consulted in lawsuits, wicked groups rubbed it out or erased it, so the Chusoedogam (Slave Investigation Directorate) recommended that one copy of the official register be kept at the Uijeongbu.

src: 대가(大駕) 앞의 시위를 엄격히 하기 위해 청로대(淸路隊)를 설치함.
t: The Cheongnodae (Road-Clearing Guard) was established to strengthen the guard in front of the royal carriage.

src: 추쇄(推刷)한 노비는 모두 26만 1천 9백 84명이고, 여러 고을과 여러 역(驛)의 노비는 모두 9만 5백 81명이라고 추쇄도감(推刷都監)에서 보고함
t: The Chusoedogam reported that the total number of investigated slaves was 261,984, and the total number of slaves in the various counties and stations was 90,581.

src: 단운재사(丹雲齋舍) 건립
t: Danunjaesa Hall was built.

src: 흉년으로 수적(水賊)들이 발생함
t: Due to famine, water bandits appeared.

src: 당시 사섬시(司贍寺)에 쌓아둔 노비신공(奴婢身貢)의 총계는 면포(緜布)가 72만 4천 5백여 필(匹)이고 정포(正布)가 18만여 필임
t: At that time, the total slave tribute stored at the Saseomsi amounted to over 724,500 bolts of cotton cloth and over 180,000 bolts of plain cloth.

src: 곡식 2천 석을 바친 임복(林福)의 소원에 따라 그 네 아들을 모두 양민(良民)으로 만들어 주고, 그 인원에 맞먹는 공천(公賤)을 본주인에게 보상으로 줌
t: In accordance with the wish of Im Bok, who donated 2,000 seok of grain, all four of his sons were made commoners, and public slaves equal to that number were given to their original masters as compensation.

src: 적처의 소생일 경우 장자, 중자, 딸의 구분없이 모두에게 같은 양의 재산을 분배하고 그 가운데 승중자에 한하여 1/5을 더해줌.(자녀균분상속)
t: In the case of children born of the legal wife, whether eldest son, other sons, or daughters, property was divided equally among all of them, except that the heir who continued the ancestral rites was given an additional one-fifth. (Equal inheritance among sons and daughters)

src: 왕비가 선정전에서 양노연을 베품.
t: The Queen held a feast for the elderly at Seonjeongjeon.

src: 여외 정병(旅外正兵)을 혁파하여 보인(保人)으로 하도록 함.
t: The Yeoöe Jeongbyeong was abolished and made into bo-in (supporting personnel).

src: 전라도 나주와 영암에 속한 섬들과 그 앞바다에서 수적들이 거도선(居刀船)이라는 빠른 선박을 이용하여 약탈을 행함
t: Water bandits used fast boats called geodoseon to plunder the islands and offshore waters belonging to Naju and Yeongam in Jeolla-do.

src: 영안도(永安道)의 토호(土豪)들이 양민을 많이 점유하여 세전관하(世傳管下)라고 이름하고 노비(奴婢)처럼 부림
t: Local strongmen of Yeongan-do possessed many commoners, calling them saejeon-gwanha, and used them like slaves.

src: 속신(贖身)한 노비들이 사망하였다고 사칭하였다가 생존하여 현재 잡힌 자가 자못 많으니, 자세히 추쇄(推刷)할 것을 추쇄수개도감(推刷修改都監)에서 아룀
t: The Chusoesugaedogam reported that among slaves who had redeemed their status, quite a few who had falsely claimed to have died were actually alive and had now been caught, so they should be thoroughly investigated.

src: 임하사전탑과 법흥사전탑 중수
t: The Imhasa Stone Pagoda and Beopheungsa Stone Pagoda were repaired.

src: 황해도에서 무장을 갖춘 산적들이 관찰사를 포위해 위협하고 마을을 횡행함
t: Armed mountain bandits in Hwanghae-do surrounded and threatened the provincial governor and rampaged through villages.

src: 속공(屬公)된 사천(私賤)이 사실이 애매한 것은 모두 본주인에 돌려주도록 함
t: Private slaves that had been confiscated to the state but whose facts were ambiguous were all ordered to be returned to their original masters.

src: 왕비가 양노연을 베품.
t: The Queen held a feast for the elderly at Seonjeongjeon.

src: 부모가 아들들에게 노비를 나누어 줄 때 문서를 만들지 않아, 여러 아들들이 각각 따로 부리다가 자손들에게 전해 줄 때 조부모가 나누어 주지 않은 노비라 칭하고 소송하는 일들이 자주 있으니 대책을 세워야 한다고 김경조
t: Kim Gyeong-jo said that when parents divided slaves among their sons without making documents, the sons each managed them separately, and when passing them to their descendants, disputes frequently arose over slaves claimed not to have been divided by the grandparents, so measures should be established.

src: 중궁이 선정전에서 양노연을 베품.
t: The Queen Consort held a feast for the elderly at Seonjeongjeon.

src: 예산(禮山)의 사노(私奴) 동질삼(同叱三)이 남의 집을 불사르고 사람을 쏘아 죽이고 잡물(雜物)을 강탈하였으므로 처형하도록 함
t: Dongjilsam, a private slave of Yesan, burned down another person's house, shot and killed a person, and robbed various goods, so he was ordered to be executed.

src: 호조(戶曹)에서 구(舊)저화(楮貨)와 신(新)저화(楮貨)의 구분 사용을 건의함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: The Hojo (Board of Taxation) proposed the separate use of old jeohwa and new jeohwa. Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 풍기현감 윤석보(尹碩輔) 부임
t: Yun Seok-bo, magistrate of Punggi County, took office.

src: 중궁이 선정전에서 양노연을 베품.
t: The Queen Consort held a feast for the elderly at Seonjeongjeon.

src: 북정도원수 허종(許琮)이 두만강을 건너 여진족을 토벌함.
t: Heo Jong, the Supreme Commander of the Northern Expedition, crossed the Duman River and subjugated the Jurchen.

src: 올적합(兀狄哈) 1천여 명이 조산보(造山堡)를 공격하여 경흥 부사 나사종(羅嗣宗)이 전사함.
t: About 1,000 Udige (兀狄哈) attacked Josanbo (造山堡), and the Governor of Gyeongheung, Na Sa-jong (羅嗣宗), was killed in action.

src: 탁청정 김유(濯淸亭 金緌) 출생
t: Takcheongjeong Kim Yu (濯淸亭 金緌) was born.

src: 영천자 신잠(靈川子 申潛) 출생
t: Yeongcheonja Sin Jam (靈川子 申潛) was born.

src: 우림위(羽林衛)를 설치하여 사족의 서자(庶子) 중에서 무재(武才)가 있는 자를 소속시킴.
t: The Uriimwi (羽林衛) was established, and among the illegitimate sons of the sajok, those with martial talent were enrolled in it.

src: 대소인원 및 양인취공사천소생(良人娶公私賤所生)은 비록 16세가 넘었더라도 아울러 보충대에 속하는 것을 허락함.
t: It was permitted that persons of all ranks, as well as those born from a commoner marrying a public or private slave (良人娶公私賤所生), be enrolled in the Bochungdae (補充隊) even if they were over 16 years of age.

src: 1455년 작은 활자로 간행된
t: Published in small type in 1455

src: 이 잠(李 箴) 부임
t: Yi Jam (李 箴) took office.

src: 중궁이 선정전에서 양노연을 베품.
t: The Queen held a feast for the elderly (養老宴) at Seonjeongjeon (宣政殿).

src: 유생복식, 사대부혼가의 사치풍속을 없애도록 함.
t: The extravagant customs in the attire of Confucian students and the marriages of sadaebu families were ordered to be abolished.

src: 왕비가 후원의 채상단에 왕세자빈 및 내외명부를 거느리고 친잠을 행함.
t: The Queen, accompanied by the Crown Princess and the ranked ladies of the inner and outer courts, performed the rite of silkworm rearing (親蠶) at the mulberry-picking altar (採桑壇) in the rear garden.

src: 왕비가 선정전에서 양노연을 베품.
t: The Queen held a feast for the elderly (養老宴) at Seonjeongjeon (宣政殿).

src: 경상도의 효녀, 절부를 정문복호(旌門復戶)함.
t: Filial daughters and chaste wives of Gyeongsang-do were honored with commemorative gates and exemption from labor duties (旌門復戶).

src: 폐비 윤씨의 기일에 소선(素膳)을 올림.
t: A vegetarian meal (素膳) was offered on the death anniversary of the deposed Queen Yun.

src: 마애 권예(磨厓 權輗) 출생
t: Maae Gwon Ye (磨厓 權輗) was born.

src: 폐비 윤씨의 묘를 장단으로 옮기고 제를 지냄.
t: The tomb of the deposed Queen Yun was moved to Jangdan, and a memorial rite was held.

src: 폐비 윤씨의 묘가 무너져 뼈가 드러나므로 천장토록 함.
t: As the tomb of the deposed Queen Yun collapsed and the bones were exposed, it was ordered to be relocated (遷葬).

src: 각사 비자 및 사족첩녀자로 자색이 있는 자 50명을 시녀로 뽑도록 함.
t: Fifty women of good appearance, selected from female slaves of government offices and daughters of concubines of the sajok, were ordered to be chosen as court maids.

src: 온계 이해(溫溪 李瀣) 출생
t: Ongye Yi Hae (溫溪 李瀣) was born.

src: 폐비 윤씨의 묘(廟)를 효사묘(孝思廟), 묘(墓)를 회묘(懷墓)라고 함.
t: The shrine (廟) of the deposed Queen Yun was named Hyosamyo (孝思廟), and her tomb (墓) was named Hoemyo (懷墓).

src: 각사 비자 14세에서 15세로 자색이 있는 자 10명을 뽑아 수모(首母)에게 분예전습(分隷傳習)하여 입내시킴.
t: Ten female slaves of government offices, aged 14 to 15 and of good appearance, were selected and assigned to a suhmo (首母) for training before entering the palace.

src: 음란남녀를 사형에 처하는 법을 정함.
t: A law was established to punish licentious men and women with death.

src: 내관의 사비를 처로 삼는 자는 잔읍(殘邑)의 노로 삼고 아울러 이혼(離異)하게 함.
t: Those who took a private slave woman of an eunuch as a wife were made slaves of a remote county (殘邑) and were also made to divorce.

src: 홍길동(洪吉童)과 연계된 조정의 무신 엄귀손(嚴貴孫)이 처벌됨
t: Eom Gwi-son (嚴貴孫), a military official at court connected to Hong Gil-dong (洪吉童), was punished.

src: 각 관청의 노비를 내수사(內需司) 소속으로 옮기는 문제에 대해 성현(成俔) 등이 부당함을 아룀
t: Regarding the matter of transferring slaves of various government offices to the Naesusa (內需司), Seong Hyeon (成俔) and others reported that it was improper.

src: 도적 홍길동(洪吉童)이 도성 근처에서 첨지(僉知)라 자칭하며 대낮에도 무리를 지어 무장하고 활동하다 체포돼 잔여 세력에 대한 소탕령이 내려짐
t: The bandit Hong Gil-dong (洪吉童), who called himself Cheomji (僉知) and operated in armed groups even in broad daylight near the capital, was arrested, and an order was issued to suppress his remaining forces.

src: 감로사(甘露寺)의 노비도 모두 내수사(內需司)에 소속되어 있는데, 지금 사족(士族)의 집 노비들이 감로사의 노비라 칭하고 모두 내수사에 들어가 속해 있으니 그 폐해가 적지 않다고 이예견(李禮堅)이 아룀
t: Yi Ye-gyeon reported that the slaves of Gamnosa Temple were all affiliated with the Office of Royal Household Affairs, and that now the slaves of scholar-official families were calling themselves slaves of Gamnosa Temple and were all entering into affiliation with the Office of Royal Household Affairs, causing considerable harm.

src: 문정왕후 윤씨 출생함.
t: Queen Munjeong (Lady Yun) was born.

src: 자녀가 없는 대군(大君)이나 공주의 양자(養子)에게는 노비 1백명을 주고, 왕자군(王子君)과 옹주(翁主)의 양자에게는 노비 70명을 주고, 나머지는 모두 내수사(內需司)에 도로 소속시키는 등의 조치를 취함
t: Measures were taken whereby the adopted son of a childless Grand Prince or Princess was given 100 slaves, the adopted son of a Prince or Princess Ongju was given 70 slaves, and the remainder were all returned to the Office of Royal Household Affairs.

src: 퇴계 이황(退溪 李滉) 출생
t: Toegye Yi Hwang was born.

src: 문외의 행행에는 여악을 쓰지 못하도록 함.
t: It was ordered that female musicians not be used for royal processions outside the palace gates.

src: 입거한 자의 딸을 처첩으로 삼아 경외에 거느리고 사는 것을 일체 금함.
t: It was completely prohibited for anyone to take the daughters of resettled persons as wives or concubines and to live with them, whether inside or outside the capital.

src: 공사천(公私賤)의 노비가 양민(良民)에게 시집가 낳은 딸자식을 오부(五部)가 수색하고, 그 아버지의 신상을 파악하도록 지시함
t: It was ordered that the Five Districts search for daughters born to public and private slaves who had married commoners, and ascertain the identity of their fathers.

src: 후손이 없는 왕자군(王子君)의 노비를 내수사(內需司)에 소속시킨 후 만일 죽은 자가 있으면 모두 곤장을 때려 신문하니, 이를 개선하라고 명령함
t: After the slaves of a Prince who had no descendants were made to belong to the Office of Royal Household Affairs, if any of them died, all were flogged and interrogated; an order was given to reform this.

src: 내수사(內需司)와 대군(大君) 및 공주(公主)의 집 노비들은 모두 호역(戶役)을 면제해 주니 부역을 모면하려는 백성들이 많이 들어간다고 정인인(鄭麟仁)이 아룀
t: Jeong In-in reported that since the slaves of the Office of Royal Household Affairs and of the households of Grand Princes and Princesses were all exempted from household labor service, many commoners seeking to evade labor service were entering into their households.

src: 제안대군(齊安大君)의 가비(家婢)인 장녹수(張綠水)는 집이 매우 가난하여 몸을 팔아서 생활을 했으므로 시집을 여러 번 갔는데, 대군(大君)의 가노(家奴)의 아내가 된 후 노래와 춤을 배워서 창기(娼妓)가 됨
t: Jang Nok-su, a household maidservant of Grand Prince Jean, came from a very poor family and had lived by selling herself, having been married several times; after becoming the wife of a household slave of the Grand Prince, she learned singing and dancing and became a courtesan.

src: 각사 비자 및 양녀 중 8세에서 11세로 용모단정한 자를 뽑도록 함.
t: It was ordered to select girls aged 8 to 11 of good appearance from among the female slaves of the various government offices and commoners' daughters.

src: 내수사(內需司)의 노비는 공역(公役)이 가벼운 까닭에, 공사(公私)의 노비들이 서로 다투어 투속(投屬)한다고 최한원(崔漢源)이 아룀
t: Choe Han-won reported that because the public labor service of the slaves of the Office of Royal Household Affairs was light, public and private slaves were competing with each other to submit themselves into its affiliation.

src: 신사임당(申師任堂) 출생함.
t: Sin Saimdang was born.

src: 폐비 윤씨를 재헌왕후로 추숭함.
t: Posthumously honored the deposed Queen Yun as Queen Jaeheon.

src: 후궁이 비구니(尼)가 되는 것을 금함.
t: Prohibited royal concubines from becoming Buddhist nuns.

src: 폐비 사건에 관련된 후궁 엄씨, 정씨를 죽임.(폐비윤씨사건)
t: Executed royal concubines Eom and Jeong, who were involved in the case of the deposed queen. (Case of Deposed Queen Yun)

src: 진연시에 의녀 80명을 택하여 여기(女妓) 중 재능있는 자에게 배워 어전 계단 위에 앉도록 함.
t: Selected 80 female physicians for royal banquets, and had those with talent among the female entertainers learn from them, seating them above the steps before the king.

src: 소혜왕후 한씨가 68세로 경춘전에서 죽음.
t: Queen Sohye, Lady Han, died at age 68 in Gyeongchunjeon.

src: 입계문에 부녀를 모성(某姓)이라 칭하고 씨(氏)라 칭하지 않게 함.
t: Ordered that in memorials submitted to the throne, women be referred to by 'a certain surname' rather than 'ssi'.

src: 각도의 노비의 신공(身貢)으로 한 사람마다 면포 1필을 더 바치도록 함
t: Ordered that slaves in each province pay one additional bolt of cotton cloth per person as body tribute.

src: 부인봉작 추증시에는 성명을 아울러 쓰도록 함.
t: Ordered that when posthumously conferring titles upon wives, their full names be written together.

src: 채청사를 8도에 분견함.
t: Dispatched honey-collecting envoys to the eight provinces.

src: 미가녀(未嫁女)를 청녀(靑女)라 칭호함.
t: Called unmarried women 'cheongnyeo'.

src: 중종의 초혼인 단경왕후 신씨를 궁에서 내보냄.
t: Expelled King Jungjong's first wife, Queen Dangyeong, Lady Sin, from the palace.

src: 월산대군 정의 처에게 승평부부인(昇平府夫人)이라는 호를 내림.
t: Granted the title of Seungpyeong-bubuin to the wife of Grand Prince Wolsan, Jeong.

src: 충공도(忠公道)부여(扶餘)에 사는 내수사(內需司)의 종 불동(佛同) 등이 일찍이 신고한 감로사(甘露寺)의 누락된 노비 2천여 명을 추쇄(推刷)하기 위하여 각도와 각 관청에게 장부에 적어 올려보내라고 명령함
t: Ordered each province and government office to compile registers and report them, in order to track down and seize more than 2,000 missing slaves of Gamnosa Temple that had previously been reported by Buldong and other slaves of the Bureau of Royal Household living in Buyeo, Chunggong-do.

src: 숙원 윤씨를 왕비로 삼음.
t: Made Consort Suk-won of the Yun clan queen.

src: 명화적(明火賊)이 횡행하자 지방에서 도성으로 옮겨온 재인(才人)과 백정(白丁)을 돌려 보냄
t: As bandits (myeonghwajeok) ran rampant, entertainers (jaein) and butchers (baekjeong) who had moved from the provinces to the capital were sent back.

src: 교종(敎宗)과 선종(禪宗)의 노비와 토지를 내수사(內需司)로 이속(移屬)하게 함
t: Had the slaves and land of the Doctrinal School (Gyojong) and the Seon School (Seonjong) transferred to the Bureau of Royal Household.

src: 전에 나인(內人)이 강제로 사들였던 노비와 토지, 집을 본주인에게 되돌려주라고 명령함
t: Ordered that slaves, land, and houses that had previously been forcibly purchased by court ladies (nain) be returned to their original owners.

src: 강원도원주(原州), 충청도의 황간, 영동, 옥천, 연풍, 괴산, 청안, 전라도의 무주, 금산, 경상도의 문경, 상주, 지례, 금산, 거창, 산음 등지에서 도적들이 떼를 지어 운반하는 부세를 빼앗고 토호들과 관청을 습
t: In Wonju of Gangwon-do; Hwanggan, Yeongdong, Okcheon, Yeonpung, Goesan, and Cheongan of Chungcheong-do; Muju and Geumsan of Jeolla-do; and Mungyeong, Sangju, Jirye, Geumsan, Geochang, and Sanŭm of Gyeongsang-do, bandits formed gangs, seized tax goods being transported, and attacked local gentry and government offices.

src: 죽헌 정두(竹軒 鄭枓) 출생
t: Jeong Du (Jukheon) was born.

src: 묵재 박사희(默齋 朴士熹) 출생
t: Park Sa-hui (Mukjae) was born.

src: 관물당 반충(觀物堂 潘沖) 출생
t: Ban Chung (Gwanmuldang) was born.

src: 해주 사람이 신무문(神武門) 밖에서 고을 수령의 불법을 격쟁(擊錚)함
t: A man from Haeju beat a gong (gyeokjaeng) outside Sinmumun Gate to petition against the illegal acts of the local magistrate.

src: 황해도 송화(松禾)에서 도적의 무리가 관아를 습격하여 군기를 탈취하고 옥문을 부수어 붙잡힌 동료들을 탈출시킴
t: In Songhwa, Hwanghae-do, a group of bandits attacked the government office, seized weapons, broke open the prison gate, and freed their captured comrades.

src: 연산군(燕山君)때 공사천 및 양민과 역자(驛子)가 모두 괴로운 역사(役使)를 싫어하여 내수사(內需司)에 투탁(投託)하여 들어왔으니, 이를 모두 찾아낼 것을 대간(臺諫)이 아룀
t: The Censorate (Daegan) reported that during the reign of Yeonsangun, public and private slaves, commoners, and station workers (yeokja), all disliking harsh labor duties, had entered under the protection of the Bureau of Royal Household, and requested that they all be found out.

src: 내수사(內需司)에 편입된 각 관청의 노비들을 지금까지 본래의 관청으로 돌려 보내지 않고 그대로 내수사에 두고 있으므로 사섬시(司贍寺)는 공납(貢納)이 지극히 적으니, 본 관청에 속하게 하라고 이세인(李世仁)이 아룀
t: Yi Se-in reported that the slaves of various government offices who had been incorporated into the Bureau of Royal Household had still not been returned to their original offices but remained under the Bureau, so that the Saseomsi received extremely little tribute, and requested that they be made to belong to their original offices.

src: 안동부사 송여해(宋汝諧) 부임
t: Song Yeo-hae took office as magistrate of Andong.

src: 삼포(三浦)에 거주하던 왜인들이 난을 일으켜 부산포(釜山浦)와 제포(薺浦)를 점령함. (삼포왜란)
t: The Japanese residing in the Three Ports (Sampo) rose in rebellion and occupied Busanpo and Jepo. (Sampo Rebellion)

src: 대소인원 연회에 의녀 및 창기를 초치하는 것을 엄금함.
t: Strictly prohibited inviting female physicians (uinyeo) and courtesans (changgi) to banquets of officials of all ranks.

src: 향리(鄕吏)와 역리(驛吏), 염한(鹽干), 목자(牧子)에게 시집간 자기비(自己婢)가 낳은 딸을 양인으로 할 것인지 천인으로 할 것인지를 의논함
t: Discussed whether daughters born to one's own female slaves who had married local clerks (hyangni), station clerks (yeokri), salt workers (yeomhan), or herders (mokja) should be classified as commoners or as low-born.

src: 중궁이 사정전에서 양노연을 베품.
t: The queen held a feast for the elderly at Sajeongjeon Hall.

src: 실행부녀의 정죄법으로 본인 및 간부를 아울러 처교하도록 함.
t: Established that for the law of sentencing wayward women (silhaeng bunyeo), both the woman herself and her paramour were to be executed by strangulation.

src: 혼인, 친영례를 왕실, 경대부가에서 실행하도록 하여 사대부나 서인이 배우도록 함.
t: Had the royal family and households of high officials (gyeongdaebu) carry out the marriage ceremony of the groom's family fetching the bride (chinyeongnye), so that scholar-officials (sadaebu) and commoners (seoin) could learn from it.

src: 남원(南原)에서는 품관(品官)들이 강성하여 관청의 노비들을 부리기를 자기의 부조노비(父祖奴婢)를 부리듯이 한다고 유순정(柳順汀)이 아룀
t: Yu Sun-jeong reported that in Namwon, local officials (pumgwan) had become so powerful that they employed government slaves as if they were their own ancestral slaves.

src: 중궁이 내외명부를 거느리고 후원에서 친잠을 행함.
t: The queen led the inner and outer ranks of court ladies (myeongbu) and performed the rite of sericulture (chinjam) in the rear garden.

src: 박상 등이 상소하여 단경왕후 신씨의 복위를 논하자 대간이 반대함.
t: Park Sang and others submitted a memorial arguing for the restoration of Queen Dangyeong of the Sin clan, but the Censorate opposed it.

src: 궁녀를 취하는 것을 금함.
t: Prohibited taking court ladies as wives.

src: 풍기현감 정광보(鄭光輔) 부임
t: Jeong Gwang-bo took office as magistrate of Punggi.

src: 장경왕후 윤씨가 25세로 경복궁 별전에서 죽음.
t: Queen Janggyeong of the Yun clan died at age 25 in a separate hall of Gyeongbokgung Palace.

src: 공사천(公私賤)의 남녀가 혼인하여 낳은 자식은 모두 천인(賤人)이 되어 양민이 점점 적어지니, 금후로는 아버지쪽을 따르든가 어머니쪽을 따르든가 일정한 법을 제정하여 양인 남녀의 자식은 모두 천인이 되지 않게 하자고
t: Children born from marriages between men and women of public and private lowborn status all became lowborn, so commoners were gradually decreasing; it was proposed that from now on, whether following the father's side or the mother's side, a fixed law should be established so that children of commoner men and women would not all become lowborn.

src: 안동부사 이우(李堣) 부임
t: Lee U appointed as magistrate of Andong.

src: 입암 유중영(立巖 柳仲郢) 출생
t: Ipam Yu Jung-yeong born.

src: 조관이 의기를 불러 술을 따르게 하는 것을 금함.
t: Banned court officials from summoning female entertainers (uigi) to pour drinks.

src: 친영, 향음주례를 중외에 효유하여 고제에 의해서 시행하게 함.
t: Proclaimed the marriage-welcoming rite (chinyeong) and the village drinking rite (hyangeumjurye) throughout the capital and provinces, to be carried out according to ancient rites.

src: 조종조에 왕패(王牌)를 내린 곳이라 하더라도 사찰의 노비는 능침(陵寢)이 있는 데만 제외하고 모두 추쇄(推刷)하여 속공하도록 명령함
t: Ordered that even in places where royal warrants (wangpae) had been issued in previous reigns, all temple slaves except those at royal tomb sites be confiscated and converted to public ownership.

src: 동호 변영청(東湖 邊永淸) 출생
t: Dongho Byeon Yeong-cheong born.

src: 귀촌 유경심(龜村 柳景深) 출생
t: Gwichon Yu Gyeong-sim born.

src: 후조당 김부필(後彫堂 金富弼) 출생
t: Hujodang Kim Bu-pil born.

src: 윤지임의 딸을 중궁으로 정함.
t: Yun Ji-im's daughter was designated as queen consort.

src: 축성사(築城司)를 비변사(備邊司)로 고침
t: Changed the Fortress Construction Office (Chukseongsa) to the Border Defense Council (Bibyeonsa).

src: 무격의 세포를 걷어들이지 못하도록 함.
t: Prohibited the collection of cloth taxes from shamans.

src: 소학, 열녀전, 여계, 여훈 등을 언문으로 번역 간행하여 중외에 퍼지게 함.
t: Had the Sohak, Yeollyeojeon, Yeogye, and Yeohun translated into vernacular script (eonmun) and published to be spread throughout the capital and provinces.

src: 내수사(內需司)의 노비는 사천(私賤)이 분명한 자들도 한결같이 선두안(宣頭案) 기록대로만 하므로 본주인을 버리고 들어온 노비들이 많으니, 이를 분간하여 등록하자고 조언형(曹彦亨)이 아룀
t: Jo Eon-hyeong reported that even though the private-slave status of Naesusa slaves was clear, they were recorded only according to the Seondu-an register, so many slaves who had abandoned their original masters had joined; this should be distinguished and registered.

src: 안동부사 이현보(李賢輔) 부임
t: Lee Hyeon-bo appointed as magistrate of Andong.

src: 일찍 과부가 된 사람에게 재가를 허락할 것을 상소하였으나 왕이 불가하다고 함.
t: A memorial was submitted proposing to allow remarriage for those who became widows early, but the king said it was not permissible.

src: 노비가 결혼하여 낳은 소생은 공천과 사천을 막론하고 일체 어머니를 따르게 하여 양인을 늘이고, 노비를 소유할 수 있는 명수를 제한하자고 유옥(柳沃)이 제안함
t: Yu Ok proposed that children born from marriages of slaves, whether public or private, should all follow the mother's status to increase the commoner population, and that the number of slaves one could own should be limited.

src: 황해도 일대에서 임꺽정의 무리가 횡행하고 관군들과 여러차례 접전을 벌였으나 오랫동안 체포되지 않음(임꺽정의 난)
t: In the Hwanghae-do region, Im Kkeokjeong's band ran rampant and clashed with government troops several times but was not captured for a long time (Im Kkeokjeong's rebellion).

src: 의주목사 이수철(李壽鐵)이 다른 사람을 붙잡아 임꺽정이라 보고하였다 처벌됨
t: Uiju magistrate Lee Su-cheol was punished for capturing another person and reporting him as Im Kkeokjeong.

src: 황해도순경사(黃海道巡警使) 이사증(李思曾)이 임꺽정의 부하 가도치를 붙잡아 형장을 가해 임꺽정이란 허위 자백을 얻어내고 조정에 보고하다 처벌됨

t: Jurchen forces raided Nokdundo (鹿屯島), killing over ten soldiers.

t: Haksa Kim Eungjo (鶴沙 金應祖) was born.

t: Northern Army Commander (北兵使) Yi Il (李鎰) compiled and submitted the Jeseungbangnyak (制勝方略).

t: Bandits (草賊) in Pyongyang stole belongings from a party of an inspector of the State Tribunal (義禁府都事) who was escorting a criminal.

src: 북병사 이일(李鎰)이 녹둔도(鹿屯島)를 기습한 시전번호(時錢藩胡)를 토벌함

t: Deputy Commander Shin Gak (申恪) defeated Japanese forces at Haeyuryeong (蟹踰嶺) in Yangju and beheaded over 60 of them.

src: 평양성(平壤城) 함락. 선조 의주(義州)로 피난
t: Pyongyang Fortress fell. King Seonjo fled to Uiju.

src: 임진강 방어선의 붕괴. 조방장 유극량(劉克亮) 전사.
t: The Imjin River defense line collapsed. Assistant commander Yu Geuk-ryang died in battle.

src: 상주(尙州)에서 순변사 이일(李鎰)이 패배하여 충주(忠州)로 철수.
t: At Sangju, Patrol Commander Yi Il was defeated and retreated to Chungju.

src: 동래성이 함락되고 부사 송상현(宋象賢), 양산 군수 조영규(趙英珪) 등이 전사
t: Dongnae Fortress fell, and Magistrate Song Sang-hyeon, Yangsan County Magistrate Jo Yeong-gyu, and others died in battle.

src: 고니시 유키나가(小西行長)의 일본군 제1군이 절영도(絶影島)에 상륙. 임진왜란 시작.
t: Konishi Yukinaga's Japanese First Army landed at Jeolyeongdo. The Imjin War began.

src: 유성룡(柳成龍)이 군제를 진관체제(鎭管體制)로 복구할 것을 청함.
t: Yu Seong-ryong requested that the military system be restored to the township defense system.

src: 순천에서 도적들이 일어나 성중의 관곡을 훔쳐감
t: Bandits rose up in Suncheon and stole government grain from within the walled town.

src: 하삼도(下三道)의 번상병들을 명나라 군중에 보내어 남병(南兵)의 무기와 진법(陣法) 등을 익히게 함.
t: Rotational soldiers from the three southern provinces were sent to the Ming army camp to practice the weapons and battle formations of the southern troops.

src: 동지사 허진(許晉)에게 명하여 척계광의 기효신서(紀效新書)중 왕세정(王世貞)이 서문을 쓴 판본을 구입하게 함.
t: Winter Solstice Envoy Heo Jin was ordered to purchase the edition of Qi Jiguang's Jixiao Xinshu with a preface by Wang Shizhen.

src: 이여송(李如松)이 고양 벽제관(碧蹄館) 근처에서 일본군의 기습으로 패배하고 파주(坡州)로 퇴각.
t: Li Rusong was defeated by a surprise Japanese attack near Byeokjegwan in Goyang and retreated to Paju.

src: 일본군이 경상도안의(安義)의 황석산성(黃石山城)을 공격하여 성이 함락되고 현감 곽준(郭䞭) 등이 전사.
t: Japanese forces attacked Hwangseoksanseong in Anui, Gyeongsang Province, and the fortress fell; Magistrate Gwak Jun and others died in battle.

src: 경상도와 충청도 속리산 등지에서 많은 도적들이 일어남
t: Many bandits rose up in Gyeongsang and Chungcheong provinces, including around Songnisan.

src: 낭청 한교(韓嶠)를 기복(起復)시켜 ≪기효신서(紀效新書)≫를 번역하여 편찬하게 함.
t: Assistant section chief Han Gyo was recalled from mourning to translate and compile the Jixiao Xinshu.

src: 경기도 인근에서 도적이 일어나 관군을 공격하고 고을을 약탈함
t: Bandits rose up in the area near Gyeonggi Province, attacking government troops and pillaging towns.

src: 황해도 정병(精兵) 4천 명을 ≪기효신서(紀效新書)≫의 속오법(束伍法)으로 편성하여 훈련하게 함.
t: 4,000 elite soldiers of Hwanghae Province were organized according to the sok-o method of the Jixiao Xinshu and trained.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)을 설치하고 유성룡(柳成龍)을 도제조로 임명함.
t: The Training Command was established, and Yu Seong-ryong was appointed as its Chief Superintendent.

src: 전라도 각 처에서 도적들이 수백명씩 일어나 횡행하고 태인에서는 옥문을 부수고 죄수들을 탈취해감
t: In various places in Jeolla Province, bandits rose up in bands of several hundred and ran rampant; in Taein they broke down the prison gates and freed the prisoners.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에서
t: At the Training Command,

src: 각 지방의 병사들을 무학사목(武學事目)에 따라 거주지에 모여 군사 훈련을 시킬 것을 명함.
t: It was ordered that soldiers of each region gather at their places of residence and undergo military training according to the Regulations for Military Training.

src: 입직 포수(砲手)로 하여금 삼안총(三眼銃)을 연습하게 하고, 살수(殺手) 훈련을 위해
t: Guard gunners were made to practice with the three-barreled gun, and for the training of swordsmen,

src: 청량산성(淸凉山城) 개축
t: Cheongnyangsanseong was rebuilt.

src: 수은 이홍조(睡隱 李弘祚) 출생
t: Sueun Yi Hong-jo was born.

src: 남부 주부 신충일(申忠一)이 건주위(建州衛)에서 돌아와 그곳의 정세와 군사 시설 등에 대해 보고함.
t: Deputy Section Chief Sin Chung-il returned from Jianzhou Guard and reported on the conditions and military facilities there.

src: 도체찰사 유성룡(柳成龍)이 ＜연병규식(鍊兵規式)＞을 정하여 경기, 황해, 평안, 함경도에 반포함.
t: Military Commissioner Yu Seong-ryong established the Regulations for Training Troops and promulgated them to Gyeonggi, Hwanghae, Pyeongan, and Hamgyeong provinces.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에 명하여 불랑기(佛狼機) 등 각종 화포의 사용법을 번역하게 하고, 안변에 있는 연환(鉛丸) 10만개를 가져오게 함
t: The Training Command was ordered to translate the usage instructions for various firearms, including the Bulanggi cannon, and to bring 100,000 lead bullets from Anbyeon.

src: 이몽학(李夢鶴)이 반란을 일으켜 홍산현(鴻山縣)을 습격하여 점령함. 이후 청양(淸陽) 등 여러 고을을 점령하여 위세를 떨치다 진압됨(이몽학의 난)이이화,
t: Yi Mong-hak rose in revolt and attacked and occupied Hongsan-hyeon. He then occupied several towns including Cheongyang and displayed his power before being suppressed (Yi Mong-hak's Revolt).

src: 천등산성(天燈山城) 중수
t: Cheondeungsanseong fortress was repaired.

src: 해남, 강진, 장흥, 보성, 무안 등의 백성들이 왜군에 귀의하여 양반층에 저항함
t: The common people of Haenam, Gangjin, Jangheung, Boseong, and Muan surrendered to the Japanese army and resisted the yangban class.

src: 내노(內奴)를 군사에 보충할 것을 장만(張晩)이 아룀
t: Jang Man reported that palace slaves should be added to supplement the army.

src: 일본군의 침공군 주력이 6백여 척의 선단에 의하여 경상도 남해안 일대에 상륙. 정유재란 발발
t: The main Japanese invasion force landed on the southern coast of Gyeongsang Province with a fleet of over 600 ships. The Jeongyu War broke out.

src: 명량(鳴梁) 수로에서 이순신(李舜臣) 함대 12척이 일본 함대 130여 척을 격파. 전라도 해안의 제해권 회복.
t: In the waters of Myeongnyang, Yi Sun-sin's fleet of 12 ships defeated a Japanese fleet of over 130 ships, restoring control of the seas along the Jeolla coast.

src: 명나라 경리 양호(楊鎬)가 지휘하는 조,명 연합군이 울산 도산성(島山城)의 일본군을 수 차례 공격하였으나 실패함.
t: The allied Joseon-Ming army commanded by Ming supervisor Yang Hao attacked the Japanese forces at Dosanseong in Ulsan several times but failed.

src: 경상 우조방장 곽재우가 창녕(昌寧)의 화왕산성(火旺山城)을 거점으로 가토오 키요마사 휘하의 일본군 공격을 수 차례 격퇴함
t: Gwak Jae-u, deputy commander of the right defense of Gyeongsang Province, using Hwawangsanseong in Changnyeong as his base, repelled several attacks by Japanese forces under Kato Kiyomasa.

src: 한교(韓嶠)가 조선 최초의 무예서인 ≪무예제보(武藝諸譜)≫를 편찬함.
t: Han Gyo compiled the Muyejebo, the first martial arts manual of Joseon.

src: 제독 마귀(麻貴)의 명나라 동로군이 울산 도산성의 일본군을 여러 날 공격하였으나 실패
t: The Ming eastern route army under commander Ma Gui attacked the Japanese forces at Dosanseong in Ulsan for several days but failed.

src: 명나라 중로군(中路軍)이 사천(泗川)의 일본군을 공격하여 신성(新城)으로 몰아냈으나 불랑기(佛狼機)의 오발 사고로 일본군의 역습을 받아 성주(星州)로 철수함.
t: The Ming central route army attacked the Japanese forces at Sacheon and drove them into Sinseong, but due to an accidental discharge of a Portuguese cannon, they suffered a Japanese counterattack and withdrew to Seongju.

src: 제독 유정(劉綎)이 지휘하는 명나라 서로군(西路軍)이 이순신(李舜臣)의 조선 수군과 합동으로 순천 왜교성(倭橋城)의 일본군을 10여 일 동안 공격하였으나 실패함.
t: The Ming western route army commanded by commander Liu Ting, together with the Joseon navy of Yi Sun-sin, attacked the Japanese forces at Waegyoseong in Suncheon for over ten days but failed.

src: 통제사 이순신(李舜臣)의 조선 수군과 진린(陳璘)의 명나라 수군 연합 함대가 노량(露梁) 앞 바다에서 일본군 선단을 공격하여 2백여 척을 격파함. 이순신은 일본군의 유탄에 전사.
t: The combined fleet of the Joseon navy under naval commander Yi Sun-sin and the Ming navy under Chen Lin attacked a Japanese fleet in the waters off Noryang, destroying over 200 ships. Yi Sun-sin was killed by a stray Japanese bullet.

src: 표은 김시온(瓢隱 金是榲) 출생
t: Pyoeun Kim Si-on was born.

src: 현감 금란수(琴蘭秀) 부임
t: Magistrate Geum Nan-su took office.

src: 판중추부사 이덕형(李德馨)에게 ≪무경요람(武經要覽)≫ 8권을 하사함.
t: Eight volumes of the Mugyeongyoram were bestowed upon Vice Councilor Yi Deok-hyeong.

src: 각지에서 화적이 일어나 민심이 안정되지 못함
t: Bandits arose in various regions and public sentiment was unsettled.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에 분화통(噴火筒)과 독화살에 바르는 독약의 제조를 명함
t: An order was given to the Military Training Command to manufacture fire-spraying tubes and poison for smearing on poisoned arrows.

src: 전라도에 기근이 들자 굶주린 사람들이 화적이 되어 횡행함
t: A famine struck Jeolla Province, and the starving people turned to banditry and ran rampant.

src: 평안도 성천(成川)에 남아 있는 ≪십일가주손자(十一家註孫子)≫를 판본으로 하여 간행할 것을 명함.
t: An order was given to use the surviving copy of the Sibilgajusonja in Seongcheon, Pyeongan Province, as the printing block for publication.

src: 오계서원(汚溪書院) 이건
t: Ogyeseowon academy was relocated.

src: 경기감사 기자헌이 난후의 충신, 효자, 절부를 치계하여 정표하게 함.
t: Gyeonggi governor Gi Ja-heon reported the loyal subjects, filial children, and chaste women after the war by memorial, so that they might be honored.

src: 경상도 병영(兵營)을 창원과 마산 등 형세가 험한 곳으로 옮길 것을 명함.
t: An order was given to relocate the Gyeongsang Province military headquarters to a strategically defensible place such as Changwon or Masan.

src: 우참찬 홍진(洪進)이 진관법(鎭管法)과 ≪제승방략(制勝方略)≫에 따라 군사를 훈련시킬 것을 주장.
t: Vice Councilor Hong Jin argued that soldiers should be trained according to the Jingwan system and the Jeseungbangnyak.

src: 류 영(柳 泳) 부임
t: Ryu Yeong took office.

src: 태촌 고상안(泰村 高尙顔) 출생
t: Go Sang-an (Taechon) was born.

src: 김제남의 딸을 왕비로 삼음.
t: Kim Je-nam's daughter was made queen.

src: 능성에서 군병 1만을 모아 운봉, 전주를 거쳐 도성을 격파한다는 글이 발견됨
t: A document was discovered stating that 10,000 troops would be gathered in Neungseong to break through Unbong and Jeonju and attack the capital.

src: 귀화한 호인(胡人) 가운데 명화적(明火賊)이 되는 자들이 많아 이들을 궁벽(窮僻)한 곳에 분산 수용함
t: Many naturalized Hu people (胡人) became bandits (明火賊), so they were dispersed and settled in remote places.

src: 왕비의 친영례를 태평관에서 행함.
t: The queen's welcoming ceremony was held at Taepyeonggwan.

src: 이몽학(李夢鶴)의 난 이후 영변, 해주에 괘서 사건이 발생하고, 거사(居士)를 칭하는 자가 만인동갑회(萬人同甲會)를 개최하여 수많은 사람을 끌어모음(이몽학(李夢鶴)의 난)
t: After Yi Mong-hak's Rebellion, incidents of posted placards occurred in Yeongbyeon and Haeju, and a person calling himself a lay Buddhist (居士) held the Manindonggaphoe (萬人同甲會) and gathered numerous people (Yi Mong-hak's Rebellion).

src: 천안의 화수(和愁), 전의의 고망난(高亡難)과 막금(莫金), 청주의 내은세(內隱世), 목천의 권생(權生), 진천의 한종손(韓從孫) 등이 각지의 사람들을 끌어모아 난을 꾀하다 발각됨
t: Hwasu of Cheonan, Go Mangnan and Makgeum of Jeonui, Naeunse of Cheongju, Gwonsaeng of Mokcheon, Han Jongson of Jincheon, and others gathered people from various regions to plot a rebellion, but it was discovered.

src: 명화적(明火賊)최유년(崔有年)이 처벌됨
t: The bandit (明火賊) Choe Yu-nyeon was punished.

src: 흉년의 기미가 있자 명화적(明火賊)이 곳곳에서 일어남
t: As signs of famine appeared, bandits (明火賊) rose up everywhere.

src: 포천에서 화적이 조정의 관료를 살해하고 재물을 탈취함
t: In Pocheon, bandits killed a court official and seized property.

src: 수원(水原)에서 화적이 민가의 재물을 탈취하고 충청도에서도 나타남
t: In Suwon, bandits seized property from private houses, and they also appeared in Chungcheong Province.

src: 강화도(江華島)의 수직 사관(守直史官)에게 명하여 ≪병장설(兵將說)≫, ≪진법(陣法)≫, ≪역대병요(歷代兵要)≫ 등을 올려 보내게 함.
t: The guard historian (守直史官) of Ganghwa Island was ordered to send up the Byeongjangseol (兵將說), Jinbeop (陣法), Yeokdaebyeongyo (歷代兵要), and others.

src: 은을 화폐로 사용하는 문제에 대해 논의함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: The issue of using silver as currency was discussed.

src: 화적들이 도성 내에서 횡행함
t: Bandits ran rampant within the capital.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에 추가로 마병을 설치하고 기사(騎射), 기창(騎槍) 등을 익히도록 함.
t: Cavalry was additionally established in the Directorate of Training (訓鍊都監), and mounted archery (騎射), mounted spearmanship (騎槍), and others were trained.

src: 임진왜란 중의 공훈에 따라 호성(扈聖), 선무(宣武), 청난(淸難) 3공신의 녹훈을 지급함(호성공신)(선무공신)(청난공신)
t: Merit titles were granted to the three groups of meritorious subjects — Hoseong (扈聖), Seonmu (宣武), and Cheongnan (淸難) — according to their merits during the Imjin War (Hoseong Meritorious Subjects)(Seonmu Meritorious Subjects)(Cheongnan Meritorious Subjects).

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에서 ≪연병실기(鍊兵實紀)≫, ≪기효신서(紀效新書)≫, ≪조련도식(操鍊圖式)≫, ≪권보(拳譜)≫를 인출하게 함.
t: The Directorate of Training (訓鍊都監) had the Yeonbyeongsilgi (鍊兵實紀), Gihyosinseo (紀效新書), Joryeondosik (操鍊圖式), and Gwonbo (拳譜) printed.

src: 《화첩(畵帖)》과《약포영첩(藥圃影帖)》을 그림
t: The Hwacheop (畵帖) and Yakpoyeongcheop (藥圃影帖) were painted.

src: 평안도 동관(潼關)이 여진족의 공격으로 함락됨
t: Donggwan (潼關) in Pyeongan Province fell to a Jurchen attack.

src: 경기 감사 이정구(李廷龜)가 행주산성(幸州山城)의 수축을 건의함.
t: Gyeonggi Governor Yi Jeong-gu proposed the repair of Haengju Mountain Fortress (幸州山城).

src: 여진족을 막기 위해 각종 화기(火器)를 충분히 보내고 방어군을 입송시킴.
t: To block the Jurchens, various firearms (火器) were sufficiently sent, and defense troops were dispatched.

src: 영소일에 부인관광을 통금하고 범하는 사족은 그 가장을 치죄하게 함.
t: On Yeongsoil, women were prohibited from sightseeing, and if a person of the sajok class violated this, the head of the household was to be punished.

src: 병조에서 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에 보관된 ≪연병실기(鍊兵實紀)≫를 바탕으로 50-60 건을 인쇄하여 반사함.
t: The Ministry of War printed 50 to 60 copies based on the Yeonbyeongsilgi (鍊兵實紀) kept at the Directorate of Training (訓鍊都監) and distributed them.

src: 임해군(臨海君)이 사가(私家)에서 백성을 구타하며 노비를 마음대로 빼앗고, 사나운 종을 시켜 여염집을 부수며 가는 곳마다 주민을 침탈함
t: Prince Imhae beat commoners at his private residence, seized slaves at will, had his fierce servants destroy commoners' houses, and plundered residents wherever he went.

src: 완담서원(浣潭書院) 이건
t: Wandam Seowon was relocated.

src: 안동부사 정구(鄭逑) 부임
t: Andong magistrate Jeong Gu takes office.

src: 태백산사고지(太白山史庫址) 건립
t: The site of the Taebaeksan Historical Archive was established.

src: 삼도수군통제사(三道水軍統制使)를 기본 직임으로 하고 수사를 겸하도록 하여 통제사의 격을 높임.
t: The Naval Commander of the Three Provinces was made the principal post, with the position concurrently holding that of Naval Commander, thereby raising the rank of the Naval Commander of the Three Provinces.

src: 흉년이 들어 곳곳에서 도적이 일어나고 그 중 경기도, 황해도에서 가장 극심함
t: A famine occurred, and bandits arose in many places, being most severe in Gyeonggi and Hwanghae Provinces.

src: 사람을 죽여 쓸개를 빼내 가는 일이 일어나고 있다는 와언(訛言)이 퍼져 인적이 끊기고 농사가 폐해짐
t: A false rumor spread that people were being killed to have their gallbladders removed, causing the roads to empty of people and farming to be abandoned.

src: 철산(鐵山) 군수(郡守)와 미관(彌串) 첨사(僉使)가 이끄는 관군과 서해에서 활동하는 수적이 전투를 벌여 수적 13명, 관군 10명이 죽고 군수와 첨사가 크게 부상당함
t: The county magistrate of Cheolsan and the garrison commander of Migwan, leading government troops, fought pirates active in the West Sea; thirteen pirates and ten government soldiers were killed, and the magistrate and garrison commander were severely wounded.

src: 대궐내에서 쓰는 경비는 모두 내사노비(內司奴婢)의 신공(身貢)에만 의지하는데, 금년에는 노비의 신공을 상납하지 않은 자가 많으니 각도에 공문을 보내 빠른 시일내에 모두 상납시키도록 명령함
t: The expenses used within the palace relied solely on the tribute payments of the slaves of the Office of Royal Household; since many had failed to submit their tribute this year, an order was given to send documents to each province demanding prompt payment in full.

src: 임천향사(臨川鄕祠) 건립
t: Imcheon Hyangsa was established.

src: 부안 앞바다에 수적선 8척이 나타나 법성포의 조운선 등을 빼앗아 감
t: Eight pirate ships appeared off the coast of Buan and seized the grain transport ships of Beopseongpo.

src: 풍기현감 권태일(權泰一) 부임
t: Pungi county magistrate Gwon Tae-il takes office.

src: 임진난 후 충신, 효자, 열녀를 정표하도록 함.
t: After the Imjin War, orders were given to honor loyal subjects, filial sons, and virtuous women.

src: 서인(庶人)과 천인들이 자기 노복(奴僕)을 대하는 데 있어서 같은 일을 하고 같은 그릇의 밥을 먹으며 심지어 잠자리도 같이하는 자가 있는 등 신분의 차등을 두거나 서로 격의를 갖는 일이 없다고 의금부(義禁府) 낭청(
t: It was reported that commoners and lowborn people, in dealing with their own servants, did the same work, ate from the same bowl, and some even shared the same sleeping quarters, showing no distinction of status or reserve toward each other, according to the Uigeumbu Nangcheong (

src: 내훈(內訓)을 언해하게 함.
t: The Naehun was ordered to be rendered into vernacular Korean.

src: 예조에 명하여 여악을 다시 설치하게 함.
t: The Ministry of Rites was ordered to reestablish the female musicians.

src: 도성문 밖에 화적들이 출몰함
t: Bandits appeared outside the gates of the capital.

src: 왕의 사친인 공빈 김씨를 자숙단인공성왕후(慈淑端仁恭聖王后)라 추승하고 능을 성릉이라고 함.
t: The king's biological mother, Lady Gongbin of the Kim clan, was posthumously honored as Jasuk Danin Gongseong Wanghu, and her tomb was called Seongneung.

src: 부사용 한교(韓嶠)가 상소하여 ≪연병실기(鍊兵實紀)≫의 거기보(車騎步) 전법을 채용할 것을 주장함.
t: Assistant military officer Han Gyo submitted a memorial arguing for the adoption of the chariot-cavalry-infantry tactics described in the Yeonbyeong Silgi.

src: 이항복(李恒福)이 전차(戰車) 사용 문제에 대해서 아룀.
t: Yi Hang-bok reported on the matter of using war chariots.

src: 도성 가까운 곳에 명화적(明火賊)이 출현하여 조정의 관원을 살해함
t: Torch bandits appeared near the capital and killed a court official.

src: 부사과 한교(韓嶠)가 명나라의 척계광(戚繼光)이 쓴
t: Assistant military officer Han Gyo, on what was written by Qi Jiguang of Ming,

src: 정산서원(鼎山書院) 건립
t: Jeongsan Seowon was founded.

src: 숙의 삼간택차 처녀에게 금혼령을 내림.
t: A ban on marriage was issued for maidens eligible for the third selection round for a suui.

src: 임실의 이민(吏民)들이 난을 일으켜 현감을 위협함
t: Officials and commoners of Imsil staged a revolt and threatened the county magistrate.

src: 병산서원(屛山書院) 창건
t: Byeongsan Seowon was founded.

src: 함경도 지역의 방어를 위해 노비로서 장용대(壯勇隊)를 설치하고 군공을 세울 경우 양인을 허락함.
t: For the defense of the Hamgyong region, a Jangyongdae unit was established using slaves, and those who achieved military merit were permitted to become commoners.

src: 명화적(明火賊) 수십 명이 한밤중에 도성의 남대문(南大門) 밖에 나타나 재물을 탈취함
t: Several dozen bandits (明火賊) appeared outside Namdaemun (南大門), the southern gate of the capital, at night and plundered property.

src: 공주에 명화적(明火賊)이 출현하여 인명을 살상하고 남원에서 부세로 수송되어 오던 포목을 탈취함
t: Bandits (明火賊) appeared in Gongju, killed people, and seized cotton cloth being transported from Namwon as tax.

src: 조총청(鳥銃廳)을 화기도감(火器都監)으로 개칭하고 조총 이외에 각종 화기 생산.이왕무, ＜광해군대 화기도감에 대한 연구＞
t: The Bureau of Muskets (鳥銃廳) was renamed the Directorate of Firearms (火器都監), and various firearms were produced in addition to muskets. Lee Wang-mu, <A Study of the Directorate of Firearms during the Gwanghaegun Era>

src: 북방의 노복(奴僕) 중 군인이 된 자는 장용(壯勇)이라고 호칭을 붙이고, 공로를 세우거나 무예(武藝)에 합격한 자에게는 면천(免賤)을 허락할 것을 비변사(備邊司)에서 아뢰니, 따름
t: The Border Defense Council (備邊司) reported that among the servants (奴僕) in the northern region, those who became soldiers should be called Jangyong (壯勇), and that those who achieved merit or passed the martial arts (武藝) examination should be granted manumission (免賤); this was followed.

src: 나주(羅州), 순천(順天), 장흥(長興), 당진(唐津), 해남(海南), 무안(務安), 광양(光陽) 등의 내사노비(內司奴婢)의 신공(身貢)이 3년이 지나도록 바쳐지지 않고 있으니 조사를 명령함
