t: It was ordered that an investigation be conducted because the body tribute (身貢) of the Naesa slaves (內司奴婢) in Naju (羅州), Suncheon (順天), Jangheung (長興), Dangjin (唐津), Haenam (海南), Muan (務安), Gwangyang (光陽), and other places had not been paid for over three years.

src: 병조에서 보병 가포(步兵價布)를 2필에서 1필로 줄일 것을 건의함.
t: The Ministry of War proposed reducing the infantry cloth tax (步兵價布) from two bolts to one bolt.

src: 춘천에 출현하여 인명을 해친 명화적(明火賊)이 잡혀 처벌됨
t: Bandits (明火賊) who appeared in Chuncheon and harmed people were captured and punished.

src: 전라도 동복의 호장(戶長) 오언복(吳彦福) 등이 무리를 이루어 난을 일으키자 읍내 민가들이 놀라 흩어짐
t: When the local headman (戶長) Oh Eon-bok (吳彦福) and others of Dongbok in Jeolla Province formed a group and raised a revolt, the households in the town were startled and scattered.

src: 사천(私賤)을 군역(軍役)에 정하는 것을 모두 금지하라고 사간원(司諫院)에서 상소함
t: The Office of the Censor General (司諫院) submitted a memorial to prohibit entirely the assignment of privately owned slaves (私賤) to military service (軍役).

src: 월천 조목(月川 趙穆) 배향
t: Wolcheon Jo Mok (月川 趙穆) was enshrined.

src: 영천군수 조찬한(趙纘韓) 부임
t: Jo Chan-han (趙纘韓) took office as magistrate of Yeongcheon.

src: 중학(中學)의 노비로서 면천(免賤)되거나 면역(免役)된 자 및 별감(別監)에 투속(投屬)한 자들을 본래의 역(役)으로 되돌려 보내라고 정시현(鄭時賢) 등이 상소함
t: Jeong Si-hyeon (鄭時賢) and others submitted a memorial requesting that the slaves of the Central School (中學) who had been manumitted (免賤) or exempted from labor duty (免役), as well as those who had become attached to the Byeolgam (別監), be returned to their original duties (役).

src: 우눌재 유의하(愚訥齋 柳宜河) 출생
t: Unulje Yu Ui-ha (愚訥齋 柳宜河) was born.

src: 인목대비전의 작호 삭제를 논의시킴.
t: Discussion was held on removing the title of Queen Dowager Inmok.

src: 충청도에 화적이 크게 번성함
t: Bandits flourished greatly in Chungcheong Province.

src: 명화적(明火賊)인 홍주의 승려 경율(景栗), 신천의 승려 굉간(宏侃), 창원의 정대립(鄭大立) 등이 체포됨
t: Bandits (明火賊) including the monk Gyeongyul (景栗) of Hongju, the monk Goenggan (宏侃) of Sincheon, and Jeong Dae-rip (鄭大立) of Changwon were captured.

src: 반초당 이명익(反招堂 李溟翼) 출생
t: Banchodang Yi Myeong-ik (反招堂 李溟翼) was born.

src: 인목대비를 서궁에 유폐함.
t: Queen Dowager Inmok was confined to Seogung.

src: 신안현(新安縣), 삼가현(三嘉縣)에서 명화적(明火賊) 무리인 백가미(白加未) 등이 체포됨
t: Bandits (明火賊) including Baek Ga-mi (白加未) were captured in Sinan-hyeon (新安縣) and Samga-hyeon (三嘉縣).

src: 세자궁의 소훈 간택으로 11세에서 19세의 처녀단자를 올리도록 함. 처녀를 은닉하여 불출한 자는 중율에 처하고 비록 1품 재신이더라도 영불서용함.
t: For the selection of a Sohun (昭訓) for the Crown Prince's palace, lists of unmarried women aged 11 to 19 were ordered to be submitted. Anyone who concealed a woman and failed to report her would be subject to severe punishment, and even a first-rank minister would be permanently barred from office.

src: 거듭된 명나라의 후금 토벌 원병 요청으로 13,000명의 출병을 결정. 도원수에 강홍립(姜弘立), 부원서에 김경서(金景瑞)를 임명함.
t: Due to repeated requests from Ming China for reinforcements to subjugate Later Jin, it was decided to dispatch 13,000 troops. Gang Hong-rip (姜弘立) was appointed Supreme Commander and Kim Gyeong-seo (金景瑞) was appointed Deputy Commander.

src: 기근으로 각지에서 명화적(明火賊)이 일어났는데, 특히 경기도, 충청도, 전라도와 도성문 밖이 가장 크게 번성함
t: Due to famine, bandits (明火賊) arose in various regions; they flourished especially in Gyeonggi, Chungcheong, and Jeolla Provinces, and outside the gates of the capital.

src: 강홍립(姜弘立)이 거느린 조선군이 후금군에 투항하여 누르하치에게 조선의 입장을 알림.
t: The Joseon army led by Gang Hong-rip (姜弘立) surrendered to the Later Jin army and informed Nurhaci of Joseon's position.

src: 왕비가 친잠함.
t: The Queen personally performed sericulture.

src: 강홍립(姜弘立) 등 10여 명을 제외하고 후금에 억류된 요동(遼東) 출병 조선군 귀국.
t: The Joseon troops who had been dispatched to Liaodong (遼東) and detained by Later Jin returned home, except for Gang Hong-rip (姜弘立) and about ten others.

src: 함경도 단천 사람들이 수령의 탐학에 불만을 품고 군중을 모아 봉기하여 관아를 파괴함
t: People of Dancheon, Hamgyeong-do, harbored resentment against the magistrate's exploitation, gathered a crowd, rose up, and destroyed the government office.

src: 명나라 장수 요동(遼東)유격 모문룡(毛文龍)이 철산(鐵山)의 가도(椵島)에 동강진(東江鎭)을 설치함.
t: Ming general, Liaodong yugyeok Mao Wenlong, established Donggang-jin on Gado Island in Cheolsan.

src: 목재 홍여하(木齋 洪汝河) 출생
t: Mokjae Hong Yeoha was born.

src: 죽산에서 중앙 관리를 사칭한 사람이 고을 옥문을 때려 부수고 중죄인들을 탈출시킴
t: In Juksan, a person impersonating a central government official broke down the county jail gate and released serious criminals.

src: 왕대비가 복위하고, 상궁 김개시를 죽임.
t: The queen dowager was restored to her position, and court lady Kim Gae-si was killed.

src: 광해군 및 폐비 유씨를 강화에 유배시킴.
t: Gwanghaegun and the deposed queen consort Yu were exiled to Ganghwa.

src: 선조의 후궁 김씨의 호와 능호를 혁파함.
t: The title and tomb name of King Seonjo's concubine Kim were abolished.

src: 도성 내에 화적이 출현하여 양반가의 재물을 탈취함
t: Bandits appeared within the capital city and seized property from yangban households.

src: 내수사(內需司) 노비의 3분의 1을 속오군에 충정시켜 북쪽의 변란에 대비하게 함.
t: One third of the slaves of the Naesusa were conscripted into the Sogogun to prepare against disturbances in the north.

src: 김상궁(金尙宮)의 조카 사위인 아전의 자식 정몽필(鄭夢弼)은 권력을 믿고 명례궁(明禮宮)의 본궁에 사적인 감옥을 설치한 뒤, 남의 노비를 빼앗고는 그 주인을 잡아 가두어 혹독한 매질을 가하여 노비문서를 뺏은 뒤에야
t: Jeong Mong-pil, son of a clerk and nephew-in-law of Kim Sanggung, relying on his power, set up a private prison at the main hall of Myeongnye-gung, seized other people's slaves, captured and imprisoned their owners, subjected them to harsh beatings, and only after taking their slave documents

src: 경기 수영을 강화도(江華島)로 옮기는 문제를 상의함.
t: Discussed the matter of moving the Gyeonggi naval headquarters to Ganghwado.

src: 평안 병사 겸 부원수인 이괄(李适)이 안주(安州)에서 반란을 일으킴. (이괄의 난)
t: Yi Gwal, Pyeongan Provincial Army Commander and concurrently Deputy Commander-in-Chief, rose in rebellion at Anju. (Yi Gwal's Rebellion)

src: 반정후 경기(京妓)를 없앰. 자전 복위의 연회(豊呈)를 위해 기생의 상래를 청하였으나 따르지 않음.
t: After the restoration, the capital gisaeng were abolished. Although a request was made for gisaeng to come up for the banquet (pungjeong) celebrating the queen dowager's restoration, it was not followed.

src: 기근이 들고 와언(訛言)이 퍼져 도성민들 가운데 짐을 싸서 빠져나가는 이들이 많이 생김
t: Famine struck and false rumors spread, causing many capital city residents to pack their belongings and flee.

src: 각지에 명화적(明火賊)이 일어나 합천에서는 군수가 칼에 찔리고, 곤양에서는 죄인이 피살됨
t: Myeonghwajeok (armed bandits) arose in various places; in Hapcheon the county magistrate was stabbed, and in Gonyang a criminal was killed.

src: 인조반정에 참여한 반정군으로 국왕 호위부대인 호위청(扈衛廳) 창설최효식,
t: The Howicheong, a royal guard unit, was established from the restoration army that took part in the Injo Restoration, Choi Hyo-sik,

src: 서얼허통법을 정함.
t: The Seoeol Heotong Law (law permitting secondary sons' civil service eligibility) was established.

src: 제주 대정의 무남무녀(巫男巫女)의 세포(稅布)를 줄임.
t: The tax cloth (sepo) of shamans (munam-munyeo) in Daejeong, Jeju was reduced.

src: 후금의 침입에 대비하여 지뢰포(地雷砲)를 서북 지방에 배치하게 함
t: Land mine cannons (jiroepo) were deployed in the northwestern region to prepare against invasion by Later Jin.

src: 호조(戶曹)에서 인경궁(仁慶宮)에 주전청(鑄錢廳)을 설치할 것을 건의조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: The Board of Taxation proposed establishing a Jujeoncheong (coin minting office) at Injeong-gung, Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 의성에서 부역 거부로 처벌을 받은 사람이 무리를 모아 봉기하여 관아를 둘러싸고 수령을 위협함
t: In Uiseong, a person who had been punished for refusing corvée labor gathered a crowd and rose up, surrounding the government office and threatening the magistrate.

src: 남한산성(南漢山城) 축성 공사 완성(책임자 이서). 성의 둘레가 6,297보(步)이고 여장(女牆)이 1297개.
t: Construction of Namhansanseong Fortress was completed (person in charge: Yi Seo). The circumference of the fortress was 6,297 bo, with 1,297 parapets (yeojang).

src: 동전 600관(貫)을 주전청(鑄錢廳)에서 주조하였으나 양이 부족하여 사용하지 못함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: 600 gwan of copper coins were minted at the Jujeoncheong, but the amount was insufficient for use, Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 홍 립(洪 雴) 부임
t: Hong Rip took office.

src: 황해감사가 호란 때의 사족부녀 126명 중 절의가 뛰어난 자를 치계함.
t: The Governor of Hwanghae reported by dispatch on those among 126 sajok women captured during the Manchu invasion who displayed outstanding chastity and fidelity.

src: 영장절목(營將節目)을 반포하여 각도에 5영을 두고 영장(營將) 1인씩을 두게 함.
t: Promulgated the Yeongjang jeolmok (營將節目), establishing 5 yeong in each province and placing one yeongjang (營將) in each.

src: 강원도횡성(橫成)의 전 익찬(翊贊) 이인거(李仁居)가 척화대의를 내걸고 반란을 일으킴
t: Yi In-geo (李仁居), former ikchan (翊贊) of Hoengseong, Gangwon-do, raised a rebellion under the banner of the great cause of rejecting peace with the Qing.

src: 인조는 강화도(江華島)로 피난하고 소현세자(昭顯世子)는 전주(全州)로 분조(分朝)하여 내려감
t: King Injo took refuge on Ganghwado, and Crown Prince Sohyeon went down to Jeonju to form a separate court (分朝).

src: 강화도(江華島) 행재소(行在所)에서 후금과 화맹(和盟) 의식 거행. 정묘화약(丁卯和約) 성립.
t: A peace oath ceremony (和盟) with Later Jin was held at the temporary palace (行在所) on Ganghwado. The Jeongmyo Peace Treaty (丁卯和約) was concluded.

src: 후금군 3만 명이 압록강을 도하하여 의주(義州)성 포위. 정묘호란(丁卯胡亂) 발발. 14일 의주성 함락.
t: 30,000 Later Jin troops crossed the Amnok River and besieged Uiju fortress. The Jeongmyo War (丁卯胡亂) broke out. On the 14th, Uiju fortress fell.

src: 봉화현감 홍은(洪隱) 부임
t: Hong Eun (洪隱) took office as magistrate of Bonghwa.

src: 수암 유진(修巖 柳袗) 배향
t: Suam Yu Jin (修巖 柳袗) was enshrined.

src: 금옹 김학배(錦翁 金學培) 출생
t: Geumong Kim Hak-bae (錦翁 金學培) was born.

src: 이귀(李貴)의 건의로 장관(將官)들에게 병법을 가르치는 능마아청(能麽兒廳)을 개설.
t: On the proposal of Yi Gwi (李貴), the Neungmaacheong (能麽兒廳), which taught military tactics to officers, was established.

src: 호란을 틈타 유민을 결집해 철원과 평강 사이에서 출몰하던 명화적(明火賊)이충경(李忠景), 한성길(韓成吉), 계춘(戒春), 막동(莫同) 등이 처형됨
t: Yi Chung-gyeong (李忠景), Han Seong-gil (韓成吉), Gyechun (戒春), Makdong (莫同), and others—bandits (明火賊) who had gathered displaced people and appeared between Cheorwon and Pyeonggang taking advantage of the war—were executed.

src: 100세 이상의 양반여자에게 봉작을 함.
t: Titles of nobility were bestowed upon yangban women aged 100 or older.

src: 무예청(武藝廳)을 설치함
t: The Muyecheong (武藝廳) was established.

src: ＜포보절목(砲保節目)＞을 반포하여 훈련도감(訓鍊都監) 급보제(給保制)의 폐단을 시정하려함.
t: The Pobo jeolmok (砲保節目) was promulgated in an attempt to correct the abuses of the geupbo system (給保制) of the Training Special Command (訓鍊都監).

src: 남원에서 살인계(殺人契)가 조직되어 인명을 살상하고 재물을 약탈하였으며 이웃 고을로 확산됨
t: In Namwon, a murder society (殺人契) was organized, killing people and plundering property, and it spread to neighboring towns.

src: 이서(李曙)의 건의로 경기도의 부서군(赴西軍) 300명을 감함.
t: On the proposal of Yi Seo (李曙), 300 troops of the buseogun (赴西軍) in Gyeonggi-do were reduced.

src: 군기시(軍器寺)에 별조청(別造廳)을 설치하여 화기를 제조하고 화약을 굽게 함.
t: A Byeoljocheong (別造廳) was established at the Gungisi (軍器寺) to manufacture firearms and produce gunpowder.

src: 화량(花梁), 영종(永宗), 초지(草芝), 제물(濟物) 등 4곳의 보(堡)를 옮겨 정함
t: The four forts (堡) of Hwaryang, Yeongjong, Choji, and Jemul were relocated.

src: 칠성루(七星樓) 건립
t: Chilseongnu (七星樓) was built.

src: 국휼 때 성혼하는 사대부에게는 가장에게 죄를 주도록 함.
t: For sadaebu who married during a period of national mourning, the head of the household was to be punished.

src: 경기 수사(水使)를 통어사(統禦使)로 호칭하고 충청도와 황해도의 수군을 함께 통솔하게 함.
t: The naval commander (水使) of Gyeonggi was renamed tongeosa (統禦使) and given joint command over the navies of Chungcheong-do and Hwanghae-do.

src: 인목대비 김씨가 49세로 인경궁 흠명전에서 죽음.
t: Queen Dowager Inmok, Lady Kim, died at age 49 in Heungmyeongjeon Hall of Ingyeong Palace.

src: 허난설헌 시문집 간행.
t: The collected poems and writings of Heo Nanseolheon were published.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)과 군기시(軍器寺)의 화약과 궁시를 평안도로 보냄.
t: Gunpowder and bows and arrows from the Training Special Command (訓鍊都監) and the Gungisi (軍器寺) were sent to Pyeongan-do.

src: 중국의 만력통보(萬曆通寶)을 모방하여 팔분서조선통보(八分書朝鮮通寶)를 새로 발행함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: In imitation of China's Wanli Tongbao (萬曆通寶), a new coin, the Palbunseo Joseon Tongbo (八分書朝鮮通寶), was issued. Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Compilation Committee,

src: 이 장(李 獎) 부임
t: Yi Jang (李獎) took office.

src: 영천군수 이후기(李厚基) 부임
t: Yi Hu-gi (李厚基) was appointed magistrate of Yeongcheon.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)의 마병(馬兵) 육성을 위해 장관을 더 추가함.
t: Additional officers were appointed in the Hullyeon dogam to train cavalry (馬兵).

src: 각사(各司) 노비의 신공(身貢)을 동전으로 대납케 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: The body tribute (身貢) of slaves belonging to various offices (各司) was made to be paid in copper coins instead.

src: 선혜청이 거두는 곡식의 10분의 1을 동전으로 거두게 함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: One tenth of the grain collected by the Seonhyecheong was made to be collected in copper coins.

src: 풍기현감 김상적(金尙績) 부임
t: Kim Sang-jeok (金尙績) was appointed magistrate of Punggi.

src: ≪화포식언해(火砲式諺解)≫와 ≪염소방언해(焰焇方諺解)≫를 간행함≪고병서해제≫, 육군본부, 1979, 224쪽화포식언해
t: Hwaposhik eonhae (火砲式諺解) and Yeomsobang eonhae (焰焇方諺解) were published.

src: 황해 감사 남선과 수원 부사 윤지가 화폐 주조를 청하여 허락함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Governor of Hwanghae Nam Seon and magistrate of Suwon Yun Ji requested the minting of currency, and it was approved.

src: 지남 김남일(砥南 金南一) 출생
t: Kim Nam-il, pen name Jinam (砥南 金南一), was born.

src: 도체찰사 김류(金瑬) 등이 여러 산성의 도형을 그려 올림.
t: Do-chechalsa Kim Ryu (金瑬) and others drew and submitted maps of various mountain fortresses.

src: 각도의 속오군(束伍軍) 2만 명을 가려 뽑아 불시에 대비하게 함.
t: 20,000 sogo troops (束伍軍) from each province were selected and prepared for emergencies.

src: 청나라 선봉군이 압록강을 도하하여 의주(義州) 점령. 병자호란 발발.
t: The Qing vanguard forces crossed the Amnok River and occupied Uiju. The Second Manchu invasion of Joseon broke out.

src: 남한산성(南漢山城) 북문으로 출격한 조선군이 청군의 매복 공격으로 300명 전사
t: Joseon troops that sortied from the north gate of Namhansanseong lost 300 men killed in a Qing ambush.

src: 중외의 가난한 남녀로 혼인할 때를 놓친 자에게 자장(資粧)을 마련하여 혼인하게 함.
t: Poor men and women throughout the country who had missed the time for marriage were provided with dowries (資粧) so that they could marry.

src: 도성에 변고가 생길 것이라는 와언(訛言)이 떠돌아 사람들이 빠져나감
t: A rumor (訛言) that a disaster would occur in the capital spread, and people fled the city.

src: 제도(諸道)의 영장(營將)을 혁파함
t: The yeongjang (營將) of the various provinces were abolished.

src: 인조가 삼전도(三田渡)에서 청 태종에게 항복
t: King Injo surrendered to Emperor Taizong of Qing at Samjeondo.

src: 청군에 강화도(江華島)가 함락되고 김상용(金尙容) 등 전사
t: Ganghwado fell to the Qing army, and Kim Sang-yong and others were killed.

src: 왕이 대신과 청에 시녀 보내는 일을 의논함. 각읍, 각사 비자로 자색자 8명을 뽑음.
t: The king discussed with his ministers the matter of sending maidservants to Qing. Eight women of good appearance were selected from among the female slaves of the various towns and offices.

src: 남평 조씨부인이 윤회봉사로 외조모님 제사를 지냄.(윤회봉사(輪廻奉祀)·분할봉사(分轄奉祀))
t: Lady Jo of Nampyeong performed ancestral rites for her maternal grandmother under the yunhoebongsa system. (yunhoebongsa (輪廻奉祀), bunhalbongsa (分轄奉祀))

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에 7국(局)을 설치하여 무과에 합격한 훈련도감 포수를 소속시킴. 국출신(局出身) 제도 창설
t: Seven bureaus (局) were established in the Hullyeon dogam, to which gunners of the Hullyeon dogam who had passed the military examination were assigned. The gukchulsin (局出身) system was created.

src: 각사 비자로 제도에 있는 10명을 심양에 입송함.
t: Ten female slaves belonging to various offices in the provinces were sent to Shenyang.

src: 허 한(許 僩) 부임
t: Heo Han (許僩) was appointed.

src: 경상도 속오군을 동원하여 금오산성(金烏山城)을 축조함.
t: Sogo troops of Gyeongsang Province were mobilized to construct Geumosanseong.

src: 춘당대(春塘臺)에서 내금위포(內禁衛砲)를 시험함.
t: The Naegeumwipo (內禁衛砲) was tested at Chundangdae.

src: 경기 지방의 속오군을 중심으로 정초군(精抄軍)을 설치하고 번상하게 함.
t: The Jeongchogun (精抄軍) was established centered on the sogo troops of Gyeonggi Province, and they were made to serve in rotation in the capital.

src: 도정서원(道正書院) 건립
t: Dojeong Seowon established

src: 약포사당(藥圃祠堂) 건립
t: Yakpo Sadang established

src: 긍구당 김세환(肯構堂 金世煥) 출생
t: Geunggudang Kim Se-hwan born

src: 유 철(兪 㯙) 부임
t: Yu Cheol took office

src: 삼강서원(三江書院) 건립
t: Samgang Seowon established

src: 궁녀 계향, 계환(소현제자빈 궁녀)이 저주사건으로 국문을 받다가 불복하여 죽음.
t: Court ladies Gyehyang and Gyehwan (court ladies of Crown Princess Consort Sohyeon) were interrogated in the curse incident and died without confessing.

src: 충청도, 전라도에 화적들이 크게 번성함
t: Bandits flourished greatly in Chungcheong-do and Jeolla-do

src: 소현세자빈 강씨를 사사함.
t: Crown Princess Consort Kang, wife of Crown Prince Sohyeon, was ordered to commit suicide.

src: 일본은행권, 대만은행권의 예입에 관한 법령 제57호가 발포되어 1원 권 이상의 일본은행권과 대만은행권은 금융기관에 무이자로 예입하게 함朝鮮銀行調査部,
t: Ordinance No. 57 concerning the deposit of Bank of Japan notes and Bank of Taiwan notes was promulgated, requiring Bank of Japan notes and Bank of Taiwan notes of 1 won or more to be deposited interest-free at financial institutions.朝鮮銀行調査部,

src: 충청도, 전라도의 사노와 평민들이 무리를 모아 임경업(林慶業)이 모군, 기병한다는 말로 결집해 난을 도모하려 하였으나 지도부의 분열과 토벌군의 진격으로 흩어짐
t: Private slaves and commoners of Chungcheong-do and Jeolla-do gathered in groups, rallying under rumors that Im Gyeong-eop was recruiting troops and raising an army, and attempted to plot a rebellion, but they dispersed due to division among the leadership and the advance of the suppression forces

src: 임 준(任 濬) 부임
t: Im Jun took office

src: 풍기현감 박경원(朴慶元) 부임
t: Pungi County Magistrate Park Gyeong-won took office

src: 사대부에서 서인에 이르기까지 혼인시에 음식, 의복, 찬품의 사치를 일절 금단하여 적발되면 치죄하게 함.
t: From the sadaebu to commoners, extravagance in food, clothing, and dishes at weddings was entirely prohibited, and those caught were to be punished.

src: 흉년과 기근으로 많은 사람들이 화적이 되었는데, 특히 경기도와 충청도에 번성함
t: Due to bad harvests and famine, many people became bandits, and this was especially prevalent in Gyeonggi-do and Chungcheong-do

src: 역리의 양첩소생 여자는 역안에 올리지 않게 함.
t: Daughters born of yangcheop of station clerks were no longer to be registered in the station register.

src: 변란 시에 실행한 사족부녀의 가장에게 개취(改娶)하는 것을 허하도록 함.
t: Husbands of women of the sajok class who had lost their chastity during times of upheaval were permitted to remarry.

src: 춘파리사(春坡里祠) 건립
t: Chunpari-sa established

src: 배순정려비(裵純旌閭碑) 건립
t: Bae Sun Jeongnyeobi established

src: 적암 김태중(適庵 金台重) 출생
t: Jeogam Kim Tae-jung born

src: 청옹 이후영(淸翁 李後榮) 출생
t: Cheongong Yi Hu-yeong born

src: 청의 사신이 와서 종실의 여자를 뽑음.
t: A Qing envoy came and selected women of the royal clan.

src: 청의 사신이 종실의 딸을 뽑아보내라는 칙서를 가져옴.
t: A Qing envoy brought an imperial edict demanding that a daughter of the royal clan be selected and sent.

src: 금림군 개윤(愷胤)의 딸을 의순공주(義順公主)에 봉함.
t: The daughter of Geumnim-gun Gae-yun was invested as Princess Uisun.

src: 의순공주 북행에 시녀 16명, 여의, 유온 등 수명이 따라감.
t: Princess Uisun's journey north was accompanied by 16 maidservants, along with several others including yeoui and yuon.

src: 영중추부사 김육(金堉)이 평양과 의주에서 시범적으로 화폐를 유통시키자고 청하여 허락함 (김육(金堉)의 화폐유통책(貨幣流通策))조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Chief of the Privy Council Kim Yuk requested that currency be circulated on a trial basis in Pyongyang and Uiju, and this was permitted. (Kim Yuk's currency circulation policy)朝鮮王朝實錄 CD-ROM 刊行委員會,

src: 미산고택(味山古宅) 건립
t: Construction of Misan Gotaek.

src: 귀인 조씨(인조 후궁)를 사사함.
t: Royal Consort Jo (a royal concubine of King Injo) was ordered to commit suicide.

src: 김우명(金佑明)의 딸을 세자빈으로 간택함.
t: The daughter of Kim U-myeong was selected as Crown Princess.

src: 임진왜란 이후 수군 강화를 위해 통영(統營)에 설치하였던 첨방군(添防軍)을 폐지.
t: After the Japanese invasions of Korea, the Cheombanggun (reinforcement troops) that had been established in Tongyeong to strengthen the navy was abolished.

src: 무신의 삭시사(朔試射)와 무과에서 철전(鐵箭) 대신 유엽전(柳葉箭)을 쓰도록 함(화살의 종류)
t: In military officials' monthly archery tests and the military examination, willow-leaf arrows were used instead of iron arrows (types of arrows).

src: 상평창이 화폐 유통을 적극적으로 장려하기 위해 ＜행전절목(行錢節目)＞을 제정하여 실시함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: Sangpyeongchang established and implemented the "Regulations for Circulating Currency" (Haengjeon Jeolmok) to actively promote the circulation of currency.Veritable Records of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 어영군(御營軍)의 군액을 21,000명으로 증원
t: The troop strength of the Eoyeonggun was increased to 21,000.

src: 금군(禁軍) 6백 명 전원에게 말을 지급하여 기병(騎兵)으로 전환시킴.
t: All 600 members of the Geumgun were provided with horses and converted into cavalry.

src: 선폐청에서 대동미(大同米)를 화폐로 징수하여 화폐 사용을 늘리자고 건의함조선왕조실록 CD-ROM 간행위원회,
t: The Seonpyecheong proposed collecting the Daedongmi as currency to increase the use of money.Veritable Records of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 황해도에 화적이 횡행함
t: Bandits rampaged in Hwanghae Province.

src: 상주 지방에 기근이 들고 화적이 출현하여 민심이 동요함
t: Famine occurred in the Sangju region and bandits appeared, causing public unrest.

src: 국법에 궁녀는 각사 비로 뽑았는데, 이후 양가녀로 뽑도록 함. 민간에서 소동이 일어나 10세 이상이면 다투어 혼인함.
t: According to national law, court ladies had been selected from government office servants, but afterward they were to be selected from commoner girls. An uproar occurred among the people, and those aged 10 or older competed to marry.

src: 죽봉 김간(竹峯 金侃) 출생
t: Juk-bong Gim Gan was born.

src: 경상도에서 속오군 급보법(給保法)을 최초로 시행함
t: In Gyeongsang Province, the Sogo-gun provision-granting law was implemented for the first time.

src: 원두표(元斗杓)의 건의로 삼남의 16곳 영에 전임 영장(營將) 파견
t: On the recommendation of Won Du-pyo, dedicated Yeongjang were dispatched to 16 garrisons in the three southern provinces.

src: 청나라에서 러시아 정벌을 위해 조선 포수(砲手) 100여 명 지원 요청
t: Qing requested Joseon to send over 100 musketeers to support its campaign against Russia.

src: 변급(邊岌)이 지휘하는 조선군이 흑룡강에서 러시아군을 격파하고 귀국. (제1차 나선정벌(羅禪征伐))
t: The Joseon army led by Byeon Geup defeated Russian forces at the Heilong River and returned home. (The First Naseon Jeongbeol)

src: 궁녀 선입으로 민간에서 조혼이 행하여짐.
t: Due to the selection of court ladies, early marriage was practiced among the common people.

src: 능동재사(陵洞齋舍) 건립
t: Construction of Neungdong Jaesa.

src: 중외 효자, 열녀 60여 명을 뽑아 정표 혹은 증작 복호하여 풍속을 장려하게 함.
t: 60-some filial sons and virtuous women from the capital and provinces were selected and honored with commendation or posthumous rank and tax exemption to encourage good customs.

src: 금군(禁軍)을 1천 명으로 확장이태진,
t: The Geumgun was expanded to 1,000 members.Yi Tae-jin,

src: 강화도(江華島)연미정(燕尾亭)에서 덕포(德浦)까지의 해변에 보(堡)를 설치하는 문제 논의.
t: Discussion on the issue of establishing forts along the coast from Yeonmijeong to Deokpo on Ganghwa Island.

src: 추쇄어사(推刷御史)의 파견 문제에 대하여 대신들과 의논함
t: Discussed with the ministers the matter of dispatching the Chusoe Eosa.

src: 임금이 추쇄도감(推刷都監)의 사목(事目)을 보고 허술하다고 그 내용을 엄하게 함
t: The king reviewed the regulations of the Chusoe Dogam and, finding them lax, tightened their contents.

src: 노비추쇄에 대해 의논하였으며, 각사노비안(各司奴婢案)에 등록된 자는 19만명인데 신공(身貢)을 거두는 수는 2만 7천명뿐이라고 이시방(李時昉)이 아룀
t: Discussions were held on the tracing of slaves, and Yi Si-bang reported that while 190,000 people were registered in the slave registers of the various government offices, only 27,000 paid the body tribute.

src: 금위 장사(禁衛將士)에게 좁은 소매의 짧은 옷을 입도록 함.
t: Ordered the guard officers and soldiers (禁衛將士) to wear short clothes with narrow sleeves.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에서 표류한 네덜란드인의 조총을 모방하여 새로운 체제의 조총을 만듦
t: The Hullyeon dogam (訓鍊都監) made a new type of matchlock gun by imitating the matchlock gun of a drifted Dutchman.

src: 이온(李蘊)이 명나라 병서인 ≪등단필구(登壇必究)≫를 요약한 ≪단구첩록(壇究捷錄)≫을 편찬함.
t: Yi On (李蘊) compiled the Dan-gu-cheop-rok (壇究捷錄), a summary of the Ming military book Deungdanpilgu (登壇必究).

src: 추원재 및 사당(追遠齋및祠堂) 건립
t: Chuwonjae and a shrine (追遠齋및祠堂) were built.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)의 군사를 1만 명 수준으로 늘리도록 함
t: Ordered the increase of Hullyeon dogam (訓鍊都監) soldiers to about 10,000.

src: 밀암 이재(密菴 李栽) 출생
t: Milam Yi Jae (密菴 李栽) was born.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監) 보군(步軍) 10초(哨) 증액이태진,
t: Increased the Hullyeon dogam (訓鍊都監) infantry (步軍) by 10 cho (哨) Lee Tae-jin,

src: 어영청(御營廳)에 기병 부대인 별마대(別馬隊)를 설치 이태진,
t: Established Byeolmadae (別馬隊), a cavalry unit, in the Eoyeongcheong (御營廳) Lee Tae-jin,

src: 어영청(御營廳)에 대포 전문 부대인 별파진(別破陣) 511명을 두고 15번으로 번을 나누어 입번하게 함.
t: Placed 511 soldiers of Byeolpajin (別破陣), a cannon specialist unit, in the Eoyeongcheong (御營廳), and divided them into 15 rotations for duty.

src: 경상북도 병마우후 신유가 지휘하는 조선군이 청군과 흑룡강 어귀에서 러시아군 격파.
t: The Joseon army, commanded by Sin Yu, the byeongmauhu of Gyeongsangbuk-do, together with the Qing army, defeated the Russian army at the mouth of the Heilong River.

src: 혼상(婚喪) 복식의 사치금제를 어기는 조관 이하는 파직하고 유생은 정거하고 삼의사는 수금하고 부녀는 그 가장을, 서인, 상녀는 곧장 과죄하게 함.
t: Ordered that court officials and below who violate the luxury prohibition on wedding and funeral attire be dismissed, Confucian scholars be suspended, the Samuisa be imprisoned, for women their household heads be punished, and commoners and low-born women be punished directly.

src: 사대부 부녀들이 산에서 놀이하는 것을 금함.
t: Prohibited sadaebu women from playing in the mountains.

src: 안악의 농민 10여 명이 비변사에 서장(書狀)과 지도를 올리며 새로 생긴 궁방의 폐단을 시정해달라고 요구함
t: More than 10 farmers from Anak submitted a document and a map to the Bibyeonsa, requesting correction of the abuses of the newly established gungbang.

src: 허목이 상소하여 자의대비 복제의 삼년설을 논함.
t: Heo Mok submitted a memorial discussing the three-year mourning theory for Jaui daebi's mourning attire.

src: 경외 양민이 삭발하여 중이 된 자에게 환속을 명함.
t: Ordered commoners inside and outside the capital who shaved their heads to become monks to return to secular life.

src: 청주의 부민(富民)이 명화적(明火賊)에 살해됨
t: A wealthy commoner of Cheongju was killed by myeonghwajeok (明火賊).

src: 귀봉종택(龜峯宗宅) 건립
t: Gwibong jongtaek (龜峯宗宅) was built.

src: 영천군수 홍주세(洪柱世) 부임
t: Hong Juse (洪柱世) took office as magistrate of Yeongcheon.

src: 반계(磻溪) 유형원(柳馨遠)이 화폐를 전국적으로 사용할 것을
t: Bangye Yu Hyeong-won (柳馨遠) that currency be used nationwide

src: 도성내 종루(鐘樓) 근처에서 명화적(明火賊)이 인가에 침입하여 재물을 탈취함
t: Near Jongnu (鐘樓) in the capital, myeonghwajeok (明火賊) broke into houses and stole property.

src: 성내양니원(城內兩尼院)을 파하고 여승으로 40세 이하된 자는 환속을 명하고 그 나머지는 성외니원으로 출함.
t: Abolished the two nunneries inside the capital walls (城內兩尼院), ordered nuns under 40 to return to secular life, and sent the rest to nunneries outside the walls.

src: 이장영(李張英)의 저술
t: A writing by Yi Jang-yeong (李張英).

src: 물계서원(勿溪書院) 건립
t: Mulgye seowon (勿溪書院) was built.

src: 노량(露梁)에서 열무(閱武)함. 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)과 어영청(御營廳) 군사 9,000명이 참여함
t: Held a military review at Noryang (露梁). 9,000 soldiers from the Hullyeon dogam (訓鍊都監) and Eoyeongcheong (御營廳) participated.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監) 포보(砲保)의 수를 9000명 증액하여 기존의 가포(價布) 3필을 2필로 줄임.
t: Increased the number of pobo (砲保) of the Hullyeon dogam (訓鍊都監) by 9,000, reducing the existing gapo (價布) from 3 pil to 2 pil.

src: 전라도 내 사찰의 불상에서 땀이 흘렀다는 와언(訛言)이 퍼져 도민들이 동요하고 머리를 깍아 승려가 되려는 자들이 늘어남
t: A false rumor spread that sweat had flowed from Buddhist statues in temples in Jeolla-do, causing the people of the province to grow agitated and increasing numbers of those wishing to shave their heads and become monks.

src: 가뭄으로 궁녀를 방출함.
t: Court ladies were released due to drought.

src: 경광정사(鏡光精舍) 개편
t: Gyeonggwang jeongsa (鏡光精舍) was reorganized.

src: 지진(地震)이 일어나 해괴제(解怪祭)를 거행
t: An earthquake occurred, and a haegoeje (解怪祭) was held.

src: 궁가 면세전결수를 정함. 대군, 공주는 400결, 군, 옹주는 250결로 함.
t: The tax-exempt land allotments for royal households were set. Grand princes and princesses were allotted 400 gyeol, and princes and royal daughters were allotted 250 gyeol.

src: 지촌종택(芝村宗宅) 건립
t: Jichon jongtaek (芝村宗宅) was built.

src: 명화적(明火賊)이 전국 각지에서 출현함
t: Myeonghwajeok (明火賊, armed bandits) appeared in various places across the country.

src: 강도(江都) 어사(御使) 민유중이 강화도(江華島)에 보관된 미곡과 군기(軍器)의 수효를 보고함.
t: Gangdo eosa (江都御使) Min Yu-jung reported on the quantities of grain and military equipment stored on Ganghwa Island (江華島).

src: 기장 사람 박시구(朴蓍龜)을 불러 구궁진(九宮陣)과 거전법(車戰法)을 시험하게 함.
t: Bak Si-gu (朴蓍龜), a man from Gijang, was summoned to have the nine-palace formation (九宮陣) and chariot warfare tactics (車戰法) tested.

src: 시녀 간택으로 민간에서 급혼이 유행함.
t: Due to the selection of maids-in-waiting, hasty marriages became prevalent among the common people.

src: 보은에 명화적(明火賊)이 출현해 인명을 해침
t: Myeonghwajeok (明火賊) appeared in Boeun and killed people.

src: 금군의 정원을 700명으로 조정하여 7번으로 나누고 별장(別將)을 1명만 임명함.
t: The authorized strength of the Geumgun was fixed at 700, divided into seven rotations, and only one byeoljang (別將) was appointed.

src: 경상 감사 이상진(李尙眞)이 안명로(安命老)가 지은 병서인
t: Gyeongsang Governor Yi Sang-jin reported on the military treatise written by An Myeong-no,

src: 강화(江華)의 덕포진(德浦鎭), 철곶진(鐵串鎭), 정포진(井浦鎭)을 통진, 풍덕, 교동으로 옮기고 인근 고을의 육군 315인을 나누어 줌.
t: Deokpo-jin (德浦鎭), Cheolgot-jin (鐵串鎭), and Jeongpo-jin (井浦鎭) on Ganghwa Island were relocated to Tongjin, Pungdeok, and Gyodong, and 315 infantrymen from neighboring towns were allotted to them.

src: 호적(戶籍)을 작성할 때, 사대부집에서 일하는 솔노비(率奴婢) 가운데에 주인집의 문 밖에 막을 치고 산다는 이유로 솔노비의 호구가 두 곳에 중복 기록된 경우가 있다고 한성부(漢城府)가 보고
t: When compiling household registers, the Hanseongbu reported that among the solnobi (率奴婢) laboring in yangban households, there were cases where household registration was duplicated in two places because they lived in shelters set up outside their master's gate.

src: 인현왕후 민씨(숙종 계비)가 반송방 사제에서 출생함.
t: Queen Inhyeon of the Min clan (King Sukjong's second queen consort) was born at a private residence in Bansongbang.

src: 명화적(明火賊)으로 잡힌 김선립(金先立)이 처형됨
t: Kim Seon-rip, who had been captured as a myeonghwajeok (明火賊), was executed.

src: 도성 안에 명화적(明火賊)이 출현하여 사람을 살해함
t: Myeonghwajeok (明火賊) appeared within the capital city and killed people.

src: 도성내 양반가의 노비가 명화적(明火賊)과 결탁해 주인의 재물을 탈취함
t: Slaves of a yangban household within the capital city colluded with myeonghwajeok (明火賊) to seize their master's property.

src: 경기도의 곳곳에서 명화적(明火賊)이 출현해 사람을 살해하고 재물을 탈취하나 체포하지 못함
t: Myeonghwajeok (明火賊) appeared in various places in Gyeonggi-do, killing people and seizing property, but could not be captured.

src: 훈련도감에서 땔나무 산판을 강원도 낭천에 마련하자 부근의 거주민 10여 명이 밤에 포를 쏘고 위협함
t: When the Hullyeon dogam established a firewood-cutting ground in Nangcheon, Gangwon-do, about ten nearby residents fired guns at night and threatened them.

src: 각사 여비의 신공 각 반필을 감함.
t: The tribute cloth payment owed by female slaves (女婢) of each government office was reduced by half a bolt each.

src: 정초청(精抄廳)을 세우고 병조판서가 주관하도록 함.
t: Jeongchocheong (精抄廳) was established, and the Minister of War was placed in charge of it.

src: 송시열이 창기와 무당의 궁중 출입이 불가하다고 상소함.
t: Song Si-yeol submitted a memorial stating that courtesans and shamans should not be permitted to enter the palace.

src: 경상도 비안현에서 잡힌 명화적(明火賊)을 중죄로 다스리지 않은 감사가 처벌됨
t: The governor who failed to punish severely the myeonghwajeok (明火賊) captured in Bian-hyeon, Gyeongsang-do, was punished.

src: 병조판서 김좌명(金佐命)이 척계광(戚繼光)의 ≪기효신서(紀效新書)≫를 인출하여 삼남(三南)에 보내고 왕에게 바침.
t: Minister of War Kim Jwa-myeong printed Qi Jiguang's Jixiao Xinshu and sent it to the three southern provinces, and presented it to the king.

src: 봉화현감 한여우(韓如愚) 부임
t: Bongwha County Magistrate Han Yeo-u took office

src: 훈련별대(訓鍊別隊) 창설
t: The Hullyeon Byeoldae (Special Training Unit) was founded

src: 송시열의 건의로 동성통혼을 금함.
t: On the recommendation of Song Si-yeol, marriage between people of the same clan name was prohibited.

src: 공사천 양처의 소생은 어머니 역을 따르게 함.
t: The children of public and private slaves born to a commoner wife were made to follow their mother's status duty.

src: 공사천(公私賤)이 양인인 아내에게서 낳은 소생에 대하여는 어머니의 역(役)을 따르게 할 것을 제도를 세워 정식을 삼으라고 명령함
t: It was ordered that a system be established as a fixed rule whereby the children born to public and private slaves by commoner wives should follow the status duty of their mother

src: 기천정사(箕川精舍) 건립
t: Gicheon Jeongsa (study hall) was built

src: 전 부사 정승명(鄭承明)이 대구에서 명화적(明火賊)에 살해당함
t: Former deputy magistrate Jeong Seung-myeong was killed by bandits (myeonghwajeok) in Daegu

src: 경상도 곳곳에서 도적이 일어나 운반중인 각 고을의 세폐 방물(歲幣方物)과 군포를 탈취함
t: Bandits arose in various places in Gyeongsang Province and seized the annual tribute goods and military cloth taxes of each county that were being transported

src: 북평사(北評事) 이선(李選)이 ≪제승방략(制勝方略)≫을 중간함.
t: Bukpyeongsa Yi Seon reprinted the Jeseung Bangnyak

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)의 전부(前部)를 혁파하여 군사를 기르는 비용을 줄임.
t: The front unit of the Hullyeon Dogam (Military Training Command) was abolished to reduce the cost of maintaining troops.

src: 금산의 이광성(李光星) 등이 무리를 모아 덕유산에서 진을 치고 웅거하다 체포되고 명화적(明火賊) 1백여 명이 관문 근처에까지 나와 활동함
t: Yi Gwang-seong and others of Geumsan gathered a group and occupied a position at Deogyusan, setting up camp there, but were captured, and over a hundred bandits appeared near the government office gates and were active

src: 흉년이 크게 들자 경기도, 충청도 각지에서 농민들이 봉기하였는데 금산에서는 좌수 이광성(李光星)을 중심으로 포수와 승려, 역졸, 유민과 굶주린 농민들이 결합하여 6개월 가량 저항하다 진압됨
t: When a great famine struck, peasants rose up in various places in Gyeonggi and Chungcheong provinces; in Geumsan, gunners, monks, government post-station workers, wandering people, and starving peasants united around the local headman Yi Gwang-seong and resisted for about six months before being suppressed

src: 기근과 전염병으로 각지의 사람들이 서로 떼를 지어 도적질을 행하여 화적으로 인한 인명 살상피해가 끊이지 않음
t: Due to famine and epidemics, people in various places banded together to commit robbery, and casualties from bandit attacks did not cease

src: 병곡 권구(屛谷 權榘) 출생
t: Byeonggok Gwon Gu was born

src: 흉년으로 곳곳에서 도적이 발생함
t: Due to famine, bandits arose in various places

src: 예빈시정(禮賓寺正) 도거원이 진법(陣法)에 관한 책자를 올림.
t: Yebinsijeong Do Geo-won presented a book on military formation tactics.

src: 형조판서 오정위가 북한산성(北漢山城) 축조를 청함.
t: Minister of Justice Oh Jeong-wi requested the construction of Bukhansanseong (fortress).

src: 금산의 양반가에 명화적(明火賊)이 나타남
t: Bandits (myeonghwajeok) appeared at a yangban household in Geumsan

src: 각 아문 군관 중에서 적합하지 않은 자를 가려내어 정액을 새로 고쳐 정함.
t: Among the military officers of each government office, those who were unfit were weeded out and the fixed quota was newly revised.

src: 금화(金化)의 품관(品官) 집에 명화적(明火賊)이 나타남
t: Bandits (myeonghwajeok) appeared at the house of a person of official rank in Geumhwa

src: 경기도 포보(砲保) 중 건강한 자를 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)으로 소속을 옮겨 별도로 8초(哨)를 편성하고 조총을 지급함.
t: Among the gun-supporting households (poho) of Gyeonggi Province, the healthy men were transferred to the Hullyeon Dogam, forming a separate eight cho (companies), and matchlock guns were issued to them.

src: 삼소재종택(三素齋宗宅) 건립
t: Samsojae Jongtaek (head house) was built

src: 성주(星州)에 독용산성(禿用山城)을 수축함.
t: Dogyongsanseong (fortress) in Seongju was repaired and rebuilt.

src: 체부(體府)를 설치하고 허적(許積)을 체찰사로 임명함.
t: The Chebu (Field Command) was established, and Heo Jeok was appointed as Chief Commander (chalsa).

src: 훈련원에서 병거(兵車)를 선보이고, 화차(火車)에 실은 포를 시험 사격함.
t: At Hullyeonwon, war chariots were displayed, and cannons mounted on fire carts were test-fired.

src: 병조판서 김석주(金錫冑)의 건의로 정초청(精抄廳)을 폐지하고 병조에 도로 소속시킴.
t: On the recommendation of Minister of War Kim Seok-ju, the Jeongchocheong was abolished and returned to the jurisdiction of the Ministry of War.

src: 사빈영당(泗濱影堂) 건립
t: The Sabin Portrait Shrine was built.

src: 대흥산성(大興山城) 수축을 완성함
t: The repair of Daeheungsanseong was completed.

src: 군령 기관으로서 도체찰사부(都體察使府) 복설이태진,
t: The Dochechalsabu was reestablished as a military command agency. Yi Tae-jin,

src: 구만서원(龜彎書院) 건립
t: The Guman Seowon was built.

src: 미산학사(眉山學舍) 건립
t: The Misan Haksa was built.

src: 풍기현감 최진남(崔鎭南) 부임
t: Choi Jin-nam took office as magistrate of Punggi.

src: 여인의 궁중 출입을 일절 통금하도록 함.
t: Women were entirely prohibited from entering the palace.

src: 총융청(摠戎廳)의 마군 1,500명을 1,000명으로 줄이고 아울러 보인(保人)도 감함.
t: The cavalry of the Chongyungcheong was reduced from 1,500 to 1,000, and the boin were also reduced accordingly.

src: 공사천의 양처소생은 아버지 역을 따르게 함.
t: Children born to public or private slaves by commoner wives were made to follow their father's status duties.

src: 강화(江華) 유수로서 진무사(鎭撫使)를 겸하게 함
t: The Governor of Ganghwa was made to concurrently serve as Jinmusa.

src: 강화도(江華島) 수비체제의 강화를 위해 진무영(鎭撫營) 창설
t: The Jinmuyeong was established to strengthen the defense system of Ganghwa Island.

src: 병조판서 김석주(金錫冑)가 강화도(江華島) 49곳에 돈대(墩臺)를 쌓을 곳을 표시한 지도를 올림.
t: Minister of War Kim Seok-ju submitted a map marking 49 locations on Ganghwa Island where dondae were to be built.

src: 상평통보(常平通寶)에 관한 행전절목(行錢節目)을 제정하여 시행함(상평통보 행전절목)
t: Regulations on the circulation of Sangpyeongtongbo coins were enacted and implemented (Sangpyeongtongbo Haengjeon Jeolmok).

src: 사천(私賤)이 양인 여자를 취하여 아내로 삼은 자는 양역(良役)을 피하기 위하여 아내를 반비(班婢)라고 칭하는 자가 있다고 이원정(李元禎)이 아룀
t: Yi Won-jeong reported that there were cases where private slaves who had taken commoner women as wives called their wives banbi in order to evade commoner labor duties.

src: 병조판서 김석주(金錫冑)가 병서인 ≪행군수지(行軍須知)≫를 진상함.
t: Minister of War Kim Seok-ju presented the military manual Haenggun Suji.

src: 노량(露梁)에서 대규모 열무(閱武)를 행함. 새로 개발된 화차(火車)를 선보임.
t: A large-scale military review was held at Noryang. Newly developed fire carts were unveiled.

src: 강화도(江華島)에 49군데의 돈대(墩臺) 완성(강화도돈대 축조)
t: 49 dondae on Ganghwa Island were completed (construction of the Ganghwa Island dondae).

src: 상평통보 초주단자전(初鑄單字錢)을 대신하여 상평통보 당이전(當二錢)을 주조 함韓國銀行,
t: Instead of the initially cast single-character Sangpyeongtongbo coins, Sangpyeongtongbo dangijeon were cast. Bank of Korea,

src: 대동목(大同木)과 신포(身布)를 동전으로 대납하게 하는 대전납절목(代錢納節目)이 제정되어 부분적인 전납제(錢納制)가 실시됨
t: The Daejeonnap Jeolmok, which allowed Daedongmok and sinpo to be paid in coin instead, was enacted, and a partial monetary payment system was implemented.

src: 약계 권순기(藥溪 權舜紀) 출생
t: Yakgye Gwon Sun-gi was born.

src: 은 1냥의 가치가 당이전(當二錢) 400문에서 600문으로 폭락하자, 동전의 가치를 안정시키기 위해 지방관서의 동전 주조를 금지함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: When the value of 1 nyang of silver crashed from 400 mun to 600 mun in dangijeon, the casting of coins by local government offices was prohibited in order to stabilize the value of coins. Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Compilation Committee,

src: 한천 이재(寒泉 李縡) 출생
t: Hancheon Yi Jae was born.

src: 용와 유승현(慵窩 柳升鉉) 출생
t: Yongwa Yu Seung-hyeon was born.

src: 난졸재 이산두(懶拙齋 李山斗) 출생
t: Nanjoljae Yi San-du was born.

src: 정유란의 12절부를 정표함.
t: The twelve virtuous women of Jeongyu-ran were officially commended.

src: 부마의 재취할 수 없는 법을 정함.
t: A law prohibiting royal sons-in-law (buma) from remarrying was established.

src: 도성의 서소문 밖 양반가에 명화적(明火賊)이 나타남
t: Torch bandits (明火賊) appeared at a yangban household outside Seosomun Gate in the capital.

src: 공사천(公私賤)이 양인 여자를 아내로 삼아 낳은 자식을 양인으로 하는 문제에 대하여 의논함
t: Discussion was held on the issue of making the children born to public and private slaves who took commoner women as wives into commoners.

src: 민유중을 영돈녕부사 여양부원군에, 초취 이씨를 해풍부부인에 재취 송씨를 은성부부인에, 삼취 조씨를 풍안부부인으로 증함.(왕비 민씨는 재취 송씨의 소생)
t: Min Yu-jung was posthumously appointed Chief of the Office of Royal Relations and Yeoyang Buwongun; his first wife, Lady Yi, was appointed Haepung Bubuin; his second wife, Lady Song, was appointed Eunseong Bubuin; and his third wife, Lady Jo, was appointed Pungan Bubuin. (Queen Min was born of the second wife, Lady Song.)

src: 어영청(御營廳)이 경비부족으로 동전의 주조를 청하여 이를 허락하고, 지방관서에 주전을 다시 허락함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The Eoyeongcheong, due to a shortage of funds, requested permission to mint copper coins, which was granted, and local government offices were again permitted to mint coins.

src: 훈련별대(訓鍊別隊)와 정초청(精抄廳)을 합하여 금위영(禁衛營) 설치.
t: The Hullyeon Byeoldae and the Jeongchocheong were merged to establish the Geumwiyeong.

src: 삼태사의 신위 순서 문제
t: The issue of the order of the spirit tablets of the Three Grand Preceptors (Samtaesa) arose.

src: 도성내에 명화적(明火賊)이 출현하여 은화를 탈취함
t: Torch bandits (明火賊) appeared inside the capital and stole silver.

src: 각 관청과 함경도(咸鏡道)의 관노비(官奴婢)로서 미곡을 바치는 자에게는 양인이 되는 것을 허락하자고 심극(沈極)이 상소했으나, 각 관청과 내수사(內需司)의 노비만 허락함
t: Sim Geuk submitted a memorial proposing that government slaves of various offices and Hamgyeong Province who donated grain be allowed to become commoners, but only the slaves of various offices and the Naesusa were permitted to do so.

src: 능동재사(陵洞齋舍) 중건
t: Neungdong Jaesa was reconstructed.

src: 순흥향교(順興鄕校) 중건
t: Sunheung Hyanggyo was reconstructed.

src: 순흥부 복설로 원래 땅을 되돌려 줌
t: With the restoration of Sunheung-bu, the original land was returned.

src: 다시 순흥 도호부(順興 都護府)로 고침
t: It was again changed to Sunheung Dohobu.

src: 가뭄으로 궁녀 수십 명을 방출함.
t: Due to drought, several dozen court ladies were released.

src: 강도성(江都城)과 문수산성(文殊山城)을 함께 축성하도록 결정.
t: It was decided to build Gangdoseong and Munsusanseong together.

src: 남구만(南九萬)이 함경도의 친군위(親軍衛)를 단속하여 대오를 만들 것을 건의함
t: Nam Gu-man proposed regulating the Chingunwi of Hamgyeong Province and organizing them into ranks.

src: 괴산에서 명화적(明火賊)이 양반가에 출현하여 조정 대신을 살해함
t: Torch bandits appeared at a yangban household in Goesan and killed a court minister.

src: 김석주(金錫冑)의 건의로 황해도에 있는 금위영(禁衛營) 별대 소속 군인 500명을 마병으로 편제함.
t: On Kim Seok-ju's proposal, 500 soldiers belonging to the Byeoldae of the Geumwiyeong in Hwanghae Province were organized into cavalry.

src: 친기위(親騎衛)의 편성, 대우, 승진 등을 기록한 ＜친기위초택절목(親騎衛抄擇節目)＞이 완성.
t: The <Chingiwi Chotaek Jeolmok>, which recorded the organization, treatment, and promotion of the Chingiwi, was completed.

src: 한재로 궁녀 25명을 방출함.
t: Due to drought, 25 court ladies were released.

src: 장씨(장희빈)를 숙원으로 봉함.
t: Lady Jang (Jang Hui-bin) was appointed to the rank of Suk-won.

src: 이징명이 상소하여 여총(女寵)을 논함.
t: Yi Jing-myeong submitted a memorial discussing the king's excessive favor toward a woman.

src: 봉화현감 남궁초(南宮礎) 부임
t: Nam Gung-cho took office as magistrate of Bonghwa County.

src: 친기위(親騎衛)의 선발 및 지휘권을 함경 감사와 남북 병사가 주관하게 함.
t: The selection and command of the Chingiwi (親騎衛) were placed under the Hamgyeong governor and the northern and southern military commanders.

src: 묵계서원(默溪書院) 건립
t: Construction of Mukgye Seowon (默溪書院)

src: 도계서원(道溪書院) 건립
t: Construction of Dogye Seowon (道溪書院)

src: 수우당(守愚堂) 양지암(養芝菴) 중건
t: Reconstruction of Yangjiam (養芝菴) at Suudang (守愚堂)

src: 소의 장씨(장희빈)가 왕자(경종)을 낳음.
t: Soui Jang (Jang Huibin) gave birth to a prince (King Gyeongjong).

src: 경기도의 사노 박업귀(朴業貴) 등이 군사를 일으켜 도성을 침범하려 했다는 죄목으로 처벌됨
t: Park Eop-gwi (朴業貴), a private slave from Gyeonggi Province, and others were punished on charges of raising troops in an attempt to invade the capital.

src: 경기도, 황해도 등지에서 미륵신앙(彌勒信仰)을 숭상하는 사람 수십 여명이 반란을 모의하다 승려 여환(呂還) 등 11명이 처형되자 이 지역 농민들이 탄압을 피해 대거 흩어짐
t: In Gyeonggi and Hwanghae provinces, dozens of people who venerated Maitreya faith (彌勒信仰) plotted a rebellion, and when the monk Yeohwan (呂還) and ten others were executed, the farmers of the region scattered in large numbers to avoid the crackdown.

src: 소의 장씨를 희빈에 봉함.(장희빈)
t: Soui Jang was invested as Huibin. (Jang Huibin)

src: 동전가치가 폭락하여 전국적으로 동전 주조를 금지시킴조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: As the value of copper coins plummeted, the minting of coins was banned nationwide.Annals of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 왕비 민씨(인현왕후)를 폐위함.
t: Queen Min (Queen Inhyeon) was deposed.

src: 종모법(從母法) 때문에 노비와 주인 사이에 소송사건이 발생하니, 이 종모법을 폐지할 것을 목내선(睦來善)이 상소함
t: As lawsuits arose between slaves and masters due to the Jongmobeop (從母法), Mok Nae-seon (睦來善) submitted a memorial requesting the abolition of this Jongmobeop.

src: 이 고(李 杲) 부임
t: Yi Go (李 杲) took office.

src: 희빈 장씨를 왕비로 삼음.
t: Huibin Jang was made queen.

src: 난고서당(蘭皐書堂) 건립
t: Construction of Nango Seodang (蘭皐書堂)

src: 이 해에 작성된 봉화에서 가장 오래된 호구단자
t: The oldest hogudanja (household register) from Bonghwa, written in this year

src: 경주봉국사에 명선, 명혜 양공부의 원당을 봉안함.
t: The wondang (願堂) of the two princesses Myeongseon and Myeonghye was enshrined at Bongguksa Temple in Gyeongju.

src: 개성 유수 이봉징(李鳳徵)의 청에 따라 주전을 허가하고 다시 동전 주전사업을 행함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: At the request of the Gaeseong magistrate Yi Bong-jing (李鳳徵), coin minting was permitted and the coin minting project was resumed.Annals of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 남한산성(南漢山城)의 한봉(汗峰) 좌우에 돈대(墩臺)를 설치하도록 함.
t: Ordered the installation of dondae (墩臺, watchtowers) on both sides of Hanbong (汗峰) at Namhansanseong (南漢山城).

src: 훈련도감(訓練都監)이 강화성을 쌓을 때 차용한 부채를 상환하고 필요한 물품을 조달하기 위해 주전을 함
t: The Hullyeon Dogam (訓練都監) minted coins to repay debts incurred while building Ganghwaseong and to procure necessary supplies.

src: 총융청(摠戎廳)에 1년 한도로 주전을 허가하여 시급한 경비를 조달하게 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The Chongyungcheong (摠戎廳) was permitted to mint coins for a period of one year to procure urgently needed funds.Annals of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 풍기향교(豊基鄕校) 이건
t: Relocation of Punggi Hyanggyo (豊基鄕校)

src: 봉화현감 박치(朴緻) 부임
t: Bonghwa County Magistrate Park Chi (朴緻) took office.

src: 양파 유관현(陽坡 柳觀鉉) 출생
t: Birth of Yangpa Yu Gwan-hyeon (陽坡 柳觀鉉)

src: 총융청(摠戎廳)과 훈련도감(訓練都監)의 동전 주조가 끝나면 동전주조 사업을 호조(戶曹)와 상평창(常平倉)에서 전관(專管)하기로 결정조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: It was decided that once the coin minting by the Chongyungcheong (摠戎廳) and Hullyeon Dogam (訓練都監) was completed, the coin minting project would be exclusively managed by the Hojo (戶曹) and Sangpyeongchang (常平倉).Annals of the Joseon Dynasty CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 단운재사(丹雲齋舍) 중건
t: Reconstruction of Danun Jaesa (丹雲齋舍)

src: 순흥부사 정중창(鄭重昌) 부임
t: Jeong Jung-chang was appointed as magistrate of Sunheung

src: 인현왕후의 책비례를 행함.
t: Performed the investiture ceremony of Queen Inhyeon

src: 폐비 민씨(인현왕후)를 복위하고 장희빈의 쇄(도장)를 거둠.
t: Restored the deposed Queen Min (Queen Inhyeon) to her position and confiscated the seal of Lady Jang Hui-bin

src: 지방 관아에 설치되어 있는 국왕의 상징물인 전패(殿牌)를 훼손한 사람들을 처형함(전패훼손)
t: Executed people who damaged the jeonpae (殿牌), a symbol of the king installed in local government offices (jeonpae damage incident)

src: 숙의 최씨(영조 생모)를 귀인에 봉함.
t: Suguui Choi (Yeongjo's birth mother) was conferred the title of Guiin

src: 도적이 정릉의 재실에 들어가 제사에 쓰는 유기를 훔쳐 감
t: Thieves entered the jaesil of Jeongneung and stole brassware used for ancestral rites

src: 도성에 나타난 명화적(明火賊)을 체포하지 못한 포도대장이 추고됨
t: The commander of the Capital Police Bureau, who failed to capture the bandits that appeared in the capital, was reprimanded

src: 철원에서 명화적(明火賊) 수십 명이 기를 세우고 포를 쏘며 인가(人家)를 침탈함
t: Dozens of bandits in Cheorwon raised flags, fired guns, and raided private houses

src: 어영청(御營廳)에서 필요한 경비를 조달하기 위해 10달을 기한으로 동전을 주전 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The Royal Guard Command minted coins for a period of 10 months to procure necessary expenses

src: 경상, 전라, 평안 3도의 진자(賑資)를 위해 주전을 허가하여 호조(戶曹)와 상평창(常平倉)에서 동전주조사업을 전관하기로 한 방침이 철회됨조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The policy of allowing the Ministry of Taxation and the Stabilization Granary to exclusively manage the coin minting business, having permitted minting for relief funds in the three provinces of Gyeongsang, Jeolla, and Pyeongan, was withdrawn

src: 자연재해와 기근으로 수많은 유망민이 발생함. 이는 1695년부터 1699년까지 계속해서 극심하게 일어났으며, 1702년 이후로도 지속됨
t: Numerous displaced people emerged due to natural disasters and famine. This occurred severely and continuously from 1695 to 1699, and continued even after 1702

src: 사설(私設) 주전장(鑄錢場)을 설치하여 부정하게 동전을 주조한 이전 판서 이경증(李景曾)의 손부인 박씨를 잡아 가둠조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Lady Park, the granddaughter-in-law of former Minister Yi Gyeong-jeung who set up a private coin foundry and illegally minted coins, was arrested and imprisoned

src: 기근으로 백성들이 굶주리자 명화적(明火賊)이 되어 곳곳에서 약탈을 자행함
t: As the people starved from famine, they became bandits and committed plundering everywhere

src: 이영창(李榮昌) 등이 무리를 일으켜 장길산(張吉山) 세력과 규합하여 도성을 침범하려다 사전에 발각됨
t: Yi Yeong-chang and others raised a group and joined forces with Jang Gil-san's faction to invade the capital, but were discovered beforehand

src: 광주(廣州)민 수백 명이 대궐 앞에서 길을 막고 살아갈 자금을 얻기를 호소하였으며, 이 일의 처리를 맡은 수어사 이세화(李世華)의 집으로 가 군관을 구타함
t: Several hundred people of Gwangju blocked the road in front of the palace and appealed for funds to survive, and went to the house of Defense Commissioner Yi Se-hwa, who was in charge of handling this matter, and beat military officers

src: 숭릉(崇陵)에 도적이 들어가 정자각(丁字閣)의 포진(鋪陳)을 훔쳐 갔으며, 행궁인 경덕궁(慶德宮)에서도 도적이 숭정전(崇政殿)의 어탑(御榻)과 휘장(揮帳)을 훔쳐 가려다 사로잡힘
t: Thieves entered Sungneung and stole the floor coverings of the Jeongjagak, and at Gyeongdeokgung, the temporary palace, thieves also tried to steal the royal couch and curtains of Sungjeongjeon but were caught

src: 장길산(張吉山)이 지휘하는 농민군 봉기함. 광대 출신으로 많은 무리들을 거느리고 평안도, 함경도, 황해도 일대에서 활약하나 끝내 잡히지 않음. 이해 전국 각지에서 도적 집단이 횡행함(장길산의 난)
t: The peasant army led by Jang Gil-san rose in rebellion. Of gwangdae (entertainer) origin, he led many followers and was active in the areas of Pyeongan-do, Hamgyeong-do, and Hwanghae-do, but was never caught. This year, bandit groups ran rampant throughout the country (Jang Gil-san's rebellion)

src: 군기시에서 김지남(金指南)이 지은 화약제조법에 대한 서적인 ≪신전자초방(新傳煮硝方)≫을 간행.
t: The Weapons Bureau published Sinjeonjachobang, a book on gunpowder manufacturing methods written by Kim Ji-nam

src: 원주(原州)에서 조정의 관료 출신이 화적에게 살해당함
t: A former court official was killed by bandits in Wonju

src: 도성 남문 밖 양반가에 화적이 출현해 재물을 탈취함
t: Bandits appeared at a yangban household outside the south gate of the capital and seized property

src: 금전지불을 약속 보증하는 일종의 채용증서(債用證書), 신용전표(信用錢票)인 어음이 상업거래에 사용됨尹錫範 外 共著,
t: Eoeum, a type of promissory note guaranteeing payment of money, a credit note, was used in commercial transactions

src: 먼 거리에 동전을 보내거나 직접 가져가기 어려울 때 이를 대신한 신용전표(信用錢票)인 환(換)이 상업활동에 사용됨尹錫範 外 共著,
t: Hwan, a credit note used in place of sending or carrying coins over long distances, was used in commercial activities

src: 희빈 장씨에게 사사함.
t: Ordered Lady Jang Hui-bin to commit suicide

src: 인현왕후 민씨가 35세로 창경궁 경춘전에서 죽음.
t: Queen Inhyeon Min died at age 35 in Gyeongchunjeon, Changgyeonggung

src: 소천서원(蘇川書院) 건립
t: Socheon Seowon was established

src: 세자가 희빈 장씨의 상에 직접 임함.
t: The Crown Prince personally attended the funeral of Royal Consort Jang.

src: 옥동서원(玉洞書院) 건립
t: Okdong Seowon was established.

src: 양역 변통(良役變通)을 담당할 기구로서 이정청(釐正廳) 설치.
t: Ijeongcheong was established as an agency to handle the reform of the yangyeok system.

src: 전주에서 올라오던 상납 물건이 천안에서 탈취당하고, 포천에서는 포(砲)와 활로 무장한 사람들이 고을을 횡행하였으며, 서흥에서는 봉수에 보관된 군기를 탈취당함
t: Tribute goods being sent up from Jeonju were stolen in Cheonan, in Pocheon people armed with guns and bows roamed the town, and in Seoheung military weapons stored in the beacon towers were stolen.

src: 기천정사(箕川正舍) 승격
t: Gicheon Jeongsa was elevated in status.

src: 봉화현감 박태적(朴泰迪) 부임
t: Bak Tae-jeok took office as magistrate of Bonghwa.

src: 삼산 유정원(三山 柳正源) 출생
t: Yu Jeong-won (Samsan) was born.

src: 이정청(釐正廳)에서 5군문의 제도를 고치도록 함
t: Ijeongcheong had the system of the Five Military Camps reformed.

src: 수군의 신포(身布)를 3필에서 2필로 감하여 육군과 동일하게 함.
t: The military cloth tax for the navy was reduced from 3 bolts to 2 bolts, making it equal to that of the army.

src: 태안 사람들이 태복시(太僕寺)에서 대대로 전해온 전토(田土)를 침탈하자 신문고를 치며 억울함을 호소함
t: When land that had been passed down for generations at the Taebok-si was encroached upon, the people of Taean struck the sinmungo drum to appeal their grievance.

src: 우참찬 이이명(李頤命)이 만주 지역과 조선 서북 지방을 함께 그려 넣은 요계관방도(遼薊關防圖)를 그려 바침.
t: Right State Councilor Yi I-myeong drew and presented the Yogyegwanbangdo, a map depicting both the Manchu region and the northwestern region of Joseon.

src: 오계서원(汚溪書院) 이건
t: Ogye Seowon was relocated.

src: 영천군수 박태익(朴泰翊) 부임
t: Bak Tae-ik took office as magistrate of Yeongcheon.

src: 둔암 조규양(鈍岩 趙葵陽) 출생
t: Jo Gyu-yang (Dunam) was born.

src: 강원도의 화전 농민들이 감사 송정규(宋廷奎)의 양전(量田)으로 인한 폐해에 불만을 가지고 봉기하여 총을 쏘며 감사의 잘못을 따져 물음
t: Slash-and-burn farmers in Gangwon-do, discontented with the harm caused by Governor Song Jeong-gyu's land survey, rose up and fired guns to protest against the governor's wrongdoing.

src: 봉화현감 조정례(趙正禮) 부임
t: Jo Jeong-rye took office as magistrate of Bonghwa.

src: 서인 상례의 제한을 다시 엄하게 함.
t: The restrictions on funeral rites for commoners were tightened again.

src: 사빈서원(泗濱書院) 이건
t: Sabin Seowon was relocated.

src: 수곡 권보(樹谷 權甫) 출생
t: Gwon Bo (Sugok) was born.

src: 팔우헌 조보양(八友軒 趙普陽) 출생
t: Jo Bo-yang (Palwoheon) was born.

src: 4월부터 시작한 북한산성(北漢山城) 축조 공사를 완료함.
t: The construction of Bukhansanseong, which had begun in April, was completed.

src: 호남노령 근처 10여 고을에 명화적(明火賊)이 출현함
t: Bandits wielding torches (myeonghwajeok) appeared in more than ten towns near Honam-noryeong.

src: 전 인의(引儀) 안정기(安鼎基)의 건의에 따라 군문(軍門)에서 병거(兵車)를 제작하게 함
t: Following the suggestion of former Uiui Ahn Jeong-gi, war chariots were ordered to be manufactured in the military camps.

src: 기근으로 유망하는 사람들이 늘어나고 변경에서는 와언(訛言)이 퍼져 소란이 일어남
t: Due to famine, the number of vagrants increased, and false rumors spread in the border regions, causing disturbances.

src: 강화(江華) 내성(內城) 완공이민웅, ＜18세기 강화도 수비체제의 강화＞,
t: Completion of the inner wall of Ganghwa. Lee Min-woong, <The Reinforcement of Ganghwado's Defense System in the 18th Century>,

src: 무이서당(武夷書堂) 건립
t: Muiseodang was founded.

src: 도성의 연은문(延恩門)에 명나라 인의 후손이 청나라에 무릎꿇은 조선국에 고유(告諭)한다는 내용의 괘서가 발생함
t: A placard was posted at Yeoneunmun in the capital, containing content in which a descendant of a Ming person proclaimed to Joseon, which had submitted to Qing.

src: 옥천서원(玉泉書院) 건립
t: Okcheon Seowon was founded.

src: 북한산성(北漢山城)에 비축되는 군량을 관리하는 관청인 경리청(經理廳)이 설치되고 도제조 등이 임명됨
t: Gyeongnicheong, the office in charge of military provisions stored at Bukhansanseong, was established, and a Dojejo and others were appointed.

src: 소양서원(瀟陽書院) 건립
t: Soyang Seowon was founded.

src: 친기위(親騎衛)의 정원을 1,200명으로 증액하고 1년 4차례 시재(試才)하여 우수자를 포상하도록 함.
t: The authorized strength of the Chingiwi was increased to 1,200, and skill tests were held four times a year to reward those who excelled.

src: 숭례문에 괘서 사건이 발생함
t: A placard incident occurred at Sungnyemun.

src: 봉화현감 이명필(李明弼) 부임
t: Yi Myeong-pil became magistrate of Bonghwa.

src: 소산 이광정(小山 李光靖) 출생
t: Sosan Yi Gwang-jeong was born.

src: 근품재 채헌(近品齋 蔡瀗) 출생
t: Geunpumjae Chae Heon was born.

src: 기양서당(岐陽書堂) 중창
t: Giyangseodang was rebuilt.

src: 평안 병사 이삼(李森)이 병영 소속 별무사(別武士)의 수효를 3백에서 5백인으로 증가시킬 것을 건의
t: Pyeongan Provincial Army Commander Yi Sam proposed to increase the number of Byeolmusa attached to the garrison from 300 to 500.

src: 강화(江華) 유수부에 장려(壯旅)와 의려(義旅)를 창설(장려, 의려)
t: Jangnyeo and Uiryeo were established at Ganghwa Yusubu (Jangnyeo, Uiryeo).

src: 황해도 감영에 별무사(別武士) 300명 창설.
t: 300 Byeolmusa were established at the Hwanghae-do provincial government office.

src: 동래부(東萊府)에 경상도별무사(別武士) 300인을 두고 별기위(別騎衛)라 칭함
t: 300 Gyeongsang-do Byeolmusa were placed at Dongnae-bu and called Byeolgiwi.

src: 전 현감 최국량(崔國亮)이 상소하여 오위 진법(陣法)의 부활을 주장하고 ≪단구첩록(壇究捷錄)≫ 8권을 바침.
t: Former magistrate Choe Gung-nyang submitted a memorial arguing for the revival of the Owi battle formation system, and presented eight volumes of the Dangu Cheomnok.

src: 소현세자빈 강씨의 위호를 복함.
t: The title of Sohyeon Seja-bin Lady Kang was restored.

src: 양덕에서 현감이 영을 따르지 않는 자를 잡아 가두자 수백여 명이 세차례에 걸쳐 관아로 몰려가 붙잡혀간 사람을 탈취함
t: In Yangdeok, when the magistrate arrested and imprisoned a person who did not follow orders, several hundred people rushed to the government office three times and seized back the person who had been taken.

src: 천안에서 윤대흥(尹大興)이라는 사람이 일족 20여명분의 군포를 자신에게 족징(族徵)하는 것에 항의해 집에 불을 지르고 타죽음
t: In Cheonan, a person named Yun Dae-heung, protesting against being subjected to clan-levy for the military cloth tax of over 20 of his kinsmen, set fire to his house and died burning.

src: 금성단(錦城壇) 건립
t: Geumseongdan was established.

src: 전옥(典獄)에 갇혀있던 명화적(明火賊)들이 옥문을 부수고 탈출함
t: Myeonghwajeok bandits imprisoned in Jeonok broke the prison gate and escaped.

src: 평안도 공사천으로 속오군이 된 자는 무학(武學)의 보인으로 편성함.
t: Those who became Sogogun from Pyeongan-do public and private slaves were organized as Boin of Muhak.

src: 태인과 회인에서 고을민들이 수령을 욕보이는 사건이 발생함. 또한 영천에서는 이태익(李台翊), 이무익(李茂翊) 등의 주도 아래 농민들이 봉기하여 환곡 수납을 거부하고 창고를 습격하며 향임을 축출함
t: Incidents occurred in Taein and Hoein in which local residents insulted the magistrates. Also in Yeongcheon, under the leadership of Yi Tae-ik, Yi Mu-ik and others, farmers rose up, refused to pay back hwangok grain loans, attacked storehouses, and expelled local functionaries.

src: 순흥부사 윤세겸(尹世謙) 부임
t: Yun Se-gyeom became magistrate of Sunheung.

src: 봉화현감 박사한(朴師漢) 부임
t: Bak Sa-han became magistrate of Bonghwa.

src: 후산 이종수(后山 李宗洙) 출생
t: Husan Yi Jong-su was born.

src: 평안도의 군제를 옛 식대로 시행하도록 함
t: Ordered that the military system of Pyeongan Province be implemented according to the old system.

src: 여승의 성내 왕래를 금함.
t: Prohibited Buddhist nuns from entering the walled city.

src: 무고(武庫)에서 천보총(千步銃)을 제작하여 평안도와 함경도에 보내게 함.
t: Had cheonbochong (thousand-step guns) manufactured at the military armory and sent to Pyeongan and Hamgyeong Provinces.

src: 진휼청(賑恤廳)에 무동(貿銅)으로 군기를 주조하도록 명하여 동전 주조를 중지시킴(영조(英祖)의 동전혁파시도)조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Ordered the Relief Agency to cast military weapons using purchased copper, thereby suspending the minting of coins (King Yeongjo's attempt to abolish coinage), Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 정 식(鄭 湜) 부임
t: Jeong Sik took office.

src: 내시가 궁녀를 뽑아 들이는 것을 엄금함.
t: Strictly prohibited eunuchs from selecting and bringing in court ladies.

src: 가선대부 변진영(邊震英)이 ≪노해(弩解)≫를 저술함.
t: Gaseon-daebu Byeon Jin-yeong wrote the Nohae.

src: 평안도 방영(防營)인 강계(江界), 선천, 창성, 삼화의 별무사(別武士) 정원이 각각 3백인씩으로 증가.
t: The quota of byeolmusa (special warriors) at the defense garrisons of Ganggye, Seoncheon, Changseong, and Samhwa in Pyeongan Province was increased to 300 each.

src: 전주, 남원, 도성에 잇달아 괘서가 발생함
t: Wall posters (gwaeseo) successively appeared in Jeonju, Namwon, and the capital.

src: 도성의 종가(鍾街)에서 괘서가 다시 발생함
t: Wall posters appeared again at Jongga Street in the capital.

src: 호남의 옥구, 임피 사이에서 괘서가 발생함
t: Wall posters appeared between Okgu and Impi in Honam.

src: 변산(邊山)에서 정도령(鄭都令)이라 칭하는 자가 부적과 술수 등으로 사람들을 모아 난을 모의하다 처벌됨
t: At Byeonsan, a person calling himself Jeong Doryeong gathered people using talismans and sorcery to plot a rebellion, and was punished.

src: 이인좌의 난과 현으로 강등
t: The Yi In-jwa Rebellion and demotion to hyeon (county) status.

src: 군기시에 보관된 김만기(金萬基)가 제작하였던 화차(火車)를 수리하게 함.
t: Had the hwacha (fire carts) made by Kim Man-gi and stored at the Military Weapons Bureau repaired.

src: 영남과 호남 사이에서 정도령(鄭都令)을 칭하며 민심을 선동하는 사람이 체포 처벌됨
t: A person who called himself Jeong Doryeong and incited public sentiment between Yeongnam and Honam was arrested and punished.

src: 경외처녀로 20, 30이 넘도록 혼가하지 못한 자에게 자장(資粧)을 마련하여 주도록 함.
t: Ordered that dowries be provided for unmarried women in the capital and countryside who had passed the age of 20 or 30 without marrying.

src: 수어청에 명하여 평총(平銃) 9백자루와 장총(長銃) 1백자루를 제조하여 남한산성(南漢山城)의 군기를 보충하게 함.
t: Ordered the Sueocheong to manufacture 900 pyeongchong (regular guns) and 100 jangchong (long guns) to supplement the military weapons of Namhansanseong.

src: 영흥(永興)에서 사로잡힌 명화적(明火賊) 24인이 밖의 일당들과 결탁해 옥을 부수고 달아남
t: Twenty-four myeonghwajeok (torch bandits) captured in Yeongheung colluded with their outside associates, broke out of prison, and fled.

src: 해주의 안필복(安必復)과 안치복(安致復) 등이 ≪정감록(鄭鑑錄)≫을 지니고 있다 체포됨.
t: An Pil-bok and An Chi-bok of Haeju were arrested for possessing the Jeonggamnok.

src: 금년 이후로는 모든 종의 양인 아내의 소생은 공천(公賤)과 사천(私賤)을 막론하고 어머니의 역(役)에 따라 양인으로 할 것을 김상성(金尙星)이 아뢰니, 이를 시행하도록 명령함(노비종모역법(奴婢從母役法))
t: Kim Sang-seong reported that from this year onward, the children born of commoner wives of all slaves, whether public or private slaves, should be made commoners in accordance with their mother's status, and it was ordered to be implemented (the Nobijongmoyeokbeop, the law of slave status following the mother).

src: 양근(楊根) 읍내에 화적이 횡행하여 양반가를 습격함
t: Bandits ran rampant in the town of Yanggeun and attacked yangban households.

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에서 새로이 동포(銅砲) 50문과 홍이포(紅夷砲) 2문을 제작함.
t: The Hullyeon-dogam newly manufactured 50 dongpo (bronze cannons) and 2 hongipo (red barbarian cannons).

src: 주전 사업에 관한 규정으로 진휼청(賑恤廳) 주전절목(鑄錢節目)과 호조(戶曹) 주전절목(鑄錢節目)을 제정하여 실시함
t: Established and implemented regulations concerning coin minting operations, namely the Coin Minting Regulations of the Relief Agency and the Coin Minting Regulations of the Ministry of Taxation.

src: 남자는 아버지의 역(役)을 따르고 여자는 어머니의 역(役)을 따르는 것으로 공사천(公私賤)의 법을 정하라고 명령함
t: Ordered that the law concerning public and private slaves be established such that men follow their father's status and women follow their mother's status.

src: 전국을 휩쓴 흉황(凶荒)으로 호조(戶曹)와 진휼청(賑恤廳)에서 백성을 구제하기 위해 상평통보(常平通寶)의 주조를 다시 재개함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Due to famine that swept the whole country, the Ministry of Taxation (Hojo) and the Relief Agency (Jinhyulcheong) resumed the minting of Sangpyeongtongbo to relieve the people.Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 충청도 충원(忠原)민들이 전임 수령의 비리를 고발하고 욕을 하며 수령의 모습을 허수아비로 만들어 활을 쏘기도 함
t: People of Chungwon in Chungcheong Province reported the previous magistrate's misconduct and cursed him, and even made a scarecrow in his likeness and shot arrows at it.

src: 호조(戶曹)와 진휼청(賑恤廳)에서 주조하는 동전의 경중을 구전(舊錢)과 같게 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The Ministry of Taxation and the Relief Agency made the weight of the coins they minted equal to that of the old coins.Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 혼취는 오례의를 정식으로 하게 함.
t: Marriage was made to follow the Five Rites as the official form.

src: 남원의 한 절에 있는 석불상(石佛像)에 난을 도모하겠다는 괘서가 발생함
t: A poster proclaiming a plot to rebel appeared on a stone Buddha statue at a temple in Namwon.

src: 동전을 사주(私鑄)한 죄인 유만영(柳萬永), 이진삼(李眞三), 김사동(金四銅)을 복주(伏誅)함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The criminals Yu Man-yeong, Yi Jin-sam, and Kim Sa-dong, who illegally minted coins, were executed.Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 교하와 파주 사이에 화적이 횡행하여 사람을 상해하고 마을을 불태움
t: Bandits rampaged between Gyoha and Paju, injuring people and burning villages.

src: 대구의 진영문(鎭營門) 밖에 감사의 비장(裨將)을 비난하는 내용이 담긴 괘서가 발생함
t: A poster criticizing the governor's aide-de-camp appeared outside the Jinyeong Gate in Daegu.

src: 대소관리가 기생첩을 두는 것을 쇄환시킴.
t: Officials of high and low rank were prohibited from keeping gisaeng concubines.

src: 판서 김시형(金始炯)이 동전 원료의 확보를 위해 국내 채동(採銅)을 건의(동전원료의 공급)조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Minister Kim Si-hyeong proposed domestic copper mining to secure raw materials for coins (supply of coin materials).Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 여사서(女四書) 및 내훈을 이덕수로 하여금 언역하게 함.
t: He had Yi Deok-su translate the Yeosaseo and Naehun into Korean.

src: 동야 김양근(東埜 金養根) 출생
t: Dongya Kim Yang-geun was born.

src: 우의정 송인명(宋寅明)이 고액전(高額錢)의 주조를 청하였으나 허락하지 않음(영조대의 고액전(高額錢) 발행논의)조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Right State Councilor Song In-myeong requested the minting of high-denomination coins, but it was not permitted (discussion on the issuance of high-denomination coins during King Yeongjo's reign).Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 정재종택(定齋宗宅) 건립
t: Jeongjae Jongtaek was built.

src: 풍기향교(豊基鄕校) 이건
t: Punggi Hyanggyo was relocated.

src: 관산지관(冠山之館) 중건
t: Gwansanjigwan was rebuilt.

src: 봉화현감 이광직(李匡直) 부임
t: Bonghwa County Magistrate Yi Gwang-jik took office.

src: 왕이 이덕수에게 여사서를 번역하여 간행하게 함.
t: The king had Yi Deok-su translate and publish the Yeosaseo.

src: 병조 판서 박문수(朴文秀)에게 명하여 ＜금군절목(禁軍節目)＞을 편수하게 함.
t: He ordered Minister of Military Affairs Park Mun-su to compile the Geumgun Jeolmok.

src: 경상도 우병영에서
t: At the Right Military Command of Gyeongsang Province

src: 평안도 병영에서 중국에서 구입한 ≪무비지(武備志)≫ 50권을 간행.
t: The Pyeongan Province Military Command published 50 volumes of the Wubeizhi purchased from China.

src: 청음 김상헌의 서원 건립문제
t: The issue of building a seowon for Cheongeum Kim Sang-heon

src: 경기병(京騎兵)의 명목을 혁파하고 이를 비변사에서 변통하게 함.
t: The nominal title of Gyeonggibyeong was abolished, and this was handled by the Border Defense Council.

src: 영천군수 최상관(崔尙觀) 부임
t: Yeongcheon County Magistrate Choe Sang-gwan took office.

src: 구와 김굉(龜窩 金 土+宏) 출생
t: Guwa Kim Goeng was born.

src: 대궐문 밖에 괘서가 발생함
t: A poster with treasonous writings appeared outside the palace gate.

src: 밀양에서 수백여 명이 돈을 모으고 계를 조직하여 수령의 교체와 향임(鄕任) 차출시 영향력을 행사함
t: Several hundred people in Miryang raised money and organized a mutual aid society (gye), exercising influence over the replacement of magistrates and the selection of local functionaries (hyangim).

src: 강원도, 평안도, 함경도, 황해도 지방에 크게 기근이 들어 각기 단호(團號)를 가진 도적이 일어났는데 도성 근처의 후서강단(後西江團), 평양의 폐사군단(廢四郡團), 재인(才人)들의 채단(彩團), 유민들의 유단(流團)
t: A great famine struck Gangwon-do, Pyeongan-do, Hamgyong-do, and Hwanghae-do, and bandit groups each bearing a group name arose, including the Huseogangdan near the capital, the Pyeosagundan of Pyongyang, the Chaedan of entertainers (jaein), and the Yudan of displaced people.

src: 타양서원(陀陽書院) 건립
t: Doyang Seowon was established.

src: 각도에서 ≪병장도설(兵將圖說)≫을 중간(重刊)하게 함.
t: Each province was ordered to reprint the Byeongjangdoseol.

src: 궁중에 보관되어 있던 ≪병장도설(兵將圖說)≫을 간행하게 함.
t: The Byeongjangdoseol kept in storage in the palace was ordered to be published.

src: 벽돌을 이용한 강화(江華) 외성(外城)을 축조 공사 시작.
t: Construction began on the outer wall of Ganghwa using brick.

src: 지방관서의 동전 주전량을 제한하기 위해 주전량의 최고한도를 정하여 지방관서에 시달함
t: To limit the amount of coin minting by provincial government offices, a maximum limit on minting quantity was set and communicated to the provincial offices.

src: 전황(錢荒) 현상과 그 대책에 대해 논의함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The phenomenon of coin scarcity (jeonhwang) and countermeasures against it were discussed.

src: 호조(戶曹)를 비롯한 함경도, 개성부, 경상도, 전라도, 평안도, 통영(統營) 등지의 관아에 주전을 허락함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Minting was permitted at the Ministry of Taxation as well as at the offices of Hamgyong-do, Gaeseong-bu, Gyeongsang-do, Jeolla-do, Pyeongan-do, and the Naval Headquarters (Tongyeong).

src: 세자빈 삼간례를 행하여 홍봉한의 딸을 세자빈으로 정함.
t: The third selection ceremony for the crown princess was held, and the daughter of Hong Bong-han was designated as crown princess.

src: 능동재사(陵洞齋舍) 중건
t: Neungdong Jaesa was rebuilt.

src: 방산정사(芳山精舍) 건립
t: Bangsan Jeongsa was established.

src: 김상적(金尙迪)이 시노비(寺奴婢)의 폐단을 아뢰니, 임금이 비총(比摠)의 절목(節目)을 정하여 아뢰라고 명령함(비총법(比摠法))
t: Kim Sang-jeok reported on the abuses concerning government slaves (sinobi), and the king ordered that regulations for the quota comparison system (bichong) be drawn up and reported.

src: 봉화현감 송사흠(宋思欽) 부임
t: Song Sa-heum took office as magistrate of Bonghwa-hyeon.

src: 수성절목(守城節目)을 작성하고 호조, 선혜청, 각 군문의 창고를 도성 안으로 옮기도록 함.
t: Regulations for the defense of the capital (suseong jeolmok) were drawn up, and the storehouses of the Ministry of Taxation, the Relief Bureau (Seonhyecheong), and the various military garrisons were ordered to be moved inside the capital walls.

src: 영풍(永豐)은 강원도, 함경도, 평안도, 황해도 네 도로 통하는 곳으로 지세가 험한데다 매년 기근이 들어 많은 사람들이 몰려 들어가 적단(賊團)을 형성해 출몰함
t: Yeongpung is a place connecting the four provinces of Gangwon-do, Hamgyong-do, Pyeongan-do, and Hwanghae-do, and as the terrain is rugged and famine strikes every year, many people gathered there and formed bandit groups (jeokdan) that appeared and disappeared.

src: 경기도 죽산(竹山)에서 말을 탄 난민들이 횡행하고 마전(麻田)에 있는 수어청(守禦廳)의 둔전 곡물을 탈취함
t: In Jukssan, Gyeonggi-do, mounted refugees ran rampant and seized the grain stores of the garrison fields of the Sueocheong located in Majeon.

src: 청주, 문의(文義) 사이에 괘서가 발생하여 여러 고을에서 계속 소요가 일어나고 피난하는 사람들이 많이 생겨남
t: A poster with treasonous writings appeared between Cheongju and Munui, causing continuous disturbances in several counties and many people fled as refugees.

src: 순흥부사 신종하(申宗夏) 부임
t: Sin Jong-ha took office as magistrate of Sunheung-bu.

src: 군문 대장에게 ≪속병장도설(續兵將圖說)≫을 간행하게 함.
t: The commanders of the military garrisons were ordered to publish the Sokbyeongjangdoseol.

src: 사대부 혼일에 납폐, 친영, 관례를 신칙하게 하며 국혼동뢰연(國婚同牢宴)에 다과를 몇 가지만 쓰게 함.
t: It was ordered that in the marriages of the gentry class, the presentation of betrothal gifts (napye), the groom's fetching of the bride (chinyeong), and the coming-of-age ceremony (gwallye) be strictly observed, and that only a few refreshments be served at the royal wedding banquet (guhondongroeyeon).

src: 부인의 다리머리에 대해 논함.
t: A discussion was held on women's wig-like hair ornaments (darimeori).

src: 동암서당(東巖書堂) 건립
t: Dongam Seodang was established.

src: 궁녀 45명을 방출함.
t: 45 court ladies were released.

src: 균역청(均役廳)을 설치하고 당상을 임명함.
t: Established the Gyunyeokcheong (均役廳) and appointed dangsang officials.

src: 군포 1필을 줄여 양역(良役)의 절반을 감하도록 함.
t: Reduced the military cloth tax by 1 pil, cutting the yangyeok (良役) burden by half.

src: ≪속병장도설(續兵將圖說) ≫을 각도의 감사와 병사에게 나누어줌.
t: Distributed the Sokbyeongjangdoseol (續兵將圖說) to the governors and military commanders of each province.

src: 수어사를 광주 유수로 고치고 총융사를 경기 병사로 고치고 서울의 군교(軍校)를 어영청(御營廳)과 금위영(禁衛營)에 분속시킴.
t: Changed Sueosa to Gwangju Yusu, changed Chongyungsa to Gyeonggi Byeongsa, and divided the military troops of the capital among the Eoyeongcheong (御營廳) and Geumwiyeong (禁衛營).

src: 삼산종택(三山宗宅) 건립
t: Built Samsan Jongtaek (三山宗宅).

src: 영조가 수성윤음(守城綸音)을 작성하여 내림.
t: King Yeongjo composed and issued the Suseong Yunŭm (守城綸音).

src: 비변사 당상 김성진(金聖鎭)이 전황(錢荒)대책으로 호조(戶曹), 선혜청, 삼군문(三軍門)이 1년에 한번씩 번갈아 가며 주조하는 5년1차주전론(五年一次鑄錢論)을 제의柳子厚,
t: Bibyeonsa dangsang Kim Seong-jin (金聖鎭) proposed the Oryeonilchajujeollon (五年一次鑄錢論), a plan for the Hojo (戶曹), Seonhyecheong, and Samgunmun (三軍門) to mint coins in rotation once every five years as a countermeasure against jeonhwang (錢荒, coin shortage). Yu Ja-hu,

src: ≪균역사목(均役事目)≫을 완성함.
t: Completed the Gyunyeoksamok (均役事目).

src: 균역사실(均役事實)을 왕세자에게 올림.
t: Presented the Gyunyeoksasil (均役事實) to the Crown Prince.

src: 김포의 명화적(明火賊) 수백명이 말을 타고 깃발을 세우고서 포를 쏘며 곳곳을 침탈함
t: Several hundred myeonghwajeok (明火賊) in Gimpo raided various places on horseback, raising flags and firing guns.

src: 각 군영의 경비조달을 위해 훈련도감, 어영청, 무위영이 상평통보 중형전(常平通寶 中型錢)을 발행함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The Hullyeondogam, Eoyeongcheong, and Muwiyeong issued Sangpyeongtongbo jungyeongjeon (常平通寶 中型錢) coins to fund the expenses of each military camp. Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Ganhaengwiwonhoe,

src: 숙빈 최씨(영조의 어머니)의 시호를 화경이라 추상함.
t: Posthumously honored Suk-bin Choi (淑嬪 崔氏, King Yeongjo's mother) with the title Hwagyeong.

src: 북정 이종주(北亭 李宗周) 출생
t: Bukjeong Yi Jong-ju (北亭 李宗周) was born.

src: 영조가 ≪위장필람(爲將必覽)≫을 지어 군문에서 간행하게 함.
t: King Yeongjo wrote the Wijangpillam (爲將必覽) and had it published for the military camps.

src: 병조판서가 금위대장(禁衛大將)을 겸하는 것을 없애고 용호영(龍虎營)만을 거느리게 함.
t: Abolished the practice of the Minister of War concurrently serving as Commander of the Geumwiyeong (禁衛大將), leaving him to command only the Yonghoyeong (龍虎營).

src: 운암종택(雲岩宗宅) 건립
t: Built Unam Jongtaek (雲岩宗宅).

src: 수원에 별효위(別驍衛) 700명을 창설.
t: Established a corps of 700 Byeolhyowi (別驍衛) in Suwon.

src: 금군청(禁軍廳)을 용호영(龍虎營)으로 개칭.
t: Renamed the Geumgunceong (禁軍廳) to Yonghoyeong (龍虎營).

src: 경상도 거창과 개령의 농민들이 환곡 징수에 불만을 품고 관창에 들어가 장부를 불태워 버림
t: Peasants of Geochang and Gaeryeong in Gyeongsang Province, angered by the collection of hwangok (relief grain loans), entered the government granary and burned the registers.

src: 배순정려비(裵純旌閭碑) 중건
t: Rebuilt the Bae Sun Jeongnyeobi (裵純旌閭碑).

src: 영천군수 조덕수(趙德洙) 부임
t: Jo Deok-su (趙德洙) took office as magistrate of Yeongcheon County.

src: 사족부녀의 다리머리를 금하고 족두리를 쓰게 함.(다리(가체)금지)
t: Prohibited daerimeori (wig headdresses) for women of the sajok class and had them wear jokduri instead. (Prohibition of dari/gache)

src: 휼전(恤典)을 베풀다.
t: Granted relief measures (恤典).

src: 해서의 요녀를 효시함.
t: Beheaded the sorceress of Haeseo.

src: 다리머리를 금하고 족두리를 허하고 아울러 여러 다른 모양을 엄금함.(다리(가체)금지)
t: Prohibited daerimeori and permitted jokduri, while strictly forbidding all other forms. (Prohibition of dari/gache)

src: 사도세자(思悼世子)가
t: Sado Seja

src: 노암 정필규(魯庵 鄭必奎) 출생
t: Noam Jeong Pil-gyu was born

src: 유암서원(流巖書院) 건립
t: Yuam Seowon was built

src: 운곡서당(雲谷書堂) 건립
t: Ungok Seodang was built

src: 상주인 배윤현(裵胤玄)이라는 사람이 대궐 문에 괘서하려다 붙잡힘
t: A man named Bae Yun-hyeon from Sangju was caught while attempting to post a placard on the palace gate

src: 금위영(禁衛營) 소속 군병들이 대궐문에 괘서하여 대장 이장오(李章吾)가 처벌됨
t: Soldiers belonging to the Geumwiyeong posted a placard on the palace gate, and the commander Yi Jang-o was punished

src: 무녀를 성외로 축출하게 함.
t: Shamans were ordered to be expelled outside the city walls.

src: 다리머리 없애는 것을 다시 강조함.(다리(가체)금지)
t: The prohibition on dari meori was reemphasized.(Ban on dari (gache))

src: 북도 가솔 군관(假率軍官)의 더 정하는 액수를 ≪양역실총(良役實總)≫에 따라 정함.
t: The additional quota for provisional subordinate military officers in the northern provinces was set according to the Yangyeok Silchong.

src: 시대부들 중 기생첩을 둔 자로서 자식이 있는 자를 제하고는 모두 쇄환하여 원적에 속하게 함.
t: Among the sadaebu, those who had gisaeng concubines were, except those with children, all returned and registered in their original household registers.

src: 6월에 큰 난리가 날 것이다는 와언(訛言)을 퍼뜨리던 사람들이 붙잡혀 처벌됨
t: People who had spread rumors that a great disturbance would occur in June were caught and punished

src: 해서에서 미륵불(彌勒佛)이라고 칭하는 자가 사람들을 선동하다 파견된 어사(御史)에 의해 처벌됨
t: In Haeseo, a person calling himself Maitreya Buddha incited people but was punished by a royal inspector dispatched there

src: 장단(長端)의 임진강 상류 절벽에 돈대(墩臺) 설치.
t: A beacon platform was installed on the cliff at the upper reaches of the Imjin River in Jangdan.

src: 황해도 장연의 어영 둔전에서 농민들이 탐학한 어영청 장교를 살해한 뒤 붙잡혀 주모자들이 처형당함
t: In the Eoyeong military farmland of Jangyeon, Hwanghae Province, farmers killed a corrupt Eoyeongcheong officer and were caught, and the ringleaders were executed

src: 장례원(掌隷院)을 형조(刑曹)에 예속시킨 다음 보민사(保民司)라고 명칭을 붙일 것을 홍봉한(洪鳳漢)이 아룀(장례원(掌隷院)의 폐지)
t: Hong Bong-han reported that the Jangnyewon should be subordinated to the Hyeongjo and then renamed Bominsa (Abolition of the Jangnyewon)

src: 궁녀 30명을 방출함.
t: 30 court ladies were released.

src: 금성(金城)에서 명화적(明火賊) 3, 4백 명이 활동하였으나 5, 6인 만이 체포됨
t: In Geumseong, 3-4 hundred armed bandits were active, but only 5-6 people were captured

src: 순흥부사 이서중(李敍中) 부임
t: Yi Seo-jung took office as magistrate of Sunheung

src: 봉화양군(良軍)의 이동
t: Movement of the Bonghwa regular troops

src: 왕비가 친잠례를 행함.
t: The queen performed the rite of personally tending silkworms.

src: 고산정사(高山精舍) 건립
t: Gosan Jeongsa was built

src: 기생첩을 둔 관직자를 처분함.
t: Officials who had gisaeng concubines were punished.

src: 주전원료 확보와 전황(錢荒)대책의 일환으로 청나라와의 국경지대인 압록강, 두만강의 강변지방에서의 동전유통을 금지시킴조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: As part of measures to secure raw materials for coin minting and address the coin shortage, the circulation of copper coins was banned in the riverside areas of the Yalu and Tumen rivers, the border regions with Qing China. Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 각도의 기한이 넘도록 혼인하지 못한 사람들에게 자급하여 혼인하도록 함.
t: People in each province who had passed the deadline without marrying were given financial support to marry.

src: 서산서원(西山書院) 건립
t: Seosan Seowon was built

src: 서류(庶類)를 허통함.
t: Allowed the illegitimate offspring (seoryu) to hold office.

src: 8도 양도에 40세가 넘도록 미혼인 자를 관에 보고하여 돕게 함.
t: In the Eight Provinces and Two Capitals, unmarried persons over 40 years of age were to be reported to the government office for assistance.

src: 지방의 천총(千摠)과 파총(把摠)을 일반 군사에서 승진시켜 차정하게 함.
t: Local commanders of a thousand (cheonchong) and commanders of a hundred (pachong) were to be appointed by promotion from ordinary soldiers.

src: 부사직 구선행(具善行)이 조화순환포(造化循環砲)와 일와봉전(一窩蜂箭)을 제작.
t: Vice Commandant Gu Seon-haeng manufactured the Johwa Sunhwanpo and Ilwabongjeon.

src: 주전하고 남은 이익 5만여 냥을 착복한 전(前) 어영대장 장지항(張志恒)을 의금부에 가둠조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Former Commander of the Royal Guard (Eoyeongdaejang) Jang Ji-hang, who embezzled over 50,000 nyang in profits remaining from minting coins, was imprisoned in the Uigeumbu.Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Compilation Committee,

src: 호고와 유휘문(好古窩 柳徽文) 출생
t: Hogowa Yu Hwi-mun was born.

src: 해남 사람들이 고을 좌수(座首)를 비난하여 괘서함
t: People of Haenam criticized the county's jwasu (local headman) and posted an anonymous notice.

src: 순흥부사 이겸진(李謙鎭) 부임
t: Sunheung Magistrate Yi Gyeom-jin took office.

src: 봉화현감 조장진(趙長鎭) 부임
t: Bonghwa County Magistrate Jo Jang-jin took office.

src: 역가(逆家)로 연좌된 부녀를 포도청에 구류하는 법을 없앰.
t: Abolished the law that detained women implicated by association with traitorous households (yeokga) in the Podocheong.

src: 무격을 성외로 축출하는 것을 금함.
t: Prohibited the expulsion of shamans (mugyeok) outside the city walls.

src: 숙위소(宿衛所)를 설치하고 홍국영(洪國榮)을 숙위 대장으로 임명함.
t: Established the Sukwiso and appointed Hong Guk-yeong as Commander of the Sukwi.

src: 함경도 감영과 남, 북병영에 별친기위(別親騎衛)를 설치하여 함경도 무과 출신을 소속시킴
t: Established the Byeolchin'giwi at the Hamgyong Provincial Office and the Southern and Northern Military Commands, and assigned to it those who had passed the military examination in Hamgyong Province.

src: 도성문 근처에 출현한 명화적(明火賊)을 잡지 못한 포도대장이 처벌됨
t: The Podocheong Commander was punished for failing to capture the myeonghwajeok (armed bandits) who appeared near the capital's gates.

src: 남형(濫刑)으로 여러 사람을 치사하게 한 고령 현감의 잘못을 고을인이 격쟁(擊錚)하여 현감이 귀양형에 처해짐
t: The people of the county petitioned by striking a gong (gyeokjaeng) over the wrongdoing of the Goryeong County Magistrate, who had caused several deaths through excessive punishment (namhyeong), and the magistrate was sentenced to exile.

src: 자여역(自如驛)의 찰방이 형벌을 남용하여 사람을 죽이자 가족들이 그가 교체되어 갈 때 짐을 빼앗고 구타를 함
t: When the Chalbang of Jayeo Station abused punishment and killed a person, the family seized his belongings and beat him as he was being replaced and departing.

src: 정재 유치명(定齋 柳致明) 출생
t: Jeongjae Yu Chi-myeong was born.

src: 궁녀의 놀이잔치를 금함.
t: Prohibited banquets and entertainments for court ladies.

src: 병조에 명하여 ＜열무의절(閱武儀節)＞을 바로 잡게 함.
t: Ordered the Ministry of War to correct the Yeolmu Uijeol.

src: 호위청(扈衛廳)의 3청을 1청으로 축소하고 350명을 정원으로 함.
t: Reduced the three offices of the Howicheong to one office and set the quota at 350 men.

src: 추쇄관(推刷官)을 혁파하였으며, 비변사(備邊司)에서 혁파절목(革罷節目)을 올림(비변사의 노비추쇄혁파절목)
t: Abolished the Chusoegwan, and the Bibyeonsa submitted the abolition regulations (the Bibyeonsa's Regulations on the Abolition of Slave Chusoe).

src: 호조판서 구윤옥(具允鈺)이 재정 보충을 위해 주전을 건의하여, 상평통보(常平通寶)의 주전사업이 재개됨조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Minister of Taxation Gu Yun-ok proposed minting coins to supplement the treasury, and the minting of Sangpyeongtongbo coins resumed.Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Compilation Committee,

src: 통어영(統禦營)을 강화부에 합치고 강화(江華) 유수에게 경기 와 삼도 통어사를 겸임시킴.
t: Merged the Tongeoyeong into Ganghwa-bu, and had the Ganghwa Yusu concurrently serve as the Tongeosa of Gyeonggi and the Three Provinces.

src: 괴헌고택(槐軒古宅) 건립
t: Goehon Old House was built.

src: 무녀를 경외로 축출하고 무세는 해당 읍에 징납하게 함.
t: Expelled female shamans outside the capital and had the shaman tax collected by the respective county.

src: 경기도 광주민들이 품질이 나쁜 곡식을 환곡으로 분급하는데 불만을 품고 수어사(守禦使)에게 호소하려 하였으나 없자 도성문에 몰려가 항의함(광주민 작난사건)
t: Gyeonggi-do Gwangju residents, dissatisfied with the poor quality grain distributed as hwangok (relief loan grain), tried to appeal to the Sueosa but as he was absent, they gathered at the capital gate to protest (Gwangju residents' disturbance incident)

src: 임금의 수레 행차 앞에서 6건의 격쟁(擊錚)이 일어남
t: Six cases of gyeokjaeng (beating a gong to appeal) occurred in front of the king's royal procession

src: 덕산 사람이 궁방 궁감(宮監)의 폐단에 대해 격쟁(擊錚)하여 궁감이 처벌됨
t: A person from Deoksan lodged a gyeokjaeng complaint about the abuses of a gunggam, and the gunggam was punished

src: 무예별감(武藝別監)의 훈련 절차를 수록한 병서인 ≪이진총방(肄陣總方)≫ 간행.
t: Ijinchongbang, a military manual recording the training procedures of the Muye Byeolgam, was published

src: 승려의 입성을 다시 엄하게 금함.
t: The entry of Buddhist monks into the capital was again strictly prohibited

src: 봉화현감 심공저(沈公著) 부임
t: Bonghwa hyeongam Sim Gong-jeo took office

src: 함경도 북청(北靑)에서 부사가 환곡을 납부하지 않은 사람들을 처벌하자 수십여 명이 관아로 몰려 들어 결박을 풀어주고 부사를 모욕함
t: In Bukcheong, Hamgyeong-do, when the busa punished people who had not paid back their hwangok, several dozen people stormed into the government office, released the bound offenders, and insulted the busa

src: 전황(錢荒)이 극심하여 외국의 동전을 수입하여 사용하자는 의견이 제기됨조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: As the coin shortage (jeonhwang) became severe, an opinion was raised to import and use foreign coins

src: ≪병학통(兵學通)≫이 완성됨≪조선왕조실록≫병학통의 진도
t: Byeonghaktong was completed

src: 무예 출신의 칭호를 장용위(壯勇衛)로 개명함.
t: The title of Muye chulsin was renamed Jangyongwi

src: 각 영의 습진(習陣), 남한산성(南漢山城)의 성조(城操) 및 통영의 수조(水操)에
t: Regarding the seupjin of each yeong, the seongjo of Namhansanseong, and the sujo of Tongyeong

src: ≪정감록(鄭鑑錄)≫을 근거로 사람들을 모아 반란을 모의한 문광겸(文光謙), 홍복영(洪福榮) 등이 처벌받고 관련자들도 체포됨≪조선왕조실록≫, 정조 9년 3월 16일
t: Mun Gwang-gyeom, Hong Bok-yeong, and others, who had plotted rebellion by gathering people based on the Jeonggamnok, were punished, and those involved were also arrested

src: 호조(戶曹)가 주전사업을 전관하는 호조전관제(戶曹專管制)가 확립되고, 훈련대장 구선복(具善復)을 주전당상으로 임명하여 67만 냥의 동전을 주조하게 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: The Hojo jeongwanje, in which the Hojo exclusively managed coin casting, was established, and Gu Seon-bok, the Hullyeon daejang, was appointed as jujeon dangsang to cast 670,000 nyang of copper coins

src: 안동부사 유의양(柳義養) 부임
t: Andong busa Yu Ui-yang took office

src: 주전 경비를 줄이기 위해 일시에 대량으로 주조하는 방침을 정하고 주전 한도액을 100만 냥으로 늘림조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: To reduce coin casting expenses, a policy of large-scale casting at one time was set, and the casting limit was increased to 1,000,000 nyang

src: 화천서원(花川書院) 건립
t: Hwacheon Seowon was built

src: 유암서원(流巖書院) 이건
t: Yuam Seowon was relocated

src: 서간사(西磵祠)에 편액 하사
t: A plaque was bestowed upon Seogansa

src: 영천군수 한대유(韓大裕) 부임
