t: Yeongcheon gunsu Han Dae-yu took office

src: 기존의 여러 판본을 종합하여 장용영(壯勇營)에서 ≪병학지남(兵學指南)≫을 편집, 간행함.
t: Byeonghakjinam was compiled and published by Jangyongyeong, synthesizing various existing editions

src: 수원(水原), 평택, 온양, 아산, 천안, 직산 등지에서 외적의 침입에 관한 와언(訛言)이 퍼져 사람들이 동요함
t: In Suwon, Pyeongtaek, Onyang, Asan, Cheonan, Jiksan, and other areas, rumors (waeon) about a foreign invasion spread, causing people to be alarmed

src: 부녀의 다리머리(가체)를 금함.(다리(가체)금지)
t: Women's dari (gache) was banned. (Dari (gache) prohibition)

src: 장용영(壯勇營)에서 ＜향군신정절목(鄕軍新定節目)＞을 올림.
t: Jangyongyeong submitted the Hyanggun sinjeong jeolmok

src: 제천의 한 백성이 관가에 올린 소장(訴狀)이 받아들여지지 않고 감금되자 아들을 시켜 격쟁(擊錚)함
t: When a Jecheon commoner's petition submitted to the government office was not accepted and he was detained, his son performed gyeokjaeng on his behalf

src: 호조판서 서유린(徐有隣)이 매년 5-6만 냥을 규칙적으로 주조 발행하는 세주제(歲鑄制)를 건의하여 연례주전제(年例鑄錢制)가 실시
t: Hojo panseo Seo Yu-rin proposed the sejuje of regularly casting 50,000-60,000 nyang every year, and the yeollye jujeonje was implemented

src: 삼도통어사(三道統禦使)를 교동부(橋桐府)에 다시 설치하고 부사를 올려 수군절도사로 삼음.
t: Reestablished the Samdo Tongeosa (Naval Commander of Three Provinces) at Gyodong-bu, and elevated the busa to serve as Naval Commander (Suguk Jeoldosa).

src: 고산서원(高山書院) 설립
t: Gosan Seowon was established.

src: 도류인(죄인)의 처첩이 따르기를 원하는 자에게는 율문에 의하여 허락하도록 명함.
t: Ordered that wives and concubines of exiled criminals who wished to follow them be permitted to do so in accordance with the legal statutes.

src: 명나라 사람의 후손으로 이루어진 부대인 한인 아병(漢人牙兵)을 한려(漢旅)로 개칭하고 한려신설절목(漢旅新設節目)을 만듦.
t: Renamed the Hanin Abyeong (a unit composed of descendants of Ming Chinese) to Hallyeo, and drew up the Hallyeo Sinseol Jeolmok (New Establishment Regulations for the Hallyeo).

src: 종합적인 무예서인 ≪무예도보통지(武藝圖譜通志)≫ 5책이 완성되어 장용영에서 인쇄하여 각 군영에 내려 보냄.
t: The comprehensive martial arts manual Muyedobotongji, in 5 volumes, was completed, printed at the Jangyongyeong, and distributed to each military garrison.

src: 순흥향교(順興鄕校) 이건
t: Sunheung Hyanggyo was relocated.

src: 순흥부사 김익휴(金翊休) 부임
t: Kim Ik-hyu took office as Sunheung busa.

src: 강원도 영월에 괘서가 발생함
t: An anonymous poster (gwaeseo) appeared in Yeongwol, Gangwon-do.

src: 새로 간행한 ≪병학지남(兵學指南)≫을 장용영의 지방 무사가 있는 고을에 내려 보냄.
t: The newly printed Byeonghakjinam was distributed to the counties where the Jangyongyeong's local warriors were stationed.

src: 박필관(朴弼寬)이라는 사람이 토호(土豪)의 폐단 등에 관해 신문고를 울림
t: A man named Bak Pil-gwan sounded the petition drum (sinmungo) regarding the abuses of local powerful families (tojo) and other matters.

src: 각신 김희(金熹)에게 ≪임경업실기(林慶業實記)≫를, 서용보(徐龍輔)에게 ≪김덕령유사(金德齡遺事)≫를 편찬하게 함.
t: Ordered the royal secretary Kim Hui to compile the Imgyeongeop Silgi and Seo Yong-bo to compile the Kim Deok-ryeong Yusa.

src: 노비의 폐단에 대하여 세밀히 조사하여 그에 대한 의견을 올리도록 명령함
t: Ordered a detailed investigation of the abuses concerning slaves and nobi, and that opinions on the matter be submitted.

src: 호서(湖西)의 노비 공납은 모두 돈으로만 거두는 것으로 규정을 정할 것을 명령함
t: Ordered that the tribute payments of nobi in Hoseo be fixed to be collected entirely in cash.

src: 각지에서 명화적(明火賊)이 출현하였는데 충청도에서 가장 세력이 큼
t: Bands of armed bandits (myeonghwajeok) appeared in various regions, with the strongest force found in Chungcheong-do.

src: 총융청(摠戎廳) 오영(五營)의 제도를 개정하고 관성장(管城將)의 호칭을 별아병천총(別牙兵千摠)으로 개칭함
t: Revised the system of the Five Camps (Oyeong) of the Chongyungcheong, and renamed the title of Gwanseongjang to Byeorabyeong Cheonchong.

src: 비변사에서 ＜장용외영 친군위절목(壯勇外營親軍衛節目)＞을 마련함.
t: The Bibyeonsa drew up the Jangyong Oeyeong Chinguwi Jeolmok.

src: 경기좌방영(京畿左防營)을 남양의 독성(禿城)으로 옮겨 설치하고 방어사가 토포사(討捕使)를 겸하게 함
t: Relocated the Gyeonggi Jwabangyeong to Dokseong in Namyang, and had the bangeosa concurrently serve as tosaesa.

src: 장용영에서 ＜내영신정절목(內營新定節目)＞과 ＜외영신정절목(外營新定節目)＞을 작성하여 내영과 외영 제도가 완비됨.
t: The Jangyongyeong drew up the Naeyeong Sinjeong Jeolmok and the Oeyeong Sinjeong Jeolmok, thereby completing the systems of the Inner and Outer Camps.

src: 수원부를 화성(華城)으로 개칭하고, 부사를 유수(留守)로 승격시켜 장용외사(壯勇外使)와 행궁정리사(行宮整理使)를 겸임하게 함.
t: Renamed Suwon-bu to Hwaseong, and elevated the busa to yusu, having him concurrently serve as Jangyong Oesa and Haenggung Jeongnisa.

src: 호조(戶曹) 정랑 정동교(鄭東敎)가 당십전(當十錢)의 주조를 건의함(정조대의 고액전(高額錢) 발행논의)조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Jeong Dong-gyo, a jeongnang of the Hojo, proposed the minting of the Dangsipjeon (discussion on the issuance of high-denomination coinage during King Jeongjo's reign).

src: 태장재사(台庄齋舍) 재건
t: Taejang Jaesa was rebuilt.

src: 화성 축조를 위해 8도의 성지(城池) 모양을 그려서 올리게 함.
t: Ordered that drawings of the shapes of fortress moats (seongji) from the eight provinces be submitted for the construction of Hwaseong.

src: 화성(華城) 축조를 위해 성곽 제도에 대한 여러 내용을 정리한 ≪성제도설(城制圖說)≫을 편찬함.
t: Compiled the Seongjedoseol, which organized various contents on fortress wall systems, for the construction of Hwaseong.

src: 노봉서원(魯峯書院) 건립
t: Nobong Seowon was established.

src: 무고(武庫)에서 ≪신전자초방(新傳煮硝方)≫을 인출하여 반포함.
t: The Sinjeon Jachobang was printed and distributed from the Mugo (Military Arsenal).

src: 수어경청(守禦京廳)을 혁파하고, 광주부(廣州府)를 승격시켜 유수(留守)를 둚.
t: Abolished the Suŏgyeongcheong (守禦京廳) and elevated Gwangju-bu (廣州府) to establish a Yusu (留守, superintendent).

src: 역대 군제와 진법(陣法)에 대해서 정리한 ≪군려대성(軍旅大成)≫ 완성.
t: Completed the Gullyeodaeseong (軍旅大成), which compiled the military systems and battle formations (陣法) of successive reigns.

src: 조선 전국의 군액(軍額)에 대해서 조사 정리한 ≪삼군총고(三軍摠攷)≫ 완성.
t: Completed the Samgunchonggo (三軍摠攷), which investigated and compiled the military troop numbers (軍額) of Joseon nationwide.

src: 비변사에서 ＜화성협수군제절목(華城協守軍制節目)＞을 마련하여 화성의 협수체제(協守體制)를 정비함.
t: The Bibyeonsa prepared the Hwaseonghyeopsugunjejeolmok (華城協守軍制節目) to reorganize the defense system (協守體制) of Hwaseong.

src: 이순신(李舜臣)의 행적과 유고(遺稿)를 정리하여 ≪충무공이순신전서(忠武公李舜臣全書)≫ 간행.
t: Compiled the accounts and posthumous writings of Yi Sun-sin, publishing the Chungmugong Yi Sun-sin Jeonseo (忠武公李舜臣全書).

src: 둘레 4,400보의 화성(華城)이 완공됨.
t: Hwaseong (華城), with a perimeter of 4,400 bo, was completed.

src: 제주 기생 만덕이 굶주리는 백성을 구했다는 보고를 받음.
t: Received a report that Mandeok, a gisaeng of Jeju, had saved starving people.

src: ≪화성성역의궤(華城城役儀軌)≫가 완성됨.
t: The Hwaseong Seongyeok Uigwe (華城城役儀軌) was completed.

src: 윤시동(尹蓍東)에게 ≪무경칠서(武經七書)≫의 편집, 교정을 담당하게 함.
t: Had Yun Si-dong (尹蓍東) take charge of editing and proofreading the Mugyeong Chilseo (武經七書).

src: 삼소재 김종락(三素齋 金宗烙) 출생
t: Samsojae Kim Jong-rak (三素齋 金宗烙) was born.

src: 비변사에서 ＜장용영외영오읍군병절목(壯勇營外營五邑軍兵節目)＞을 마련하여 장용 외영의 오위-속오위(屬五衛) 체제를 완성함.
t: The Bibyeonsa prepared the Jangyongyeongoeyeongoeupgunbyeongjeolmok (壯勇營外營五邑軍兵節目) to complete the Owi-Sogowi (五衛-屬五衛) system of the Jangyong Oeyeong.

src: 평안도 개천의 토호(土豪) 현재묵(玄在黙) 등이 고을 장교와의 다툼을 계기로 향인 8백여 명을 이끌고 관아로 몰려가 소요를 일으킴
t: Hyeon Jae-muk (玄在黙) and other local strongmen (土豪) of Gaecheon, Pyeongan Province, led over 800 local people to the government office and caused a disturbance, triggered by a dispute with local officers.

src: 열녀 금씨(琴氏) 정려(旌閭)
t: A memorial gate (旌閭) was erected for the virtuous woman (烈女) Geum-ssi.

src: 전라도 영암에서 환곡의 폐단에 대해 고을 사람들이 격쟁(擊錚)함
t: In Yeongam, Jeolla Province, local people beat a drum to petition (擊錚) about the abuses of the hwangok (還穀) grain loan system.

src: 충청도 홍산에서 “나라에 죄인들의 원기가 넘쳐 기근이 들었”다는 등의 말을 퍼뜨린 이한복(李漢福) 등이 붙잡힘
t: Yi Han-bok (李漢福) and others, who had spread rumors such as that famine had occurred because the vengeful spirits of criminals filled the nation, were arrested in Hongsan, Chungcheong Province.

src: 호조판서 김화진(金華鎭)이 당십전(當十錢)과 당오전(當五錢)의 주조를 건의조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Minister of Taxation (戶曹判書) Kim Hwa-jin (金華鎭) proposed the minting of dangsipjeon (當十錢) and dangojeon (當五錢) coins.

src: 강씨종택(姜氏宗宅) 중수
t: The Gang clan head house (姜氏宗宅) was renovated.

src: 왕대비를 대왕대비, 왕비를 왕대비로 존하고 대왕대비 수렴청정을 행함.
t: The Queen Dowager was honored as Grand Queen Dowager, and the Queen was honored as Queen Dowager, who then conducted regency (垂簾聽政).

src: 지산서당(芝山書堂) 건립
t: Jisan Seodang (芝山書堂) was established.

src: 서얼허통을 시행함.
t: Implemented the seoeol heotong (庶孼許通), permitting children of concubines to hold office.

src: 정순왕후의 수렴청정으로 천주교 박해 시작(오가작통법 실시).
t: With the regency of Queen Dowager Jeongsun, the persecution of Catholicism began (implementing the ogajakdongbeop, the five-household mutual responsibility system).

src: 창원과 하동의 장터에 난을 선동하는 괘서가 발생함
t: Anonymous posters instigating rebellion (掛書) appeared at the markets of Changwon and Hadong.

src: 내노비(內奴婢)와 시노비(寺奴婢)의 혁파를 명령하고, 내사(內司)와 각 궁방(宮房) 및 각 관청의 노비안(奴婢案)을 돈화문(敦化門) 밖에서 불태우도록 함
t: Ordered the abolition of the naenobi (內奴婢) and sinobi (寺奴婢), and had the slave registers (奴婢案) of the Naesa (內司), the various palace agencies (宮房), and government offices burned outside Donhwamun (敦化門).

src: 임금이 내노비(內奴婢)와 시노비(寺奴婢)의 혁파에 대한 말씀을 내려, 내노비(內奴婢) 3만 6천 9백 74명과 시노비(寺奴婢) 2만 9천 93명을 모두 양민으로 삼도록 허락함(내시노비(內寺奴婢)의 폐지)
t: The King issued a proclamation on the abolition of naenobi (內奴婢) and sinobi (寺奴婢), permitting all 36,974 naenobi and 29,093 sinobi to become commoners (the abolition of naesinobi (內寺奴婢)).

src: 순흥부사 한대유(韓大裕) 부임
t: Han Dae-yu (韓大裕) took office as magistrate (府使) of Sunheung.

src: 장용영(壯勇營)을 혁파하여 병력과 장비 등을 이전 군영으로 이관함.
t: The Jangyongyeong (壯勇營) was abolished, and its troops and equipment were transferred to the previous military camps.

src: 장용외영(壯勇外營)을 축소하여 총리영(摠理營)을 두고 수원 유수가 총리사를 겸하게 함.
t: The Oe Jangyongyeong (壯勇外營) was reduced, the Chongniyeong (摠理營) was established, and the Governor (Yusu) of Suwon concurrently served as the Commander (Chongnisa).

src: 순선옹주의 부마간택으로 9세에서 13세의 동자에게 금혼령을 내림.
t: For the selection of a husband for Sunseon-ongju, a ban on marriage was issued for boys aged 9 to 13.

src: 숙선옹주가 도위 홍석주와 혼인함.
t: Sukseon-ongju married the royal son-in-law (dowi) Hong Seok-ju.

src: 정순왕후 김씨가 61세로 창덕궁 경복전에서 죽음.
t: Queen Jeongsun, of the Kim clan, died at the age of 61 at Gyeongbokjeon Hall in Changdeokgung.

src: 도림강당(道林講堂)과 추원사(追遠祠) 건립
t: Dorim Lecture Hall (道林講堂) and Chuwonsa Shrine (追遠祠) were built.

src: 우의정 이시수(李時秀)가 주전사업의 호전전관제와 전황(錢荒)이 제대로 시행되지 못하니 호조(戶曹)와 선혜청이 함께 주전을 할 것을 건의, 이에 따라 선혜청에서도 동전을 주조하게 됨
t: Right State Councilor Yi Si-su (李時秀) proposed that, since the Hojeon-jeongwan system (戶錢專管制) of the coin-minting project and the coin shortage (錢荒) were not being properly addressed, the Ministry of Taxation (戶曹) and the Seonhyecheong should jointly mint coins; accordingly, the Seonhyecheong also began casting copper coins.

src: 용호영(龍虎營)의 정원을 100명 증가시켜 700명이 7번으로 숙위하게 하다.
t: The quota of the Yonghoyeong (龍虎營) was increased by 100 to 700, so that they stood night guard duty in seven shifts.

src: 함경도 북청(北靑)민들이 관아로 몰려가 수령을 위협하고 좌수를 불로 지졌으며 단천민들은 수령과 좌수를 축출함(단천봉기)
t: People of Bukcheong in Hamgyeong Province rushed to the government office, threatened the magistrate, and burned the Jwasu, while the people of Dancheon expelled the magistrate and the Jwasu (Dancheon Uprising).

src: 호남의 기근으로 유민들이 많이 발생함
t: Due to famine in Honam, many people became refugees.

src: 개성에서 수백명이 백정을 축출하라는 소장(訴狀)을 올리고 관아의 나졸들과 투석전을 벌임
t: In Gaeseong, hundreds of people submitted a petition demanding the expulsion of butchers (baekjeong) and engaged in a stone-throwing battle with the government office's constables.

src: 홍경래(洪景來)군, 가산 군수를 처단하고 정주성을 점령함
t: Hong Gyeong-nae's army executed the magistrate of Gasan and occupied Jeongju fortress.

src: 홍경래(洪景來)가 평안도에서 반란을 일으켜 가산(嘉山), 정주(定州) 등 여러 군현을 점령함. (홍경래의 난)
t: Hong Gyeong-nae rose in rebellion in Pyeongan Province and occupied several counties including Gasan and Jeongju. (Hong Gyeong-nae's Rebellion)

src: 평안도에서 홍경래(洪景來), 이희저(李禧著) 등이 가산(嘉山)을 근거로 봉기함(홍경래의 난)
t: In Pyeongan Province, Hong Gyeong-nae, Yi Hui-jeo, and others rose up based in Gasan (Hong Gyeong-nae's Rebellion).

src: 황해도 곡산에서 한명홍(韓命弘), 장진(張辰) 등 수백여 명의 농민들이 봉기하여 관아를 습격하고 수령의 병부(兵符)와 인신(印信)을 빼앗음(곡산농민봉기)
t: In Goksan, Hwanghae Province, Han Myeong-hong, Jang Jin, and several hundred peasants rose up, attacked the government office, and seized the magistrate's military tally and official seal (Goksan Peasant Uprising).

src: 효자, 열녀, 효부, 충신 백여 인을 정려하고 직질을 줌.
t: More than a hundred filial sons, virtuous women, filial wives, and loyal subjects were honored with commendations and given official ranks.

src: 관군이 정주성을 점령하여 봉기 지휘부인 홍경래(洪景來), 김사용(金士用), 김창시(金昌始), 이제초(李齊初) 등을 참륙함
t: Government troops captured Jeongju fortress and executed the uprising's leaders, Hong Gyeong-nae, Kim Sa-yong, Kim Chang-si, and Yi Je-cho.

src: 정약용(丁若鏞)이 민간방위체제에 관한 병서인
t: Jeong Yak-yong (丁若鏞) wrote a military text on the civilian defense system, titled

src: 제주에 사는 풍헌(風憲) 양제해(梁濟海)가 과중한 부세에 불만을 품고 있다가 홍경래(洪景來)난을 계기로 봉기를 도모하다 처벌됨(양제해의 봉기모의사건)
t: Yang Je-hae, a Pungheon living on Jeju, harbored discontent over excessive taxation and, taking the occasion of Hong Gyeong-nae's rebellion, plotted an uprising but was punished (Yang Je-hae's Uprising Plot Case).

src: 훈련도감(訓鍊都監)에서 박종경(朴宗慶)의
t: At the Hullyeondogam (訓鍊都監), Park Jong-gyeong's (朴宗慶)

src: 영천군수 윤직(尹稙) 부임
t: Yun Jik took office as magistrate of Yeongcheon.

src: 용인에서 이응길(李應吉) 등이 횃불을 들고 총을 쏘며 고을을 횡행하다 사로잡혀 처형됨
t: In Yongin, Yi Eung-gil and others roamed the town carrying torches and firing guns, but were captured and executed.

src: 개성부(開城府)에서 필요한 경비를 보충하기 위해 동전을 주전 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Gaeseong-bu (開城府) minted copper coins to supplement necessary expenses. Joseon Wangjo Sillok CD-ROM Publication Committee,

src: 장수인 채수영(蔡壽永)이 홍경래(洪景來)가 살아있다는 등의 말로 사람을 모으고 난을 일으켜 도성까지 진격하려 했다는 혐의로 처벌됨
t: General Chae Su-yeong was punished on charges of gathering people with claims that Hong Gyeong-nae was still alive and attempting to raise a rebellion to march on the capital.

src: 순흥부사 유계린(柳季麟) 부임
t: Yu Gye-rin took office as magistrate of Suheung.

src: 화성(華城)의 성문에 괘서가 발생함
t: A defamatory poster appeared at the gate of Hwaseong Fortress.

src: 사현정(四賢井) 중건
t: Reconstruction of Sahyeonjeong Well.

src: 순흥부사 이의원(李懿遠) 부임
t: Yi Ui-won took office as magistrate of Sunheung.

src: 봉화현감 박시원(朴時源) 부임
t: Bak Si-won took office as magistrate of Bonghwa.

src: 명온공주가 동녕위 김현근과 혼인함.
t: Princess Myeongon married Kim Hyeon-geun, Dongnyeongwi.

src: 명온공주의 부마간택을 위해 12세에서 15세의 동자에게 금혼령을 내림.
t: A marriage ban was issued for boys aged 12 to 15 in order to select a royal son-in-law for Princess Myeongon.

src: 금위영(禁衛營)에서의 동전 주전을 허가함李碩崙,
t: Permission was granted for Geumwiyeong to mint coins.

src: 석호 유도성(石湖 柳道性) 출생
t: Seokho Yu Do-seong was born.

src: 고성이씨 탑동파종택 수리
t: Repair of the head house of the Tapdong branch of the Goseong Yi clan.

src: 송소종택(松巢宗宅) 재건
t: Reconstruction of Songso Jongtaek.

src: 을미의병 대장 척암 김도화(拓菴 金道和) 출생
t: Cheogam Kim Do-hwa, commander of the Eulmi righteous army, was born.

src: 평안도 중화(中和)인 김치규(金致奎)가 청주 북문에 홍경래(洪景來)가 살아있다는 등의 내용으로 괘서하였다 처벌됨
t: Kim Chi-gyu of Junghwa, Pyeongan Province, was punished for posting a placard on the north gate of Cheongju claiming that Hong Gyeong-nae was still alive.

src: 경주민들이 옥에서 자살한 사람의 시체 검시를 장기 현감에게 요구했다 거절당하자 칼과 몽둥이를 들고 관아에 들어가 수령을 위협함
t: The people of Gyeongju demanded that the magistrate of Jangi conduct an autopsy on a person who had committed suicide in prison, and when refused, they entered the government office with swords and clubs to threaten the magistrate.

src: 청주에서 박형서(朴亨瑞)란 사람이 홍경래(洪景來)가 살아있다는 괘서를 한 김치규(金致奎)를 모방하여 진영(鎭營)에 괘서하였다가 처벌됨
t: In Cheongju, a man named Bak Hyeong-seo, imitating Kim Chi-gyu who had posted a placard claiming Hong Gyeong-nae was alive, posted a placard at the garrison and was punished.

src: 남흥재사(南興齋舍) 건립
t: Construction of Namheung Jaesa.

src: 양종필(梁鍾佖)이라는 사람이 임금의 어가 행차 앞에서 격쟁(擊錚)함
t: A man named Yang Jong-pil beat a gong before the king's royal procession to file a grievance.

src: 서산 김흥락(西山 金興洛) 출생
t: Seosan Kim Heung-nak was born.

src: 효현왕후 김씨(헌종비)가 안국방 외씨제에서 출생함.
t: Queen Hyohyeon of the Kim clan, consort of Heonjong, was born at her maternal relative's house in Anguk-bang.

src: 개성부(開城府)에서의 동전 주전을 허가함李碩崙,
t: Permission was granted for Gaeseong-bu to mint coins.

src: 훈련도감(訓練都監)에서의 동전 주전을 허가함李碩崙,
t: Permission was granted for Hullyeondogam to mint coins.

src: 강화에서 수적(水賊) 김수온(金守溫)의 무리가 선원 14명을 바다에서 살해하고 재물을 탈취한 혐의로 체포됨
t: In Ganghwa, the gang of the water pirate Kim Su-on was arrested on charges of killing 14 sailors at sea and stealing their property.

src: 영의정 남공철(南公轍)이 은의 유출을 방지하고 은의 유입을 촉진하기 위해 은 가격을 인상할 것을 건의柳子厚,
t: Chief State Councillor Nam Gong-cheol proposed raising the price of silver in order to prevent the outflow of silver and promote its inflow.

src: 경기감영(京畿監營)에서의 동전 주전을 허가함李碩崙,
t: Permission was granted for Gyeonggi Gamyeong to mint coins.

src: 치암 이만현(恥岩 李晩鉉) 출생
t: Chiam Yi Man-hyeon was born.

src: 정일당 강씨 죽음.
t: Jeongildang Kang died.

src: 도성에서 시전(市廛)의 곡물 상인들과 경강(京江) 상인들의 농간으로 쌀값이 폭등하자 빈민들이 폭동을 일으켜 시전을 방화하고 파괴함
t: In the capital, rice prices skyrocketed due to manipulation by grain merchants of the licensed shops (sijeon) and Gyeonggang merchants, and the poor rioted, setting fire to and destroying the shops.

src: 왕대비가 수렴청정함.
t: The Queen Dowager ruled as regent behind a curtain.

src: 무격을 도외로 축출함.
t: Shamans were expelled outside the province.

src: 강시환이 수렴청정을 논하여 절도에 안치됨.
t: Gang Si-hwan discussed the regency and was exiled to a remote island.

src: 하동고택(河東古宅) 건립
t: Hadong Old House was built.

src: 을미의병장 담와 권세연(澹窩 權世淵) 출생
t: Eulmi righteous army leader Damwa Gwon Se-yeon was born.

src: 충청도 대흥군(大興郡)에서 집권자들의 죄행을 폭로하여 괘서한 성국로(成國老), 이종려(李鍾呂)가 처벌됨
t: In Daeheung-gun, Chungcheong-do, Seong Guk-ro and Yi Jong-ryeo, who posted anonymous placards exposing the crimes of those in power, were punished.

src: 기해교화로 천주교도 130여 명이 처형되고 프랑스 신부 3명이 군문에 효수됨.
t: In the Gihae persecution, more than 130 Catholics were executed and 3 French priests were beheaded and displayed at the military camp gate.

src: 대동미(大同米)를 동전으로 대납(代納)하게 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: Daedongmi (uniform tax rice) was allowed to be paid in copper coins instead.

src: 고산서원(古山書院) 건립
t: Gosan Seowon was built.

src: 죽산 사람 안달원(安達源)이 관아에 불만을 품고 부사(府使) 행차시 가마를 부수고 하인을 구타함
t: An Dal-won of Juksan, harboring resentment against the government office, smashed the palanquin during the magistrate's procession and beat the servants.

src: 탁지(度支)에 비축한 왜동(倭銅) 20만 근으로 동전을 주조하게 함조선왕조실록CD-ROM간행위원회,
t: 200,000 geun of Japanese copper stored by the Board of Taxation was used to mint coins.

src: 항일자정순국 죽포 김순흠(竹圃 金舜欽) 출생
t: Anti-Japanese martyr Jukpo Kim Sun-heum was born.

src: 경주민 수백 명이 환곡의 폐단 시정을 요구하며 상경하여 연일 대궐문에서 상소함
t: Several hundred people of Gyeongju went to the capital demanding reform of the abuses of the hwangok system, and petitioned at the palace gate for consecutive days.

src: 향산 이만도(響山 李晩燾) 출생
t: Hyangsan Yi Man-do was born.

src: 경상도 산청에서 괘서한 김유선(金裕璿)을 효수하게 함
t: Kim Yu-seon, who posted an anonymous placard in Sancheong, Gyeongsang-do, was beheaded and displayed.

src: 독립운동가 백하 김대락(白下 金大洛) 출생
t: Independence activist Baekha Kim Dae-rak was born.

src: 총융청(摠戎廳)을 총위영(摠衛營)으로 고침
t: Chongyungcheong was renamed Chongwiyeong.

src: 왕비에게 후사가 없으므로 후궁을 둠.
t: As the queen had no heir, a royal concubine was installed.

src: 경외의 유생 8천명이 서류 허통을 청함.
t: 8,000 Confucian scholars from the capital and provinces petitioned for the abolition of restrictions on seoja.

src: 은언군 인의 손 이원범(철종)을 왕사로 정함. 대왕대비가 수렴청정함.
t: Yi Won-beom (King Cheoljong), grandson of Prince Eunon Yi In, was appointed as the royal heir. The Grand Queen Dowager ruled as regent behind a curtain.

src: 총위영(摠衛營)을 총융청(摠戎廳)으로 다시 개칭함.
t: Chongwiyeong was renamed back to Chongyungcheong.

src: 의주(義州)백마산성(白馬山城)에 별장(別將)을 신설함.
t: A byeoljang post was newly established at Baekmasanseong in Uiju.

src: 순흥부사 김숙연(金肅淵) 부임
t: Kim Suk-yeon took office as magistrate of Sunheung.

src: 만회고택(晩悔古宅) 중건

src: 서류를 허통시켜 모든 사환에 각별히 거두어 쓰라고 명함.
t: Ordered that the descendants of secondary status (seoryu) be given full access, and be specially recruited for all government posts.

src: 황해도 사람 채희재(蔡喜載)가 주동이 되어 난을 도모하다 처형됨
t: Chae Hui-jae, a man from Hwanghae Province, was executed for plotting a rebellion as its ringleader.

src: 명성왕후 민씨(고종비) 여주 근동면 섬낙리 사제에서 출생함.
t: Queen Myeongseong of the Min clan (consort of Gojong) was born at her family's private residence in Seomnak-ri, Geundong-myeon, Yeoju.

src: 봉화현감 임백능(任百能) 부임

src: 경상도 봉화에서 괘서한 사람들을 문초함

src: 영의정 김좌근(金左根)이 은화를 주조하여 동전과 함께 사용할 것을 건의韓國銀行,
